`.github/workflows/ci.yml`:

```yml
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            build-essential cmake ninja-build pkg-config python3 python3-cryptography \
            libsdl2-dev libepoxy-dev libavformat-dev libavcodec-dev libavutil-dev \
            libswscale-dev libswresample-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev \
            libvulkan-dev glslang-tools libgtk-3-dev libarchive-dev \
            libcurl4-openssl-dev libssl-dev nlohmann-json3-dev
      - name: Build native engine
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build/native -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build build/native
      - name: Build installer, launcher and updater
        run: |
          cmake -S installer -B build/installer -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build build/installer
      # A public checkout has no game assets: fixture-dependent tests self-skip at configure time.
      - name: Asset-free native tests
        run: ctest --test-dir build/native --output-on-failure
      - name: Installer, launcher and updater tests
        run: ctest --test-dir build/installer --output-on-failure
      - name: WRS2 format checks
        run: python3 tools/check_wrs2.py
      - name: Packaging policy self-check
        run: python3 tools/package_kabus_appimage.py --self-check

```

`.github/workflows/release.yml`:

```yml
name: Release
# Tag vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-pre] -> pinned AppImage assembly, signed update payload, DRAFT
# GitHub release. Updaters ignore drafts: nothing is offered until the owner publishes
# it after qualification. Never ships game assets (see docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md).
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 240
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Work directories
        run: |
          echo "WORK=$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "DIST=$RUNNER_TEMP/dist" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Check tag against project version
        run: |
          version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}
          project=$(sed -n 's/^project(kabus22_native VERSION \([^ ]*\) .*/\1/p' CMakeLists.txt)
          installer=$(sed -n 's/^project(kabus22_setup VERSION \([^ ]*\) .*/\1/p' installer/CMakeLists.txt)
          core=${version%%[-+]*}
          test "$core" = "$project" && test "$core" = "$installer" || { echo "Tag $version does not match CMake $project/$installer"; exit 1; }
          case $version in *-*) echo "CHANNEL=experimental" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"; echo "PRERELEASE=--prerelease" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" ;;
                           *) echo "CHANNEL=stable" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"; echo "PRERELEASE=" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" ;; esac
          echo "VERSION=$version" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Host tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl gnupg squashfs-tools python3-cryptography
      - name: Verify signing secret matches embedded public key
        env:
          KABUS22_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.KABUS22_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY }}
        run: |
          embedded=$(sed -n 's/^set(K22_UPDATE_PUBLIC_KEY "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' installer/CMakeLists.txt)
          actual=$(python3 tools/release/sign_manifest.py --public-key)
          test -n "$embedded" && test "$embedded" = "$actual" || { echo "Signing key does not match K22_UPDATE_PUBLIC_KEY"; exit 1; }
      - name: Acquire pinned innoextract helper and AppImage runtime
        run: |
          mkdir -p build-appimage/cache packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64
          curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
            https://constexpr.org/innoextract/files/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz \
            -o build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz
          printf '%s\n' '008efe5011476ccc4aae17c3e22038b5a1bc5c7aad2b9d4d869537bf3874d21f  build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz' | sha256sum --check
          mkdir -m 700 build-appimage/cache/innoextract-keyring
          gpg --homedir "$PWD/build-appimage/cache/innoextract-keyring" --batch \
            --import packaging/helper-innoextract/upstream/dscharrer.asc
          gpg --homedir "$PWD/build-appimage/cache/innoextract-keyring" --batch \
            --verify packaging/helper-innoextract/upstream/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz.sig \
            build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz
          tar --extract --xz --file build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz \
            --directory packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64 --strip-components=3 \
            innoextract-1.9-linux/bin/amd64/innoextract
          printf '%s\n' '7a8ad941deeb0de8d1f804830f339fd17e27cfbce473615d79d1d65c106884e9  packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64/innoextract' | sha256sum --check
          chmod +x packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64/innoextract
          curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
            https://github.com/VHSgunzo/uruntime/releases/download/v0.8.1/uruntime-appimage-squashfs-lite-x86_64 \
            -o build-appimage/cache/uruntime-appimage-squashfs-lite-x86_64
          printf '%s\n' '32c6024a14ff375749ee3bed3330c1586a6dd2bfeddbbd7ceacc053aec2b27a3  build-appimage/cache/uruntime-appimage-squashfs-lite-x86_64' | sha256sum --check
      - name: Build pinned toolchain image (Dockerfile on stdin, no build context)
        run: docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t kabus22-ubuntu24-toolchain - < tools/Dockerfile.ubuntu24
      - name: Build and assemble AppImage
        run: sh tools/build_kabus_baseline.sh "$WORK" kabus22-ubuntu24-toolchain
      - name: Build signed update payload from the assembled AppImage
        env:
          KABUS22_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.KABUS22_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY }}
        run: |
          image="$WORK/Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage"
          offset=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["appimage"]["squashfs_offset"])' "$image.json")
          unsquashfs -no-progress -o "$offset" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/appdir" "$image"
          python3 tools/release/make_update_manifest.py --appdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/appdir" \
            --version "$VERSION" --channel "$CHANNEL" --output-dir "$DIST"
          python3 tools/release/sign_manifest.py "$DIST/kabus22-update.json"
          cp "$image" "$image.json" "$image.sources.tar.gz" "$DIST/"
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="kabus22-linux-$VERSION/" -o "$DIST/native-source.tar.gz" "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          (cd "$DIST" && sha256sum -- * > SHA256SUMS)
      - name: Create draft GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --draft --verify-tag $PRERELEASE \
            --title "Kabus22 Linux $VERSION" --notes "Draft: qualify, then publish. Channel: $CHANNEL." "$DIST"/*

```

```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(kabus22_native VERSION 0.4.1 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
add_compile_definitions(K22_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(SDL2 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET sdl2)
pkg_check_modules(EPOXY REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET epoxy)
pkg_check_modules(AV REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libavformat libavcodec libavutil libswscale libswresample)
pkg_check_modules(FREETYPE REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET freetype2)
pkg_check_modules(FONTCONFIG REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET fontconfig)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
find_program(K22_GLSLANG_VALIDATOR glslangValidator REQUIRED)
# Shader bytecode is embedded into the ELF, never compiled or located at runtime.
set(K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/native/shaders")
set(K22_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
set(K22_SHADER_INCLUDES
  "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/raster_uniform.glsl"
  "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/ray_query.glsl"
  "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/pbr.glsl"
  "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/effects.glsl")
set(K22_SHADER_FILES scene.vert scene.frag shadow.vert shadow.geom shadow.frag
  ui.vert ui.frag post.vert post.frag sky.frag warp.frag cloud.frag deform.comp tonemap.frag
  effects.frag rt_signals.comp rt_filter.comp scene.tesc scene.tese)
# OpenGL embeds the same PBR source text as Vulkan; re-run configure when it changes.
file(READ "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/pbr.glsl" K22_PBR_GLSL)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/pbr.glsl")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/render_pbr_glsl.hpp" CONTENT "#pragma once\ninline constexpr const char* pbrGLSL=R\"K22(@K22_PBR_GLSL@)K22\";\n" @ONLY)
file(READ "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/effects.glsl" K22_EFFECTS_GLSL)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/effects.glsl")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/render_effects_glsl.hpp" CONTENT "#pragma once\ninline constexpr const char* effectsGLSL=R\"K22(@K22_EFFECTS_GLSL@)K22\";\n" @ONLY)
set(K22_SHADER_OUTPUTS)
set(K22_SHADER_EMBED_ARGUMENTS)
foreach(shader IN LISTS K22_SHADER_FILES)
  string(REPLACE "." "_" symbol "${shader}")
  set(output "${K22_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${shader}.spv")
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${output}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${K22_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    COMMAND "${K22_GLSLANG_VALIDATOR}" --target-env vulkan1.2 -V
      "-I${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}" "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/${shader}" -o "${output}"
    DEPENDS "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/${shader}" ${K22_SHADER_INCLUDES}
    VERBATIM)
  list(APPEND K22_SHADER_OUTPUTS "${output}")
  list(APPEND K22_SHADER_EMBED_ARGUMENTS "${symbol}" "${output}")
endforeach()
set(K22_RT_SHADER "${K22_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/scene.rt.frag.spv")
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${K22_RT_SHADER}"
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${K22_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
  COMMAND "${K22_GLSLANG_VALIDATOR}" --target-env vulkan1.2 -V
    "-I${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}" -DK22_RAY_QUERY=1 "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/scene.frag" -o "${K22_RT_SHADER}"
  DEPENDS "${K22_SHADER_DIRECTORY}/scene.frag" ${K22_SHADER_INCLUDES}
  VERBATIM)
list(APPEND K22_SHADER_OUTPUTS "${K22_RT_SHADER}")
list(APPEND K22_SHADER_EMBED_ARGUMENTS scene_rt_frag "${K22_RT_SHADER}")
set(K22_SHADER_HEADER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/render_vulkan_spirv.hpp")
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${K22_SHADER_HEADER}"
  COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/native/embed_spirv.py"
    "${K22_SHADER_HEADER}" ${K22_SHADER_EMBED_ARGUMENTS}
  DEPENDS ${K22_SHADER_OUTPUTS} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/native/embed_spirv.py"
  VERBATIM)
include(cmake/KabusODE.cmake)
# AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 / FSR 3.1.4 upscaler + Vulkan backend (MIT; third_party/FidelityFX-SDK/KABUS-PROVENANCE.txt).
# tools/k22_fsr3_blobs.py replaces the SDK's Windows-only FidelityFX_SC: SPIR-V + descriptor reflection.
set(K22_FFX "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/FidelityFX-SDK")
set(K22_FFX_BLOBS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/k22_fsr3_blobs.h")
file(GLOB_RECURSE K22_FFX_GPU CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${K22_FFX}/sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu/*.h" "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/backends/vk/shaders/*.glsl")
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${K22_FFX_BLOBS}"
  COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/k22_fsr3_blobs.py" --glslang "${K22_GLSLANG_VALIDATOR}"
    --sdk "${K22_FFX}" --output "${K22_FFX_BLOBS}"
  DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/k22_fsr3_blobs.py" ${K22_FFX_GPU}
  VERBATIM)
set(K22_FFX_SOURCES "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/components/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp" "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp"
  "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/shared/ffx_assert.cpp" "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/shared/ffx_message.cpp"
  "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/shared/ffx_object_management.cpp" "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/shared/ffx_breadcrumbs_list.cpp")
add_library(kabus22_fsr3 STATIC ${K22_FFX_SOURCES} native/fsr_vk.cpp "${K22_FFX_BLOBS}")
set_source_files_properties(${K22_FFX_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w") # upstream sources (local patches: KABUS-PROVENANCE.txt)
target_include_directories(kabus22_fsr3 SYSTEM PRIVATE "${K22_FFX}/sdk/include" "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/shared"
  "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/backends/shared" "${K22_FFX}/sdk/src/components" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" ${Vulkan_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_include_directories(kabus22_fsr3 PRIVATE native)
target_compile_options(kabus22_fsr3 PRIVATE -include "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/k22-ffx-posix/k22_ffx_posix.h")
install(FILES "${K22_FFX}/LICENSE.txt" DESTINATION share/doc/kabus22/third_party RENAME FidelityFX-SDK-LICENSE.txt)
add_library(kabus22_core native/engine.cpp native/wdl.cpp native/assets.cpp native/render.cpp
  native/render_gl.cpp native/render_vulkan.cpp native/render_vulkan_raster.cpp native/render_vulkan_rt.cpp native/vulkan_loader.cpp
  native/media.cpp native/physics.cpp native/texture_pack.cpp native/controller.cpp native/saves.cpp native/console.cpp "${K22_SHADER_HEADER}")
target_include_directories(kabus22_core PUBLIC native PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" ${Vulkan_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(kabus22_core PUBLIC PkgConfig::SDL2 PkgConfig::EPOXY PkgConfig::AV PkgConfig::FREETYPE PkgConfig::FONTCONFIG Threads::Threads ODE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} PRIVATE kabus22_fsr3)
target_compile_options(kabus22_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
add_executable(kabus22 native/main.cpp native/scenario.cpp)
target_link_libraries(kabus22 PRIVATE kabus22_core)
install(TARGETS kabus22 RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(wdl_regression native/wdl_regression.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(wdl_regression PRIVATE kabus22_core)

    add_test(NAME material_boundaries COMMAND k22-render-check "${K22_TEST_MATERIALS}")

  # Real-data gameplay scenarios (docs/GAMEPLAY_TESTING.md); registered only when an installed game directory is supplied.
  set(K22_GAME_DATA "" CACHE PATH "Original game directory for the gameplay_scenarios test (empty: not registered)")
  set(K22_ORIGINAL_SAVES "" CACHE PATH "Original Windows game directory with kayit*.sav/kysd.sav for save-based scenarios")

    add_test(NAME gameplay_scenarios COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DK22=$<TARGET_FILE:kabus22>" "-DGAME=${K22_GAME_DATA}" "-DSAVES=${K22_ORIGINAL_SAVES}"

    set_tests_properties(gameplay_scenarios PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 7200)

    # Native captures of tests/reference/*.k22s against the original's captures (tools/wine-reference/, docs/GAMEPLAY_TESTING.md#reference-comparison).

    set(K22_REFERENCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Reference captures of the original game (wineref.py output) for reference_comparison (empty: not registered)")

      set_tests_properties(reference_comparison PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 3600)
    endif()
  endif()
  find_program(K22_UPSCALER_PYTHON python3)  # the tool runs as `python3`; may differ from the shader-embedding interpreter
  execute_process(COMMAND "${K22_UPSCALER_PYTHON}" -c "import PIL, numpy" RESULT_VARIABLE K22_UPSCALER_DEPS OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET)
  if(K22_UPSCALER_DEPS EQUAL 0)
    add_test(NAME texture_upscaler COMMAND "${K22_UPSCALER_PYTHON}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/texture-upscaler/test_upscale.py")
  else()
    message(STATUS "Skipping texture_upscaler: Python Pillow/numpy unavailable")
  endif()
endif()

`README.md`:

```md
# Kabus22 Linux

A reverse-engineered **native Linux engine, GTK installer, standalone GTK launcher and signed updater for Kabus 22**. It reads your own original game scripts and assets; it does not launch Wine, run the Windows engine, or bundle the game.

## Features and scope

- C++20 WDL runtime with campaign/A6 and offline Bonus/A7 compatibility paths, native archive/model/world loading, collision and ODE physics.
- SDL2 input/windowing, FFmpeg audio/video, FreeType/fontconfig text, and a default desktop OpenGL renderer.
- Explicit Vulkan raster or hardware-ray-query rendering. Unsupported explicitly requested features fail instead of silently switching backends.
- Optional graphics (current source): presets `original` (default, unchanged) / `enhanced` / `ultra` / `custom`, `--graphics KEY=VALUE`, PBR + HDR tone mapping, non-destructive HD texture packs (`tools/texture-upscaler`), shadow maps, SSAO, bloom, FXAA, TAA, volumetric fog, ray-traced shadows, GI and rough reflections with denoising. `kabus22 --list-capabilities` reports what this machine supports; presets disable unsupported features with a notice. See [docs/GRAPHICS_ROADMAP.md](docs/GRAPHICS_ROADMAP.md).
- Native GTK installer: installs from a user-owned ISO, the original `setup.exe`+`setup-1.bin`, or an installed Windows game folder (`--source`, auto-detected); `--verify` / `--repair`; versioned layout with atomic switching. Native widescreen for the original campaign is included without a patch folder. See [docs/INSTALLER.md](docs/INSTALLER.md).
- Separate GTK launcher: Install/Import, Verify, Repair, Play, renderer/preset/ray-tracing/texture-pack settings, FPS limit (original 72 cap, 30–240 or unlimited; `fps_limit` in [docs/GRAPHICS_ROADMAP.md](docs/GRAPHICS_ROADMAP.md)), controller settings, language, optional first-person camera, updates and diagnostic logs.
- `kabus22-updater`: GitHub Releases updates (stable/experimental), Ed25519-signed manifests, integrity checks, transactional install and rollback; game data, saves and settings are never touched. See [docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md](docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md).
- Modern controller mode (`~/.config/kabus22/controller.ini`; original mode is the default), atomic saves with rotating backups, and `kabus22 --import-saves WINDOWS_GAME_DIR` for original Windows saves.
- Save anywhere and developer console (native additions, inert until used): F5 quicksave / F9 quickload into the game's own save list with the player position restored, and a `` ` ``/F10 console with `god`, `noclip`, `give`, `get`/`set`, `level`, `tp`, `fps`, `timescale` and more. See [docs/CONSOLE.md](docs/CONSOLE.md).
- Scenario-based gameplay regression (`kabus22 --scenario`) over original saves: [docs/GAMEPLAY_TESTING.md](docs/GAMEPLAY_TESTING.md). Project status: [docs/PROGRESS.md](docs/PROGRESS.md), limits: [docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md](docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md), reverse engineering: [docs/REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md](docs/REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md).

Original-media installation, startup, scenario-driven gameplay from 27 original saves and real OpenGL/Vulkan GPU checks have been exercised privately. **A continuous full campaign/Bonus playthrough, complete original-Windows parity and execution on older CPUs are not established.** Nondefault stencil, software-world-light and VIEW render-to-bitmap routes remain unsupported. Ray tracing has a 1024-material-sampler-binding ceiling.

## AppImage prerelease download

Use the **[v0.1.1 experimental prerelease](https://github.com/sergen213/kabus22-linux/releases/tag/v0.1.1)** for integrated original-ISO widescreen and the recovered bitmap-font palette correction. Use assets and checksums from that exact release; historical private artifact hashes in the packaging notice do not identify this download.

The earlier [v0.1.0 release](https://github.com/sergen213/kabus22-linux/releases/tag/v0.1.0) is retained unchanged and predates these corrections.

The current-source standalone launcher and subsequent engine changes are **not included in the unchanged published v0.1.1 release**.

Download these assets together:

- `Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage` — native installer, engine and bundled non-host libraries.
- `Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage.sources.tar.gz` — matching distribution-library/FFmpeg/ODE corresponding sources, dependency build recipes and notices.
- `native-source.tar.gz` — native project/build/test sources and the reviewed `packaging/helper-innoextract/` and `packaging/runtime-uruntime/` source/notice inventories from the exact `v0.1.1` tagged Git commit, also available through its Git source links.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums of the three release assets above.

Helper/runtime corresponding sources are in those `packaging/` paths of `native-source.tar.gz`, and inside the extracted AppImage at `usr/share/licenses/kabus22/innoextract` and `usr/share/licenses/kabus22/uruntime`; they are **not** in the dependency sidecar. Uruntime's MIT license is distinct from its separately executed GPL-containing squashfuse/unsquashfs helpers (including GPL LZO and, in squashfuse, LGPL libfuse). Their complete retained sources/static build recipes provide the rebuild/relink route; the [packaging notice](packaging/NOTICE.txt) identifies these boundaries and the preserved component attributions.

From the download directory, verify the files before execution:

```sh
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
chmod +x Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage
./Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage
```

Run as your ordinary user, **not with sudo**. In the ISO picker, select your legally obtained original Kabus 22 ISO and choose a new installation directory. Leave community extras empty for native original-campaign widescreen; a separately obtained Kabus22Patch folder is optional for independently desired extras. No ISO, original game scripts/assets or patch is included in the release. The installer extracts media without running Windows code and creates application-menu and desktop shortcuts. OpenGL is the default; shortcuts also offer explicit Vulkan RT/raster actions.

**Minimum runtime requirements:** x86-64 Linux with **glibc 2.38 or newer**, a graphical desktop and a working host GPU driver/desktop OpenGL 3.3 or newer. GPU drivers, GL/Vulkan loaders and Wayland libraries are host-owned, not bundled. Optional Vulkan needs a host Vulkan loader/driver supporting Vulkan 1.3 and the requested features; hardware RT additionally needs ray queries, acceleration structures, buffer device addresses, descriptor indexing and shader int64. Unsupported explicit Vulkan/RT requests fail without automatic fallback. Generic x86-64 compilation does not establish execution on older CPUs.

This is an experimental prerelease, **not certification of a complete campaign/Bonus playthrough, original-Windows parity, older-CPU compatibility or legal compliance**. See the scope limitations above and the release notes for checks actually performed on the published build. Keep both source archives and notices with any redistributed AppImage; component licenses apply, and no project-wide license is assigned.

## Build from source (Ubuntu 24.04, x86-64)

CMake 3.20+, a C++20 compiler, Python 3 and these development packages are required. Vulkan headers and `glslangValidator` are build dependencies even when you run only OpenGL; shaders are compiled and embedded at build time.

```sh
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends \
  git build-essential cmake ninja-build pkg-config python3 \
  libsdl2-dev libepoxy-dev libavformat-dev libavcodec-dev libavutil-dev \
  libswscale-dev libswresample-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev \
  libvulkan-dev glslang-tools libgtk-3-dev libarchive-dev innoextract \
  libcurl4-openssl-dev libssl-dev nlohmann-json3-dev python3-cryptography

git clone https://github.com/sergen213/kabus22-linux.git
cd kabus22-linux
cmake -S . -B build/native -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build/native --parallel 2
cmake -S installer -B build/installer -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build/installer --parallel 2
```

The pinned ODE **source** archive and BSD notices are included under `third_party/`; configuration checks its hash and applies two hash-checked recipes in `cmake/`: the contact merge (`KabusODEContact.cmake`) and zero-initialization of the LCP solver's `state[]` array (`KabusODELcp.cmake`). These commands build three separate executables: `build/native/kabus22`, `build/installer/kabus22-setup` and `build/installer/kabus22-launcher`. No original game data is needed to compile them. A local source build uses your distribution's libraries; it is not the separately pinned AppImage dependency closure described below.

### Tests

```sh
ctest --test-dir build/native --output-on-failure
ctest --test-dir build/installer --output-on-failure
python3 tools/check_wrs2.py
```

A source-only checkout registers three asset-free native CTests (`wdl_semantics`, `asset_boundaries`, `media_boundaries`) and two separate installer-directory tests (`installer_security_boundaries`, `launcher_settings_behavior`). The archive-tool check also generates its own fixtures.

Three additional native tests (`engine_boundaries`, `material_boundaries`, `physics_boundaries`) register automatically only when their private original-game fixtures exist at CMake's expected paths. They use `Normal_Mix.fx` and `Normal_SunMix.fx` under `reverse/media/iso/mode/samples/K22_mode.wrs/`, and `reverse/extracted/assets/yr.hmp`; engine needs both shader files and terrain, material needs both shader files, physics needs terrain. If present, the private wrapped-media fixture under `reverse/decompiled/runtime/campaign-media/riff-vorbis/` also extends `media_boundaries`. These files are intentionally not published. Reconfigure after supplying legally obtained fixtures. Default CTest success alone is not graphical or gameplay qualification.

## Install your own game

Run the installer as your ordinary user, **not with sudo**. A separately built installer does not search `PATH` for payloads: without overrides it expects `kabus22`, `kabus22-launcher` and `innoextract` beside its own executable. Supply all three explicitly for this source-build layout:

```sh
./build/installer/kabus22-setup \
  --engine "$PWD/build/native/kabus22" \
  --launcher "$PWD/build/installer/kabus22-launcher" --extractor /usr/bin/innoextract
```

In the window, select your original ISO and choose a **new** installation directory. **Current source includes native original-campaign widescreen by default; leave community extras empty for an ISO-only install.** A separately obtained Kabus22Patch folder is only needed if you independently want its extras. It is neither bundled nor automatically discovered, and installation does not rewrite WDL scripts or require patch artwork.

For an unattended install, substitute your own absolute media path:

```sh
./build/installer/kabus22-setup \
  --iso "/path/to/Kabus 22.iso" --install-dir "$HOME/Games/Kabus22" \
  --engine "$PWD/build/native/kabus22" \
  --launcher "$PWD/build/installer/kabus22-launcher" --extractor /usr/bin/innoextract \
  --unattended
```

Add `--patch "/path/to/Kabus22Patch"` only for separately desired community extras, not to enable native original-campaign widescreen. The installer refuses existing destinations and existing shortcuts; it stages extraction and preserves the source media on cancellation. The developer `--setup` route accepts the original loose `setup.exe` with its original sibling `setup-1.bin`, instead of `--iso`; it extracts them without running Windows code. `--help` lists options and `--self-check` runs asset-free CLI/security checks.

The current-source install contains `bin/kabus22-launcher`, `bin/kabus22` and `game/`. The examples above rely on installed host libraries; a bundled dependency payload additionally requires its corresponding notices. Application-menu and desktop shortcuts open the standalone settings launcher, not the engine directly. Explicit Vulkan RT/raster actions preselect the launcher's API choice; they **do not automatically Play**. Display adaptation remains engine-owned. Your desktop environment may require marking a desktop shortcut trusted before opening it.

### Standalone settings launcher (current source)

Unlike the installer, which requires your own ISO and a new destination, the launcher opens an **existing native installation** and needs no ISO or extraction:

```sh
./build/installer/kabus22-launcher --install-dir "$HOME/Games/Kabus22"
# Or use the installed application:
"$HOME/Games/Kabus22/bin/kabus22-launcher" --install-dir "$HOME/Games/Kabus22"
```

Its six tabs are Launch, Graphics, Audio, Keyboard, Joystick and Bonus. **Apply** writes settings without starting the game; **Play** saves and starts the separate native engine. Campaign and installed offline Bonus data are selectable. OpenGL, Vulkan raster and Vulkan hardware RT remain explicit choices without fallback.

Campaign controls retain original authored resolution and 16/32-bit color-depth compatibility records, lighting quality, completion buffering, mipmapping, anisotropy, reflections, blood color/amount and brightness/contrast/gamma. The color-depth record is a script/video compatibility choice, **not a promise of the old D3D framebuffer's physical format**. Blood amount and the three effects/music/dialogue volumes use 0–100; brightness/gamma use −100–100 and contrast −80–80. Original scripts may floor audio gains, so zero is not guaranteed exact mute. Ten keyboard actions and six joystick buttons are editable; joystick buttons use 1–12.

Bonus exposes its five source-consumed settings: authored resolution, shader level, anisotropy, music and stored brightness (50 is neutral; accepted native fixed-point range −2097102–2097151, not a recovered Windows UI range). Its separate AA choices request off/basic/4/9 samples, negotiated against native hardware. Campaign and Bonus text support `tr`/`en`/`de`; Campaign voice/movie audio supports `tr`/`en` (German text defaults to English voices). Saved patch locales are preserved unless intentionally changed; “Keep saved language / game default” also preserves patch indices not advertised as native locales. Patched/custom display remains game-owned. No speculative sensitivity, software-light, stencil-shadow or online-score controls are added.

Launcher choices live in `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/kabus22/launcher.ini`. Game settings use the engine's existing save root, `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/kabus22`, including private Campaign/Bonus records; original installed media and source defaults remain unchanged. Use private XDG directories for experiments. Native original-campaign display controls follow the engine limits below.

## Run the native engine

```sh
# Default OpenGL (desktop OpenGL 3.3 or newer)
./build/native/kabus22 --data "$HOME/Games/Kabus22/game"

# Explicit Vulkan hardware ray tracing
./build/native/kabus22 --data "$HOME/Games/Kabus22/game" --renderer vulkan

# Explicit Vulkan raster, without ray tracing
./build/native/kabus22 --data "$HOME/Games/Kabus22/game" \
  --renderer vulkan --ray-tracing off
```

You can instead run the installed `"$HOME/Games/Kabus22/bin/kabus22"` with the same arguments. Vulkan requires a working host Vulkan loader/driver, Vulkan 1.3 and the requested device features. RT additionally requires ray queries, acceleration structures, buffer device addresses, descriptor indexing and shader int64. There is no automatic fallback on unsupported hardware. GPU drivers and GL/Vulkan loaders are not shipped here.

**Skipping intros.** Press Escape, Return, Space, the left mouse button or pad A/B/Start to skip the startup logos (FIP Publishing / Son Işık, about 15 s; the original cannot skip them), the New Game intro and full-screen movies (the original scripts accept only Escape there). The logos are fast-forwarded, not cut, so their script effects still run; the skipping press does not reach the menu or the game. Without a press, nothing changes.

### Original-campaign widescreen (v0.1.1)

For an automatically selected, recognized original `K22.wdl` campaign, the engine defaults to desktop-sized borderless display. It integrates the recovered Kabus22Patch resolution and state-dependent menu/HUD/text geometry using **original ISO artwork**, including the original menu illustration and eye animation. No proprietary patch scripts, replacement artwork or Windows DLLs are shipped. Already-patched `K22Widescreen.wdl` and custom `--script` entries retain their own behavior rather than receiving a second transform.

OpenGL, Vulkan raster and Vulkan RT consume the **same engine-prepared camera, UI and hit geometry**. Main-camera viewport dimensions track the native window; authored signed ARC/ASPECT behavior is preserved, and portal/mirror/custom VIEWs are not forced full-window. This is recovered resolution/UI integration, **not an inferred Hor+ projection or exact community-patch restyling**. The community patch does not supply a Bonus widescreen algorithm; Bonus is unchanged by this correction. Full campaign/Bonus acceptance and steady campaign CPU performance remain unestablished.

Ghidra recovery distinguishes indexed-PCX **FONT** decoding from ordinary BMAP decoding: FONT preserves glyph indices and uses the normalized **active RGB palette**, not the embedded PCX palette or index-as-alpha. Palette selection tries the supplied input's basename `.raw`, then `palette.raw`, then RGB332; normalization keeps index 0 black and 255 white and lifts dark nonzero entries to brightness 8. World-palette events refresh cached FONT images; ordinary BMAP embedded-palette decoding is unchanged. Font data still comes only from your supplied media.

Actual OpenGL, Vulkan raster and Vulkan RT glyph-pixel checks show all **eight genuine Font0 load-menu rows at 2560×1377** (the window-manager-clamped window), with source text alpha 50 unchanged. **5120×1440** was checked only through headless producer/API geometry, preserving authored load-row spacing, not actual GPU/window-system output. The extreme **16384×720** API check exercises a **selected-slot viewport with clipping**, not eight simultaneously visible rows or GPU/window-system proof at that size. This retains the recovered script-scale asymmetry rather than inventing a uniform fit-to-screen layout.

v0.1.1 qualification passed all six native CTests and the separate installer CTest, and exercised fresh shipping-library original-ISO standalone consumers in OpenGL, Vulkan raster and Vulkan RT: source-input menus/FONT rows and selected HUD, pause, map, fade, projection and extreme-display API paths. The exact corrected AppImage additionally passed ISO-only installation without payload overrides, all installed inventory hashes, both generated shortcuts, 2560×1440 startup/captures in all three backends, and an ABI-compatible shared-library loader/replacement check in an independent extracted tree. **These bounded checks are not full NewGame/playthrough acceptance or proof of a rebuilt/new-ABI replacement library.** Historical release/artifact receipts do not qualify this correction.

Use `--display authored` to restore original scripted display services and resolution presets. In native mode, `--resolution WIDTHxHEIGHT` chooses explicit dimensions for windowed/fullscreen use (minimum 1280×720, maximum 16384 per dimension); unset dimensions or either dimension zero use the desktop dimensions for both. `--window-mode windowed|fullscreen|borderless` selects the mode; borderless always uses desktop dimensions, even with an explicit resolution. These options do not change incidental headless/custom-script defaults or require changes to installer shortcuts.

```sh
# Explicit native windowed resolution for the original campaign
./build/native/kabus22 --data "$HOME/Games/Kabus22/game" \
  --display native --resolution 1920x1080 --window-mode windowed

# Original scripted display/preset behavior
./build/native/kabus22 --data "$HOME/Games/Kabus22/game" --display authored
```

Useful engine options:

| Option | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `--mode campaign\|bonus` | Campaign is default; Bonus uses your supplied Bonus data. |
| `--display native\|authored` | Native original-campaign display adaptation (default), or original scripted display services/presets. |
| `--resolution WIDTHxHEIGHT` | Native windowed/fullscreen dimensions; unset/either zero uses desktop, borderless always uses desktop. |
| `--window-mode windowed\|fullscreen\|borderless` | Native display mode; original campaign defaults to borderless. |
| `--language tr\|en\|de` | Select text language. |
| `--audio-language tr\|en` | Select campaign audio language. |
| `--script ENTRY` | Select a supplied WDL entry instead of automatic selection. |
| `--define SYMBOL` | Add a compiler definition; Bonus AA uses `defanti_0` through `defanti_3`. |
| `--frames N` | Bound a run to N engine frames. |
| `--capture FILE` | Capture actual rendered output; not available with `--headless`. |
| `--headless` | Run script/engine logic without a window; not Vulkan rendering. |

Saves/configuration live under `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/kabus22`, separate from the supplied game data. Use a private `XDG_DATA_HOME` when running experiments so they do not affect your normal saves. Run `./build/native/kabus22 --help` for the complete CLI.

## Optional AppImage assembly — additional inputs required

Building your own AppImage is optional; downloading a release does not require Docker or the development toolchain. **A clone alone is not immediately ready to assemble an AppImage.** Assembly needs the excluded upstream helper/runtime binaries, Docker with BuildKit, network access for authenticated provisioning, and the exact pinned toolchain/dependency evidence. The public prerelease includes matching dependency sources and exact native release sources; successful local assembly alone is not runtime qualification or legal certification.

The included `packaging/helper-innoextract/` and `packaging/runtime-uruntime/` inventories, referenced notices/provenance and licensed corresponding-source archives form the packaging metadata closure. Keep those members unchanged: the packager authenticates them. Historical notice references to private qualification reports are not files available in this checkout.

### Acquire the excluded pinned helper and runtime

On the host, install `curl` and `gnupg` and use a current Docker installation. Download the official **innoextract 1.9 amd64** helper, not a locally rebuilt or arbitrary distro binary, for AppImage assembly. [Helper provenance](packaging/helper-innoextract/PROVENANCE.txt) records the upstream URLs, detached signatures, author fingerprint and limitations. Its statements about locally retained binary archives describe the private acquisition history; those binaries are excluded here.

```sh
sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends curl gnupg
mkdir -p build-appimage/cache packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
  https://constexpr.org/innoextract/files/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz \
  -o build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz
printf '%s\n' '008efe5011476ccc4aae17c3e22038b5a1bc5c7aad2b9d4d869537bf3874d21f  build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz' | sha256sum --check
mkdir -m 700 build-appimage/cache/innoextract-keyring
gpg --homedir "$PWD/build-appimage/cache/innoextract-keyring" --batch \
  --import packaging/helper-innoextract/upstream/dscharrer.asc
gpg --homedir "$PWD/build-appimage/cache/innoextract-keyring" --batch \
  --verify packaging/helper-innoextract/upstream/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz.sig \
  build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz
tar --extract --xz --file build-appimage/cache/innoextract-1.9-linux.tar.xz \
  --directory packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64 --strip-components=3 \
  innoextract-1.9-linux/bin/amd64/innoextract
printf '%s\n' '7a8ad941deeb0de8d1f804830f339fd17e27cfbce473615d79d1d65c106884e9  packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64/innoextract' | sha256sum --check
chmod +x packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64/innoextract

curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
  https://github.com/VHSgunzo/uruntime/releases/download/v0.8.1/uruntime-appimage-squashfs-lite-x86_64 \
  -o build-appimage/cache/uruntime-appimage-squashfs-lite-x86_64
printf '%s\n' '32c6024a14ff375749ee3bed3330c1586a6dd2bfeddbbd7ceacc053aec2b27a3  build-appimage/cache/uruntime-appimage-squashfs-lite-x86_64' | sha256sum --check
```

Proceed only if all hash/signature checks succeed. The retained author's primary fingerprint is `ADE9653703D4ADE0E997758128555A66D7E1DEC9`; a signature against that official key is not independent web-of-trust certification. The helper's default packaging path is `packaging/helper-innoextract/bin/amd64/innoextract`; the Python packager also accepts `--innoextract PATH`. The baseline shell driver uses the default path and requires the unmodified pinned runtime at the cache path above. Its fixed-width runtime policy patch is applied during assembly, not to your downloaded input.

### Build the isolated toolchain and assemble locally

Send only the Dockerfile on stdin, **never the full repository as Docker build context**:

```sh
docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t kabus22-ubuntu24-toolchain \
  - < tools/Dockerfile.ubuntu24
sh tools/build_kabus_baseline.sh "$PWD/build-baseline" kabus22-ubuntu24-toolchain
```

The image pins Ubuntu 24.04/snapshot packages, builds LGPL-only FFmpeg 6.1.1 and classic SDL2 dependencies, and provides Python 3.11+, `readelf`, `patchelf`, SquashFS tools, `glib-compile-schemas` and the updater's libcurl/OpenSSL/nlohmann-json development packages. Do not substitute Ubuntu's GPL-enabled FFmpeg binaries for this packaging closure. The driver builds the engine, GTK installer, separate GTK launcher and release (non-test) `kabus22-updater` with two parallel jobs using enumerated read-only source mounts, then passes the mandatory `--launcher` and `--updater` payloads to `tools/package_kabus_appimage.py`. It acquires authenticated corresponding dependency sources with network access, then assembles offline. The AppImage entry remains the installer; the installed settings launcher is a distinct application. ISO/assets/user data never enter the image. Output AppImage, JSON report and `.AppImage.sources.tar.gz` paths must be new; outputs are not overwritten or uploaded. Keep notices, matching dependency source sidecar and exact native project sources with any distributed artifact. The private qualified baseline required glibc 2.38 or newer; host GPU loaders/drivers are deliberately excluded. Update payload/manifest signing and rollback are described in [docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md](docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md).

## Ghidra tools

`reverse/scripts/RecoverKabus.java` exports selected address-backed symbols, strings, references and decompilation; `reverse/scripts/ExportEmbeddedPcx.java` exports an embedded PCX verbatim with provenance. Neither includes a game executable or image. Use Ghidra and its supported JDK with a program you own, imported/analyzed in your own project. In the GUI, add `reverse/scripts/` to Script Manager's search paths; the script headers describe their arguments.

For an existing analyzed project, a read-only headless export can be run as follows (set your own Ghidra/project/output locations):

```sh
"$GHIDRA_HOME/support/analyzeHeadless" "$PROJECT_DIRECTORY" "$PROJECT_NAME" \
  -process K22.exe -noanalysis -readOnly -scriptPath "$PWD/reverse/scripts" \
  -postScript RecoverKabus.java "$OUTPUT_DIRECTORY" 120 20
```

The PCX script accepts `OUTPUT_DIRECTORY IMAGE_ADDRESS [POINTER_ADDRESS [PE_FILE ...]]`; addresses must match your exact program. Generated decompilations, reports and extracted images remain private and outside this publication. These scripts are not required to build or run the engine.

## Publication and rights

This Git repository publishes implementation/build/test sources and the explicitly inventoried third-party source/notices. It excludes original ISOs, game assets/scripts/patches, proprietary SDKs, Windows executables, compiled helpers/runtimes, AppImages, build outputs, Ghidra databases, generated decompilations and private captures/acceptance receipts. The two authored Ghidra scripts are the exception within the otherwise excluded reverse-engineering workspace. Public binary/source release assets are distributed separately through GitHub Releases, not committed to the source tree.

`.gitignore` is a strict reviewed-source allowlist, not a general build-output blacklist. New files remain ignored until explicitly reviewed and added to that allowlist; do not bypass it to publish game data or generated/private outputs.

**No project-wide license has been assigned.** Public source visibility is not an open-source license or a clean-room certification. Existing file-specific third-party notices remain applicable: preserve the libgamestudio MIT attribution in `native/assets.cpp`, the ODE/OU BSD texts and dependency notices/source inventories. They do not grant rights to Kabus 22 or its original media. Obtain and use the game/optional patch yourself under their applicable terms. [Packaging notice](packaging/NOTICE.txt) preserves historical private qualification and the public prerelease policy, including corresponding sources and shared-library replacement. Historical private reports and artifact paths referenced there are not downloadable releases.

`cmake/KabusODEContact.cmake`:

```cmake
# Apply only the recovered GenerateContact body, on every configure (not just
# FetchContent's extraction/patch stamp). Keep the official archive unchanged.
# Authority: world-contact-boundary/contract.txt section 4 and paired 100c9930 ASM.
set(_kabus_contact_file "${kabus_ode_SOURCE_DIR}/ode/src/collision_trimesh_box.cpp")
set(_kabus_contact_original_sha256 "748b26ef299b6abeb0ddf23d910889673ecf18da01d34f6c94eedb69ccc72970")
set(_kabus_contact_modified_sha256 "b4e81e712cd5c833e38d95287b4ce415bc8db32e20deacc2f9eae93b5c6ddd42")
file(SHA256 "${_kabus_contact_file}" _kabus_contact_actual_sha256)
set(_kabus_contact_replacement [=[void sTrimeshBoxColliderData::GenerateContact(int TriIndex, const dVector3 in_ContactPos, const dVector3 in_Normal, dReal in_Depth)
{
    // acknex.dll 100c9930: float storage, live x87 PC64 ordered predicates.
#if !defined(dSINGLE) || !defined(__LDBL_MANT_DIG__) || __LDBL_MANT_DIG__ != 64
#error Kabus contact merge requires float dReal and 64-significand-bit long double
#endif
    if (m_ctContacts == (m_iFlags & 0xffff))
        return;

    bool matched = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < m_ctContacts; ++i)
    {
        dContactGeom* Contact = SAFECONTACT(m_iFlags, m_ContactGeoms, i, m_iStride);
        const long double dx = (long double)in_ContactPos[0] - (long double)Contact->pos[0];
        const long double dy = (long double)in_ContactPos[1] - (long double)Contact->pos[1];
        const long double dz = (long double)in_ContactPos[2] - (long double)Contact->pos[2];
        const long double distance2 = (dy * dy + dx * dx) + dz * dz;
        if (distance2 < 1.1920928955078125e-7L) // float word 0x34000000
        {
            const long double dot =
                ((long double)in_Normal[2] * (long double)Contact->normal[2]
                 + (long double)in_Normal[0] * (long double)Contact->normal[0])
                + (long double)in_Normal[1] * (long double)Contact->normal[1];
            const long double absoluteDot = dot < 0 ? -dot : dot;
            if (absoluteDot > 0.99999988079071044921875L) // float word 0x3f7ffffe
            {
                if (in_Depth > Contact->depth)
                    Contact->depth = in_Depth;
                matched = true; // Promote every match, retaining first geometry.
            }
        }
    }
    if (matched)
        return;

    dContactGeom* Contact = SAFECONTACT(m_iFlags, m_ContactGeoms, m_ctContacts, m_iStride);
    SET(Contact->pos, in_ContactPos);
    Contact->pos[3] = 0;
    SET(Contact->normal, in_Normal);
    Contact->normal[3] = 0;
    Contact->depth = in_Depth;
    Contact->g1 = m_Geom1;
    Contact->g2 = m_Geom2;
    // Native-only compatibility metadata: original 44-byte payload has no sides.
    Contact->side1 = TriIndex;
    Contact->side2 = -1;
    ++m_ctContacts;
}]=])
if(NOT _kabus_contact_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_contact_original_sha256
   AND NOT _kabus_contact_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_contact_modified_sha256)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected ODE contact source SHA256: ${_kabus_contact_actual_sha256}")
endif()
# Reconstruct and authenticate on both paths: changed helper contents cannot
# silently leave an old replacement in an already populated FetchContent cache.
file(READ "${_kabus_contact_file}" _kabus_contact_source)
string(FIND "${_kabus_contact_source}" "void sTrimeshBoxColliderData::GenerateContact(" _kabus_contact_start)
string(FIND "${_kabus_contact_source}" "\n\n\n\n\n\nvoid sTrimeshBoxColliderData::SetupInitialContext" _kabus_contact_end)
if(_kabus_contact_start LESS 0 OR _kabus_contact_end LESS _kabus_contact_start)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned ODE GenerateContact boundary not found")
endif()
string(SUBSTRING "${_kabus_contact_source}" 0 ${_kabus_contact_start} _kabus_contact_prefix)
string(SUBSTRING "${_kabus_contact_source}" ${_kabus_contact_end} -1 _kabus_contact_suffix)
set(_kabus_contact_source "${_kabus_contact_prefix}${_kabus_contact_replacement}${_kabus_contact_suffix}")
string(SHA256 _kabus_contact_result_sha256 "${_kabus_contact_source}")
if(NOT _kabus_contact_result_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_contact_modified_sha256)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ODE contact replacement recipe/hash mismatch")
endif()
if(_kabus_contact_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_contact_original_sha256)
    file(WRITE "${_kabus_contact_file}" "${_kabus_contact_source}")
endif()
message(STATUS "Kabus ODE contact source SHA256: ${_kabus_contact_modified_sha256}")

`cmake/KabusODELcp.cmake`:

```cmake
# Zero-initialize dSolveLCP's state[] in the pinned ODE source, on every configure.
# Keep the official archive unchanged. Upstream allocates state[] uninitialized, and
# swapProblem() swaps entries not yet assigned: an invalid bool load (UBSan). Every
# entry is assigned before it is read as a value, so starting false changes no result.
set(_kabus_lcp_file "${kabus_ode_SOURCE_DIR}/ode/src/lcp.cpp")
set(_kabus_lcp_original_sha256 "76b3771a02736a29fa552ec49a163953420eb98aa98d8a3cbe0da21f5ed9d03c")
set(_kabus_lcp_modified_sha256 "3467227bf68f38e2ea72785006545a998672952994aca6158492018da9c5ddfa")
file(SHA256 "${_kabus_lcp_file}" _kabus_lcp_actual_sha256)
if(NOT _kabus_lcp_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_lcp_original_sha256
   AND NOT _kabus_lcp_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_lcp_modified_sha256)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected ODE lcp source SHA256: ${_kabus_lcp_actual_sha256}")
endif()
if(_kabus_lcp_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_lcp_original_sha256)
    # The upstream file is uniformly CRLF; file(READ) drops the CRs, so restore them
    # after the insertion. The hash check below proves the exact byte result.
    file(READ "${_kabus_lcp_file}" _kabus_lcp_source)
    set(_kabus_lcp_needle "bool *state = memarena->AllocateArray<bool> (n);")
    string(FIND "${_kabus_lcp_source}" "${_kabus_lcp_needle}" _kabus_lcp_at)
    if(_kabus_lcp_at LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned ODE dSolveLCP state allocation not found")
    endif()
    string(REPLACE "${_kabus_lcp_needle}"
        "${_kabus_lcp_needle}\n    // Kabus22: swapProblem() swaps state[] entries that are not assigned yet; start them false.\n    for (unsigned kabus_i = 0; kabus_i != n; ++kabus_i) state[kabus_i] = false;"
        _kabus_lcp_source "${_kabus_lcp_source}")
    string(ASCII 13 _kabus_cr)
    string(REPLACE "\n" "${_kabus_cr}\n" _kabus_lcp_source "${_kabus_lcp_source}")
    string(SHA256 _kabus_lcp_result_sha256 "${_kabus_lcp_source}")
    if(NOT _kabus_lcp_result_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_lcp_modified_sha256)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "ODE lcp state recipe/hash mismatch: ${_kabus_lcp_result_sha256}")
    endif()
    file(WRITE "${_kabus_lcp_file}" "${_kabus_lcp_source}")
    file(SHA256 "${_kabus_lcp_file}" _kabus_lcp_actual_sha256)
    if(NOT _kabus_lcp_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _kabus_lcp_modified_sha256)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Written ODE lcp source SHA256 mismatch: ${_kabus_lcp_actual_sha256}")
    endif()
endif()
message(STATUS "Kabus ODE lcp source SHA256: ${_kabus_lcp_modified_sha256}")

`docs/ACKNEX_A631.md`:

```md
# Acknex A6.31 plugin interface and its native equivalents

How the Kabus 22 campaign engine (A6 6.31.4, `K22.exe`) loads and calls plugin DLLs, what the community patch's `kabus_dll.dll` and the original `RenkAyar.dll` do through that interface, and where the native engine implements the same services.

Labels: **CONFIRMED** / **HIGH CONFIDENCE** / **HYPOTHESIS** / **UNKNOWN**. Related: [COMMUNITY_PATCH_ANALYSIS](COMMUNITY_PATCH_ANALYSIS.md) · [PATCH_BINARY_DIFF](PATCH_BINARY_DIFF.md) · [reverse-engineering/SCRIPT_SYSTEM](reverse-engineering/SCRIPT_SYSTEM.md) · [ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE](ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md).

Sources: Conitec plugin SDK headers as shipped in the author's repository (`reverse/community/iseeeva-kabus22/kabus_vs/Kabus.Acknex.Plugin/Acknex/include/{adll,afuncs,atypes,avars}.h`, `Acknex/lib/adll.lib`, `readme_acknex.txt`); plugin source `…/Index.hpp`, `Utils/**`; recovered engine contract `reverse/decompiled/runtime/CONTRACT.txt` §5, §17; `reverse/decompiled/RenkAyar.behavior.txt`; native `native/engine.cpp`, `native/wdl.cpp`, `native/check_engine.cpp`. All private except `native/`.

## 1. Entry points and registration

| Element | Original A6 6.31 | Label |
|---|---|---|
| Plugin discovery | At start-up, after script compilation, the engine enumerates `*.dll` in `PLUGINDIR` (empty or trailing `.` = current directory), skips `compiler.dll`/`ackport.dll`, `LoadLibraryA`s each, keeps ≤ 64 modules (`004133c0`, `CONTRACT.txt:630-637`) | CONFIRMED (static) |
| Handshake | If export `A6_DLLAPI` exists it is called with the engine interface `006438b0`; module kept only if the signed result < 631; otherwise `A5_DLLAPI(00644380)` with result < 512; else unloaded (`0040c330`, `CONTRACT.txt:652-659`) | CONFIRMED (static) |
| `A6_DLLAPI` | Provided by the SDK import library (`adll.lib` contains `/EXPORT:_A6_DLLAPI` and `engine_bind`); the plugin does not write it. `RenkAyar.dll` returns `0x276` (630) | CONFIRMED |
| Function binding inside the plugin | `adll.h` with `DLL_USE`: every engine function in `afuncs.h` becomes a function pointer `F(f)=(*f)`; `ENGINE_VARS *ev` holds pointers to every engine variable listed in `avars.h` (578 entries); `engine_bind()` fills them | CONFIRMED (headers) |
| Callback resolution | Engine functions are resolved by name through the interface callback at `interface+0xa30` (`RenkAyar` binds `draw_begin` this way) | CONFIRMED (`RenkAyar.behavior.txt:13-19`) |
| Script declaration | `dllfunction Name(args);` declares an external; calls are resolved by export name among loaded plugins. Up to 4 `var`/pointer arguments, `cdecl` (`CONTRACT.txt:220-221`) | CONFIRMED (contract); multi-DLL name resolution order UNKNOWN |
| Explicit load | `dll_open("x.dll")` returns a handle; scripts assign the global `dll_handle` before calling that DLL's functions (`K22Widescreen.wdl` `main`, original `K22.wdl`) | CONFIRMED (scripts); exact effect of `dll_handle` on dispatch HYPOTHESIS |

## 2. Data access

| Topic | SDK contract | Label |
|---|---|---|
| Numeric `var` | `typedef long var`; 22.10 fixed point. `_VAR(int)=i<<10`, `_VAR(double)`, `_INT(x)=x>>10` (arithmetic shift, rounds toward −∞ for negatives), `_FLOAT(x)=x/1024` (`adll.h`) | CONFIRMED |
| Script `INT()` vs SDK `_INT` | script `INT` truncates toward zero and stays scaled; SDK `_INT` floors — different results for negative fractions (`CONTRACT.txt:204-207`) | CONFIRMED |
| Engine variables | `v(name)` = `*ev->name`; e.g. `v(screen_size)`, `ev->camera` (`VIEW*`) | CONFIRMED (headers) |
| Strings | `STRING{C_LINK link; char* chars; long length; long flags}`; `_CHR(s)=s->chars` (`atypes.h:270-275`) | CONFIRMED |
| Engine structs | `ENTITY`, `VIEW`, `PANEL`, `TEXT`, `BMAP`, `MATERIAL`… in `atypes.h`. A7/A8 SDK layouts must not be used as the A6 ABI (`CONTRACT.txt:224`) | CONFIRMED |

## 3. The two Kabus plugins

### 3.1 `kabus_dll.dll` (community patch; source `Index.hpp`)

| Export | Signature (source) | Behaviour | Label |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DiscordRPC_TryConnect` | `bool(STRING* appId)` | `Discord_Initialize(appId, handlers, 1, NULL)` then presence update; idempotent | CONFIRMED (source) |
| `DiscordRPC_IsConnected` | `bool()` | returns a local flag set by `TryConnect` (not a real connection state) | CONFIRMED |
| `DiscordRPC_TryDisconnect` | `void()` | `Discord_Shutdown` | CONFIRMED |
| `DiscordRPC_SetStateDetails` | `void(STRING* details, STRING* state)` | copies strings, start timestamp on first call, `Discord_UpdatePresence` | CONFIRMED |
| `INI_IsInitialized` | `bool()` | false only if `new Ini` failed | CONFIRMED |
| `INI_GetVariable` | `char*(STRING* key)` | `Screen:Mode` [0,2], `Screen:X` [0,3840], `Screen:Y` [0,2160]: digit-only and in range or reset to the minimum (0) **and rewritten to disk**; other keys raw or `"undefined"`; returns `_strdup` | CONFIRMED |
| `INI_SetVariable` | `void(STRING* key, STRING* value)` | validated for the three keys, saved immediately | CONFIRMED |
| `Parse_EscapeChar` | `char*(STRING* in)` | replaces `\' \" \\ \n \r \t \b \f \v` with control characters (comment: A6 `txt_load` does not), returns `_strdup` | CONFIRMED |

Lifetime and ownership:

- `DllMain` calls `engine_bind()` for every reason code (attach, detach, thread). **CONFIRMED.**
- Module globals `DiscordRpcVar = new RPC()` and `IniVar = new Ini("K22.ini")` are created during `LoadLibrary` (static initialisation). Because the engine auto-loads every plugin in the game directory at start-up (§1), `K22.ini` is read, validated and possibly rewritten **before** any script runs; it is resolved relative to the process working directory and never freed. **HIGH CONFIDENCE.**
- `INI_GetVariable`/`Parse_EscapeChar` return heap copies that the engine never frees: one leak per call (≈ 575 per subtitle load, plus each INI query). Small, bounded by language reloads. **HIGH CONFIDENCE.**
- The `bool` exports return their value in `AL` only (MSVC `bool` ABI); the engine reads the whole `EAX` as a raw `var`. `true` therefore arrives as raw 1 (0.000977), not 1.0, and the upper 24 bits are not guaranteed zero. Scripts only test `== 0`, which is correct unless stale upper bits make a `false` non-zero. **HYPOTHESIS** (not observed on Windows).
- `kabus_rpc.dll` has no `A6_DLLAPI`/`A5_DLLAPI`, so engine auto-enumeration loads and immediately unloads it; it stays resident only as an import of `kabus_dll.dll`. **HIGH CONFIDENCE.**

Patch scripts using it: `K22Widescreen.wdl` (`INI_*` for display set-up), `silah.wdl`, `cinematic.wdl` (`Screen:Mode` dependent weapon offsets), `dil_degistir.wdl` (`Parse_EscapeChar` on every subtitle line), `discord.wdl` (connect/update loop every frame). **CONFIRMED.**

### 3.2 `RenkAyar.dll` (original game)

Exports `dl_Reset`, `dl_PaKaGa(brightness, contrast, gamma, mode)`; builds 3×256 16-bit ramps and calls `IDirect3DDevice9::SetGammaRamp` via `draw_begin`'s device (vtable 0x54). Formula and modes: `reverse/decompiled/RenkAyar.behavior.txt:21-40`. **CONFIRMED** (static); D3D method identity **HIGH CONFIDENCE**.

## 4. Native equivalents

The native engine loads no Windows DLL. External script functions that the original game and patch need are host services.

| Original mechanism | Native implementation | Label |
|---|---|---|
| `PLUGINDIR` + `*.dll` auto-load | `Engine::initialize_plugins` (`native/engine.cpp:1148-1156`): only the default/current `PLUGINDIR` is accepted; if any of the 8 `kabus_dll` names is declared `dllfunction`, opens the `kabus_dll.dll` service; if `dl_PaKaGa`/`dl_Reset` is declared, opens `renkayar.dll` | CONFIRMED |
| `dllfunction` declaration | parsed as an external function (`native/wdl.cpp:169-174`, `Runtime::external_import`, `native/wdl.cpp:462`); a script-defined body with the same name wins over the service (`native/check_engine.cpp:3868-3869`) | CONFIRMED |
| `dll_open` | `svc_plugin_open` (`native/engine.cpp:1139-1146`): `renkayar.dll` → gamma service, `kabus_dll.dll` → loads `K22.ini` once ("module-global IniVar … dll_open is not a reload"), anything else → explicit error | CONFIRMED |
| `dll_handle` | ordinary global; services are dispatched by function name. Export names of the two DLLs do not overlap, so no ambiguity arises | CONFIRMED |
| `INI_*` | `svc_ini_parse`/`svc_ini_load`/`svc_ini_save`/`svc_ini_normalize` (`native/engine.cpp:1111-1138`, `:1205-1206`): same three validated keys and ranges, invalid → `"0"` and rewritten; private `K22.ini` under the save root, falling back to a read-only copy in the game data | CONFIRMED |
| `INI_GetVariable` return | new engine string per call (`native/engine.cpp:1205` comment: original export returns an independent `strdup`) — no leak | CONFIRMED |
| `Parse_EscapeChar` | same nine escape pairs (`native/engine.cpp:1207`) | CONFIRMED |
| `DiscordRPC_*` | native Discord IPC client over `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/discord-ipc-N` with 1 s retry throttle, handshake, duplicate-presence suppression (`native/engine.cpp:1091-1110`, `:1208-1212`); returns integer `var` 1/0 | CONFIRMED |
| `dl_PaKaGa`/`dl_Reset` | gamma ramp computed with the recovered integer/float sequence into `nativeAdjustment`, applied by the renderer post-pass (`native/engine.cpp:1235-1236`) | CONFIRMED |
| Tests | `native/check_engine.cpp:3761-3905`: INI fixture, provider admission per `PLUGINDIR`, script-override precedence, re-open without reload, escape service | CONFIRMED (source; executed by the existing native CTest suite) |

Differences that matter:

1. Native `bool` services return 1.0 (raw 1024) where the DLL returns raw 1 in `AL`; equal under the scripts' `== 0` tests. **HIGH CONFIDENCE.**
2. Native refuses unknown DLLs instead of silently loading them; original start-up would load any `*.dll` in the game directory (including, in the Lutris install, ReShade's `d3d9.dll` entry). **CONFIRMED** (native), original behaviour per §1.

## 5. SDK licence constraints

`readme_acknex.txt` (Conitec): the SDK may be used for plugins only if a machine-readable copy of the complete product source is provided (unless the author holds a Pro/SDK licence); `.cpp`/`.h` may be redistributed, **the `.lib` libraries may not**; DLLs must not act as wrappers exposing the engine interface. The author's repository redistributes `adll.lib`. The native project contains none of these SDK files. **CONFIRMED** (text); legal conclusions: [COMMUNITY_CREDITS](COMMUNITY_CREDITS.md).

`docs/ASSET_FORMATS.md`:

```md
# Asset formats in the native port

Purpose: developer reference for how the native Linux engine (`native/`) and installer/launcher (`installer/`) read, validate, extract and store each Kabus 22 asset format, and which variants are unsupported.

Related: [REVERSE_ENGINEERING index](REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md) · [RESOURCE_FORMATS (original byte layouts)](reverse-engineering/RESOURCE_FORMATS.md) · [ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE](ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md) · [DATA_STRUCTURES](reverse-engineering/DATA_STRUCTURES.md) · [FUNCTION_MAP](reverse-engineering/FUNCTION_MAP.md) · [GAMEPLAY_SYSTEMS](GAMEPLAY_SYSTEMS.md)

Byte layouts and original-executable addresses live in [RESOURCE_FORMATS](reverse-engineering/RESOURCE_FORMATS.md); this file covers native behaviour only. Confidence labels as defined there. Native citations are `file:symbol`; line numbers are omitted for files that were being edited concurrently when this was written (2026-10-09). "Census" = read-only walk of the installed game files done for these docs.

---

## 1. Resolution pipeline

| Step | Native implementation | Confidence / evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Root scan | `native/assets.cpp:Assets::Assets` walks the data root recursively (symlinks skipped) into a loose-file map keyed by `safe_name` (case-folded, trailing `.`/space stripped, absolute/empty rejected); case-insensitive collisions are errors | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Archive mount | `Assets::mount`; campaign `native/main.cpp` mounts `K22.wrs`, `Kaynak.k22`, `K22Widescreen.wrs` (each only if present); Bonus mounts `K22_mode.wrs`. Script `RESOURCE` (`native/wdl.cpp` parser `resource` callback) and `add_resource` (`native/engine.cpp:Engine::builtin`) also call `Assets::mount` | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Lookup | `Assets::read`: loose file first, then archive entry | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Duplicate archive names | Bonus: first-mounted wins (`try_emplace`), matching A7 (`bonus-core/CORE_CONTRACT.txt:46`). Campaign: **last-mounted wins** (`insert_or_assign`), whereas original A6 lookup `00420120` returns the first match | CONFIRMED divergence (code vs `reverse/decompiled/loaders/K22.exe.00420120.c:99-126`). Census: the only cross-archive duplicate among the campaign base archives is `palette.raw` (same stored size in all); effect for patch archives is UNKNOWN |
| Size limits | 128 MiB per member/image (`assetLimit`), 64 MiB PE read for the font (`fontPeLimit`), 1 GiB decoded cache (`cacheLimit`) | CONFIRMED (`native/assets.cpp` constants) |

## 2. WRS archives

`Assets::mount` / `Assets::decompress` / `Assets::read_entry` (`native/assets.cpp`).

| Behaviour | Native | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| Magic | `WRS2` (name XOR `0xa5`) or `WRS3` (XOR `0xb5`); anything else, including the legacy no-magic variant, is rejected | CONFIRMED (code). Legacy variant unsupported; none shipped (CONFIRMED census) |
| Header | 40 bytes: 32-byte name + big-endian stored/decoded u32; nonzero name padding, `stored > remaining`, `stored`/`decoded` > 128 MiB, or exactly one of them zero → error | CONFIRMED (code) |
| End of index | exact EOF; no sentinel record expected | CONFIRMED (code; all shipped archives parse) |
| Conflicts | duplicate member name and file-vs-directory prefix conflicts (`a` and `a/b`) → error | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Codec | LZSS, 4096-byte space-filled window, cursor 4078, LSB-first flags (1 = literal), 12-bit position, length `(hi&15)+3`; output must equal declared size exactly | CONFIRMED (code matches `K22.exe.00414bc0`) |
| Original limits | 128 archives / 4096 entries are **not** enforced natively | CONFIRMED (code: no such check) |

## 3. Worlds (`.wmb`)

`Assets::world` → `Assets::decode_world` (`native/assets.cpp`), cached per name; `World` in `native/assets.hpp`.

| Item | Native behaviour | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| Supported | `WMB6` only; 17 section pairs, sections must lie inside the file and not overlap; unindexed bytes kept in `World::metadata` | CONFIRMED (code) |
| WMB7 | rejected ("unsupported world format") | CONFIRMED; no WMB7 is shipped (census) |
| Textures | campaign: 16-bit (565) or 24-bit embedded, or external by name when `width=height=0`; Bonus profile: A7 layout (format word `10`/`12`, four mips, missing `0xffffffff` entries) | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Objects | types 1–8 decoded to `WorldEntity`/`Light`/`Path`; unknown types are errors; type 3 legacy filename/action rule per CONTRACT §24; type 7 372-byte records | CONFIRMED (code; `reverse/decompiled/runtime/CONTRACT.txt:810-826`) |
| Sun | `Engine` sets only `sun_angle` pan/tilt from `World::sunAzimuth/sunElevation`; parsed `World::sunColor` is not written to `SUN_COLOR` | CONFIRMED (`native/engine.cpp`, matches CONTRACT §19) |
| Lightmaps | atlas `256 << lightmapSize`, 24-bit; storage bytes chosen by `Assets::set_native_shadow_depth`; 565/mono LUTs from `Assets::initialize_native_lightmap_tables` (startup-captured, original `004555e0`/`00455240`) | CONFIRMED (code; CONTRACT §22) |

## 4. Models (`.mdl`, `.hmp`)

`Assets::model` → `Assets::load_model` → `Assets::decode_model` (`native/assets.cpp`).

| Item | Native behaviour | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| Magics | `MDL4`, `MDL5`, `MDL7`, `HMP5`; others rejected | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Skins | `type&15`: 7 external file (`Assets::image_ptr`), 1 skin reference, 0/2/3/4/5/6 embedded via `Assets::embedded_image`; flag 8 mip levels skipped; flag 16 material block; flag 32 length-prefixed extra data | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Indexed skins (format 0) | palette from `palette.raw` (must be 768 bytes) else last 768 bytes of `palette.pcx` (requires `0x0c` marker) | CONFIRMED (code); no shipped first skin uses format 0 (census) |
| UV normalization | geometry UVs untouched; renderer compensates the selected image by padded/raw ratio (`mdl_texture_extent`: next power of two, min 8) for formats 4/5/7 only | CONFIRMED (code; CONTRACT §25) |
| Skin bank | model-wide bank: `model_skin_index`, `model_material`, `model_has_entity_skins` (`native/assets.hpp`) | CONFIRMED (CONTRACT §26) |
| Bonus MDL7 | UV index `0xffff` widened to "absent UV" at the face boundary | CONFIRMED (CONTRACT §30) |
| Shadow LODs | `name_0.mdl` loads `_1`, `_2`, `_3` companions if present (A6 `0045b810`, A7 `1005ee90`) | CONFIRMED (code comments cite these addresses) |
| HMP5 | grid from header, frame packing must be 2, heights 4 bytes/vertex | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Limits | skins 1..256, vertices 1..65535, frames 1..4096; MDL7 vertex stride 16 or 26; triangle stride 6/12/16/26; matrix stride 68; non-triangle groups rejected | CONFIRMED (code) |
| MDL7 skin formats 6/7 after original preprocessing | not reproduced beyond the paths above | UNKNOWN original algorithm (CONTRACT §20) |

## 5. Images

`native/media.cpp:decode_image` (internal `decode_bitmap`, FFmpeg `libavcodec` + `libswscale`), wrapped by `native/assets.cpp:Assets::image_ptr`. Output: `k22::Image` (`native/assets.hpp`), straight-alpha RGBA8, top row first, plus `sourceDepth`, `nativeStorageBytes`, `nativeTextureAlpha`.

| Extension | FFmpeg decoder | Native storage metadata | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.pcx` | PCX | depth = bpp × planes; 8 → CPU1, 24 → CPU2 | CONFIRMED (code; CONTRACT §20) |
| `.bmp` | BMP | header depth; 8 → 1, 24 → 2 | CONFIRMED |
| `.tga` | TARGA | 24/32 → 3/4, or 2 when ALPHADEPTH ≤ 16 (`Assets::set_native_alpha_depth`) | CONFIRMED |
| `.dds` | DDS | storage 0 (encoded); DXT1 alpha exception preserved | CONFIRMED |
| `.jpg/.jpeg/.png/.gif/.tif/.tiff/.webp` | MJPEG/PNG/GIF/TIFF/WEBP | depth from header/pixel format | CONFIRMED (code); not used by shipped engine assets (census) |
| other | FFmpeg probe (`Decoder`) | — | CONFIRMED (code) |

`Assets::purge_image` drops cache entries (never the engine font). Bonus profile alone honours `nativeTextureAlpha`.

## 6. Fonts and palettes

| Item | Native implementation | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| `_a4font` | `Assets::image_ptr("engine/_a4font.pcx")`: loose `game/engine/_a4font.pcx`, else archive member, else extracted from a loose `K22.exe`/`K22_4GB.exe` via `extract_engine_font`; always checked by `validate_engine_font` (`native/pe_font.hpp`: length 17063, RGB24 192×72 header, CRC32 `0xf5b48715`, decoded CRC `0x339585ef`); PE parsing in `pe_font_detail::peSections` scans only initialized-data sections | CONFIRMED (code) |
| Built-in FONT object | `Engine::resolve_builtin_font` requires 192×72; `_a4font` FONT created with style 6, size 9 | CONFIRMED (`native/engine.cpp`) |
| Indexed bitmap FONT | `decode_bitmap_font` keeps the index plane and expands with the caller's 768-byte active palette (opaque alpha), not the PCX palette | CONFIRMED (`native/media.hpp`; CONTRACT second §40–41) |
| Active palette | `Engine::ensure_font_palette`: `<entry-basename>.raw`, else `palette.raw`, else RGB332; `Engine::set_font_palette` normalizes (original `00455240`/`004550e0`) | CONFIRMED (code) |

The installer never ships the font: `installer/setup.cpp:installFont` extracts `app/K22.exe` from the user's media into a private scratch directory (`installer/media.cpp:extractFontSource`, only that exact listed member, ≤ 64 MiB), writes `game/engine/_a4font.pcx` and provenance `game/engine/_a4font-source.json` (`"format":"A6 _a4font RGB24 PCX 192x72"`, source SHA-256), and discards the EXE. An optional patch's `K22.exe` may be the font source instead (`origin = "user-patch/K22.exe"`). CONFIRMED (code; installed JSON observed).

## 7. Audio

`native/media.cpp:audio` → `Decoder` (FFmpeg `libavformat`/`libavcodec`, `libswresample` to float stereo), played by `Media::sound_play` / `Media::sound_play_at` through SDL.

| Input | Native behaviour | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| WAV PCM, bare Ogg Vorbis, MP3 | FFmpeg probe/decoder | CONFIRMED (code); shipped variants listed in RESOURCE_FORMATS §8 |
| RIFF/WAVE fmt tag `0x674f` with `OggS` data | `media_payload` validates RIFF/chunk bounds and borrows the `data` chunk zero-copy as a plain Ogg stream | CONFIRMED (code; CONTRACT §34, `CONTRACT.txt:1379-1393`) |
| RIFF/WAVE fmt tag `0x676f` (`otokapi_acil.ogg`, `otokapi_zorlan.ogg`) | **not** matched by `media_payload` (it tests only `0x674f`); falls through to FFmpeg, which reports codec `unknown` for these files | Code path CONFIRMED; ffprobe result CONFIRMED; resulting runtime failure ("Native decoder unavailable") when `cinematic.wdl` plays them is HYPOTHESIS — not run |
| Volumes | `Media::master_volume` (SOUND_VOL / MIDI_VOL; zero mutes), `Media::sound_tune` | CONFIRMED (`native/media.hpp`) |

## 8. Video

`Media::movie_play` / `Media::movie_frame` / `Media::update` (`native/media.cpp`): bytes via `Assets::read` (movies are loose `.k22` files, not archive members), video through `Decoder` + `sws_scale` to RGBA, audio track through `audio`; movie frames can be bound to a bitmap target (used for `media_loop(..., bmap_for_entity(...))`).

| Item | Status | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| Container/codec | RIFF AVI, Indeo 5 (`IV50`) video, MP3 or no audio | CONFIRMED (ffprobe) |
| Indeo 5 availability | depends on the FFmpeg build linked into the engine; the bundled FFmpeg configure flags were not found in the repository | UNKNOWN (not re-verified here) |
| Original behaviour | DirectShow handoff, no engine path rewrite | CONFIRMED (CONTRACT §14) |

## 9. Settings, saves and other script files

All runtime-written files go to the private save root `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/kabus22` (`Engine::Engine` in `native/engine.cpp`; `native/saves.cpp:root`), never into the installed `game/` directory. `svc_private` (`native/engine.cpp`) rejects symlink escapes; writes are atomic temp + rename. Reads prefer the private copy, then the original asset (`file_open_read` handling in `Engine::builtin`). README states the same location (`README.md`, "Saves/configuration").

| File | Native handling | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| `options.k22` | engine: reads the private `<root>/options.k22` if present (must be 31 or 32 bytes), else the shipped asset; scripts write the private copy; launcher `installer/launcher_settings.cpp:validateCampaign` (31 or 32 bytes, per-byte maxima, key codes from `keys()`, no duplicate keys, joystick 1..12, byte 31 ≤ 5) | CONFIRMED (code) |
| `mode_ayarlar.k22`, `ygm.k22` (Bonus) | launcher `decodeBonus` (5 lines, ranges), locale marker accepted only as `111`/`222`/`333` → tr/de/en | CONFIRMED (code). Mismatch with recovered A7 launcher (`000` = en) — see RESOURCE_FORMATS §10.3 |
| `kayit<N>.sav`, `kysd.sav`, `ftz.k22` | produced by the original scripts through native `file_*` builtins; `file_asc_write` appends `uint8(raw >> 10)` (the integer part, low 8 bits) | CONFIRMED (`native/engine.cpp`); original/script regression in `native/check_engine.cpp` (`LV_LevelKaydeta`, `kysd.sav` text `"N N <label>\n"`) |
| Save rotation (in progress) | `native/saves.cpp`: `rotated()` = `kayit0..98.sav` or `kysd.sav`; `backup()` keeps numbered copies under `<root>/backups/<relative>.N`; optional sidecar `<save>.meta` starting `kabus22-save-meta <format>` with `engine=`, `written=`, `entry=`, `script=`, `origin=` keys | CONFIRMED present in working tree at time of writing; uncommitted, may change |
| `_data/saves/<name>` reads | if absent privately, fall back to the same basename in assets (patched scripts' save folder) | CONFIRMED (code) |
| `yoldata.DAT` | ordinary asset read by the original `yoldata.wdl` starter | CONFIRMED (installer allowlists `.dat`) |
| `K22.ini` | only when patched scripts bind `kabus_dll.dll`: `svc_ini_load` / `svc_ini_parse` read private then asset `K22.ini`; grammar: `;`/`#` comments, `#include` (depth ≤ 16), `[section]` or `{section}`, `key = value` or `key: value`, `\`/`/` line continuation; keys stored `section:key`; `Screen:Mode` 0..2, `Screen:X` ≤ 3840, `Screen:Y` ≤ 2160 else `0`; `svc_ini_save` rewrites `<root>/K22.ini` | CONFIRMED (code). This is native grammar, not a recovered patch-DLL grammar |
| Text catalogues (`nti.k22` etc.) | `txt_load` with original delimiter rules (CONTRACT §14) | HIGH CONFIDENCE (CONTRACT section integrated in native; not re-traced here) |

## 11. Texture packs (format contract)

**Status:** format contract owned by the Graphics/TextureTool work. At the time of writing the working tree contains `native/texture_pack.hpp`, `native/texture_pack.cpp` (in the root `CMakeLists.txt` source list) and `native/check_texture_pack.hpp`, implementing `texture_pack_root`, `load_texture_pack`, `discover_texture_packs`, `TexturePackSet::find`, `texture_key`, `decode_png`/`encode_png` and `dump_textures` — CONFIRMED (code read). `grep` found **no** use of these symbols in `native/main.cpp`, `native/engine.cpp` or `native/render*.cpp`, so engine/renderer consumption is **not yet implemented** in the tree that was read. The launcher already persists `texture-packs` in `launcher.ini`, reads a `texture_packs` capabilities list and passes `--texture-pack <NAME>` (`installer/launcher_settings.cpp`). Re-check before relying on it.

| Rule | Contract | Implemented in `texture_pack.cpp` |
|---|---|---|
| Location | `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/kabus22/packs/<NAME>/pack.txt` (relative `XDG_DATA_HOME` ignored) | yes (`texture_pack_root`, checks) |
| Header | first line exactly `kabus22-texture-pack 1` | yes |
| Metadata | `name<TAB>value`, `license<TAB>value`; both required, before entries, non-empty, no duplicates | yes |
| Entry | `<key>\t<kind>\t<relative/path.png>`; duplicate key/kind rejected | yes |
| Kind | `albedo`, `normal`, `roughness`, `metallic`, `ao` | yes |
| Key | lowercase 16-hex FNV-1a-64 (offset `0xcbf29ce484222325`, prime `0x100000001b3`) over width as LE u32, height as LE u32, then the decoded RGBA8 bytes top row first, i.e. `k22::Image::rgba` | yes (`texture_key`) |
| File | PNG only; path relative, no `..`, canonical path confined to the pack directory; regular file ≤ 64 MiB; ≤ 8192 px per side | yes |
| Dimensions | original × s, s ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8}; all kinds of one key must match | yes (`TexturePackSet::find`, `load_texture_pack`) |
| Normal maps | tangent space, OpenGL convention (+Y up); alpha forced to 255 on load | contract; alpha forcing yes |
| Roughness / metallic / AO | R channel used; packed into an ORM image R = AO, G = roughness, B = metallic (defaults AO 1, roughness 1, metallic 0) | yes |
| Priority | first pack (launcher priority order) containing the key supplies all kinds; invalid entries logged once and ignored | yes |
| Dump | `dump_textures` writes `<key>.png` for decoded originals; refuses output inside the game data directory | yes |
