`installer/check_setup.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "setup.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <set>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <sys/stat.h>

using namespace k22::setup;
namespace {
void require(bool ok, const std::string& message) { if (!ok) throw std::runtime_error(message); }
void put(const fs::path& path, std::string_view data) {
    fs::create_directories(path.parent_path());
    std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc) << data;
}
std::string get(const fs::path& path) {
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), {}};
}
template <class F> bool fails(F action) {
    try { action(); } catch (const std::exception&) { return true; }
    return false;
}
using Paths = std::vector<std::string>;

// Asset-free fixtures: source detection, versioned layout, verify and directory repair.
void fixtures(const fs::path& base) {
    std::string iso(32769 + 5, '\0');
    iso.replace(32769, 5, "CD001");
    put(base/"media/game.iso", iso);
    put(base/"media/notes.txt", "not media");
    put(base/"cd/SETUP.EXE", "MZ fake setup");
    put(base/"cd/setup-1.bin", "slice");
    put(base/"lonely/setup.exe", "MZ without slices");
    require(detectSource(base/"media/game.iso").kind == SourceKind::Iso, "ISO9660 magic not detected");
    require(detectSource(base/"cd/SETUP.EXE").kind == SourceKind::Setup, "Setup pair not detected");
    const auto mounted = detectSource(base/"cd");
    require(mounted.kind == SourceKind::Setup && mounted.path.filename() == "SETUP.EXE", "Media folder with one setup pair not detected");
    require(fails([&] { detectSource(base/"media/notes.txt"); }) && fails([&] { detectSource(base/"lonely/setup.exe"); }) &&
        fails([&] { detectSource(base/"lonely"); }) && fails([&] { detectSource(base/"missing"); }), "Unrecognised sources must fail");

    const auto win = base/"Kabus 22";
    const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> game{
        {"K22.wrs", "WRS2 campaign"}, {"Kaynak.k22", "kaynak"}, {"turkce.k22", "language"},
        {"Help/Help_Files/fon_LOGO.jpg", "logo"}, {"Menu_sound/menu_fon.ogg", "ogg"}, {"K22Widescreen.wrs", "widescreen"}};
    for (const auto& [name, data] : game) put(win/name, data);
    put(win/"K22.exe", "MZ engine");
    for (const auto* name : {"kabus_dll.dll", "d3d9.dll", "kayit0.sav", "ftz.k22", "unins000.dat", "_data/saves/slot.k22"}) put(win/name, name);
    fs::create_symlink("/nonexistent", win/"ReShade_shaders");
    const auto detected = detectSource(win);
    require(detected.kind == SourceKind::Directory && detected.edition == "merscom+kabus22patch",
        "Windows folder/edition detection failed: " + detected.edition);
    const auto preview = previewArtwork(win, {}, base/"preview");
    require(get(preview.logo) == "logo" && preview.wizard.empty(), "Directory artwork preview failed");

    // A staged flat installation becomes versions/<v> + current + compat links with both inventories.
    const auto staging = base/"stage", root = base/"install/kabus22";
    for (const auto& [name, data] : game) put(staging/"game"/name, data);
    put(staging/"bin/kabus22", "engine"); put(staging/"bin/kabus22-launcher", "launcher");
    put(staging/"lib/libdemo.so.1", "library"); put(staging/"share/licenses/kabus22/notice", "notice");
    put(staging/"kabus22.png", "icon");
    finalizeInstallation(staging, {root, win, kindName(detected.kind), detected.edition, {base/"apps/kabus22-native.desktop"}});
    fs::create_directories(root.parent_path());
    fs::rename(staging, root);
    const std::string version = K22_VERSION;
    require(fs::read_symlink(root/"current") == fs::path("versions")/version && fs::read_symlink(root/"bin") == "current/bin" &&
        fs::read_symlink(root/"lib") == "current/lib" && fs::read_symlink(root/"share") == "current/share" &&
        fs::is_regular_file(root/"versions"/version/"bin/kabus22") && fs::is_regular_file(root/"bin/kabus22-launcher") &&
        fs::is_regular_file(root/"versions"/version/".kabus22-payload.json"), "New install layout is not versioned");
    const auto inventory = get(root/".kabus22-inventory.json");
    require(inventory.find("\"path\":\"game/K22.wrs\"") != std::string::npos && inventory.find("\"path\":\"bin/") == std::string::npos &&
        inventory.find("\"edition\":\"merscom+kabus22patch\"") != std::string::npos, "Root inventory must list game files only");
    const auto clean = verify(root);
    require(clean.ok() && clean.checked == game.size() + 2 + 4, "Fresh installation must verify: " + std::to_string(clean.checked));

    put(root/"kayit0.sav", "my save");
    put(root/"options.k22", "my options");
    struct stat saveBefore{}, optionsBefore{};
    require(::stat((root/"kayit0.sav").c_str(), &saveBefore) == 0 && ::stat((root/"options.k22").c_str(), &optionsBefore) == 0, "stat");
    fs::remove_all(root/"game/Help");
    fs::remove(root/"game/Kaynak.k22");
    put(root/"game/K22.wrs", "tampered");
    put(root/"game/turkce.k22", "tampered");
    put(win/"turkce.k22", "another edition");
    put(root/"versions"/version/"bin/kabus22-launcher", "tampered payload");
    const auto broken = verify(root);
    const auto payloadPath = "versions/" + version + "/bin/kabus22-launcher";
    require(broken.missing == Paths{"game/Help/Help_Files/fon_LOGO.jpg", "game/Kaynak.k22"} &&
        broken.modified == Paths{"game/K22.wrs", "game/turkce.k22", payloadPath}, "Verify must report missing and modified files");

    const auto repaired = repair(root, win, {});
    require(get(root/"game/K22.wrs") == "WRS2 campaign" && get(root/"game/Kaynak.k22") == "kaynak" &&
        get(root/"game/Help/Help_Files/fon_LOGO.jpg") == "logo", "Repair did not restore game files");
    // Different source bytes and payload are never written; saves/options untouched.
    require(repaired.missing.empty() && repaired.modified == Paths{"game/turkce.k22", payloadPath} &&
        get(root/"game/turkce.k22") == "tampered" && get(root/"versions"/version/"bin/kabus22-launcher") == "tampered payload",
        "Repair must restore only inventory-identical game bytes");
    struct stat saveAfter{}, optionsAfter{};
    require(::stat((root/"kayit0.sav").c_str(), &saveAfter) == 0 && ::stat((root/"options.k22").c_str(), &optionsAfter) == 0 &&
        get(root/"kayit0.sav") == "my save" && get(root/"options.k22") == "my options" &&
        saveAfter.st_ino == saveBefore.st_ino && saveAfter.st_mtim.tv_nsec == saveBefore.st_mtim.tv_nsec &&
        optionsAfter.st_ino == optionsBefore.st_ino && optionsAfter.st_mtim.tv_nsec == optionsBefore.st_mtim.tv_nsec,
        "Repair touched saves or options");
    require(std::none_of(fs::directory_iterator(root), fs::directory_iterator(), [](const auto& entry) {
        return entry.path().filename().string().starts_with(".kabus22-setup-"); }), "Repair left its staging directory");
    put(win/"turkce.k22", "language");
    put(root/"versions"/version/"bin/kabus22-launcher", "launcher");
    require(repair(root, win, {}).ok() && verify(root).ok(), "Repair from the matching source must fully verify");
    fs::remove(root/".kabus22-owned");
    require(fails([&] { verify(root); }), "Verify must refuse a root without the ownership marker");
}

// Reinstall commit: empty and owned folders are replaced keeping user files, shortcuts are replaced,
// failures roll back, foreign folders and directory shortcuts are refused untouched.
void reinstall(const fs::path& base, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>& game) {
    const auto root = base/"re/kabus22", apps = base/"re/apps/kabus22-native.desktop", desk = base/"re/desktop/kabus22-native.desktop";
    const auto stage = [&](const fs::path& at, const std::string& extra) {
        for (const auto& [name, data] : game) put(at/"game"/name, data);
        put(at/"game"/extra, extra);
        put(at/"bin/kabus22", "engine"); put(at/"bin/kabus22-launcher", "launcher");
        put(at/"lib/libdemo.so.1", "library"); put(at/"share/licenses/kabus22/notice", "notice"); put(at/"kabus22.png", "icon");
        finalizeInstallation(at, {root, base, "iso", "merscom", {apps, desk}});
        return get(at/".kabus22-inventory.json");
    };
    const auto names = [](const fs::path& folder) {
        std::set<std::string> result;
        for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(folder)) result.insert(entry.path().filename().string());
        return result;
    };
    fs::create_directories(root);
    const auto first = stage(base/"s1", "first-only.k22");
    const auto owned = names(base/"s1");
    publish(base/"s1", root, {});
    require(verify(root).ok() && get(root/".kabus22-inventory.json") == first && !fs::exists(base/"s1"), "Empty folder must receive the installation");

    put(root/"options.k22", "my options"); put(root/"_data/saves/kayit0.sav", "my save"); put(root/".launcher.lock", "");
    put(apps, "old entry"); fs::create_directories(desk.parent_path()); fs::create_symlink("/nonexistent", desk);

    const auto userKept = [&] {

    };

    require(fails([&] { publish(base/"s2", root, {{base/"sc/a", apps}, {base/"sc/missing", desk}}); }), "Missing staged shortcut must fail");
    require(get(root/".kabus22-inventory.json") == first && fs::exists(root/"game/first-only.k22") && verify(root).ok() && userKept() &&
        get(apps) == "old entry" && fs::is_symlink(desk) && get(base/"sc/a") == "new entry" && fs::exists(base/"s2/game/second-only.k22"),
        "Failed reinstall must restore the old installation, shortcuts and staging");

    publish(base/"s2", root, {{base/"sc/a", apps}, {base/"sc/b", desk}});
    auto expected = owned;
    expected.insert({"options.k22", "_data", ".launcher.lock"});
    require(verify(root).ok() && get(root/".kabus22-inventory.json") == second && !fs::exists(root/"game/first-only.k22") &&
        fs::exists(root/"game/second-only.k22") && names(root) == expected && userKept(),
        "Reinstall must leave exactly the new installation plus user files");
    require(get(apps) == "new entry" && !fs::is_symlink(desk) && get(desk) == "new entry" &&
        !fs::exists(base/"s2") && !fs::exists(base/"sc/a") && !fs::exists(base/"sc/b"), "Reinstall must replace shortcuts and remove staging");

    put(base/"foreign/notes.txt", "mine");
    stage(base/"s3", "third.k22");
    require(fails([&] { publish(base/"s3", base/"foreign", {}); }) && names(base/"foreign") == std::set<std::string>{"notes.txt"} &&
        get(base/"foreign/notes.txt") == "mine" && fs::exists(base/"s3/.kabus22-owned"), "Foreign non-empty folder must be refused untouched");
    put(base/"sc/c", "new entry"); fs::create_directories(base/"dirapps/kabus22-native.desktop");
    require(fails([&] { publish(base/"s3", base/"fresh", {{base/"sc/c", base/"dirapps/kabus22-native.desktop"}}); }) &&
        !fs::exists(base/"fresh") && fs::exists(base/"s3/.kabus22-owned") && get(base/"sc/c") == "new entry", "Directory shortcut must be refused before changes");
    publish(base/"s3", base/"fresh", {});
    require(verify(base/"fresh").ok() && !fs::exists(base/"s3"), "Missing root must receive the installation");
}
}
```

```cpp
// Asset-free regressions for k22::layout and k22::update (no network).
#include "layout.hpp"
#include "update.hpp"

int failures = 0;
void check(bool good, const std::string& what) {
    if (!good) { ++failures; std::cerr << "FAIL: " << what << '\n'; }
}
template <class F> void throws(F&& body, const std::string& what) {
    try { body(); check(false, what + " (did not throw)"); } catch (const std::exception&) {}
}
void put(const fs::path& path, const std::string& data, mode_t mode = 0644) {
    fs::create_directories(path.parent_path());
    std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary) << data;
    ::chmod(path.c_str(), mode);
}
std::string get(const fs::path& path) {
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    std::stringstream out; out << in.rdbuf(); return out.str();
}
// Everything in root except layout-owned entries, with content: must never change.
std::map<std::string, std::string> foreign(const fs::path& root) {
    std::map<std::string, std::string> result;
    for (auto it = fs::recursive_directory_iterator(root); it != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); ++it) {
        const auto relative = it->path().lexically_relative(root);
        const auto top = relative.begin()->string();
        if (top == "bin" || top == "lib" || top == "share" || top == "current" || top == "versions") { if (it.depth() == 0) it.disable_recursion_pending(); continue; }
        result[relative.string()] = it->is_regular_file() ? get(it->path()) : "<dir>";
    }
    return result;
}
fs::path stage(const fs::path& root, const std::string& version, const std::string& marker) {
    const auto staged = layout::stage_dir(root, version);
    put(staged/"bin/kabus22", marker, 0755);
    put(staged/"lib/libx.so.1", marker);
    put(staged/"share/licenses/n.txt", marker);
    return staged;
}
void layoutChecks(const fs::path& base) {
    const auto root = base/"install";
    put(root/".kabus22-owned", "Kabus22 native installation 1\n");
    put(root/"bin/kabus22", "old engine", 0755);
    put(root/"bin/kabus22-launcher", "old launcher", 0755);
    put(root/"lib/libold.so.1", "old lib");
    put(root/"share/licenses/kabus22/n.txt", "notice");
    put(root/"game/K22.wrs", "original asset");
    put(root/"kayit1.sav", "save slot");
    put(root/"options.k22", "options");
    put(root/"kabus22.png", "icon");
    const auto untouched = foreign(root);
    throws([&] { layout::commit(root, layout::stage_dir(root, "0.3.0"), "0.3.0"); }, "commit on flat layout");
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(root/"versions")) fs::remove_all(entry.path());
    check(layout::active_version(root).empty(), "flat root has no active version");
    // Crash after moving bin only: migration resumes.
    fs::create_directories(root/"versions/0.2.0");
    fs::rename(root/"bin", root/"versions/0.2.0/bin");
    layout::migrate_flat(root, "0.2.0");
    check(layout::active_version(root) == "0.2.0", "migrated active version");
    check(fs::read_symlink(root/"current") == "versions/0.2.0" && fs::read_symlink(root/"bin") == "current/bin", "relative current/compat links");
    check(get(root/"bin/kabus22") == "old engine" && get(root/"lib/libold.so.1") == "old lib", "payload reachable through compat links");
    layout::migrate_flat(root, "0.2.0");
    check(layout::active_version(root) == "0.2.0" && layout::installed_versions(root) == std::vector<std::string>{"0.2.0"}, "migration is idempotent");
    // Crash after the current swap, before compat links and .state.
    fs::remove(root/"lib"); fs::remove(root/"versions/.state");
    layout::migrate_flat(root, "0.2.0");
    check(fs::read_symlink(root/"lib") == "current/lib", "resumed compat link");
    check(layout::find_root(root/"versions/0.2.0/bin/kabus22") == root, "find_root from versioned executable");
    check(layout::find_root(root/"bin/kabus22") == root, "find_root through compat link");
    check(layout::find_root(base/"elsewhere/bin/x").empty(), "find_root without marker");
    // Commit, retention and rollback.
    layout::commit(root, stage(root, "0.2.1", "engine 0.2.1"), "0.2.1");
    check(layout::active_version(root) == "0.2.1" && layout::previous_version(root) == "0.2.0", "commit 0.2.1");
    check(get(root/"bin/kabus22") == "engine 0.2.1", "compat link follows current");
    fs::create_directories(root/"versions/.stage-0.9.9-crashed");
    put(root/"versions/.stage-0.9.9-crashed.tar.gz", "partial");
    ::symlink("versions/0.2.0", (root/"versions/.tmp-current-1").c_str());
    layout::commit(root, stage(root, "0.3.0-beta.1", "engine beta"), "0.3.0-beta.1");
    check(layout::installed_versions(root) == std::vector<std::string>{"0.2.1", "0.3.0-beta.1"}, "retains only active+previous");
    check(!fs::exists(fs::symlink_status(root/"versions/.stage-0.9.9-crashed")) && !fs::exists(fs::symlink_status(root/"versions/.tmp-current-1")), "crash leftovers pruned");
    throws([&] { layout::commit(root, stage(root, "0.3.0-beta.1", "dup"), "0.3.0-beta.1"); }, "commit of active version");
    throws([&] { layout::commit(root, base, "0.4.0"); }, "commit of foreign directory");
    layout::rollback(root);
    check(layout::active_version(root) == "0.2.1" && layout::previous_version(root) == "0.3.0-beta.1", "rollback");
    check(get(root/"bin/kabus22") == "engine 0.2.1", "rollback payload");
    layout::rollback(root);
    check(layout::active_version(root) == "0.3.0-beta.1", "rollback toggles");
    // Crash after current swap but before .state: previous is the recorded active.
    std::ofstream(root/"versions/.state") << "active=0.2.1\nprevious=0.2.0\n";
    check(layout::previous_version(root) == "0.2.1", "stale .state after swap");
    {
        layout::Lock lock(root);
        throws([&] { layout::Lock second(root); }, "concurrent lock");
    }
    layout::Lock again(root);
    check(foreign(root) == untouched, "saves, options, game and icon untouched");
    throws([&] { layout::migrate_flat(base/"nomarker", "0.2.0"); }, "unowned root");
    throws([&] { layout::stage_dir(root, "../x"); }, "invalid version");
}
void versionChecks() {
    const char* order[] = {"0.9.0", "0.10.0", "1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha.1", "1.0.0-alpha.beta", "1.0.0-beta",
                           "1.0.0-beta.2", "1.0.0-beta.11", "1.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0", "1.0.1"};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < std::size(order); ++i)
        check(update::compare_versions(order[i], order[i + 1]) < 0 && update::compare_versions(order[i + 1], order[i]) > 0, std::string("semver ") + order[i]);
    check(update::compare_versions("1.0.0+build.1", "1.0.0") == 0, "build metadata ignored");
    throws([] { update::compare_versions("1.0", "1.0.0"); }, "invalid semver");
    const auto releases = update::parse_releases(R"([
        {"tag_name":"v0.4.0","draft":true,"prerelease":false,"assets":[]},
        {"tag_name":"v0.3.0-beta.1","draft":false,"prerelease":true,"body":"beta","published_at":"2026-10-02T00:00:00Z","assets":[]},
        {"tag_name":"nightly","draft":false,"prerelease":true,"assets":[]},
        {"tag_name":"v0.2.1","draft":false,"prerelease":false,"body":"notes","published_at":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z",
         "assets":[{"name":"kabus22-update.json","browser_download_url":"https://example.invalid/m","size":10}]},
        {"tag_name":"0.2.0","draft":false,"prerelease":false,"body":null,"assets":[]}])");
    check(releases.size() == 3, "drafts and non-semver tags skipped");
    const auto* stable = update::select(releases, "stable");
    check(stable && stable->version == "0.2.1" && stable->notes == "notes" && stable->assets.size() == 1 && stable->assets[0].size == 10, "stable channel");
    const auto* experimental = update::select(releases, "experimental");
    check(experimental && experimental->version == "0.3.0-beta.1", "experimental channel");
    check(!update::select(releases, "stable", "0.3.0-beta.1"), "stable excludes prerelease by version");
    check(update::select(releases, "stable", "0.2.0") != nullptr, "exact version");
    throws([] { update::parse_releases("{\"message\":\"rate limited\"}"); }, "non-array API response");
    check(update::valid_repository("sergen213/kabus22-linux") && !update::valid_repository("a/../b") && !update::valid_repository("a/b/c"), "repository validation");
}
std::string b64(const std::string& data) {
    std::string out(4 * ((data.size() + 2) / 3) + 1, '\0');
    out.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(EVP_EncodeBlock(reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(out.data()), reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(data.data()), static_cast<int>(data.size()))));
    return out;
}
struct Key {
    std::unique_ptr<EVP_PKEY, decltype(&EVP_PKEY_free)> pkey{nullptr, EVP_PKEY_free};
    Key() { pkey.reset(EVP_PKEY_Q_keygen(nullptr, nullptr, "ED25519")); }
    std::string publicKey() const { std::string raw(32, '\0'); std::size_t size = 32; EVP_PKEY_get_raw_public_key(pkey.get(), reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(raw.data()), &size); return b64(raw); }
    std::string sign(const std::string& data) const {
        std::unique_ptr<EVP_MD_CTX, decltype(&EVP_MD_CTX_free)> context(EVP_MD_CTX_new(), EVP_MD_CTX_free);
        std::string signature(64, '\0'); std::size_t size = 64;
        EVP_DigestSignInit(context.get(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, pkey.get());
        EVP_DigestSign(context.get(), reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(signature.data()), &size, reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(data.data()), data.size());
        return b64(signature) + "\n";
    }
};
void signatureChecks() {
    const Key key, other;
    const std::string manifest = R"({"format":1,"version":"0.2.1","channel":"stable","min_glibc":"2.38","payload":{"name":"kabus22-0.2.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz","sha256":")"
        + std::string(64, 'a') + R"(","size":123},"components":["engine","launcher"]})";
    const auto signature = key.sign(manifest);
    const auto parsed = update::verify_manifest(manifest, signature, key.publicKey());
    check(parsed.version == "0.2.1" && parsed.size == 123 && parsed.sha256 == std::string(64, 'a') && parsed.components.size() == 2, "valid manifest accepted");
    auto tampered = manifest; tampered[tampered.find("2.38") + 3] = '9';
    throws([&] { update::verify_manifest(tampered, signature, key.publicKey()); }, "tampered manifest");
    auto hash = manifest; hash.replace(hash.find(std::string(64, 'a')), 64, std::string(64, 'b'));
    throws([&] { update::verify_manifest(hash, signature, key.publicKey()); }, "tampered payload hash");
    throws([&] { update::verify_manifest(manifest, signature, other.publicKey()); }, "wrong key");
    throws([&] { update::verify_manifest(manifest, b64(std::string(63, 'x')), key.publicKey()); }, "short signature");
    auto badName = manifest; badName.replace(badName.find("0.2.1-linux"), 5, "0.2.2");
    throws([&] { update::verify_manifest(badName, key.sign(badName), key.publicKey()); }, "signed but inconsistent payload name");
    check(update::public_key().size() == 44, "embedded public key present");
    update::require_glibc("2.17");
    throws([] { update::require_glibc("99.0"); }, "glibc minimum");
}
struct Entry { std::string name; mode_t type; mode_t mode = 0644; std::string data, link; bool hard = false; };
void archiveOf(const fs::path& path, const std::vector<Entry>& entries) {
    std::unique_ptr<archive, decltype(&archive_write_free)> out(archive_write_new(), archive_write_free);
    archive_write_add_filter_gzip(out.get());
    archive_write_set_format_pax_restricted(out.get());
    archive_write_open_filename(out.get(), path.c_str());
    for (const auto& item : entries) {
        std::unique_ptr<archive_entry, decltype(&archive_entry_free)> entry(archive_entry_new(), archive_entry_free);
        archive_entry_set_pathname(entry.get(), item.name.c_str());
        archive_entry_set_filetype(entry.get(), item.type);
        archive_entry_set_perm(entry.get(), item.mode);
        if (item.hard) archive_entry_set_hardlink(entry.get(), item.link.c_str());
        else if (!item.link.empty()) archive_entry_set_symlink(entry.get(), item.link.c_str());
        archive_entry_set_size(entry.get(), item.type == AE_IFREG && !item.hard ? static_cast<la_int64_t>(item.data.size()) : 0);
        archive_write_header(out.get(), entry.get());
        if (!item.data.empty()) archive_write_data(out.get(), item.data.data(), item.data.size());
    }
    archive_write_close(out.get());
}
void archiveChecks(const fs::path& base) {
    const std::vector<Entry> valid = {{"bin", AE_IFDIR, 0755}, {"bin/kabus22", AE_IFREG, 0755, "engine"},
        {"./bin/kabus22-launcher", AE_IFREG, 0755, "launcher"}, {"bin/kabus22-setup", AE_IFREG, 0755, "setup"},
        {"bin/kabus22-updater", AE_IFREG, 0755, "updater"},
        {"lib/libx.so.1", AE_IFREG, 0644, "lib"}, {"lib/libx.so", AE_IFLNK, 0777, "", "libx.so.1"}, {"share/n.txt", AE_IFREG, 0644, "n"}};
    fs::create_directories(base/"archives");
    int index = 0;
    const auto run = [&](const std::vector<Entry>& entries) {
        const auto archivePath = base/"archives"/(std::to_string(++index) + ".tar.gz");
        const auto stageDir = base/"archives"/("stage" + std::to_string(index));
        archiveOf(archivePath, entries);
        fs::create_directory(stageDir);
        update::extract_payload(archivePath, stageDir, "0.2.1");
        return stageDir;
    };
    const auto good = run(valid);
    check(get(good/"bin/kabus22") == "engine" && fs::read_symlink(good/"lib/libx.so") == "libx.so.1", "valid payload extracted");
    const auto payload = get(good/".kabus22-payload.json");
    check(payload.find("\"path\":\"bin/kabus22\"") != std::string::npos && payload.find("\"version\":\"0.2.1\"") != std::string::npos &&
          payload.find(update::sha256_file(good/"bin/kabus22")) != std::string::npos, "payload inventory written");
    const std::vector<std::vector<Entry>> hostile = {
        {{"../evil", AE_IFREG, 0644, "x"}}, {{"/tmp/k22-evil", AE_IFREG, 0644, "x"}}, {{"bin/../../evil", AE_IFREG, 0644, "x"}},
        {{"game/K22.wrs", AE_IFREG, 0644, "x"}}, {{"kayit1.sav", AE_IFREG, 0644, "x"}},
        {{"lib/escape", AE_IFLNK, 0777, "", "../../etc"}}, {{"lib/abs", AE_IFLNK, 0777, "", "/etc/passwd"}},
        {{"lib/d", AE_IFLNK, 0777, "", "../share"}, {"lib/d/x", AE_IFREG, 0644, "x"}},
        {{"bin/kabus22", AE_IFREG, 0755, "e"}, {"bin/hard", AE_IFREG, 0644, "", "bin/kabus22", true}},
        {{"bin/dev", AE_IFCHR, 0644}}, {{"bin/fifo", AE_IFIFO, 0644}}, {{"bin/suid", AE_IFREG, 04755, "x"}},
        {{"bin/kabus22", AE_IFREG, 0755, "only engine"}}};
    // Each hostile entry follows an otherwise valid payload, so only it can cause rejection.
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < hostile.size(); ++i) {
        auto entries = i + 1 == hostile.size() ? std::vector<Entry>{} : valid;
        if (i == 8) entries.erase(entries.begin() + 1);
        entries.insert(entries.end(), hostile[i].begin(), hostile[i].end());
        std::string why;
        try { run(entries); } catch (const std::exception& error) { why = error.what(); }
        std::cout << "hostile archive " << i << " rejected: " << why << '\n';
        check(!why.empty() && why.find("lacks executable") == std::string::npos ? true : i + 1 == hostile.size() && !why.empty(), "hostile archive " + std::to_string(i) + ": " + why);
    }
    check(!fs::exists(base/"evil") && !fs::exists("/tmp/k22-evil") && !fs::exists(base/"archives/share/x"), "nothing written outside stage");
}
}

int main() {
    char pattern[] = "/tmp/k22-update-check-XXXXXX";
    const fs::path base = ::mkdtemp(pattern);
    try { layoutChecks(base); versionChecks(); signatureChecks(); archiveChecks(base); }
    catch (const std::exception& error) { std::cerr << "FAIL: unexpected exception: " << error.what() << '\n'; ++failures; }
    fs::remove_all(base);
    if (failures) { std::cerr << failures << " updater check(s) failed\n"; return 1; }
    std::cout << "Updater layout/version/signature/archive checks passed\n";
}
```

`installer/check_updater_e2e.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end kabus22-updater check against a local HTTP fixture (CTest).

Uses the test-only kabus22-updater-testhttp build (K22_UPDATER_TEST_HTTP: admits
http://127.0.0.1 and env-supplied API base/public key) and the real release tools in
tools/release. The shipped kabus22-updater is only checked offline (identity, status,
absence of the test hooks). Usage: check_updater_e2e.py TESTHTTP_UPDATER RELEASE_UPDATER
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import functools
import hashlib
import http.server
import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import threading
from pathlib import Path

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "tools/release"


def run(*args, check=True, env=None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    result = subprocess.run([str(arg) for arg in args], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if check and result.returncode:
        raise AssertionError(f"{args} failed {result.returncode}:\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}")
    return result


def snapshot(root: Path) -> dict:
    """Everything except layout-owned entries; must never change."""
    result = {}
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        relative = path.relative_to(root)
        if relative.parts[0] in ("bin", "lib", "share", "current", "versions"):
            continue
        result[str(relative)] = path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() else "dir"
    return result


def full(root: Path) -> dict:
    result = {}
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        if path.is_symlink():
            result[str(path.relative_to(root))] = "->" + os.readlink(path)
        elif path.is_file():
            result[str(path.relative_to(root))] = path.read_bytes()
    return result


def tree(base: Path, marker: str) -> Path:
    for name in ("kabus22", "kabus22-launcher", "kabus22-setup", "kabus22-updater", "innoextract"):
        (base / "bin").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (base / "bin" / name).write_text(f"#!/bin/sh\necho {name} {marker}\n")
        (base / "bin" / name).chmod(0o755)
    (base / "lib").mkdir()
    (base / "lib/libk22test.so.1").write_text(marker)
    (base / "lib/libk22test.so").symlink_to("libk22test.so.1")
    (base / "share/licenses").mkdir(parents=True)
    (base / "share/licenses/NOTICE.txt").write_text("notice " + marker)
    return base


def release(tag: str, prerelease: bool, port: int, directory: str, names: list[str]) -> dict:
    return {"tag_name": "v" + tag, "draft": False, "prerelease": prerelease, "body": f"Notes for {tag}",
            "published_at": "2026-10-09T00:00:00Z",
            "assets": [{"name": name, "size": 0, "browser_download_url": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{directory}/{name}"}
                       for name in names]}


class Quiet(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args) -> None:
        pass


def main() -> None:
    testhttp, shipped = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="k22-updater-e2e-") as scratch:
        work = Path(scratch)
        key, wrong = work / "key", work / "wrong-key"
        public = run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "sign_manifest.py", "--generate-key", key).stdout.strip()
        run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "sign_manifest.py", "--generate-key", wrong)
        assert oct(key.stat().st_mode & 0o777) == "0o600" and public not in key.read_text()
        assert run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "sign_manifest.py", "--public-key", "--key", key).stdout.strip() == public
        server = work / "server"
        payload_names = lambda version: ["kabus22-update.json", "kabus22-update.json.sig", f"kabus22-{version}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"]

        def build(version: str, channel: str, directory: str, signer: Path = key) -> Path:
            out = server / directory
            run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "make_update_manifest.py", "--tree", tree(work / ("tree-" + directory), version),
                "--version", version, "--channel", channel, "--output-dir", out)
            run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "sign_manifest.py", out / "kabus22-update.json", "--key", signer)
            return out

        def handmade(version: str, directory: str, members: list[tuple[str, bytes]], manifest_version: str | None = None) -> None:
            out = server / directory
            out.mkdir(parents=True)
            buffer = io.BytesIO()
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer, mode="w:gz") as archive:
                for name, data in members:
                    info = tarfile.TarInfo(name)
                    info.size, info.mode = len(data), 0o755
                    archive.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
            data = buffer.getvalue()
            name = f"kabus22-{manifest_version or version}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
            (out / f"kabus22-{version}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz").write_bytes(data)
            (out / name).write_bytes(data)
            manifest = {"format": 1, "version": manifest_version or version, "channel": "stable", "min_glibc": "2.17",
                        "payload": {"name": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "size": len(data)}}
            (out / "kabus22-update.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
            run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "sign_manifest.py", out / "kabus22-update.json", "--key", key)

        # Release tooling refuses non-payload content.
        bad_tree = tree(work / "bad-tree", "x")
        (bad_tree / "game").mkdir()
        assert run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "make_update_manifest.py", "--tree", bad_tree, "--version", "9.9.9",
                   "--channel", "stable", "--output-dir", work / "refused", check=False).returncode
        (bad_tree / "game").rmdir()
        (bad_tree / "share/K22.wrs").write_text("asset")
        assert run(sys.executable, TOOLS / "make_update_manifest.py", "--tree", bad_tree, "--version", "9.9.9",
                   "--channel", "stable", "--output-dir", work / "refused", check=False).returncode

        build("0.4.2", "stable", "good-0.4.2")
        build("0.5.0-beta.1", "experimental", "good-0.5.0-beta.1")
        tampered = build("0.4.3", "stable", "bad-0.4.3")
        payload = tampered / "kabus22-0.4.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
        payload.write_bytes(payload.read_bytes()[:-1] + bytes([payload.read_bytes()[-1] ^ 1]))
        build("0.4.4", "stable", "bad-0.4.4", signer=wrong)
        edited = build("0.4.5", "stable", "bad-0.4.5")
        (edited / "kabus22-update.json").write_text((edited / "kabus22-update.json").read_text().replace("2.38", "2.17"))
        build("0.4.6", "experimental", "bad-0.4.6")
        handmade("0.4.7", "bad-0.4.7", [("bin/kabus22", b"x"), ("bin/kabus22-launcher", b"x"), ("bin/kabus22-setup", b"x"), ("bin/kabus22-updater", b"x"),
                                         ("../escaped", b"x")])
        handmade("0.4.8", "bad-0.4.8", [("bin/kabus22", b"x"), ("bin/kabus22-launcher", b"x"), ("bin/kabus22-setup", b"x"), ("bin/kabus22-updater", b"x")],
                 manifest_version="0.4.2")

        handler = functools.partial(Quiet, directory=str(server))
        httpd = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), handler)
        port = httpd.server_address[1]
        good = [release("0.4.2", False, port, "good-0.4.2", payload_names("0.4.2")),
                release("0.5.0-beta.1", True, port, "good-0.5.0-beta.1", payload_names("0.5.0-beta.1"))]
        bad = [release(version, False, port, "bad-" + version, payload_names(version))
               for version in ("0.4.3", "0.4.4", "0.4.5", "0.4.6", "0.4.7", "0.4.8")]
        for repository, releases in (("o/n", good), ("o/bad", bad)):
            (server / "repos" / repository).mkdir(parents=True)
            (server / "repos" / repository / "releases").write_text(json.dumps(releases))
        threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        try:
            root = work / "install"
            for name in ("kabus22", "kabus22-launcher"):
                (root / "bin").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (root / "bin" / name).write_text("legacy " + name)
                (root / "bin" / name).chmod(0o755)
            (root / "lib").mkdir()
            (root / "lib/libold.so.1").write_text("old")
            (root / "share/licenses").mkdir(parents=True)
            (root / ".kabus22-owned").write_text("Kabus22 native installation 1\n")
            (root / "game").mkdir()
            (root / "game/K22.wrs").write_text("original asset")
            (root / "kayit1.sav").write_text("save slot")
            (root / "options.k22").write_text("options")
            untouched = snapshot(root)
            config = work / "config/kabus22"
            config.mkdir(parents=True)
            (config / "updates.ini").write_text("[Updates]\nrepository=o/n\nchannel=stable\n")
            env = {**os.environ, "HOME": str(work), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(work / "config"),
                   "KABUS22_UPDATER_TEST_API": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", "KABUS22_UPDATER_TEST_PUBLIC_KEY": public}
            updater = lambda *args, check=True: run(testhttp, "--install-dir", root, *args, check=check, env=env)

            for binary in (testhttp, shipped):
                assert run(binary, "--version").stdout.startswith("kabus22 native updater 0.4.1")
                assert "--rollback" in run(binary, "--help").stdout
            assert b"KABUS22_UPDATER_TEST_API" not in shipped.read_bytes() and b"KABUS22_UPDATER_TEST_API" in testhttp.read_bytes()
            assert run(shipped, "--install-dir", root, "--check", "--repository", "bad", check=False).returncode == 2

            check = json.loads(updater("--check", "--json").stdout)
            assert check == {"current": "0.4.1", "latest": "0.4.2", "channel": "stable", "update_available": True,
                             "notes": "Notes for 0.4.2", "published": "2026-10-09T00:00:00Z", "repository": "o/n"}, check
            assert json.loads(updater("--check", "--json", "--channel", "experimental").stdout)["latest"] == "0.5.0-beta.1"
            assert "update available" in updater("--check").stdout

            applied = updater("--apply")
            lines = [line for line in applied.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("progress ")]
            assert lines[0].startswith("progress 0 ") and lines[-1].startswith("progress 100 "), applied.stdout
            assert all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 100 for line in lines)
            assert os.readlink(root / "current") == "versions/0.4.2" and os.readlink(root / "bin") == "current/bin"
            assert "kabus22 0.4.2" in run(root / "bin/kabus22").stdout
            assert (root / "versions/0.4.1/bin/kabus22").read_text() == "legacy kabus22"
            inventory = json.loads((root / "versions/0.4.2/.kabus22-payload.json").read_text())
            assert inventory["version"] == "0.4.2" and any(item["path"] == "bin/kabus22-updater" for item in inventory["files"])
            assert json.loads(updater("--status").stdout) == {"active": "0.4.2", "previous": "0.4.1", "installed": ["0.4.1", "0.4.2"]}
            assert snapshot(root) == untouched
            assert "Already up to date" in updater("--apply").stdout

            before = full(root)
            for version, reason in (("0.4.3", "SHA-256 mismatch"), ("0.4.4", "signature is invalid"),
                                    ("0.4.5", "signature is invalid"), ("0.4.6", "not a stable release"),
                                    ("0.4.7", "Unsafe payload path"), ("0.4.8", "does not match release")):
                result = updater("--apply", "--repository", "o/bad", "--version", version, check=False)
                assert result.returncode == 1 and reason in result.stderr, (version, result.stdout, result.stderr)
                assert full(root) == before, f"{version} changed the installation"
            assert not (work / "escaped").exists() and not (root / "escaped").exists()

            updater("--apply", "--channel", "experimental")
            status = json.loads(updater("--status").stdout)
            assert status == {"active": "0.5.0-beta.1", "previous": "0.4.2", "installed": ["0.4.2", "0.5.0-beta.1"]}, status
            assert "0.5.0-beta.1 -> 0.4.2" in updater("--rollback").stdout
            assert "kabus22 0.4.2" in run(root / "bin/kabus22").stdout
            assert json.loads(run(shipped, "--install-dir", root, "--status", env=env).stdout)["active"] == "0.4.2"
            assert snapshot(root) == untouched
        finally:
            httpd.shutdown()
    print("Updater end-to-end check/apply/reject/rollback passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```cpp
Options arguments(int argc,char** argv) {
    Options o;
    for(int i=1;i<argc;++i) {
        std::string flag=argv[i];
        if(flag=="--help"||flag=="-h") {o.help=true;continue;}
        if(flag=="--version") {o.version=true;continue;}
        if(flag=="--self-check") {o.check=true;continue;}
        if(i+1>=argc) throw std::runtime_error("Missing value for "+flag);
        std::string value=argv[++i]; if(value.empty())throw std::runtime_error("Empty value for "+flag);
        if(flag=="--install-dir") {if(!o.root.empty())throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate --install-dir");o.root=fs::absolute(value).lexically_normal();}
        else if(flag=="--engine") {if(!o.engine.empty())throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate --engine");o.engine=fs::absolute(value).lexically_normal();}
        else if(flag=="--renderer") {if(!o.renderer.empty())throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate --renderer");o.renderer=value;Preferences p;p.renderer=value;validatePreferences(p);}

struct Job {
    struct Stream {Job* job;bool error;} streams[2]{{this,false},{this,true}};
    UI* ui=nullptr;GPid pid=0;int status=0,open=3,log=-1;bool show=false,timedOut=false;guint timer=0,grace=0,watches[2]{};

    bool ok() const {return !timedOut&&WIFEXITED(status)&&WEXITSTATUS(status)==0;}
    std::string failure() const {
        std::string why=timedOut?"timed out":WIFEXITED(status)?"exited with status "+std::to_string(WEXITSTATUS(status)):WIFSIGNALED(status)?"stopped by signal "+std::to_string(WTERMSIG(status)):"failed";

    }

        gtk_entry_set_text(GTK_ENTRY(repository),s.updates.repository.c_str());select(channel,s.updates.channel);
        populating=false;
        populateRendering();
    }
    void populateRendering() {
        populating=true;
        gtk_container_foreach(GTK_CONTAINER(customGrid),+[](GtkWidget* w,gpointer){gtk_widget_destroy(w);},nullptr);optionWidgets.clear();gtk_list_store_clear(packs);
        gtk_combo_box_text_remove_all(GTK_COMBO_BOX_TEXT(preset));gtk_combo_box_text_remove_all(GTK_COMBO_BOX_TEXT(fpsLimit));gtk_widget_set_sensitive(fpsLimit,false);
        const Capabilities* caps=settings&&settings->capabilities?&*settings->capabilities:nullptr;
        if(!caps){gtk_combo_box_text_append(GTK_COMBO_BOX_TEXT(preset),"original","Original");select(preset,"original");gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(backends),valid(capsNote).c_str());populating=false;if(settings)availability();return;}
        for(const auto& name:caps->presets){std::string label=name;label[0]=g_ascii_toupper(label[0]);gtk_combo_box_text_append(GTK_COMBO_BOX_TEXT(preset),name.c_str(),label.c_str());}
        const auto& p=settings->preferences;select(preset,std::count(caps->presets.begin(),caps->presets.end(),p.preset)?p.preset:"original");
        std::string summary="Engine "+caps->version+" backends:";
        for(const auto& [name,state]:caps->backends)summary+="\n  "+name+": "+(state.first?"available":"unavailable")+(state.second.empty()?"":" — "+state.second);
        gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(backends),valid(summary).c_str());
        int y=0;
        for(int pass=0;pass<2;++pass)for(const auto& o:caps->options) {
            if(o.key=="backend"||o.key=="texture_packs"||(pass==1)!=(o.backends==std::vector<std::string>{"vulkan-rt"}))continue;
            if(pass==1&&y>=0&&!std::any_of(optionWidgets.begin(),optionWidgets.end(),[](const auto& w){return w.first.backends==std::vector<std::string>{"vulkan-rt"};})){auto* h=gtk_label_new(nullptr);gtk_label_set_markup(GTK_LABEL(h),"<b>Ray tracing (Vulkan RT only)</b>");gtk_label_set_xalign(GTK_LABEL(h),0);gtk_grid_attach(GTK_GRID(customGrid),h,0,y++,2,1);}
            // fps_limit has its own Rendering row and applies under every preset.
            const bool fps=o.key=="fps_limit";auto* w=fps?fpsLimit:gtk_combo_box_text_new();bool toggle=o.values==std::vector<std::string>{"0","1"};
            for(const auto& v:o.values)gtk_combo_box_text_append(GTK_COMBO_BOX_TEXT(w),v.c_str(),toggle?(v=="1"?"On":"Off"):!fps?v.c_str():v=="original"?"Original (campaign 72, Bonus 60)":v=="unlimited"?"Unlimited (vsync off)":(v+" FPS").c_str());
            auto saved=std::find_if(p.graphics.begin(),p.graphics.end(),[&](const auto& g){return g.first==o.key;});
            select(w,saved!=p.graphics.end()&&std::count(o.values.begin(),o.values.end(),saved->second)?saved->second:o.fallback);
            std::string tip="Engine key "+o.key+", default "+o.fallback+". Backends:";for(const auto& b:o.backends)tip+=" "+b;
            if(!fps)row(customGrid,y++,o.label.c_str(),w,tip.c_str());
            optionWidgets.emplace_back(o,w);
        }
        if(optionWidgets.empty())gtk_grid_attach(GTK_GRID(customGrid),note("This engine offers no custom graphics options."),0,0,2,1);
        std::vector<const Pack*> ordered;
        for(const auto& name:p.packs)for(const auto& pack:caps->packs)if(pack.name==name)ordered.push_back(&pack);
        for(const auto& pack:caps->packs)if(std::find(ordered.begin(),ordered.end(),&pack)==ordered.end())ordered.push_back(&pack);
        for(const auto* pack:ordered){
            bool on=pack->valid&&std::count(p.packs.begin(),p.packs.end(),pack->name);GtkTreeIter it;gtk_list_store_append(packs,&it);
            gtk_list_store_set(packs,&it,0,on,1,pack->name.c_str(),2,valid((pack->valid?"":"INVALID: ")+(pack->display.empty()?"":pack->display+" — ")+pack->detail).c_str(),3,pack->valid,-1);
        }
        gtk_widget_show_all(customGrid);populating=false;availability();
    }
    void readControls() {
        auto& s=*settings;auto& p=s.preferences;
        p.mode=selected(mode);p.renderer=selected(renderer);p.display=selected(display);p.window=selected(windowMode);p.language=selected(language);p.bonusLanguage=selected(bonusLanguage);p.audioLanguage=selected(audio);p.bonusAA=std::stoi(selected(aa));p.camera=selected(camera);p.resolution=gtk_entry_get_text(GTK_ENTRY(resolution));
        for(int i=0;i<31;++i) {
            int value=(i>=8&&i<=14)||i>=25?gtk_spin_button_get_value_as_int(GTK_SPIN_BUTTON(campaign[i])):std::stoi(selected(campaign[i]));
            s.campaign[i]=static_cast<unsigned char>(value+(i==9||i==11?100:i==10?80:0));
        }
        if(s.bonusAvailable)for(int i=0;i<5;++i)s.bonus[i]=i==4?gtk_spin_button_get_value_as_int(GTK_SPIN_BUTTON(bonus[i])):std::stoi(selected(bonus[i]));
        // Without capabilities the saved graphics choices stay untouched for a capable engine.
        if(s.capabilities) {
            p.preset=selected(preset);p.graphics.clear();p.packs.clear();
            for(const auto& [o,w]:optionWidgets){auto v=selected(w);if(v!=o.fallback)p.graphics.emplace_back(o.key,v);}
            GtkTreeIter it;for(bool more=gtk_tree_model_get_iter_first(GTK_TREE_MODEL(packs),&it);more;more=gtk_tree_model_iter_next(GTK_TREE_MODEL(packs),&it)){
                gboolean on=false;gchar* name=nullptr;gtk_tree_model_get(GTK_TREE_MODEL(packs),&it,0,&on,1,&name,-1);if(on)p.packs.emplace_back(name);g_free(name);
            }
        }
        auto& c=s.controller;c.mode=selected(padMode);c.vibration=gtk_toggle_button_get_active(GTK_TOGGLE_BUTTON(vibration));
        c.deadzone=std::round(gtk_spin_button_get_value(GTK_SPIN_BUTTON(deadzone))*100)/100;c.sensitivity=std::round(gtk_spin_button_get_value(GTK_SPIN_BUTTON(sensitivity))*100)/100;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<padButtons.size();++i)c.buttons[i].second=gtk_spin_button_get_value_as_int(GTK_SPIN_BUTTON(padButtons[i]));
        readUpdates();
    }
    void readUpdates() {settings->updates.repository=gtk_entry_get_text(GTK_ENTRY(repository));settings->updates.channel=selected(channel);}
    void loadRoot() {
        try {
            auto fresh=load(rootText(),options.engine);
            if(!options.renderer.empty())fresh.preferences.renderer=options.renderer;
            options.renderer.clear();
            settings=std::move(fresh);capsNote="Querying engine capabilities…";populate();
            auto icon=settings->root/"kabus22.png";if(fs::is_regular_file(icon))gtk_window_set_icon_from_file(GTK_WINDOW(window),icon.c_str(),nullptr);
            // Original setup's small wizard image, converted at install time; older installs stay plain.
            if(auto* small=k22::wizard::load(settings->root/"wizard-small-image.png")){gtk_image_set_from_pixbuf(GTK_IMAGE(headerImage),small);g_object_unref(small);}else gtk_image_clear(GTK_IMAGE(headerImage));
            std::string text="Settings loaded. Original game files and saves are untouched. Apply or Play commits private preferences.";
            for(const auto& w:settings->warnings)text+="\nWarning: "+w;
            message(text);describeInstallation();probe();
        } catch(const std::exception& error) {populating=false;settings.reset();latest.clear();previous.clear();capsNote="Load an installation to query engine capabilities.";describeInstallation();populateRendering();availability();message(error.what());}
    }
    void describeInstallation() {
        std::string text="Installation: "+rootText();
        try{auto active=k22::layout::active_version(rootText());text+=active.empty()?"\nLayout: flat (pre-0.2 install; the first update migrates it)":"\nActive version: "+active;}catch(const std::exception& e){text+=std::string("\n")+e.what();}
        text+=settings?"\nEngine: "+settings->engine.string():"\nNo loaded installation — use Install / Import below.";
        gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(installInfo),valid(text).c_str());
    }
    // ---- child processes ----
    static gboolean pipeReady(GIOChannel* channel,GIOCondition condition,gpointer data) {
        auto& stream=*static_cast<Job::Stream*>(data);auto& j=*stream.job;char buffer[4096];gsize count=0;GError* error=nullptr;
        for(int pass=0;;++pass) {
            auto result=g_io_channel_read_chars(channel,buffer,sizeof buffer,&count,&error);if(count)j.ui->received(j,stream.error,buffer,count);
            if(error){j.err+=std::string("\n")+error->message;g_error_free(error);break;}
            if(result==G_IO_STATUS_EOF)break;
            if(result==G_IO_STATUS_AGAIN||count==0){if(condition&(G_IO_ERR|G_IO_NVAL))break;return G_SOURCE_CONTINUE;}
            if(pass==3)return G_SOURCE_CONTINUE;
        }
        // closed() may destroy the job; nothing of it is touched afterwards.
        j.watches[stream.error]=0;j.ui->closed(j);return G_SOURCE_REMOVE;
    }
    void received(Job& j,bool error,const char* bytes,std::size_t size) {
        for(std::size_t offset=0;j.log>=0&&offset<size;){auto n=::write(j.log,bytes+offset,size-offset);if(n<0&&errno==EINTR)continue;if(n<=0)break;offset+=static_cast<std::size_t>(n);}
        if(j.show)appendLog(bytes,size);
        auto& sink=error?j.err:j.out;sink.append(bytes,size);if(error&&sink.size()>65536)sink.erase(0,sink.size()-65536);if(!error&&sink.size()>(4u<<20))sink.erase(0,sink.size()-(4u<<20));
        if(error)return;
        j.partial.append(bytes,size);
        for(auto end=j.partial.find('\n');end!=std::string::npos;end=j.partial.find('\n')){
            if(auto p=progressLine(std::string_view(j.partial).substr(0,end))){gtk_widget_show(progress);gtk_progress_bar_set_fraction(GTK_PROGRESS_BAR(progress),p->first/100.0);gtk_progress_bar_set_text(GTK_PROGRESS_BAR(progress),valid(std::to_string(p->first)+"%  "+p->second).c_str());}
            j.partial.erase(0,end+1);
        }
        if(j.partial.size()>65536)j.partial.clear();
    }
    void closed(Job& j) {
        if(--j.open)return;
        auto owned=std::move(job);if(owned->timer)g_source_remove(owned->timer);if(owned->grace)g_source_remove(owned->grace);if(owned->log>=0)::close(owned->log);
        gtk_widget_hide(progress);availability();
        try{if(owned->done)owned->done(*owned);}catch(const std::exception& e){message(e.what());}
        availability();refreshLogs();
    }
    void start(const char* kind,const std::vector<std::string>& args,const fs::path& working,bool show,guint seconds,std::function<void(Job&)> done) {
        binary(args.front());
        auto j=std::make_unique<Job>();j->ui=this;j->show=show;j->done=std::move(done);
        if(kind){
            auto [path,fd]=openLog(logDirectory(),kind);j->logPath=path;j->log=fd;
            std::string header="$";for(const auto& a:args){gchar* q=g_shell_quote(a.c_str());header+=" ";header+=q;g_free(q);}header+="\n";
            if(::write(fd,header.data(),header.size())<0){}
        }
        std::vector<gchar*> argv;for(const auto& a:args)argv.push_back(const_cast<gchar*>(a.c_str()));argv.push_back(nullptr);
        GError* error=nullptr;int out=-1,err=-1;
        if(!g_spawn_async_with_pipes(working.c_str(),argv.data(),nullptr,G_SPAWN_DO_NOT_REAP_CHILD,nullptr,nullptr,&j->pid,nullptr,&out,&err,&error)) {
            std::string why=error?error->message:"Cannot spawn "+args.front();if(error)g_error_free(error);if(j->log>=0)::close(j->log);throw std::runtime_error(why);
        }
        if(show){log.clear();appendLog("",0);}
        for(int i=0;i<2;++i){
            auto* channel=g_io_channel_unix_new(i?err:out);g_io_channel_set_close_on_unref(channel,true);g_io_channel_set_encoding(channel,nullptr,nullptr);g_io_channel_set_buffered(channel,false);g_io_channel_set_flags(channel,static_cast<GIOFlags>(g_io_channel_get_flags(channel)|G_IO_FLAG_NONBLOCK),nullptr);
            j->watches[i]=g_io_add_watch(channel,static_cast<GIOCondition>(G_IO_IN|G_IO_HUP|G_IO_ERR|G_IO_NVAL),pipeReady,&j->streams[i]);g_io_channel_unref(channel);
        }
        // A detached grandchild (e.g. settings opened from the installer) may keep the pipes open: stop reading shortly after our child exits.
        g_child_watch_add(j->pid,+[](GPid pid,gint result,gpointer data){
            auto& j=*static_cast<Job*>(data);g_spawn_close_pid(pid);j.pid=0;j.status=result;
            if(j.open>1)j.grace=g_timeout_add(500,+[](gpointer d)->gboolean{auto& j=*static_cast<Job*>(d);j.grace=0;for(auto& w:j.watches)if(w){g_source_remove(w);w=0;}j.open=1;j.ui->closed(j);return G_SOURCE_REMOVE;},data);
            j.ui->closed(j);
        },j.get());
        if(seconds)j->timer=g_timeout_add_seconds(seconds,+[](gpointer data)->gboolean{auto& j=*static_cast<Job*>(data);j.timer=0;if(j.pid>0){j.timedOut=true;::kill(j.pid,SIGKILL);}return G_SOURCE_REMOVE;},j.get());
        gtk_progress_bar_set_fraction(GTK_PROGRESS_BAR(progress),0);job=std::move(j);availability();
    }
    void appendLog(const char* bytes,std::size_t size) {
        log.append(bytes,size);if(log.size()>65536)log.erase(0,log.size()-65536);setText(logView,log);
    }
    // ---- engine ----
    void probe() {
        try {
            start(nullptr,{settings->engine.string(),"--list-capabilities"},settings->root,false,20,[](Job& j){
                auto& ui=*j.ui;if(!ui.settings)return;
                try{if(!j.ok())throw std::runtime_error("engine "+j.failure());ui.settings->capabilities=parseCapabilities(j.out);ui.capsNote.clear();}
                catch(const std::exception& e){ui.settings->capabilities.reset();ui.capsNote=std::string("Capabilities unavailable: ")+e.what()+"\nPresets, custom options and texture packs are disabled; the engine starts with original graphics.";}
                ui.populateRendering();ui.queryStatus();
            });
        } catch(const std::exception& e){capsNote=std::string("Capabilities unavailable: ")+e.what();populateRendering();}
    }
    void commit(bool launch) {
        try {
            if(!settings)throw std::runtime_error("Load an existing native installation first");
            readControls();auto args=command(*settings,options.frames);save(*settings);
            if(!launch){message("Settings applied to private files. Restart the game to use them.");return;}
            const auto working=settings->root/"game"/(settings->preferences.mode=="bonus"?"Kabus 22 Mode":"");
            start("engine",args,working,true,0,[](Job& j){
                auto& ui=*j.ui;
                // Refresh game-written settings before offering another Apply; keep startup diagnostics visible.
                ui.loadRoot();
                if(ui.settings){
                    if(j.ok())ui.message("Game exited normally. Settings refreshed from private game files. Log: "+j.logPath.string());
                    else ui.message("Native game "+j.failure()+"\nSee Game output below or "+j.logPath.string()+"; no API fallback was attempted.");
                }
            });
            message("Native game running. Close it before changing settings or closing the launcher. Log: "+job->logPath.string());
        } catch(const std::exception& error) {message(std::string("Apply / launch failed: ")+error.what()+"\nReload before retrying; any successfully committed private file is retained.");availability();}
    }
    void defaults() {
        if(!settings)return;
        // Keep unsaved edits on every other page; restore only the original game records.
        readControls();
        auto extra=settings->campaign.size()==32?std::optional<unsigned char>(settings->campaign[31]):std::nullopt;
        settings->campaign=settings->defaults;if(extra&&settings->campaign.size()==31)settings->campaign.push_back(*extra);
        settings->bonus=settings->bonusDefaults;
        if(settings->bonusAvailable&&settings->localeSource.bytes)settings->preferences.bonusLanguage=bonusMarkerLanguage(*settings->localeSource.bytes);
        populate();message("Supplied campaign / Bonus record defaults and Bonus locale restored in the controls only. Apply or Play to save; launcher API/display/AA choices are unchanged.");
    }
    // ---- installation (Contract C) ----
    void runSetup(std::vector<std::string> extra,const char* what,std::function<void(Job&)> done) {
        try{auto args=std::vector<std::string>{(tools()/"kabus22-setup").string()};args.insert(args.end(),extra.begin(),extra.end());start("setup",args,g_get_home_dir(),false,0,std::move(done));message(std::string(what)+" running. Log: "+job->logPath.string());}
        catch(const std::exception& e){message(std::string(what)+" failed: "+e.what());}
    }
    void chooseSource(bool folder) {
        auto* dialog=gtk_file_chooser_dialog_new(folder?"Choose original Windows Kabus 22 folder (K22.exe / K22.wrs)":"Choose original Kabus 22 ISO or setup.exe",GTK_WINDOW(window),folder?GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_SELECT_FOLDER:GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN,"_Cancel",GTK_RESPONSE_CANCEL,"_Select",GTK_RESPONSE_ACCEPT,nullptr);
        if(!folder){auto* filter=gtk_file_filter_new();gtk_file_filter_set_name(filter,"ISO image or setup.exe");gtk_file_filter_add_pattern(filter,"*.[iI][sS][oO]");gtk_file_filter_add_pattern(filter,"[sS][eE][tT][uU][pP].[eE][xX][eE]");gtk_file_chooser_add_filter(GTK_FILE_CHOOSER(dialog),filter);}
        if(gtk_dialog_run(GTK_DIALOG(dialog))==GTK_RESPONSE_ACCEPT){gchar* path=gtk_file_chooser_get_filename(GTK_FILE_CHOOSER(dialog));gtk_entry_set_text(GTK_ENTRY(source),path);g_free(path);}
        gtk_widget_destroy(dialog);availability();
    }
    void installGame() {
        std::vector<std::string> extra;std::string media=gtk_entry_get_text(GTK_ENTRY(source));if(!media.empty())extra={"--source",media};
        runSetup(extra,"Installer",[](Job& j){auto& ui=*j.ui;ui.loadRoot();ui.message(j.ok()?"Installer closed. Installation reloaded.":"Installer "+j.failure());});
    }
    void verifyAssets() {
        gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(installResult),"Verifying every installed file against .kabus22-inventory.json…");
        runSetup({"--verify","--install-dir",rootText(),"--json"},"Verification",[](Job& j){
            auto& ui=*j.ui;std::string text;
            try{
                if(!j.ok()&&!(WIFEXITED(j.status)&&WEXITSTATUS(j.status)==3))throw std::runtime_error("kabus22-setup "+j.failure());
                auto v=parseVerify(j.out);
                text=v.ok?"All "+std::to_string(v.checked)+" inventory files verified.":std::to_string(v.checked)+" files checked: "+std::to_string(v.missing.size())+" missing, "+std::to_string(v.modified.size())+" modified. Repair restores game files from the original media.";
                std::size_t shown=0;for(auto* list:{&v.missing,&v.modified})for(const auto& path:*list)if(shown++<40)text+=std::string(list==&v.missing?"\n  missing: ":"\n  modified: ")+path;
                if(shown>40)text+="\n  … "+std::to_string(shown-40)+" more (see log)";
            }catch(const std::exception& e){text=std::string("Verification failed: ")+e.what();}
            gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(ui.installResult),valid(text).c_str());ui.message("Verification finished. Log: "+j.logPath.string());
        });
    }
    void repairInstall() {
        gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(installResult),"Repairing game files from original media…");
        runSetup({"--repair","--install-dir",rootText(),"--source",gtk_entry_get_text(GTK_ENTRY(source)),"--unattended"},"Repair",[](Job& j){
            auto& ui=*j.ui;auto text=j.ok()?std::string("Repair finished. Run Verify assets to confirm."):"Repair "+j.failure();
            gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(ui.installResult),valid(text).c_str());ui.loadRoot();ui.message(text+"\nLog: "+j.logPath.string());
        });
    }
    // ---- updates (Contract B) ----
    std::vector<std::string> updater(std::initializer_list<const char*> command) {
        std::vector<std::string> args{(tools()/"kabus22-updater").string(),"--install-dir",settings->root.string()};args.insert(args.end(),command.begin(),command.end());return args;
    }
    void queryStatus() {
        if(!settings)return;
        try{start(nullptr,updater({"--status","--json"}),settings->root,false,30,[](Job& j){
            auto& ui=*j.ui;std::string text;ui.previous.clear();
            try{if(!j.ok())throw std::runtime_error("kabus22-updater "+j.failure());auto s=parseStatus(j.out);ui.previous=s.previous;
                text="Active: "+(s.active.empty()?std::string("flat legacy layout"):s.active)+"   Previous: "+(s.previous.empty()?std::string("none"):s.previous)+"\nInstalled:";for(const auto& v:s.installed)text+=" "+v;}
            catch(const std::exception& e){text=std::string("Update status unavailable: ")+e.what();}
            gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(ui.versions),valid("Launcher "+std::string(K22_VERSION)+"\n"+text).c_str());
        });}
        catch(const std::exception& e){gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(versions),valid(std::string("Update status unavailable: ")+e.what()).c_str());}
    }
    void check() {
        try{
            readUpdates();saveUpdates(*settings);latest.clear();
            const auto& u=settings->updates;
            start("updater",updater({"--check","--json","--channel",u.channel.c_str(),"--repository",u.repository.c_str()}),settings->root,false,0,[](Job& j){
                auto& ui=*j.ui;std::string text;
                try{if(!j.ok())throw std::runtime_error("kabus22-updater "+j.failure());auto c=parseCheck(j.out);
                    text="Current "+c.current+" — latest "+(c.latest.empty()?std::string("none published"):c.latest)+" on "+c.channel+" from "+c.repository+(c.published.empty()?"":" ("+c.published+")");
                    text+=c.available?"\nAn update is available. Apply update installs it beside the current version; Roll back restores the previous one.":"\nNo newer version is available.";
                    if(c.available)ui.latest=c.latest;
                    setText(ui.notes,c.notes.empty()?"(no release notes)":c.notes);}
                catch(const std::exception& e){text=std::string("Update check failed: ")+e.what();setText(ui.notes,"");}
                gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(ui.latestInfo),valid(text).c_str());ui.message("Update check finished. Log: "+j.logPath.string());
            });
            gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(latestInfo),"Checking…");
        }catch(const std::exception& e){message(std::string("Update check failed: ")+e.what());availability();}
    }
    void updateAction(bool undo) {
        try{
            readUpdates();saveUpdates(*settings);const auto& u=settings->updates;
            auto args=undo?updater({"--rollback"}):updater({"--apply","--version",latest.c_str(),"--channel",u.channel.c_str(),"--repository",u.repository.c_str()});
            start("updater",args,settings->root,false,0,[undo](Job& j){
                auto& ui=*j.ui;ui.latest.clear();
                auto text=j.ok()?std::string(undo?"Rolled back to the previous version.":"Update installed.")+" The game uses it on next Play; restart the launcher to use its new version.":std::string(undo?"Rollback ":"Update ")+j.failure()+"\nNothing was changed on failure.";
                gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(ui.latestInfo),valid(text).c_str());ui.loadRoot();ui.message(text+"\nLog: "+j.logPath.string());
            });
            message(std::string(undo?"Rolling back":"Downloading and verifying update")+"… Log: "+job->logPath.string());
        }catch(const std::exception& e){message(std::string("Update failed: ")+e.what());availability();}
    }
    // ---- logs ----
    void refreshLogs() {
        gtk_container_foreach(GTK_CONTAINER(logList),+[](GtkWidget* w,gpointer){gtk_widget_destroy(w);},nullptr);
        logPaths=listLogs(logDirectory());std::reverse(logPaths.begin(),logPaths.end());
        for(const auto& path:logPaths){auto* l=gtk_label_new(path.filename().c_str());gtk_label_set_xalign(GTK_LABEL(l),0);gtk_list_box_insert(GTK_LIST_BOX(logList),l,-1);}
        if(logPaths.empty())setText(logText,"No logs yet in "+logDirectory().string());
        gtk_widget_show_all(logList);
    }
    void showLog(int index) {
        if(index<0||index>=static_cast<int>(logPaths.size()))return;
        std::ifstream file(logPaths[index],std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate);if(!file){setText(logText,"Cannot read "+logPaths[index].string());return;}
        std::streamoff size=file.tellg(),start=std::max<std::streamoff>(0,size-262144);file.seekg(start);std::string bytes(static_cast<std::size_t>(size-start),'\0');file.read(bytes.data(),static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
        setText(logText,(start?"[… earlier output omitted]\n":"")+bytes);
    }

}
int main(int argc,char** argv) {
    try {
```

```cpp
void require(bool value, const std::string& message) { if (!value) throw std::runtime_error(message); }
struct Fd {
    int value;
    explicit Fd(int fd): value(fd) { require(fd >= 0, std::string("Cannot open settings path: ") + std::strerror(errno)); }
    ~Fd() { ::close(value); }
    Fd(const Fd&) = delete;

fs::path checkedAbsolute(const fs::path& path) { require(!path.empty(), "Empty settings path"); return fs::absolute(path).lexically_normal(); }
// Open every component without following links, including paths outside the installation.
int directory(const fs::path& path, bool create = false) {
    auto full = checkedAbsolute(path);
    int current = ::open("/", O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC);
    require(current >= 0, "Cannot open filesystem root");
    try {
        for (const auto& component : full.relative_path()) {
            if(component.empty())continue; // A trailing separator denotes this directory, not an empty child.
            if (create && ::mkdirat(current, component.c_str(), 0700) != 0 && errno != EEXIST)
                throw std::runtime_error("Cannot create private folder: " + full.string());
            const int next = ::openat(current, component.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
            require(next >= 0, "Missing or unsafe directory: " + full.string());
            ::close(current); current = next;
            struct stat st{};
            require(::fstat(current, &st) == 0, "Cannot inspect directory");
            require(!(st.st_mode & 0022) || ((st.st_mode & S_ISVTX) && (st.st_uid == 0 || st.st_uid == ::geteuid())), "Unsafe writable directory: " + full.string());
        }
        return current;
    } catch (...) { ::close(current); throw; }
}
Snapshot snapshot(const fs::path& path, bool privateFile = false) {
    Snapshot result; result.path = checkedAbsolute(path);
    // A not-yet-created private directory is permitted, but never a dangling link.
    fs::path ancestor = result.path.parent_path();
    while (!fs::exists(ancestor)) {
        require(!fs::is_symlink(fs::symlink_status(ancestor)), "Unsafe settings directory link");
        ancestor = ancestor.parent_path();
    }
    { Fd parent(directory(ancestor)); }
    if (ancestor != result.path.parent_path()) return result;
    Fd parent(directory(result.path.parent_path()));
    int raw = ::openat(parent.value, result.path.filename().c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (raw < 0 && errno == ENOENT) return result;
    Fd file(raw); struct stat st{};
    require(::fstat(file.value, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode) && st.st_size >= 0 && st.st_size <= 16384, "Settings file is not a bounded regular file: " + result.path.string());
    if (privateFile) require(st.st_uid == ::geteuid() && !(st.st_mode & 0022) && st.st_nlink == 1, "Settings file is not private and user-owned: " + result.path.string());
    std::string bytes(static_cast<std::size_t>(st.st_size), '\0');
    std::size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < bytes.size()) {
        auto count = ::read(file.value, bytes.data() + offset, bytes.size() - offset);
        if (count < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        require(count > 0, "Settings file changed during reading"); offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(count);
    }
    char extra; require(::read(file.value, &extra, 1) == 0, "Settings file grew during reading");
    struct stat after{};
    require(::fstat(file.value, &after) == 0 && st.st_size == after.st_size && st.st_mtim.tv_sec == after.st_mtim.tv_sec && st.st_mtim.tv_nsec == after.st_mtim.tv_nsec, "Settings file changed during reading");
    result.bytes = std::move(bytes); result.device = st.st_dev; result.inode = st.st_ino;
    result.seconds = st.st_mtim.tv_sec; result.nanos = st.st_mtim.tv_nsec;
    return result;
}
void unchanged(const Snapshot& expected, bool privateFile) {
    auto now = snapshot(expected.path, privateFile);
    require(now.bytes == expected.bytes && now.device == expected.device && now.inode == expected.inode && now.seconds == expected.seconds && now.nanos == expected.nanos,
        "Settings changed outside the launcher; reload before applying: " + expected.path.string());
}
void atomicWrite(Snapshot& expected, const std::string& bytes) {
    if (expected.bytes && *expected.bytes == bytes) return;
    Fd parent(directory(expected.path.parent_path(), true)); struct stat st{};
    require(::fstat(parent.value, &st) == 0 && st.st_uid == ::geteuid() && !(st.st_mode & 0022), "Settings destination is not private and user-owned");
    unchanged(expected, true);
    auto temporary = (expected.path.parent_path()/".launcher-XXXXXX").string();
    Fd file(::mkostemp(temporary.data(), O_CLOEXEC));
    try {
        require(::fchmod(file.value, 0600) == 0, "Cannot protect settings file");
        std::size_t offset = 0;
        while (offset < bytes.size()) {
            auto count = ::write(file.value, bytes.data() + offset, bytes.size() - offset);
            if (count < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
            require(count > 0, "Cannot write settings file"); offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(count);
        }
        require(::fsync(file.value) == 0, "Cannot synchronize settings file");
        unchanged(expected, true);
        require(::renameat(parent.value, fs::path(temporary).filename().c_str(), parent.value, expected.path.filename().c_str()) == 0, "Cannot atomically publish settings");
        require(::fsync(parent.value) == 0, "Cannot synchronize settings folder");
        expected = snapshot(expected.path, true);
    } catch (...) { ::unlink(temporary.c_str()); throw; }
}

    require(user.bytes || supplied.bytes, "Supplied settings are missing: " + supplied.path.string());

    KeyFile key(g_key_file_new(), g_key_file_free);

void validateCampaign(const std::vector<unsigned char>& b) {
    require(b.size()==31 || b.size()==32, "options.k22 must contain exactly 31 or 32 bytes; malformed file preserved");
    const int maxima[]={3,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,100,200,160,200,100,100,100};
    for (int i=0;i<15;++i) require(b[i]<=maxima[i], "Invalid campaign option byte " + std::to_string(i));
    for (int i=15;i<25;++i) {
        require(std::any_of(keys().begin(),keys().end(),[&](const Key& k){return k.code==b[i];}), "Unsupported or reserved campaign keyboard binding");
        require(std::find(b.begin()+15,b.begin()+i,b[i])==b.begin()+i, "Duplicate campaign keyboard binding");
    }

std::array<int,5> decodeBonus(const std::string& bytes) {
```
