```cpp
// Mirrors the engine's reader: ';'/'#' comments, case-insensitive names, bad entries reported and defaulted, never fatal.
Controller parseController(const std::string& bytes, std::vector<std::string>& warnings) {
    Controller c=defaultController();std::string section;std::size_t start=0;
    auto trim=[](std::string_view s){while(!s.empty()&&g_ascii_isspace(s.front()))s.remove_prefix(1);while(!s.empty()&&g_ascii_isspace(s.back()))s.remove_suffix(1);return s;};
    auto lower=[](std::string_view s){std::string r(s);for(auto& ch:r)ch=g_ascii_tolower(ch);return r;};
    while(start<bytes.size()){
        auto end=bytes.find('\n',start);if(end==std::string::npos)end=bytes.size();
        auto line=std::string_view(bytes).substr(start,end-start);start=end+1;
        line=trim(line.substr(0,line.find_first_of(";#")));if(line.empty())continue;
        if(line.front()=='['&&line.back()==']'){section=lower(trim(line.substr(1,line.size()-2)));if(section!="controller"&&section!="buttons")warnings.push_back("controller.ini unknown section ["+section+"] ignored");continue;}
        auto eq=line.find('=');if(eq==std::string_view::npos){warnings.push_back("controller.ini line without '=' ignored: "+std::string(line));continue;}
        auto name=lower(trim(line.substr(0,eq)));auto value=std::string(trim(line.substr(eq+1)));
        auto real=[&](double& slot,double low,double high){double v=0;auto [e,ec]=std::from_chars(value.data(),value.data()+value.size(),v);
            if(!value.empty()&&ec==std::errc{}&&e==value.data()+value.size()&&std::isfinite(v)&&v>=low&&v<=high)slot=v;else warnings.push_back("controller.ini "+name+"="+value+" rejected; default used");};
        if(section=="buttons"){
            auto slot=std::find_if(c.buttons.begin(),c.buttons.end(),[&](const auto& b){return b.first==name;});int v=-1;auto [e,ec]=std::from_chars(value.data(),value.data()+value.size(),v);
            if(slot!=c.buttons.end()&&ec==std::errc{}&&e==value.data()+value.size()&&v>=0&&v<=12)slot->second=v;else warnings.push_back("controller.ini button "+name+"="+value+" rejected; default used");
        }
        else if(section!="controller")continue;
        else if(name=="mode"){if(value=="original"||value=="modern")c.mode=value;else warnings.push_back("controller.ini mode="+value+" rejected; original used");}
        else if(name=="vibration"){if(value=="0"||value=="1")c.vibration=value=="1";else warnings.push_back("controller.ini vibration="+value+" rejected; default used");}
        else if(name=="deadzone")real(c.deadzone,0,0.9);
        else if(name=="sensitivity")real(c.sensitivity,0.25,4);
        else warnings.push_back("controller.ini unknown key "+name+" ignored");
    }
    return c;
}
std::string encodeController(const Controller& c) {
    validateController(c);
    auto shortest=[](double v){char buffer[32];auto [end,ec]=std::to_chars(buffer,buffer+sizeof buffer,v);return std::string(buffer,end);};
    std::string out="[Controller]\nmode="+c.mode+"\ndeadzone="+shortest(c.deadzone)+"\nsensitivity="+shortest(c.sensitivity)+"\nvibration="+(c.vibration?"1":"0")+"\n\n[Buttons]\n";
    for(const auto& [name,value]:c.buttons)out+=name+"="+std::to_string(value)+"\n";
    return out;
}
void validateUpdates(const Updates& u) {
    auto slash=u.repository.find('/');auto part=[](std::string_view s){return !s.empty()&&s.size()<=100&&s!="."&&s!=".."&&std::all_of(s.begin(),s.end(),[](char c){return g_ascii_isalnum(c)||c=='-'||c=='_'||c=='.';});};
    require(slash!=std::string::npos&&part(std::string_view(u.repository).substr(0,slash))&&part(std::string_view(u.repository).substr(slash+1)),"Update repository must be OWNER/NAME");
    require(u.channel=="stable"||u.channel=="experimental","Update channel must be stable or experimental");
}
Updates parseUpdates(const std::string& bytes, std::vector<std::string>& warnings) {
    Updates u,d;KeyFile key(g_key_file_new(),g_key_file_free);
    if(!g_key_file_load_from_data(key.get(),bytes.data(),bytes.size(),G_KEY_FILE_NONE,nullptr)){warnings.push_back("updates.ini is malformed; defaults used");return u;}
    if(g_key_file_has_key(key.get(),"Updates","repository",nullptr))u.repository=keyText(key.get(),"Updates","repository");
    if(g_key_file_has_key(key.get(),"Updates","channel",nullptr))u.channel=keyText(key.get(),"Updates","channel");
    try{validateUpdates({u.repository,d.channel});}catch(const std::exception& e){warnings.push_back(std::string("updates.ini: ")+e.what()+"; default used");u.repository=d.repository;}
    try{validateUpdates({d.repository,u.channel});}catch(const std::exception& e){warnings.push_back(std::string("updates.ini: ")+e.what()+"; default used");u.channel=d.channel;}
    return u;
}
std::string encodeUpdates(const Updates& u) { validateUpdates(u); return "[Updates]\nrepository="+u.repository+"\nchannel="+u.channel+"\n"; }
Capabilities parseCapabilities(const std::string& text) {
    return parsedJson(text,"--list-capabilities",[](const json& j){
        Capabilities c;c.version=j.at("version").get<std::string>();
        for(const auto& [name,b]:j.at("backends").items()){require(name=="opengl"||name=="vulkan-raster"||name=="vulkan-rt","Unknown backend in capabilities: "+name);c.backends.push_back({name,{b.at("available").get<bool>(),optionalText(b,"detail")}});}
        c.presets=texts(j.at("presets"));for(const auto& p:c.presets)require(p=="original"||p=="enhanced"||p=="ultra"||p=="custom","Unknown preset in capabilities: "+p);
        for(const auto& o:j.at("options")){
            Option option{o.at("key").get<std::string>(),optionalText(o,"label"),o.at("default").get<std::string>(),texts(o.at("values")),texts(o.at("backends"))};
            require(token(option.key)&&!option.values.empty()&&std::all_of(option.values.begin(),option.values.end(),token)&&std::count(option.values.begin(),option.values.end(),option.fallback)==1,"Invalid capability option: "+option.key);
            for(const auto& b:option.backends)require(b=="opengl"||b=="vulkan-raster"||b=="vulkan-rt","Unknown backend for option "+option.key);
            if(option.label.empty())option.label=option.key;
            c.options.push_back(std::move(option));
        }
        if(j.contains("texture_packs"))for(const auto& p:j.at("texture_packs")){
            Pack pack{p.at("name").get<std::string>(),optionalText(p,"path"),optionalText(p,"detail"),p.at("valid").get<bool>(),optionalText(p,"display_name")};
            require(packName(pack.name),"Invalid texture pack name in capabilities");c.packs.push_back(std::move(pack));
        }
        return c;
    });
}
Verify parseVerify(const std::string& text) {
    return parsedJson(text,"--verify",[](const json& j){return Verify{j.at("ok").get<bool>(),j.at("checked").get<long long>(),texts(j.at("missing")),texts(j.at("modified"))};});
}
UpdateCheck parseCheck(const std::string& text) {
    return parsedJson(text,"--check",[](const json& j){
        return UpdateCheck{j.at("current").get<std::string>(),optionalText(j,"latest"),optionalText(j,"channel"),optionalText(j,"notes"),optionalText(j,"published"),optionalText(j,"repository"),j.at("update_available").get<bool>()};
    });
}
UpdateStatus parseStatus(const std::string& text) {
    return parsedJson(text,"--status",[](const json& j){return UpdateStatus{optionalText(j,"active"),optionalText(j,"previous"),texts(j.at("installed"))};});
}
std::optional<std::pair<int,std::string>> progressLine(std::string_view line) {
    if(!line.empty()&&line.back()=='\r')line.remove_suffix(1);
    if(!line.starts_with("progress "))return std::nullopt;
    line.remove_prefix(9);
    int value=-1;auto [end,ec]=std::from_chars(line.data(),line.data()+line.size(),value);
    if(ec!=std::errc{}||value<0||value>100)return std::nullopt;
    std::string_view rest(end,line.data()+line.size()-end);
    if(rest.empty())return std::pair{value,std::string()};
    if(rest.front()!=' ')return std::nullopt;
    return std::pair{value,std::string(rest.substr(1))};
}
fs::path logDirectory() { return fs::path(g_get_user_state_dir())/"kabus22/logs"; }
std::vector<fs::path> listLogs(const fs::path& folder) {
    std::vector<fs::path> logs;std::error_code error;
    for(const auto& entry:fs::directory_iterator(folder,error)){auto name=entry.path().filename().string();if(entry.is_regular_file()&&!entry.is_symlink()&&name.ends_with(".log")&&name.find('-')!=std::string::npos)logs.push_back(entry.path());}
    // Names are kind-YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS-micro.log: order by timestamp, oldest first.
    std::sort(logs.begin(),logs.end(),[](const fs::path& a,const fs::path& b){auto x=a.filename().string(),y=b.filename().string();return std::pair(x.substr(x.find('-')),x)<std::pair(y.substr(y.find('-')),y);});
    return logs;
}
std::pair<fs::path,int> openLog(const fs::path& folder, std::string_view kind, std::size_t keep) {
    require(token(kind)&&kind.find('-')==std::string_view::npos&&keep>0,"Invalid log kind");
    Fd dir(directory(folder,true));struct stat st{};
    require(::fstat(dir.value,&st)==0&&st.st_uid==::geteuid()&&!(st.st_mode&0022),"Log folder is not private and user-owned: "+folder.string());
    std::vector<fs::path> same;for(auto& log:listLogs(folder))if(log.filename().string().starts_with(std::string(kind)+"-"))same.push_back(log);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i+keep<=same.size();++i)::unlinkat(dir.value,same[i].filename().c_str(),0);
    GDateTime* now=g_date_time_new_now_local();gchar* stamp=g_date_time_format(now,"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S-%f");std::string name=std::string(kind)+"-"+stamp+".log";g_free(stamp);g_date_time_unref(now);
    int fd=::openat(dir.value,name.c_str(),O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC,0600);
    require(fd>=0,"Cannot create log "+(folder/name).string()+": "+std::strerror(errno));
    return {folder/name,fd};
}
fs::path defaultRoot() { return fs::path(g_get_user_data_dir())/"kabus22"; }
// Versioned installs run from versions/<active>/bin; never follow the compat bin link for executable admission.
fs::path binDirectory(const fs::path& root) { auto active=layout::active_version(root); return active.empty()?root/"bin":root/"versions"/active/"bin"; }
Settings load(const fs::path& root, const fs::path& executable) {
    Settings s; s.root=checkedAbsolute(root); s.engine=executable.empty()?binDirectory(s.root)/"kabus22":checkedAbsolute(executable);
    Fd folder(directory(s.root)); struct stat st{};
    require(::fstat(folder.value,&st)==0&&st.st_uid==::geteuid()&&!(st.st_mode&0022),"Installation must be private and user-owned");
    require(snapshot(s.root/".kabus22-owned").bytes==std::optional<std::string>("Kabus22 native installation 1\n"),"Not a Kabus22 native installation (ownership marker missing)");
    binary(s.engine); { Fd game(directory(s.root/"game")); }
    s.privateRoot=defaultRoot(); s.configFile=fs::path(g_get_user_config_dir())/"kabus22/launcher.ini";
    s.campaignPrivate=snapshot(s.privateRoot/"options.k22",true); s.campaignSource=snapshot(s.root/"game/options.k22");
    s.campaign=campaignBytes(effective(s.campaignPrivate,s.campaignSource)); validateCampaign(s.campaign);
    require(s.campaignSource.bytes.has_value(),"Supplied campaign defaults missing"); s.defaults=campaignBytes(*s.campaignSource.bytes); validateCampaign(s.defaults);
    s.originalCampaign=originalEntry(s.root/"game");s.languages=campaignLanguages(s.root/"game");
    s.bonusAvailable=fs::is_regular_file(s.root/"game/Kabus 22 Mode/K22_mode.wrs");
    if(s.bonusAvailable) {
        s.bonusPrivate=snapshot(s.privateRoot/"mode_ayarlar.k22",true); s.bonusSource=snapshot(s.root/"game/Kabus 22 Mode/mode_ayarlar.k22");
        s.bonus=decodeBonus(effective(s.bonusPrivate,s.bonusSource)); require(s.bonusSource.bytes.has_value(),"Supplied Bonus defaults missing"); s.bonusDefaults=decodeBonus(*s.bonusSource.bytes);
        s.localePrivate=snapshot(s.privateRoot/"ygm.k22",true); s.localeSource=snapshot(s.root/"game/Kabus 22 Mode/ygm.k22");
        // Bonus launcher (entry-contract.txt): rms0/1/2 = 000/111/222; 111 -> tr, 222 -> de, anything else -> en.
        s.preferences.bonusLanguage=bonusMarkerLanguage(effective(s.localePrivate,s.localeSource));
    }
    const char* locale=g_get_language_names()[0]; std::string language=locale?locale:"en";
    s.preferences.language=language.starts_with("tr")?"tr":language.starts_with("de")?"de":"en";
    s.preferences.audioLanguage=s.preferences.language=="tr"?"tr":"en";
    s.config=snapshot(s.configFile,true); if(s.config.bytes) s.preferences=parsePreferences(*s.config.bytes,s.preferences);
    if(s.preferences.language!="saved"&&!std::count(s.languages.begin(),s.languages.end(),s.preferences.language))s.preferences.language=language.starts_with("tr")?"tr":language.starts_with("de")?"de":"en";
    s.preferences.language=savedCampaignLanguage(s.campaign,s.preferences.language,s.languages);
    s.initialLanguage=s.preferences.language;
    s.controllerFile=snapshot(s.configFile.parent_path()/"controller.ini",true); s.controller=s.controllerFile.bytes?parseController(*s.controllerFile.bytes,s.warnings):defaultController();
    s.updatesFile=snapshot(s.configFile.parent_path()/"updates.ini",true); if(s.updatesFile.bytes) s.updates=parseUpdates(*s.updatesFile.bytes,s.warnings);
    return s;
}
void saveUpdates(Settings& s) {
    validateUpdates(s.updates); Fd lock(privateLock(s.privateRoot)); unchanged(s.updatesFile,true);
    if(!s.updatesFile.bytes&&s.updates==Updates{}) return;
    std::vector<std::string> ignored; if(s.updatesFile.bytes&&parseUpdates(*s.updatesFile.bytes,ignored)==s.updates) return;
    atomicWrite(s.updatesFile,encodeUpdates(s.updates));
}
void save(Settings& s) {
    validateCampaign(s.campaign); validatePreferences(s.preferences);
    if(s.bonusAvailable) (void)decodeBonus(encodeBonus(s.bonus));
    require(s.preferences.mode!="bonus"||s.bonusAvailable,"Bonus data is not installed");
    Fd lock(privateLock(s.privateRoot));
    // Check every source before any publication, so stale game edits cannot be overwritten.
    for(const auto* expected:{&s.campaignPrivate,&s.config,&s.controllerFile,&s.updatesFile}) unchanged(*expected,true);
    unchanged(s.campaignSource,false);
    if(s.bonusAvailable) { unchanged(s.bonusPrivate,true); unchanged(s.bonusSource,false); unchanged(s.localePrivate,true); unchanged(s.localeSource,false); }
    if(s.campaign.size()==32&&s.preferences.language!=s.initialLanguage&&s.preferences.language!="saved")
        s.campaign[31]=static_cast<unsigned char>(languageIndex(s.preferences.language));
    const std::string bytes(s.campaign.begin(),s.campaign.end());
    if(bytes!=effective(s.campaignPrivate,s.campaignSource)) atomicWrite(s.campaignPrivate,bytes);
    if(s.bonusAvailable) {
        if(s.bonus!=decodeBonus(effective(s.bonusPrivate,s.bonusSource))) atomicWrite(s.bonusPrivate,encodeBonus(s.bonus));
        // Exact original rms*.txt markers (3 bytes, no newline).
        if(bonusMarkerLanguage(effective(s.localePrivate,s.localeSource))!=s.preferences.bonusLanguage) atomicWrite(s.localePrivate,bonusMarker(s.preferences.bonusLanguage));
    }
    atomicWrite(s.config,encodePreferences(s.preferences));
    // An absent controller.ini means original mode; rewrite only on a real change so user comments survive.
    std::vector<std::string> ignored; validateController(s.controller); validateUpdates(s.updates);
    if(s.controller!=(s.controllerFile.bytes?parseController(*s.controllerFile.bytes,ignored):defaultController())) atomicWrite(s.controllerFile,encodeController(s.controller));
    if((s.updatesFile.bytes||s.updates!=Updates{})&&s.updates!=(s.updatesFile.bytes?parseUpdates(*s.updatesFile.bytes,ignored):Updates{})) atomicWrite(s.updatesFile,encodeUpdates(s.updates));
}
std::vector<std::string> command(const Settings& s, const std::optional<unsigned long long>& frames) {
    validatePreferences(s.preferences); binary(s.engine); const auto& p=s.preferences;
    require(p.mode!="bonus"||s.bonusAvailable,"Bonus data is not installed");
    const fs::path data=s.root/"game"/(p.mode=="bonus"?"Kabus 22 Mode":""); { Fd folder(directory(data)); }
    std::vector<std::string> args={s.engine.string(),"--data",data.string(),"--mode",p.mode};
    if(p.mode=="bonus")args.insert(args.end(),{"--language",p.bonusLanguage});
    else if(p.language!="saved"&&(s.campaign.size()!=32||p.language!=s.initialLanguage)){
        require(std::count(s.languages.begin(),s.languages.end(),p.language)==1,"Text language "+p.language+" needs the community patch language data, which is not installed");
        args.insert(args.end(),{"--language",p.language});
    }
    if(p.mode=="campaign") { args.insert(args.end(),{"--audio-language",p.audioLanguage});
        if(s.originalCampaign) { args.insert(args.end(),{"--display",p.display});
            if(p.display=="native") { args.insert(args.end(),{"--window-mode",p.window}); if(!p.resolution.empty()&&p.window!="borderless") args.insert(args.end(),{"--resolution",p.resolution}); }
            else if(p.window!="windowed") args.insert(args.end(),{"--define","deftam_d3d"});
        }
        if(s.originalCampaign&&p.camera!="original") args.insert(args.end(),{"--camera",p.camera});
    } else args.insert(args.end(),{"--define","defanti_"+std::to_string(p.bonusAA)});
    if(p.renderer=="opengl") args.insert(args.end(),{"--renderer","opengl"});
    else args.insert(args.end(),{"--renderer","vulkan","--ray-tracing",p.renderer=="vulkan-rt"?"on":"off"});
    if(s.capabilities) {
        const auto& c=*s.capabilities;bool packs=false;
        if(p.preset!="original"){require(std::count(c.presets.begin(),c.presets.end(),p.preset)==1,"Graphics preset "+p.preset+" is not offered by this engine; choose another on Rendering");args.insert(args.end(),{"--preset",p.preset});}
        // backend and texture_packs have dedicated controls; stale or inapplicable custom values fall back to the engine default.
        // fps_limit (its own Rendering row) applies under every preset; the other keys only under custom.
        for(const auto& [key,value]:p.graphics){
            if(p.preset!="custom"&&key!="fps_limit")continue;
            auto o=std::find_if(c.options.begin(),c.options.end(),[&](const Option& o){return o.key==key;});
            if(o==c.options.end()||key=="backend"||key=="texture_packs"||value==o->fallback||std::count(o->values.begin(),o->values.end(),value)!=1||std::count(o->backends.begin(),o->backends.end(),p.renderer)!=1)continue;
            args.insert(args.end(),{"--graphics",key+"="+value});
        }
        for(const auto& name:p.packs)if(std::any_of(c.packs.begin(),c.packs.end(),[&](const Pack& k){return k.valid&&k.name==name;})){args.insert(args.end(),{"--texture-pack",name});packs=true;}
        // Explicit packs imply texture_packs=1; with none checked, keep enhanced/ultra from auto-loading every installed pack.
        if(!packs&&(p.preset=="enhanced"||p.preset=="ultra")&&std::any_of(c.options.begin(),c.options.end(),[](const Option& o){return o.key=="texture_packs";}))args.insert(args.end(),{"--graphics","texture_packs=0"});
    }
    if(frames) args.insert(args.end(),{"--frames",std::to_string(*frames)});
    return args;
}
void selfCheck() {
    const std::vector<unsigned char> original={2,1,0,0,1,0,1,0,50,100,80,130,65,90,100,72,80,77,75,31,32,30,50,35,16,1,2,3,4,5,6};
    validateCampaign(original); auto patched=original; patched.push_back(5); validateCampaign(patched);
    for(int code:{66,67,68}){auto rebound=original;rebound[15]=code;validateCampaign(rebound);}
    auto rejects=[](auto action) { bool rejected=false; try{action();}catch(const std::exception&){rejected=true;} require(rejected,"Invalid settings accepted by self-check"); };
    for(int failure=0;failure<5;++failure) { auto invalid=original; if(failure==0) invalid.pop_back(); if(failure==1) invalid[9]=201; if(failure==2) invalid[15]=28; if(failure==3) invalid[16]=invalid[15]; if(failure==4) invalid[25]=0; rejects([&]{validateCampaign(invalid);}); }
    auto bonus=decodeBonus("2\r\n2\r\n0\r\n1\r\n50\r\n"); require(decodeBonus(encodeBonus(bonus))==bonus,"Bonus roundtrip regression");
    for(const std::string invalid:{"2\n2\n0\n1","4\n2\n0\n1\n50\n","2\n2\n0\n1\n50\nextra","2\n2\n0\n1\n50junk\n"}) rejects([&]{decodeBonus(invalid);});
    Preferences p; p.renderer="vulkan-raster"; p.resolution="2560x1440"; require(parsePreferences(encodePreferences(p)).renderer==p.renderer,"Preference roundtrip regression");
    rejects([&]{parsePreferences("[Launcher]\nrenderer=unknown\n");});
    rejects([&]{parsePreferences("[Launcher]\nbonus-aa=not-a-number\n");});
    // Exercise real private publication, symlink refusal and stale-update admission, not UI wiring.
    GError* error=nullptr; gchar* name=g_dir_make_tmp("kabus22-launcher-check-XXXXXX",&error);
    if(!name) { std::string message=error?error->message:"Cannot create self-check folder"; if(error)g_error_free(error); throw std::runtime_error(message); }
    fs::path scratch=name; g_free(name);
    try {
        auto expected=snapshot(scratch/"settings",true); atomicWrite(expected,"first"); require(expected.bytes==std::optional<std::string>("first"),"Atomic settings publication regression");
        auto stale=expected; atomicWrite(expected,"second"); rejects([&]{atomicWrite(stale,"overwrite");});
        require(::symlink("settings",(scratch/"link").c_str())==0,"Cannot create link self-check"); rejects([&]{snapshot(scratch/"link",true);});
        struct stat st{}; require(::stat((scratch/"settings").c_str(),&st)==0&&(st.st_mode&0777)==0600,"Settings permission regression");
        fs::create_directory(scratch/"game");
        {Fd plain(directory(scratch/"game"));Fd trailing(directory(scratch/"game"/""));struct stat a{},b{};
            require(::fstat(plain.value,&a)==0&&::fstat(trailing.value,&b)==0&&a.st_dev==b.st_dev&&a.st_ino==b.st_ino,"Trailing directory separator admission regression");}
        require(::symlink("game",(scratch/"linked-game").c_str())==0,"Cannot create directory link self-check");
        rejects([&]{Fd unsafe(directory(scratch/"linked-game"/""));});
        require(::mkfifo((scratch/"engine-fifo").c_str(),0700)==0,"Cannot create executable FIFO self-check");
        rejects([&]{binary(scratch/"engine-fifo");});
        {Fd held(privateLock(scratch));auto pid=::fork();require(pid>=0,"Cannot fork lock self-check");
            if(pid==0){::close(held.value);bool refused=false;try{Fd competing(privateLock(scratch));}catch(const std::exception&){refused=true;}::_exit(refused?0:1);}
            int status=0;pid_t waited;do{waited=::waitpid(pid,&status,0);}while(waited<0&&errno==EINTR);
            require(waited==pid&&WIFEXITED(status)&&WEXITSTATUS(status)==0,"Interprocess settings lock admitted a competing writer");}
        {Fd released(privateLock(scratch));}
        auto entry=snapshot(scratch/"game/K22.wrs");atomicWrite(entry,"entry");
        // Copy the engine stand-in into the private scratch tree: the build tree's ancestors may be legitimately group-writable.
        fs::copy_file("/proc/self/exe",scratch/"kabus22");
        Settings launch;launch.root=scratch;launch.engine=scratch/"kabus22";launch.campaign=patched;launch.originalCampaign=originalEntry(scratch/"game");
        require(launch.originalCampaign,"Private 32-byte options disabled original installed entry");
        auto args=command(launch);require(std::find(args.begin(),args.end(),"--window-mode")!=args.end(),"Original native display arguments omitted with 32-byte options");
        const std::vector<std::string> patchLanguages{"tr","en","de","es","ru","pl"};
        for(bool installed:{false,true})for(int index=0;index<=5;++index){
            launch.languages=installed?patchLanguages:std::vector<std::string>{"tr","en","de"};
            launch.campaign[31]=index;launch.preferences.language=savedCampaignLanguage(launch.campaign,"en",launch.languages);launch.initialLanguage=launch.preferences.language;
            constexpr const char* expectedLanguage[]={"tr","en","de","saved","saved","saved"};
            require(launch.preferences.language==(installed?patchLanguages[index]:std::string(expectedLanguage[index])),"Saved patch language initialization regression");
            args=command(launch);require(std::find(args.begin(),args.end(),"--language")==args.end(),"Saved patch locale was overridden without a user change");
        }
        launch.preferences.language="tr";args=command(launch);auto languageArg=std::find(args.begin(),args.end(),"--language");
        require(languageArg!=args.end()&&*std::next(languageArg)=="tr","Intentional patch language selection omitted");
        launch.preferences.language="ru";args=command(launch);languageArg=std::find(args.begin(),args.end(),"--language");
        require(languageArg!=args.end()&&*std::next(languageArg)=="ru","Installed patch language es/ru/pl selection omitted");
        launch.languages={"tr","en","de"};rejects([&]{command(launch);});launch.preferences.language="tr";
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace k22::launcher {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using Pairs = std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>;
struct Preferences {
    std::string mode = "campaign", renderer = "opengl", display = "native";
    std::string window = "borderless", resolution, language = "en", audioLanguage = "en";
    std::string bonusLanguage = "en";
    std::string camera = "original"; // original | first-person (engine --camera; original campaign scripts only)
    int bonusAA = 0;
    std::string preset = "original"; // Contract D presets; graphics overrides apply to "custom" only.
    Pairs graphics;
    std::vector<std::string> packs;  // enabled texture packs, priority order
};
// Contract D: `kabus22 --list-capabilities`.
struct Option { std::string key, label, fallback; std::vector<std::string> values, backends; };
struct Pack { std::string name, path, detail; bool valid = false; std::string display; };
struct Capabilities {
    std::string version;
    std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::pair<bool, std::string>>> backends; // name -> available, detail
    std::vector<std::string> presets;
    std::vector<Option> options;
    std::vector<Pack> packs;
    bool available(std::string_view backend) const;
};
struct Controller {
    std::string mode = "original";
    double deadzone = 0.15, sensitivity = 1.0;
    bool vibration = true;
    std::vector<std::pair<std::string, int>> buttons; // every controllerButtons() entry, 0 = unmapped
    bool operator==(const Controller&) const = default;
};
// Contract B: updates.ini.
struct Updates { std::string repository = "sergen213/kabus22-linux", channel = "stable"; bool operator==(const Updates&) const = default; };
struct Verify { bool ok = false; long long checked = 0; std::vector<std::string> missing, modified; };
struct UpdateCheck { std::string current, latest, channel, notes, published, repository; bool available = false; };
struct UpdateStatus { std::string active, previous; std::vector<std::string> installed; };
struct Snapshot {
    fs::path path;
    std::optional<std::string> bytes;
    unsigned long long device = 0, inode = 0;
    long long seconds = 0, nanos = 0;
};
struct Settings {
    fs::path root, engine, privateRoot, configFile;
    bool originalCampaign = false, bonusAvailable = false;
    std::vector<unsigned char> campaign, defaults;
    std::array<int, 5> bonus{}, bonusDefaults{};
    Preferences preferences;
    std::string initialLanguage;
    std::vector<std::string> languages{"tr","en","de"}; // campaign text languages the installed data supports
    Snapshot campaignPrivate, campaignSource, bonusPrivate, bonusSource, localePrivate, localeSource, config, controllerFile, updatesFile;
    Controller controller;
    Updates updates;
    std::vector<std::string> warnings;
    std::optional<Capabilities> capabilities; // absent: engine without presets, so no graphics arguments are emitted
};
struct Key { int code; const char* name; };
std::span<const Key> keys();
std::span<const char* const> controllerButtons();
void validateCampaign(const std::vector<unsigned char>& bytes);
std::array<int, 5> decodeBonus(const std::string& bytes);
void validatePreferences(const Preferences& preferences);
// tr/en/de always; es/ru/pl (patch DD_Dil 3-5) when K22Widescreen.wrs and _data/language/<folder>/subtitle/general.txt exist.
std::vector<std::string> campaignLanguages(const fs::path& game);
// ygm.k22, Bonus launcher rms0/1/2.txt: first line 111 -> tr, 222 -> de, anything else -> en; written as 000/111/222.
std::string bonusMarkerLanguage(std::string_view marker);
std::string bonusMarker(const std::string& language);
Controller defaultController();
void validateController(const Controller& controller);
Controller parseController(const std::string& bytes, std::vector<std::string>& warnings);

Capabilities parseCapabilities(const std::string& json);
```

`installer/layout.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "layout.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <regex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sys/file.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace k22::layout {
namespace {
constexpr const char* payloadDirs[] = {"bin", "lib", "share"};
void require(bool good, const std::string& message) {
    if (!good) throw std::runtime_error(message);
}
void fail(const std::string& what, const fs::path& path) {
    throw std::runtime_error(what + ": " + path.string() + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
}
bool present(const fs::path& path) { return fs::symlink_status(path).type() != fs::file_type::not_found; }
bool realDir(const fs::path& path) { return fs::symlink_status(path).type() == fs::file_type::directory; }
void syncDir(const fs::path& path) {
    const int fd = ::open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0) fail("Cannot open directory", path);
    const int result = ::fsync(fd);
    ::close(fd);
    if (result != 0) fail("Cannot sync directory", path);
}
fs::path versionsOf(const fs::path& root) {
    require(fs::symlink_status(root/".kabus22-owned").type() == fs::file_type::regular,
        "Not a Kabus22-owned installation: " + root.string());
    const auto versions = root/"versions";
    if (!present(versions) && ::mkdir(versions.c_str(), 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) fail("Cannot create", versions);
    require(realDir(versions), "versions is not a real directory: " + versions.string());
    return versions;
}
// Temporary symlinks live in versions/ (same filesystem); rename(2) atomically
// replaces the root entry, never a real directory (rename fails with EISDIR).
void swapLink(const fs::path& root, const char* name, const std::string& target) {
    const auto temporary = root/"versions"/(".tmp-" + std::string(name) + "-" + std::to_string(::getpid()));
    ::unlink(temporary.c_str());
    if (::symlink(target.c_str(), temporary.c_str()) != 0) fail("Cannot create symlink", temporary);
    if (::rename(temporary.c_str(), (root/name).c_str()) != 0) {
        const int error = errno;
        ::unlink(temporary.c_str());
        errno = error;
        fail("Cannot replace", root/name);
    }
    syncDir(root);
}
void compatLinks(const fs::path& root) {
    for (const auto* name : payloadDirs) {
        const auto target = std::string("current/") + name;
        std::error_code error;
        if (fs::is_symlink(fs::symlink_status(root/name)) && fs::read_symlink(root/name, error) == target) continue;
        require(!realDir(root/name), "Legacy flat layout; migrate first: " + (root/name).string());
        swapLink(root, name, target);
    }
}
void writeState(const fs::path& root, std::string_view active, std::string_view previous) {
    const auto state = root/"versions/.state", temporary = root/"versions/.state.tmp";
    {
        std::ofstream out(temporary, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out << "active=" << active << "\nprevious=" << previous << '\n';
        out.flush();
        require(bool(out), "Cannot write " + temporary.string());
    }
    const int fd = ::open(temporary.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0 || ::fsync(fd) != 0) { if (fd >= 0) ::close(fd); fail("Cannot sync", temporary); }
    ::close(fd);
    if (::rename(temporary.c_str(), state.c_str()) != 0) fail("Cannot replace", state);
    syncDir(root/"versions");
}
std::pair<std::string, std::string> readState(const fs::path& root) {
    std::ifstream in(root/"versions/.state");
    std::string line, active, previous;
    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        if (line.starts_with("active=")) active = line.substr(7);
        else if (line.starts_with("previous=")) previous = line.substr(9);
    }
    return {valid_version(active) ? active : "", valid_version(previous) ? previous : ""};
}
bool versionDir(const fs::path& root, const std::string& version) {
    return valid_version(version) && realDir(root/"versions"/version);
}
void prune(const fs::path& root, const std::vector<std::string>& keep) {
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(root/"versions")) {
        const auto name = entry.path().filename().string();
        const bool scratch = name.starts_with(".stage-") || name.starts_with(".tmp-") || name.starts_with(".download-");
        if ((!scratch && !valid_version(name)) || std::find(keep.begin(), keep.end(), name) != keep.end()) continue;
        fs::remove_all(entry.path());
    }
    syncDir(root/"versions");
}
} // namespace

fs::path find_root(const fs::path& realExecutable) {
    std::error_code error;
    auto path = fs::weakly_canonical(realExecutable, error);
    if (error) return {};
    for (int level = 0; level < 4 && path.has_parent_path() && path != path.root_path(); ++level) {
        path = path.parent_path();
        if (fs::symlink_status(path/".kabus22-owned", error).type() == fs::file_type::regular) return path;
    }
    return {};
}
bool valid_version(std::string_view version) {
    static const std::regex pattern(R"((0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})\.(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})\.(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)");
    return version.size() <= 64 && std::regex_match(version.begin(), version.end(), pattern);
}
std::string active_version(const fs::path& root) {
    std::error_code error;
    const auto target = fs::read_symlink(root/"current", error).string();
    if (error || !target.starts_with("versions/")) return {};
    const auto version = target.substr(9);
    return versionDir(root, version) ? version : "";
}
std::string previous_version(const fs::path& root) {
    const auto active = active_version(root);
    const auto [recorded, previous] = readState(root);
    // A crash after the current swap but before .state leaves recorded == old active.
    const auto candidate = recorded == active ? previous : recorded;
    return candidate != active && versionDir(root, candidate) ? candidate : "";
}
std::vector<std::string> installed_versions(const fs::path& root) {
    std::vector<std::string> result;
    std::error_code error;
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(root/"versions", error))
        if (const auto name = entry.path().filename().string(); versionDir(root, name)) result.push_back(name);
    std::sort(result.begin(), result.end());
    return result;
}
std::string running_version(const fs::path& root) {
    std::error_code error;
    const auto self = fs::read_symlink("/proc/self/exe", error);
    const auto versions = fs::weakly_canonical(root/"versions", error);
    if (error) return {};
    const auto relative = self.lexically_relative(versions);
    if (relative.empty() || *relative.begin() == "..") return {};
    const auto name = relative.begin()->string();
    return valid_version(name) ? name : "";
}
fs::path stage_dir(const fs::path& root, std::string_view version) {
    require(valid_version(version), "Invalid version: " + std::string(version));
    auto pattern = (versionsOf(root)/(".stage-" + std::string(version) + "-XXXXXX")).string();
    require(::mkdtemp(pattern.data()) != nullptr, "Cannot create staging directory: " + std::string(std::strerror(errno)));
    return pattern;
}
void commit(const fs::path& root, const fs::path& staged, std::string_view versionView) {
    const std::string version(versionView);
    require(valid_version(version), "Invalid version: " + version);
    const auto versions = versionsOf(root);
    require(staged.parent_path() == versions && staged.filename().string().starts_with(".stage-") && realDir(staged),
        "Staged payload must come from stage_dir: " + staged.string());
    require(realDir(staged/"bin"), "Staged payload lacks bin/");
    for (const auto* name : payloadDirs) fs::create_directory(staged/name);
    for (const auto* name : payloadDirs) require(!realDir(root/name), "Legacy flat layout; migrate first: " + (root/name).string());
    const auto old = active_version(root);
    require(version != old, "Version " + version + " is already active");
    const auto target = versions/version;
    if (present(target)) {
        require(version != running_version(root), "Refusing to replace the running version " + version);
        fs::remove_all(target);
    }
    if (::rename(staged.c_str(), target.c_str()) != 0) fail("Cannot publish version", target);
    syncDir(versions);
    swapLink(root, "current", "versions/" + version);
    compatLinks(root);
    writeState(root, version, old);
    prune(root, {version, old, running_version(root)});
}
void rollback(const fs::path& root) {
    versionsOf(root);
    const auto previous = previous_version(root), active = active_version(root);
    require(!previous.empty(), "No previous version to roll back to");
    swapLink(root, "current", "versions/" + previous);
    compatLinks(root);
    writeState(root, previous, active);
}
void migrate_flat(const fs::path& root, std::string_view versionView) {
    const std::string version(versionView);
    require(valid_version(version), "Invalid version: " + version);
    const auto versions = versionsOf(root);
    const auto target = versions/version;
    const bool flat = std::any_of(std::begin(payloadDirs), std::end(payloadDirs), [&](const char* name) { return realDir(root/name); });
    if (!flat && present(root/"current")) {
        // Resume a migration interrupted after the current swap.
        if (!active_version(root).empty()) { compatLinks(root); if (readState(root).first.empty()) writeState(root, active_version(root), ""); }
        return;
    }
    require(flat || realDir(target/"bin"), "No flat installation payload to migrate in " + root.string());
    require(!present(root/"current"), "Inconsistent layout: current exists beside flat payload");
    if (!present(target) && ::mkdir(target.c_str(), 0755) != 0) fail("Cannot create", target);
    require(realDir(target), "Version path is not a directory: " + target.string());
    for (const auto* name : payloadDirs) require(!present(root/name) || realDir(root/name) || fs::is_symlink(fs::symlink_status(root/name)),
        "Unexpected non-directory entry: " + (root/name).string());
    for (const auto* name : payloadDirs) {
        if (realDir(root/name)) {
            require(!present(target/name), "Both flat and versioned " + std::string(name) + " exist; refusing to merge");
            if (::rename((root/name).c_str(), (target/name).c_str()) != 0) fail("Cannot move", root/name);
            syncDir(root); syncDir(target);
        } else if (!present(target/name)) {
            fs::create_directory(target/name);
        }
    }
    swapLink(root, "current", "versions/" + version);
    // Missing compat links (moved dirs) are created; never replaces unrelated files.
    compatLinks(root);
    writeState(root, version, readState(root).first == version ? readState(root).second : "");
}
Lock::Lock(const fs::path& root) : fd(-1) {
    const auto path = versionsOf(root)/".lock";
    fd = ::open(path.c_str(), O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    if (fd < 0) fail("Cannot open lock", path);
    if (::flock(fd, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) != 0) { ::close(fd); throw std::runtime_error("Another Kabus22 update/installation is in progress"); }
}
Lock::~Lock() { if (fd >= 0) ::close(fd); }
}

```

`installer/layout.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

// Versioned installation layout (Contract A). Mutations only ever create, move,
// replace or delete root/{bin,lib,share,current} and entries inside root/versions/;
// saves, options, game/ and every other root entry are never touched.
// Every mutating call requires root/.kabus22-owned. Callers serialize mutations by
// holding a Lock (not taken internally: flock is per open file description).
namespace k22::layout {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
// Walks up to 4 parents of the executable's directory for .kabus22-owned; empty if none.
fs::path find_root(const fs::path& realExecutable);
// "MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-pre][+build]", at most 64 characters.
bool valid_version(std::string_view version);
// Target of root/current ("versions/<v>"); empty for legacy flat or unversioned roots.
std::string active_version(const fs::path& root);
// Rollback target; empty when none is installed.
std::string previous_version(const fs::path& root);
std::vector<std::string> installed_versions(const fs::path& root);
// Version directory the calling process executes from; empty otherwise.
std::string running_version(const fs::path& root);
// New private (0700) directory inside root/versions; fill it with bin/lib/share.
fs::path stage_dir(const fs::path& root, std::string_view version);
// Publishes staged as versions/<version>, swaps current atomically, records .state
// (previous = old active) and prunes all versions but active, previous and running.
void commit(const fs::path& root, const fs::path& staged, std::string_view version);
// Swaps current back to the previous version; active becomes the new previous.
void rollback(const fs::path& root);
// Moves legacy flat root/{bin,lib,share} into versions/<version> plus compat symlinks.
// Idempotent and resumable after a crash at any step; no-op once versioned.
void migrate_flat(const fs::path& root, std::string_view version);
struct Lock {
    explicit Lock(const fs::path& root); // throws if another process holds it
    ~Lock();
    Lock(const Lock&) = delete;
    Lock& operator=(const Lock&) = delete;
    int fd;
};
}
```

`installer/main.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "setup.hpp"
#include "wizard_style.hpp"
#include <gtk/gtk.h>
#include <gdk/gdkkeysyms.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <atomic>
#include <csignal>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <utility>

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
extern "C" {
#include <libavcodec/avcodec.h>
#include <libavutil/error.h>
#include <libswscale/swscale.h>
}

namespace {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using namespace k22::setup;
constexpr const char* Version = "kabus22 native installer " K22_VERSION;
std::atomic<bool> interrupted{false};
static_assert(std::atomic<bool>::is_always_lock_free);
void interrupt(int) { interrupted.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed); }

struct Options {
    Request request;
    bool unattended = false, help = false, version = false, check = false, verify = false, repair = false, json = false;
};
Options arguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    Options options;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const std::string flag = argv[i];
        if (flag == "--help" || flag == "-h") { options.help = true; continue; }
        if (flag == "--version") { options.version = true; continue; }
        if (flag == "--self-check") { options.check = true; continue; }
        if (flag == "--unattended") { options.unattended = true; continue; }
        if (flag == "--verify") { options.verify = true; continue; }
        if (flag == "--repair") { options.repair = true; continue; }
        if (flag == "--json") { options.json = true; continue; }
        fs::path* target = nullptr;
        if (flag == "--source") target = &options.request.source;
        else if (flag == "--iso") target = &options.request.sourceIso;
        else if (flag == "--setup") target = &options.request.sourceSetup;
        else if (flag == "--install-dir") target = &options.request.installRoot;
        else if (flag == "--engine") target = &options.request.enginePayload;
        else if (flag == "--launcher") target = &options.request.launcherPayload;
        else if (flag == "--updater") target = &options.request.updaterPayload;
        else if (flag == "--extractor") target = &options.request.extractor;
        else if (flag == "--patch") target = &options.request.optionalPatch;
        else throw std::runtime_error("Unknown option: " + flag);
        if (++i == argc || argv[i][0] == '\0') throw std::runtime_error("Missing value for " + flag);
        if (!target->empty()) throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate option: " + flag);
        *target = fs::absolute(argv[i]).lexically_normal();
    }
    const auto& request = options.request;
    const int sources = int(!request.source.empty()) + int(!request.sourceIso.empty()) + int(!request.sourceSetup.empty());
    if (sources > 1) throw std::runtime_error("Choose one of --source, --iso or the developer --setup route.");
    if (options.verify && options.repair) throw std::runtime_error("Choose --verify or --repair, not both.");
    if ((options.verify || options.repair) && !request.optionalPatch.empty())
        throw std::runtime_error("--verify/--repair cannot be combined with --patch.");
    if (options.verify && sources) throw std::runtime_error("--verify checks the installation only; it takes no source.");
    if (options.json && !options.verify) throw std::runtime_error("--json is only available with --verify.");
    if ((options.unattended || options.repair) && !sources)
        throw std::runtime_error("--unattended and --repair require --source GAME.iso|setup.exe|WINDOWS_GAME_FOLDER.");
    return options;
}
void argumentCheck() {
    auto parse = [](std::vector<std::string> values) {
        std::vector<char*> argv;
        for (auto& value : values) argv.push_back(value.data());
        return arguments(static_cast<int>(argv.size()), argv.data());
    };
    const auto result = parse({"kabus22-setup", "--iso", "media with spaces.iso", "--unattended"});
    if (!result.unattended || result.request.sourceIso.filename() != "media with spaces.iso")
        throw std::runtime_error("CLI path parsing regression");
    const auto repair = parse({"kabus22-setup", "--repair", "--install-dir", "root", "--source", "Kabus 22"});
    const auto verify = parse({"kabus22-setup", "--verify", "--json"});
    if (!repair.repair || repair.request.source.filename() != "Kabus 22" || !verify.verify || !verify.json)
        throw std::runtime_error("Verify/repair CLI parsing regression");
    const auto launcher = parse({"kabus22-setup", "--launcher", "settings with spaces"});
    if (launcher.request.launcherPayload.filename() != "settings with spaces")
        throw std::runtime_error("Launcher payload parsing regression");
    for (const auto& invalid : std::vector<std::vector<std::string>>{
            {"kabus22-setup", "--iso"}, {"kabus22-setup", "--unattended"},
            {"kabus22-setup", "--iso", "one.iso", "--setup", "setup.exe"},
            {"kabus22-setup", "--iso", "one.iso", "--iso", "two.iso"},
            {"kabus22-setup", "--launcher"}, {"kabus22-setup", "--launcher", "one", "--launcher", "two"},
            {"kabus22-setup", "--unknown"}, {"kabus22-setup", "--source", "a", "--iso", "b"},
            {"kabus22-setup", "--verify", "--repair", "--source", "a"}, {"kabus22-setup", "--repair"},
            {"kabus22-setup", "--verify", "--source", "a"}, {"kabus22-setup", "--json"},
            {"kabus22-setup", "--unattended", "--verify", "--source", "a"}}) {
        bool rejected = false;
        try { (void)parse(invalid); } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { rejected = true; }
        if (!rejected) throw std::runtime_error("CLI invalid argument regression");
    }
}
void defaults(Request& request) {
    const auto paths = defaultPaths();
    if (request.installRoot.empty()) request.installRoot = paths.installRoot;
    request.applicationsDir = paths.applicationsDir;
    request.desktopDir = paths.desktopDir;
    // Only executable siblings are implicit payloads; never search PATH or the working directory.
    const auto bundle = fs::read_symlink("/proc/self/exe").parent_path();
    if (request.enginePayload.empty()) request.enginePayload = bundle / "kabus22";
    if (request.launcherPayload.empty()) request.launcherPayload = bundle / "kabus22-launcher";
    if (request.updaterPayload.empty()) request.updaterPayload = bundle / "kabus22-updater";
    if (request.extractor.empty()) request.extractor = bundle / "innoextract";
}
// Machine-readable progress for the launcher: "progress <0-100> <message>", only on change.
Progress printer() {
    return [last = std::string(), percent = -1](const std::string& stage, std::uint64_t done, std::uint64_t total) mutable {
        const int now = total ? static_cast<int>(std::min(done, total) * 100 / total) : std::max(percent, 0);
        if (now != percent || stage != last) { std::cout << "progress " << now << ' ' << stage << std::endl; percent = now; last = stage; }
        return !interrupted.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    };
}

struct Pixels {
    int width = 0, height = 0, stride = 0;
    std::vector<unsigned char> rgba;
};
Pixels nativeArtwork(const fs::path& path) {
    constexpr int maxBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
    constexpr std::int64_t maxPixels = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
    const auto failure = [](const char* action, int error) {
        char detail[AV_ERROR_MAX_STRING_SIZE]{};
        av_strerror(error, detail, sizeof(detail));
        return std::runtime_error(std::string("Artwork: ") + action + ": " + detail);
    };
    std::ifstream input(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!input) throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: cannot open extracted JPEG");
    const auto length = input.tellg();
    if (length < std::streampos(4) || length > std::streampos(maxBytes))
        throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: JPEG size must be between 4 bytes and 8 MiB");
    const int bytes = static_cast<int>(static_cast<std::streamoff>(length));
    input.seekg(0);
    const auto freePacket = [](AVPacket* value) { av_packet_free(&value); };
    std::unique_ptr<AVPacket, decltype(freePacket)> packet(av_packet_alloc(), freePacket);
    if (!packet) throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: cannot allocate JPEG packet");
    int result = av_new_packet(packet.get(), bytes);
    if (result < 0) throw failure("cannot allocate padded JPEG bytes", result);
    if (!input.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(packet->data), bytes) ||
        input.peek() != std::char_traits<char>::eof() || input.bad())
        throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: cannot read complete JPEG, or file changed during reading");
    if (packet->data[0] != 0xff || packet->data[1] != 0xd8)
        throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: extracted file is not a standalone JPEG");
    const AVCodec* decoder = avcodec_find_decoder(AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG);
    if (!decoder) throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: FFmpeg MJPEG decoder is unavailable");
    const auto freeCodec = [](AVCodecContext* value) { avcodec_free_context(&value); };
    std::unique_ptr<AVCodecContext, decltype(freeCodec)> context(avcodec_alloc_context3(decoder), freeCodec);
    if (!context) throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: cannot allocate JPEG decoder");
    context->thread_count = 1;
    context->max_pixels = maxPixels;
    context->err_recognition = AV_EF_EXPLODE;
    result = avcodec_open2(context.get(), decoder, nullptr);
    if (result < 0) throw failure("cannot open JPEG decoder", result);
    result = avcodec_send_packet(context.get(), packet.get());
    if (result < 0) throw failure("cannot decode JPEG packet", result);
    const auto freeFrame = [](AVFrame* value) { av_frame_free(&value); };
    std::unique_ptr<AVFrame, decltype(freeFrame)> frame(av_frame_alloc(), freeFrame);
    if (!frame) throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: cannot allocate decoded frame");
    result = avcodec_receive_frame(context.get(), frame.get());
    if (result < 0) throw failure("cannot receive decoded JPEG image", result);
    if (frame->width <= 0 || frame->height <= 0 || frame->format < 0 ||
        std::int64_t(frame->width) * frame->height > maxPixels)
        throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: invalid image dimensions or image exceeds 16 megapixels");
    Pixels pixels;
    pixels.width = frame->width;
    pixels.height = frame->height;
    // Fits the wizard page body without growing the 391px Inno page height.
    constexpr int maxWidth = 440, maxHeight = 100;
    if (pixels.width > maxWidth || pixels.height > maxHeight) {
        if (std::int64_t(frame->width) * maxHeight >= std::int64_t(frame->height) * maxWidth) {
            pixels.width = maxWidth;
            pixels.height = std::max(1, int(std::int64_t(frame->height) * maxWidth / frame->width));
        } else {
            pixels.height = maxHeight;
            pixels.width = std::max(1, int(std::int64_t(frame->width) * maxHeight / frame->height));
        }
    }
    pixels.stride = pixels.width * 4;
    pixels.rgba.resize(std::size_t(pixels.stride) * pixels.height);
    std::unique_ptr<SwsContext, decltype(&sws_freeContext)> scaler(
        sws_getContext(frame->width, frame->height, static_cast<AVPixelFormat>(frame->format),
            pixels.width, pixels.height, AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA, SWS_BILINEAR, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr),
        &sws_freeContext);
    if (!scaler) throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: cannot create JPEG-to-RGBA scaler");
    unsigned char* destination[4] = {pixels.rgba.data(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
    const int strides[4] = {pixels.stride, 0, 0, 0};
    result = sws_scale(scaler.get(), frame->data, frame->linesize, 0, frame->height, destination, strides);
    if (result < 0) throw failure("cannot convert JPEG to RGBA", result);
    if (result != pixels.height) throw std::runtime_error("Artwork: incomplete JPEG-to-RGBA conversion");
    return pixels;
}

struct PreviewScratch {
    fs::path root;
    PreviewScratch() {
        GError* error = nullptr;
        char* directory = g_dir_make_tmp("kabus22-artwork-XXXXXX", &error);
        if (!directory) {
            const std::string message = error ? error->message : "Cannot create artwork scratch directory";
            if (error) g_error_free(error);
            throw std::runtime_error(message);
        }
        root = directory;
        g_free(directory);
    }
    ~PreviewScratch() { std::error_code error; fs::remove_all(root, error); }
};
void accessible(GtkWidget* widget, const char* name, const char* description = nullptr) {
    AtkObject* object = gtk_widget_get_accessible(widget);
    atk_object_set_name(object, name);
    if (description) atk_object_set_description(object, description);
}
std::string displayText(const std::string& text) {
    char* valid = g_utf8_make_valid(text.data(), static_cast<gssize>(text.size()));
    std::string result = valid;
    g_free(valid);
    return result;
}
void labelText(GtkWidget* label, const std::string& text) {
    const auto valid = displayText(text);
    gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(label), valid.c_str());
}
// Inno's page icons; themes without them leave the space empty instead of a broken-image glyph.
GtkWidget* themedIcon(const char* name) {
    return gtk_icon_theme_has_icon(gtk_icon_theme_get_default(), name) ? gtk_image_new_from_icon_name(name, GTK_ICON_SIZE_DND) : gtk_image_new();
}

const char* T(Text id) { return texts[id][language]; }

// The original setup first asks for its language; the system locale preselects it.
bool chooseLanguage() {
    const char* locale = nullptr;
    for (const char* name : {"LC_ALL", "LC_MESSAGES", "LANG"}) if ((locale = g_getenv(name)) && *locale) break;
    const std::string_view code = locale ? locale : "";
    language = code.starts_with("tr") ? Turkish : code.starts_with("de") ? German : English;
    auto* dialog = gtk_dialog_new_with_buttons(T(LanguageTitle), nullptr, GTK_DIALOG_MODAL,
        T(Ok), GTK_RESPONSE_OK, T(Cancel), GTK_RESPONSE_CANCEL, nullptr);
    gtk_window_set_resizable(GTK_WINDOW(dialog), FALSE);
    gtk_window_set_position(GTK_WINDOW(dialog), GTK_WIN_POS_CENTER);
    auto* row = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, 14);
    gtk_container_set_border_width(GTK_CONTAINER(row), 10);
    auto* icon = themedIcon("media-optical");
    gtk_widget_set_valign(icon, GTK_ALIGN_START);
    auto* column = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, 18);
    auto* choices = gtk_combo_box_text_new();
    for (const char* name : {"Deutsch", "English", "Türkçe"}) gtk_combo_box_text_append_text(GTK_COMBO_BOX_TEXT(choices), name);
    gtk_combo_box_set_active(GTK_COMBO_BOX(choices), language);
    accessible(choices, "Setup language");
    gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(column), k22::wizard::text(T(LanguagePrompt)), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
    gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(column), choices, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
    gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(row), icon, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
    gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(row), column, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
    gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(gtk_dialog_get_content_area(GTK_DIALOG(dialog))), row, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
    gtk_dialog_set_default_response(GTK_DIALOG(dialog), GTK_RESPONSE_OK);
    gtk_widget_show_all(dialog);
    gtk_widget_grab_focus(gtk_dialog_get_widget_for_response(GTK_DIALOG(dialog), GTK_RESPONSE_OK));
    const bool accepted = gtk_dialog_run(GTK_DIALOG(dialog)) == GTK_RESPONSE_OK;
    language = static_cast<Language>(std::clamp(gtk_combo_box_get_active(GTK_COMBO_BOX(choices)), 0, 2));
    gtk_widget_destroy(dialog);
    return accepted;
}

// Inno Setup page flow: welcome, media (native addition), destination, additional tasks, ready,
// installing, finished. Welcome/finished show the large wizard image, inner pages the small one.
enum Page { Welcome, Media, Destination, Tasks, Ready, Installing, Finished };
class Installer {
    Request request_;
    Result result_;
    GtkWidget *window_, *stack_, *source_, *destination_, *patch_, *image_, *mediaStatus_, *mediaErrors_,
              *summary_, *status_, *errors_, *progress_, *launchCheck_, *finishErrors_, *back_, *next_, *cancel_;
    std::vector<GtkWidget*> editable_, sides_, smalls_;
    GtkFileChooserNative* chooser_ = nullptr;
    std::mutex mutex_;
    std::thread worker_;
    std::atomic<bool> cancelled_{false};
    std::string stage_, error_;
    std::uint64_t done_ = 0, total_ = 0;
    Pixels pixels_;
    GdkPixbuf *wizard_ = nullptr, *wizardSmall_ = nullptr; // worker results, under mutex_
    int page_ = Welcome;
    bool finished_ = false, dirty_ = false, succeeded_ = false, busy_ = false, previewing_ = false,
         installed_ = false, closing_ = false;
    guint timer_ = 0;
    bool loose_;

    GtkWidget* button(GtkWidget* box, const char* mnemonic, GCallback callback) {
        auto* widget = gtk_button_new_with_mnemonic(mnemonic);
        g_signal_connect(widget, "clicked", callback, this);
        gtk_box_pack_end(GTK_BOX(box), widget, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        return widget;
    }
    // Entry with Inno's Browse… button beside it.
    GtkWidget* field(GtkWidget* body, const char* name, const fs::path& value, const char* description, GCallback browse) {
        auto* row = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, 10);
        auto* entry = gtk_entry_new();
        gtk_entry_set_text(GTK_ENTRY(entry), value.c_str());
        gtk_widget_set_tooltip_text(entry, description);
        accessible(entry, name, description);
        auto* browser = gtk_button_new_with_mnemonic(T(Browse));
        accessible(browser, (std::string("Browse: ") + name).c_str(), description);
        g_signal_connect(browser, "clicked", browse, this);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(row), entry, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(row), browser, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(body), row, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        editable_.insert(editable_.end(), {entry, browser});
        return entry;
    }
    void add(GtkWidget* page, int index) {
        gtk_stack_add_named(GTK_STACK(stack_), page, std::to_string(index).c_str());
    }
    // Welcome / finished: large wizard image at the left, white text panel (returned for extras).
    GtkWidget* sidePage(int index, Text title, Text body) {
        auto* page = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, 0);
        auto* side = k22::wizard::styled(gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, 0), "wizard-side");
        gtk_widget_set_size_request(side, k22::wizard::SideWidth, k22::wizard::PageHeight);
        auto* image = gtk_image_new();
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(side), image, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
        sides_.push_back(image);
        auto* paper = k22::wizard::styled(gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, 0), "wizard-white");
        auto* panel = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, 12);
        for (auto edge : {gtk_widget_set_margin_start, gtk_widget_set_margin_end, gtk_widget_set_margin_top, gtk_widget_set_margin_bottom})
            edge(panel, 14);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(panel), k22::wizard::styled(k22::wizard::text(T(title)), "wizard-welcome-title"), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(panel), k22::wizard::text(T(body)), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(paper), panel, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(page), side, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(page), paper, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
        add(page, index);
        return panel;
    }
    // Inner page: header strip, then the indented body this returns.
    GtkWidget* innerPage(int index, Text title, Text subtitle) {
        GtkWidget *heading, *subheading, *image;
        auto* page = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(page), k22::wizard::header(heading, subheading, image), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(heading), T(title));
        gtk_label_set_text(GTK_LABEL(subheading), T(subtitle));
        smalls_.push_back(image);
        auto* body = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL, 12);
        gtk_widget_set_margin_start(body, 36);
        gtk_widget_set_margin_end(body, 36);
        gtk_widget_set_margin_top(body, 16);
        gtk_widget_set_margin_bottom(body, 12);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(page), body, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
        add(page, index);
        return body;
    }
    // Inno's icon + sentence line at the top of the media and destination pages.
    void lead(GtkWidget* body, const char* icon, Text text) {
        auto* row = gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, 12);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(row), themedIcon(icon), FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        auto* label = k22::wizard::text(T(text));
        gtk_widget_set_valign(label, GTK_ALIGN_CENTER);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(row), label, TRUE, TRUE, 0);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(body), row, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
    }
    GtkWidget* detail(GtkWidget* body, bool expand) {
        auto* label = k22::wizard::text("");
        gtk_label_set_selectable(GTK_LABEL(label), TRUE);
        gtk_widget_set_valign(label, GTK_ALIGN_START);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(body), label, expand, expand, 0);
        return label;
    }
    // Consumes both references; a missing image keeps the plain panel.
    void artwork(GdkPixbuf* large, GdkPixbuf* small) {
        if (large) {
            auto* scaled = gdk_pixbuf_scale_simple(large, k22::wizard::SideWidth, k22::wizard::PageHeight, GDK_INTERP_BILINEAR);
            for (auto* image : sides_) gtk_image_set_from_pixbuf(GTK_IMAGE(image), scaled);
            if (scaled) g_object_unref(scaled);
            g_object_unref(large);
        }
        if (small) {
            for (auto* image : smalls_) gtk_image_set_from_pixbuf(GTK_IMAGE(image), small);
            g_object_unref(small);
        }
    }
    std::string text(GtkWidget* entry) const { return gtk_entry_get_text(GTK_ENTRY(entry)); }
    void setControls() {
        // The artwork preview runs in the background; only the media row and Install wait for it.
        const bool idle = !busy_, browsing = idle || previewing_;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < editable_.size(); ++i) gtk_widget_set_sensitive(editable_[i], !installed_ && (idle || (previewing_ && i >= 2)));
        gtk_widget_set_visible(back_, (page_ > Welcome && page_ < Installing) || (page_ == Installing && idle && !installed_));
        gtk_widget_set_sensitive(back_, browsing);
        gtk_widget_set_visible(next_, page_ != Installing);
        gtk_button_set_label(GTK_BUTTON(next_), T(page_ == Ready ? InstallButton : page_ == Finished ? Finish : Next));
        const bool filled = (page_ != Media || !text(source_).empty()) && (page_ != Destination || !text(destination_).empty());
        gtk_widget_set_sensitive(next_, (page_ == Ready ? idle : browsing) && filled && !closing_);
        gtk_widget_set_visible(cancel_, page_ != Finished);
        gtk_widget_set_sensitive(cancel_, !busy_ || !cancelled_.load());
    }
    void show(int page) {
        page_ = page;
        gtk_stack_set_visible_child_name(GTK_STACK(stack_), std::to_string(page).c_str());
        if (page == Ready) {
            std::string summary = std::string(T(ReadyDestination)) + "\n      " + text(destination_) + "\n\n" + T(ReadyMedia) +
                "\n      " + text(source_) + "\n\n" + T(ReadyTasks) + "\n      " + T(ReadyShortcuts);
            if (!text(patch_).empty()) summary += "\n      " + std::string(T(ReadyExtras)) + text(patch_);
            gtk_text_buffer_set_text(gtk_text_view_get_buffer(GTK_TEXT_VIEW(summary_)), displayText(summary).c_str(), -1);
        }
        setControls();
        if (gtk_widget_get_visible(next_)) gtk_widget_grab_focus(next_);
    }
    void next() {
        if (page_ == Ready) begin(false);
        else if (page_ == Finished) finish();
        else show(page_ + 1);
    }
    void finish() {
        if (gtk_toggle_button_get_active(GTK_TOGGLE_BUTTON(launchCheck_))) {
            try { launch(result_); }
            catch (const std::exception& error) {
                labelText(finishErrors_, error.what());
                gtk_toggle_button_set_active(GTK_TOGGLE_BUTTON(launchCheck_), FALSE);
                return;
            }
        }
        close();
    }
    bool confirmExit() {
        auto* dialog = gtk_message_dialog_new(GTK_WINDOW(window_), GTK_DIALOG_MODAL, GTK_MESSAGE_QUESTION, GTK_BUTTONS_NONE, "%s", T(ExitBody));
        gtk_window_set_title(GTK_WINDOW(dialog), T(ExitTitle));
        gtk_dialog_add_buttons(GTK_DIALOG(dialog), T(Yes), GTK_RESPONSE_YES, T(No), GTK_RESPONSE_NO, nullptr);
        gtk_dialog_set_default_response(GTK_DIALOG(dialog), GTK_RESPONSE_NO);
        const bool yes = gtk_dialog_run(GTK_DIALOG(dialog)) == GTK_RESPONSE_YES;
        gtk_widget_destroy(dialog);
        return yes;
    }
    void cancelPressed() {
        if (installed_) close();
        else if (busy_ && previewing_ && page_ == Media) cancel();
        else if (confirmExit()) close();
    }
    void choose(GtkWidget* entry, GtkFileChooserAction action, bool source, bool parent = false) {
        auto* dialog = gtk_file_chooser_native_new(source ? "Select original Kabus22 media" :
                parent ? "Select parent for the new kabus22 directory" : "Select optional Kabus22Patch community extras",
                GTK_WINDOW(window_), action, "Select", "Cancel");
        chooser_ = dialog;
        if (source) {
            auto* filter = gtk_file_filter_new();
            gtk_file_filter_set_name(filter, loose_ ? "Original setup.exe (developer media)" : "ISO images");
            gtk_file_filter_add_pattern(filter, loose_ ? "*.exe" : "*.iso");
            gtk_file_filter_add_pattern(filter, loose_ ? "*.EXE" : "*.ISO");
            gtk_file_chooser_add_filter(GTK_FILE_CHOOSER(dialog), filter);
            auto* all = gtk_file_filter_new();
            gtk_file_filter_set_name(all, "All files");
            gtk_file_filter_add_pattern(all, "*");
            gtk_file_chooser_add_filter(GTK_FILE_CHOOSER(dialog), all);
        }
        const fs::path current = gtk_entry_get_text(GTK_ENTRY(entry));
        if (!current.empty()) {
            const auto folder = (source || parent) ? current.parent_path() : current;
            gtk_file_chooser_set_current_folder(GTK_FILE_CHOOSER(dialog), folder.c_str());
        }
        bool selectedSource = false;
        if (gtk_native_dialog_run(GTK_NATIVE_DIALOG(dialog)) == GTK_RESPONSE_ACCEPT && !closing_) {
            char* selected = gtk_file_chooser_get_filename(GTK_FILE_CHOOSER(dialog));
            if (selected) {
                fs::path path = selected;
                g_free(selected);
                if (parent) path /= "kabus22";
                gtk_entry_set_text(GTK_ENTRY(entry), path.c_str());
                selectedSource = source;
            }
        }
        g_object_unref(dialog);
        chooser_ = nullptr;
        if (closing_) { close(); return; }
        if (selectedSource) begin(true);
    }
    void begin(bool preview) {
        if (busy_ || installed_) return;
        GtkWidget* status = preview ? mediaStatus_ : status_;
        GtkWidget* errors = preview ? mediaErrors_ : errors_;
        if (!preview) show(Installing);
        try {
            labelText(errors, "");
            const fs::path source = text(source_);
            if (source.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("Select your original ISO image first.");
            Request input = request_;
            input.source = fs::absolute(source).lexically_normal();
            input.sourceIso.clear(); input.sourceSetup.clear();
            input.installRoot = text(destination_);
            if (input.installRoot.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("Choose an installation directory.");
            input.installRoot = fs::absolute(input.installRoot).lexically_normal();
            input.optionalPatch = text(patch_);
            if (!input.optionalPatch.empty()) input.optionalPatch = fs::absolute(input.optionalPatch).lexically_normal();
            cancelled_ = false;
            busy_ = true;
            previewing_ = preview;
            labelText(status, T(preview ? ReadingArtwork : Preparing));
            gtk_progress_bar_set_fraction(GTK_PROGRESS_BAR(progress_), 0);
            {
                std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                finished_ = succeeded_ = dirty_ = false;
                stage_.clear(); error_.clear(); done_ = total_ = 0;
                pixels_ = {};
            }
            if (preview) gtk_image_clear(GTK_IMAGE(image_));
            setControls();
            worker_ = std::thread([this, input = std::move(input), preview] {
                const auto progress = [this](const std::string& stage, std::uint64_t done, std::uint64_t total) {
                    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                    stage_ = stage; done_ = done; total_ = total; dirty_ = true;
                    return !cancelled_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && !interrupted.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
                };
                try {
                    if (preview) {
                        PreviewScratch scratch;
                        const auto artwork = previewArtwork(input.source, input.extractor, scratch.root / "media", progress);
                        if (cancelled_.load() || interrupted.load()) throw Cancelled();
                        auto pixels = nativeArtwork(artwork.logo);
                        auto* large = k22::wizard::load(artwork.wizard);
                        auto* small = k22::wizard::load(artwork.wizardSmall);
                        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                        pixels_ = std::move(pixels);
                        if (wizard_) g_object_unref(wizard_);
                        if (wizardSmall_) g_object_unref(wizardSmall_);
                        wizard_ = large; wizardSmall_ = small;
                        stage_ = T(ArtworkLoaded);
                    } else {
                        auto result = install(input, progress);
                        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                        result_ = std::move(result);
                        succeeded_ = true;
                    }
                } catch (const Cancelled& error) {
                    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                    stage_ = T(preview ? ArtworkCancelled : InstallCancelled);
                    error_ = error.what();
                } catch (const std::exception& error) {
                    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                    stage_ = T(preview ? ArtworkFailed : NotCompleted);
                    error_ = error.what();
                } catch (...) {
                    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                    stage_ = T(preview ? ArtworkFailed : NotCompleted);
                    error_ = "Unexpected native installer error.";
                }
                std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                finished_ = dirty_ = true;
            });
        } catch (const std::exception& error) {
            busy_ = false;
            previewing_ = false;
            labelText(status, preview ? "" : T(NotCompleted));
            labelText(errors, error.what());
            setControls();
        }
    }
    void cancel() {
        if (!busy_) return;
        cancelled_ = true;
        labelText(previewing_ ? mediaStatus_ : status_, T(Cancelling));
        setControls();
    }
    void close() {
        if (chooser_) {
            closing_ = true;
            gtk_native_dialog_hide(GTK_NATIVE_DIALOG(chooser_));
            g_signal_emit_by_name(chooser_, "response", GTK_RESPONSE_CANCEL);
        } else if (busy_) { closing_ = true; cancel(); }
        else gtk_widget_destroy(window_);
    }
    gboolean tick() {
        if (interrupted.load()) close();
        if (!busy_) return G_SOURCE_CONTINUE;
        bool finished;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            finished = finished_;
            if (dirty_) {
                if (!cancelled_.load() || finished) labelText(previewing_ ? mediaStatus_ : status_, stage_);
                labelText(previewing_ ? mediaErrors_ : errors_, error_);
                if (!previewing_)
                    gtk_progress_bar_set_fraction(GTK_PROGRESS_BAR(progress_), total_ ?
                        std::clamp(static_cast<double>(done_) / static_cast<double>(total_), 0.0, 1.0) : 0);
                dirty_ = false;
            }
            if (!total_ && !finished && !previewing_) gtk_progress_bar_pulse(GTK_PROGRESS_BAR(progress_));
        }
        if (!finished) return G_SOURCE_CONTINUE;
        worker_.join();
        busy_ = false;
        previewing_ = false;
        installed_ = succeeded_;
        if (!pixels_.rgba.empty()) {
            auto pixels = std::make_unique<Pixels>(std::move(pixels_));
            auto* pixbuf = gdk_pixbuf_new_from_data(pixels->rgba.data(), GDK_COLORSPACE_RGB, TRUE, 8,
                pixels->width, pixels->height, pixels->stride,
                [](guchar*, gpointer owner) { delete static_cast<Pixels*>(owner); }, pixels.get());
            if (pixbuf) {
                pixels.release();
                gtk_image_set_from_pixbuf(GTK_IMAGE(image_), pixbuf);
                g_object_unref(pixbuf);
                accessible(image_, "Original Kabus22 logo", "Decoded from the selected original game media.");
            } else labelText(mediaErrors_, "Cannot display the decoded original artwork.");
        }
        artwork(std::exchange(wizard_, nullptr), std::exchange(wizardSmall_, nullptr));
        if (closing_) { gtk_widget_destroy(window_); return G_SOURCE_CONTINUE; }
        if (installed_) {
            gtk_progress_bar_set_fraction(GTK_PROGRESS_BAR(progress_), 1);
            show(Finished);
        } else setControls();
        return G_SOURCE_CONTINUE;
    }
public:
    explicit Installer(Request request) : request_(std::move(request)), loose_(!request_.sourceSetup.empty()) {
        window_ = gtk_window_new(GTK_WINDOW_TOPLEVEL);
        gtk_window_set_title(GTK_WINDOW(window_), T(Title));
        gtk_window_set_resizable(GTK_WINDOW(window_), FALSE);

        auto* nav = k22::wizard::styled(gtk_box_new(GTK_ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL, 0), "wizard-nav");
        gtk_container_set_border_width(GTK_CONTAINER(nav), 12);
        gtk_box_pack_start(GTK_BOX(content), nav, FALSE, FALSE, 0);
        cancel_ = button(nav, T(Cancel), G_CALLBACK(+[](GtkButton*, gpointer data) { static_cast<Installer*>(data)->cancelPressed(); }));
        gtk_widget_set_margin_start(cancel_, 10);
        next_ = button(nav, T(Next), G_CALLBACK(+[](GtkButton*, gpointer data) { static_cast<Installer*>(data)->next(); }));
        back_ = button(nav, T(Back), G_CALLBACK(+[](GtkButton*, gpointer data) {

        }));

            !request_.source.empty() ? request_.source : loose_ ? request_.sourceSetup : request_.sourceIso,

            G_CALLBACK(+[](GtkButton*, gpointer data) { auto* self = static_cast<Installer*>(data); self->choose(self->source_, GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN, true); }));

            g_signal_connect(entry, "changed", G_CALLBACK(+[](GtkEditable* editable, gpointer data) {

                self->setControls();
            }), this);
        g_signal_connect(window_, "delete-event", G_CALLBACK(+[](GtkWidget*, GdkEvent*, gpointer data) -> gboolean {

            if (self->installed_ || self->confirmExit()) self->close();
            return TRUE;
        }), this);
        g_signal_connect(window_, "destroy", G_CALLBACK(+[](GtkWidget*, gpointer) { gtk_main_quit(); }), nullptr);

            if (key->keyval != GDK_KEY_Escape) return FALSE;
            static_cast<Installer*>(data)->cancelPressed();

        }), this);
        timer_ = g_timeout_add(100, +[](gpointer data) -> gboolean { return static_cast<Installer*>(data)->tick(); }, this);

        if (!text(source_).empty()) begin(true);
    }
    ~Installer() {
        if (timer_) g_source_remove(timer_);
        cancelled_ = true;
        if (worker_.joinable()) worker_.join();
        if (wizard_) g_object_unref(wizard_);
        if (wizardSmall_) g_object_unref(wizardSmall_);
    }
};
```
