int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        auto options = arguments(argc, argv);
        if (options.help) {
            std::cout << Version << "\nUsage: kabus22-setup [--source GAME.iso|setup.exe|WINDOWS_GAME_FOLDER] [--install-dir DIRECTORY]\n"
                "                     [--patch PATCH_DIRECTORY] [--engine NATIVE_ELF] [--launcher SETTINGS_ELF]\n"
                "                     [--updater UPDATER_ELF] [--extractor INNOEXTRACT] [--unattended]\n"
                "       kabus22-setup --verify [--install-dir ROOT] [--json]\n"
                "       kabus22-setup --repair [--install-dir ROOT] --source GAME.iso|setup.exe|WINDOWS_GAME_FOLDER [--unattended]\n"
                "--source detects an ISO image, original setup.exe with sibling setup-1.bin, or an installed\n"
                "Windows Kabus22 folder (K22.wrs + K22.exe; only game data is imported). --iso/--setup still work.\n"
                "Original-campaign widescreen is included in the native engine; no patch folder is required.\n"
                "--patch optionally installs separately obtained Kabus22Patch extras; none are bundled or auto-discovered.\n"
                "--unattended installs without a window; SIGINT/SIGTERM cancel safely.\n"
                "--verify compares installed files with the recorded inventory (exit 3 on mismatch).\n"
                "--repair restores missing/modified game files from the source, then verifies (exit 3 if any remain).\n"
                "--engine, --launcher, --updater and --extractor override trusted bundled siblings for development.\n"
                "--self-check runs CLI/core security regression checks without installing.\n";
            return 0;
        }
        if (options.version) { std::cout << Version << '\n'; return 0; }
        if (options.check) { argumentCheck(); selfCheck(); std::cout << "Installer self-check passed.\n"; return 0; }
        defaults(options.request);
        std::signal(SIGINT, interrupt);
        std::signal(SIGTERM, interrupt);
        if (options.verify || options.repair) {
            auto& request = options.request;
            const auto source = !request.source.empty() ? request.source : !request.sourceIso.empty() ? request.sourceIso : request.sourceSetup;
            const auto result = options.verify ? verify(request.installRoot, options.json ? Progress{} : printer())
                                               : repair(request.installRoot, source, request.extractor, printer());
            if (options.json) {
                std::cout << nlohmann::json{{"ok", result.ok()}, {"checked", result.checked},
                    {"missing", result.missing}, {"modified", result.modified}}.dump() << '\n';
            } else {
                for (const auto& path : result.missing) std::cerr << "missing: " << path << '\n';
                for (const auto& path : result.modified) std::cerr << "modified: " << path << '\n';
                std::cout << (result.ok() ? "Installation verified: " : "Installation has mismatches: ") << result.checked << " files checked, "
                          << result.missing.size() << " missing, " << result.modified.size() << " modified\n";
            }
            return result.ok() ? 0 : 3;
        }
        if (options.unattended) {
            const auto result = install(options.request, printer());
            std::cout << "Native installation complete: " << result.root << "\nShortcut: " << result.shortcut << '\n';
            return 0;
        }
        if (!gtk_init_check(nullptr, nullptr))
            throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open the GTK display. Use --unattended with --iso for a headless install.");
        k22::wizard::style();
        if (!chooseLanguage()) return 0;
        Installer installer(std::move(options.request));
        gtk_main();
        return 0;
    } catch (const Cancelled& error) {
        std::cerr << "kabus22-setup: " << error.what() << '\n';
        return 130;
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        std::cerr << "kabus22-setup: " << error.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }
}

#include "media.hpp"
#include <archive.h>
#include <archive_entry.h>
#include <glib.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cerrno>
#include <charconv>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <spawn.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>

extern char** environ;
namespace k22::setup::media {
namespace {
constexpr std::uint64_t memberLimit = 4ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
constexpr std::uint64_t totalLimit = 32ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
constexpr std::size_t entryLimit = 32768, listingLimit = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
void require(bool ok, const std::string& message) {
    if (!ok) throw std::runtime_error(message);
}
void report(const Progress& progress, const std::string& stage,
            std::uint64_t done = 0, std::uint64_t total = 0) {
    if (progress && !progress(stage, done, total)) throw Cancelled();
}
struct Fd {
    int value = -1;
    explicit Fd(int fd) : value(fd) {}
    ~Fd() { if (value >= 0) ::close(value); }
    Fd(const Fd&) = delete;
    Fd& operator=(const Fd&) = delete;
};
std::string fold(std::string_view value) {
    require(g_utf8_validate(value.data(), static_cast<gssize>(value.size()), nullptr), "Invalid UTF-8 media path");
    std::unique_ptr<gchar, decltype(&g_free)> folded(g_utf8_casefold(value.data(), static_cast<gssize>(value.size())), g_free);
    std::unique_ptr<gchar, decltype(&g_free)> normalized(g_utf8_normalize(folded.get(), -1, G_NORMALIZE_ALL_COMPOSE), g_free);
    require(normalized != nullptr, "Cannot normalize media path");
    return normalized.get();
}
void memberPath(std::string_view value) {
    require(!value.empty() && value.size() <= 1024 && value.front() != '/' && value.back() != '/', "Invalid media member path");
    require(g_utf8_validate(value.data(), static_cast<gssize>(value.size()), nullptr), "Invalid UTF-8 media member path");
    for (const auto ch : value) {
        const auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(ch);
        require(c >= 32 && c != 127 && std::string_view("\\:\"*?<>|").find(ch) == std::string_view::npos,
                "Unsafe character in media member path");
    }
    for (std::size_t begin = 0; begin < value.size();) {
        auto end = value.find('/', begin);
        if (end == std::string_view::npos) end = value.size();
        const auto part = value.substr(begin, end - begin);
        require(!part.empty() && part != "." && part != ".." && part.size() <= 255 &&
                part.front() != ' ' && part.back() != ' ' && part.back() != '.', "Unsafe media member component");
        begin = end + 1;
    }
    for (const gchar* p = value.data(); p < value.data() + value.size(); p = g_utf8_next_char(p))
        require(!g_unichar_iscntrl(g_utf8_get_char(p)), "Control character in media member path");
}
struct Paths {
    struct Node { std::string exact; bool directory; bool explicitEntry; };
    std::map<std::string, Node> seen;
    void add(const std::string& path, bool directory) {
        memberPath(path);
        std::size_t end = 0;
        do {
            end = path.find('/', end);
            const bool leaf = end == std::string::npos;
            const auto prefix = leaf ? path : path.substr(0, end);
            const bool dir = !leaf || directory;
            const auto key = fold(prefix);
            auto [it, inserted] = seen.emplace(key, Node{prefix, dir, leaf});
            if (!inserted) {
                require(it->second.exact == prefix && it->second.directory == dir,
                        "Case-fold or file/directory conflict: " + path);
                if (leaf) {
                    require(!it->second.explicitEntry, "Duplicate media member: " + path);
                    it->second.explicitEntry = true;
                }
            }
            if (leaf) break;
            ++end;
        } while (true);
    }
};
fs::path checkedPath(const fs::path& input) {
    require(!input.empty(), "Empty source path");
    const auto text = input.string();
    for (unsigned char c : text) require(c >= 32 && c != 127, "Control character in source path");
    require(g_utf8_validate(text.data(), static_cast<gssize>(text.size()), nullptr), "Invalid UTF-8 source path");
    auto path = fs::absolute(input);
    for (const auto& part : path) require(part != "..", "Parent traversal in source path");
    path = path.lexically_normal();
    fs::path current = path.root_path();
    for (const auto& part : path.relative_path()) {
        current /= part;
        struct stat st{};
        require(::lstat(current.c_str(), &st) == 0 && !S_ISLNK(st.st_mode), "Missing or symlink source path: " + current.string());
        if (current != path) require(S_ISDIR(st.st_mode), "Non-directory source ancestor");
    }
    return path;
}
struct stat regular(const fs::path& path, std::uint64_t limit = memberLimit) {
    struct stat st{};
    require(::lstat(path.c_str(), &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode) && st.st_nlink == 1 && st.st_size >= 0 &&
            static_cast<std::uint64_t>(st.st_size) <= limit, "Source must be a bounded, non-linked regular file: " + path.string());
    return st;
}
void unchanged(const fs::path& path, const struct stat& before) {
    const auto after = regular(path, totalLimit);
    require(before.st_dev == after.st_dev && before.st_ino == after.st_ino && before.st_size == after.st_size &&
            before.st_mtim.tv_sec == after.st_mtim.tv_sec && before.st_mtim.tv_nsec == after.st_mtim.tv_nsec &&
            before.st_ctim.tv_sec == after.st_ctim.tv_sec && before.st_ctim.tv_nsec == after.st_ctim.tv_nsec,
            "Source changed while reading: " + path.string());
}
void privateDirectory(const fs::path& input, bool empty) {
    const auto path = checkedPath(input);
    struct stat st{};
    require(::lstat(path.c_str(), &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) && st.st_uid == geteuid() &&
            !(st.st_mode & (S_IRWXG | S_IRWXO)), "Media staging directory must be private and user-owned");
    if (empty) require(fs::is_empty(path), "Refusing nonempty media output directory");
}
void nativeHelper(const fs::path& helper) {
    const auto st = regular(helper);
    require(!(st.st_mode & (S_IWGRP | S_IWOTH)) && ::access(helper.c_str(), X_OK) == 0,
            "Extraction helper must be a protected executable ELF");
    Fd file(::open(helper.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
    require(file.value >= 0, "Cannot open native extraction helper");
    std::array<unsigned char, 20> header{};
    require(::pread(file.value, header.data(), header.size(), 0) == static_cast<ssize_t>(header.size()) &&
            header[0] == 0x7f && header[1] == 'E' && header[2] == 'L' && header[3] == 'F' &&
            header[4] == 2 && header[5] == 1 && header[6] == 1 &&
            (header[16] == 2 || header[16] == 3) && header[17] == 0, "Extraction helper is not a native ELF executable");
#if defined(__x86_64__)
    require(header[18] == 62 && header[19] == 0, "Extraction helper CPU architecture mismatch");
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
    require(header[18] == 183 && header[19] == 0, "Extraction helper CPU architecture mismatch");
#else
#error Native installer helper validation needs the target ELF architecture
#endif
}
struct Child {
    pid_t pid = -1;
    ~Child() {
        if (pid > 0) {
            ::kill(-pid, SIGKILL);
            ::kill(pid, SIGKILL);
            while (::waitpid(pid, nullptr, 0) < 0 && errno == EINTR) {}
        }
    }
};
std::string run(const fs::path& extractor, std::vector<std::string> options,
                const Progress& progress, const std::string& stage, std::size_t maximum = listingLimit) {
    const auto helper = checkedPath(extractor);
    nativeHelper(helper);
    report(progress, stage);
    std::vector<std::string> args{helper.string(), "--no-extract-unknown", "--color=0", "--progress=0"};
    for (auto& option : options) args.push_back(std::move(option));
    std::vector<char*> argv;
    for (auto& arg : args) argv.push_back(arg.data());
    argv.push_back(nullptr);
    std::vector<std::string> environment;
    for (char** e = environ; e && *e; ++e) {
        const std::string_view value(*e);
        if (!value.starts_with("LC_ALL=") && !value.starts_with("LANG=")) environment.emplace_back(value);
    }
    environment.emplace_back("LC_ALL=C");
    environment.emplace_back("LANG=C");
    std::vector<char*> env;
    for (auto& e : environment) env.push_back(e.data());
    env.push_back(nullptr);
    int out[2], err[2];
    require(::pipe2(out, O_CLOEXEC) == 0, "Cannot create helper output pipe");
    Fd outRead(out[0]), outWrite(out[1]);
    require(::pipe2(err, O_CLOEXEC) == 0, "Cannot create helper error pipe");
    Fd errRead(err[0]), errWrite(err[1]);
    require(::fcntl(outRead.value, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) == 0 && ::fcntl(errRead.value, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) == 0,
            "Cannot configure helper output pipes");
    posix_spawn_file_actions_t actions;
    require(::posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&actions) == 0, "Cannot initialize helper spawn");
    struct Actions { posix_spawn_file_actions_t* p; ~Actions() { posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(p); } } actionsGuard{&actions};
    posix_spawnattr_t attr;
    require(::posix_spawnattr_init(&attr) == 0, "Cannot initialize helper attributes");
    struct Attr { posix_spawnattr_t* p; ~Attr() { posix_spawnattr_destroy(p); } } attrGuard{&attr};
    require(::posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(&actions, outWrite.value, STDOUT_FILENO) == 0 &&
            ::posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(&actions, errWrite.value, STDERR_FILENO) == 0 &&
            ::posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&actions, STDIN_FILENO, "/dev/null", O_RDONLY, 0) == 0 &&
            ::posix_spawnattr_setflags(&attr, POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP) == 0 && ::posix_spawnattr_setpgroup(&attr, 0) == 0,
            "Cannot configure native helper spawn");
    Child child;
    const auto result = ::posix_spawn(&child.pid, helper.c_str(), &actions, &attr, argv.data(), env.data());
    require(result == 0, "Cannot start native extraction helper: " + std::string(std::strerror(result)));
    ::close(outWrite.value); outWrite.value = -1;
    ::close(errWrite.value); errWrite.value = -1;
    std::string output, errors;
    bool outOpen = true, errOpen = true, exited = false;
    int status = 0;
    std::array<char, 16384> buffer{};
    while (!exited || outOpen || errOpen) {
        report(progress, stage);
        pollfd pipes[2]{{outOpen ? outRead.value : -1, POLLIN, 0}, {errOpen ? errRead.value : -1, POLLIN, 0}};
        const auto ready = ::poll(pipes, 2, 100);
        require(ready >= 0 || errno == EINTR, "Cannot poll native extraction helper");
        auto drain = [&](int fd, bool& open, std::string& text, std::size_t cap) {
            if (!open) return;
            for (;;) {
                const auto n = ::read(fd, buffer.data(), buffer.size());
                if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
                if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)) break;
                require(n >= 0, "Cannot read extraction helper output");
                if (n == 0) { open = false; break; }
                require(static_cast<std::size_t>(n) <= cap - text.size(), "Extraction helper output exceeded safety limit");
                text.append(buffer.data(), static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
            }
        };
        drain(outRead.value, outOpen, output, maximum);
        drain(errRead.value, errOpen, errors, 65536);
        if (!exited) {
            const auto waited = ::waitpid(child.pid, &status, WNOHANG);
            require(waited >= 0 || errno == EINTR, "Cannot reap extraction helper");
            if (waited == child.pid) { exited = true; child.pid = -1; }
        }
    }
    require(WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0,
            "Native media helper failed: " + errors.substr(0, 4096));
    require(errors.empty(), "Native media helper reported unsafe or unsupported media: " + errors.substr(0, 4096));
    return output;
}
std::uint64_t decimal(std::string_view text) {
    std::uint64_t value = 0;
    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
    require(!text.empty() && result.ec == std::errc{} && result.ptr == text.data() + text.size(), "Invalid media byte count");
    return value;
}
void validateMembers(const std::vector<Member>& members) {
    require(!members.empty() && members.size() <= entryLimit, "Missing or excessive Inno members");
    Paths paths;
    std::uint64_t total = 0;
    for (const auto& member : members) {
        paths.add(member.path.generic_string(), false);
        require(member.size <= memberLimit && member.size <= totalLimit - total, "Inno member size limit exceeded");
        total += member.size;
        require(member.checksum.size() == 32 && std::all_of(member.checksum.begin(), member.checksum.end(), [](char c) {
            return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f');
        }), "Missing or invalid MD5 checksum");
    }
}
std::vector<Member> parseList(const std::string& text) {
    require(text.size() <= listingLimit && text.find('\0') == std::string::npos, "Invalid Inno listing");
    std::vector<Member> result;
    for (std::size_t begin = 0; begin < text.size();) {
        auto end = text.find('\n', begin);
        if (end == std::string::npos) end = text.size();
        const std::string_view line(text.data() + begin, end - begin);
        require(!line.empty(), "Unexpected blank Inno listing entry");
        const auto separator = line.find(' ');
        require(separator != std::string_view::npos && line.substr(separator, 5) == " MD5 ", "Unsupported Inno listing entry");
        const auto hash = separator + 5;
        require(line.size() > hash + 33 && line[hash + 32] == ' ', "Malformed Inno checksum listing");
        memberPath(line.substr(hash + 33));
        result.push_back({fs::path(std::string(line.substr(hash + 33))), decimal(line.substr(0, separator)), std::string(line.substr(hash, 32))});
        require(result.size() <= entryLimit, "Excessive Inno listing entries");
        begin = end + 1;
    }
    validateMembers(result);
    return result;
}
void validateVerbosePaths(const std::string& text) {
    Paths paths;
    std::set<std::string> exact;
    std::size_t count = 0;
    for (std::size_t begin = 0; begin < text.size();) {
        auto end = text.find('\n', begin);
        if (end == std::string::npos) end = text.size();
        const std::string_view line(text.data() + begin, end - begin);
        if (line.starts_with(" - \"")) {
            const auto quote = line.rfind('"');
            require(quote != std::string_view::npos && quote >= 4, "Malformed complete Inno path listing");
            std::string path(line.substr(4, quote - 4));
            const bool directory = !path.empty() && path.back() == '/';
            if (directory) path.pop_back();
            memberPath(path);
            require(++count <= entryLimit, "Excessive complete Inno path entries");
            if (!exact.insert(path).second) {
                // Original multilingual ISO overwrites an excluded Windows EXE.
                require(!directory && !selected({path, 0, {}}), "Duplicate selected Inno asset: " + path);
            } else {
                paths.add(path, directory);
            }
        }
        begin = end + 1;
    }
    require(count > 0, "Missing complete Inno path inventory");
}
struct IsoMember { fs::path path; std::uint64_t size; bool directory; };
using Archive = std::unique_ptr<struct archive, decltype(&archive_read_free)>;
Archive isoArchive(int fd) {
    require(::lseek(fd, 0, SEEK_SET) == 0, "Cannot rewind ISO source");
    Archive archive(archive_read_new(), archive_read_free);
    require(archive != nullptr && archive_read_support_filter_none(archive.get()) == ARCHIVE_OK &&
            archive_read_support_format_iso9660(archive.get()) == ARCHIVE_OK &&
            archive_read_open_fd(archive.get(), fd, 128 * 1024) == ARCHIVE_OK, "Cannot open ISO9660 source");
    return archive;
}
IsoMember isoMember(struct archive_entry* entry) {
    require(archive_entry_symlink(entry) == nullptr && archive_entry_hardlink(entry) == nullptr &&
            (archive_entry_filetype(entry) == AE_IFREG || archive_entry_filetype(entry) == AE_IFDIR) &&
            archive_entry_size_is_set(entry) && archive_entry_size(entry) >= 0,
            "ISO contains a linked, special, or unsized member");
    const char* raw = archive_entry_pathname_utf8(entry);
    if (!raw) raw = archive_entry_pathname(entry);
    require(raw != nullptr, "ISO member has no path");
    std::string path(raw);
    const bool directory = archive_entry_filetype(entry) == AE_IFDIR;
    if (directory && path.size() > 1 && path.back() == '/') path.pop_back();
    // ISO9660's format-defined root entry is not an extractable member.
    if (!(directory && path == ".")) memberPath(path);
    const auto size = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(archive_entry_size(entry));
    require(size <= memberLimit, "ISO member size limit exceeded");
    return {path, size, directory};
}
unsigned sliceNumber(const fs::path& setup, const fs::path& candidate) {
    if (setup.parent_path() != candidate.parent_path()) return 0;
    const auto stem = fold(setup.stem().string());
    const auto name = fold(candidate.filename().string());
    const auto prefix = stem + '-';
    if (!name.starts_with(prefix) || !name.ends_with(".bin")) return 0;
    const auto digits = std::string_view(name).substr(prefix.size(), name.size() - prefix.size() - 4);
    if (digits.empty() || digits.front() == '0' || !std::all_of(digits.begin(), digits.end(), [](char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; })) return 0;
    const auto n = decimal(digits);
    require(n <= 128, "Excessive Inno source slices");
    return static_cast<unsigned>(n);
}
std::vector<IsoMember> sourcePair(const std::vector<IsoMember>& all, const fs::path& explicitSetup = {}) {
    std::vector<std::vector<IsoMember>> candidates;
    for (const auto& item : all) {
        if (item.directory || fold(item.path.extension().string()) != ".exe" ||
                (!explicitSetup.empty() && item.path != explicitSetup)) continue;
        std::map<unsigned, IsoMember> slices;
        for (const auto& other : all) if (!other.directory) {
            const auto number = sliceNumber(item.path, other.path);
            if (number) require(slices.emplace(number, other).second, "Duplicate Inno source slice");
        }
        if (slices.empty() || slices.begin()->first != 1) continue;
        std::vector<IsoMember> pair{item};
        unsigned expected = 1;
        for (const auto& [number, slice] : slices) {
            require(number == expected++, "Missing Inno source slice");
            pair.push_back(slice);
        }
        candidates.push_back(std::move(pair));
    }
    require(candidates.size() == 1, "Media must contain one unambiguous installer and contiguous sibling .bin slices");
    return std::move(candidates.front());
}
std::map<fs::path, struct stat> sourceSnapshot(const Prepared& source, const Progress& progress) {
    const auto setup = checkedPath(source.setup);
    std::vector<IsoMember> all;
    std::map<fs::path, struct stat> result;
    Paths paths;
    std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(setup.parent_path())) {
        report(progress, "Validating original source slices");
        if (entry.path() != setup && !sliceNumber(setup, entry.path())) continue;
        const auto path = checkedPath(entry.path());
        paths.add(path.filename().string(), false);
        const auto identity = regular(path);
        const auto size = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(identity.st_size);
        require(size > 0 && size <= totalLimit - bytes, "Invalid source slice size");
        bytes += size;
        all.push_back({path, size, false});
        result.emplace(path, identity);
    }
    sourcePair(all, setup);
    require(bytes == source.sourceBytes, "Original media slice sizes changed since preparation");
    return result;
}
void checkSourceHeader(const fs::path& setup) {
    Fd file(::open(setup.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC | O_NOFOLLOW));
    std::array<char, 2> magic{};
    require(file.value >= 0 && ::pread(file.value, magic.data(), magic.size(), 0) == 2 && magic[0] == 'M' && magic[1] == 'Z',
            "Source installer is not an original Windows setup file");
}
void writeAll(int fd, const char* bytes, std::size_t size) {
    while (size) {
        const auto n = ::write(fd, bytes, size);
        if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        require(n > 0, "Cannot write staged media");
        bytes += n; size -= static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
}
} // namespace

Prepared prepare(const fs::path& sourceIso, const fs::path& sourceSetup,
                 const fs::path& scratch, const Progress& progress) {
    require(sourceIso.empty() != sourceSetup.empty(), "Choose exactly one ISO or loose setup source");
    privateDirectory(scratch, false);
    if (!sourceSetup.empty()) {
        const auto setup = checkedPath(sourceSetup);
        regular(setup);
        std::vector<IsoMember> all;
        Paths paths;
        for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(setup.parent_path())) {
            report(progress, "Inspecting original setup slices");
            const auto name = entry.path().filename().string();
            if (entry.path() != setup && !sliceNumber(setup, entry.path())) continue;
            paths.add(name, false);
            const auto path = checkedPath(entry.path());
            const auto st = regular(path);
            all.push_back({path, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(st.st_size), false});
        }
        const auto pair = sourcePair(all, setup);
        std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
        for (const auto& item : pair) {
            require(item.size > 0 && item.size <= totalLimit - bytes, "Invalid loose source size");
            bytes += item.size;
        }
        checkSourceHeader(setup);
        return {setup, bytes};
    }
    const auto iso = checkedPath(sourceIso);
    const auto identity = regular(iso, totalLimit);
    Fd source(::open(iso.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC | O_NOFOLLOW));
    require(source.value >= 0, "Cannot open original ISO");
    struct stat opened{};
    require(::fstat(source.value, &opened) == 0 && opened.st_dev == identity.st_dev && opened.st_ino == identity.st_ino,
            "ISO source changed while opening");
    std::vector<IsoMember> all;
    Paths paths;
    std::uint64_t total = 0;
    bool root = false;
    {
        auto archive = isoArchive(source.value);
        struct archive_entry* entry = nullptr;
        int status;
        while ((status = archive_read_next_header(archive.get(), &entry)) == ARCHIVE_OK) {
            report(progress, "Inspecting ISO9660 media", all.size(), 0);
            require((archive_format(archive.get()) & ARCHIVE_FORMAT_BASE_MASK) == ARCHIVE_FORMAT_ISO9660,
                    "Only ISO9660 media is supported");
            const auto item = isoMember(entry);
            if (item.directory && item.path == ".") {
                require(!root, "Duplicate ISO root entry"); root = true;
            } else {
                paths.add(item.path.generic_string(), item.directory);
                if (!item.directory) {
                    require(item.size <= totalLimit - total, "ISO aggregate size limit exceeded"); total += item.size;
                }
                all.push_back(item);
                require(all.size() <= entryLimit, "Excessive ISO members");
            }
            require(archive_read_data_skip(archive.get()) == ARCHIVE_OK, "Cannot skip ISO member data");
        }
        require(status == ARCHIVE_EOF, "Truncated or invalid ISO directory");
    }
    const auto pair = sourcePair(all);
    std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    for (const auto& item : pair) {
        require(item.size > 0 && item.size <= totalLimit - bytes, "Invalid ISO setup slice size"); bytes += item.size;
    }
    require(fs::space(scratch).available >= bytes + 64 * 1024 * 1024, "Insufficient disk space for ISO setup slices");
    const auto staging = checkedPath(scratch) / "media";
    require(::mkdir(staging.c_str(), 0700) == 0, "Refusing existing ISO media staging directory");
    std::map<std::string, const IsoMember*> wanted;
    for (const auto& item : pair) wanted.emplace(item.path.generic_string(), &item);
    std::set<std::string> copied;
    std::uint64_t done = 0;
    auto archive = isoArchive(source.value);
    std::array<char, 256 * 1024> buffer{};
    struct archive_entry* entry = nullptr;
    int status;
    std::size_t index = 0;
    bool secondRoot = false;
    while ((status = archive_read_next_header(archive.get(), &entry)) == ARCHIVE_OK) {
        report(progress, "Staging original ISO setup slices", done, bytes);
        const auto item = isoMember(entry);
        if (item.directory && item.path == ".") {
            require(root && !secondRoot, "ISO root changed between reads"); secondRoot = true;
        } else {
            require(index < all.size() && item.path == all[index].path && item.size == all[index].size &&
                    item.directory == all[index].directory, "ISO directory changed between reads"); ++index;
        }
        const auto match = wanted.find(item.path.generic_string());
        if (match == wanted.end()) {
            require(archive_read_data_skip(archive.get()) == ARCHIVE_OK, "Cannot skip ISO member data"); continue;
        }
        require(!item.directory && copied.insert(match->first).second, "Duplicate staged ISO member");
        const auto output = staging / item.path.filename();
        Fd target(::open(output.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, 0600));
        require(target.value >= 0, "Cannot stage original setup slice");
        std::uint64_t count = 0;
        for (;;) {
            report(progress, "Staging original ISO setup slices", done, bytes);
            const auto n = archive_read_data(archive.get(), buffer.data(), buffer.size());
            require(n >= 0, "Cannot read ISO setup slice");
            if (!n) break;
            require(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n) <= item.size - count, "ISO member exceeds declared size");
            writeAll(target.value, buffer.data(), static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
            count += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n); done += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n);
        }
        require(count == item.size, "Truncated ISO setup slice");
    }
    require(status == ARCHIVE_EOF && index == all.size() && copied.size() == pair.size() && secondRoot == root,
            "Incomplete ISO staging");
    unchanged(iso, identity);
    const auto setup = staging / pair.front().path.filename();
    checkSourceHeader(setup);
    report(progress, "Staging original ISO setup slices", bytes, bytes);
    return {setup, bytes};
}

std::vector<Member> list(const Prepared& source, const fs::path& extractor, const Progress& progress) {
    const auto setup = checkedPath(source.setup);
    const auto before = sourceSnapshot(source, progress);
    checkSourceHeader(setup);
    const auto version = run(extractor, {"--data-version", "--silent", setup.string()}, progress, "Inspecting Inno data version", 1024);
    auto value = std::string_view(version);
    if (value.ends_with('\n')) value.remove_suffix(1);
    require(!value.empty() && value.size() <= 64 && std::count(value.begin(), value.end(), '.') == 2 &&
            std::all_of(value.begin(), value.end(), [](char c) { return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '.'; }),
            "Unsupported or unknown Inno data version");
    // --no-extract-unknown is the helper's version gate, including original 5.1.10.
    validateVerbosePaths(run(extractor, {"--list", setup.string()}, progress, "Validating all original media paths"));
    auto members = parseList(run(extractor, {"--list", "--list-sizes", "--list-checksums", "--silent", setup.string()},
                                 progress, "Listing original game media"));
    for (const auto& [path, identity] : before) unchanged(path, identity);
    return members;
}

bool selected(const Member& member) {
    const auto path = member.path.generic_string();
    memberPath(path);
    const auto lower = fold(path);
    const auto extension = fold(member.path.extension().string());
    if (lower.starts_with("app/") && (extension == ".k22" || extension == ".wrs" || extension == ".dat")) return true;
    if (lower.starts_with("app/help/")) return extension == ".jpg" || extension == ".html";
    if (lower.starts_with("app/gallery/")) return extension == ".jpg";
    if (lower.starts_with("app/menu_sound/") || lower.starts_with("app/kabus 22 mode/menu_ses/")) return extension == ".ogg";
    return false;
}

namespace {
bool fontSource(const Member& member) {
    return member.path.generic_string() == "app/K22.exe" && member.size > 0 &&
           member.size <= 64ULL * 1024 * 1024;
}
void extractChecked(const Prepared& source, const fs::path& extractor,
                    const std::vector<Member>& members, const fs::path& output,
                    const Progress& progress) {
    validateMembers(members);
    privateDirectory(output, true);
    const auto destination = checkedPath(output);
    const auto setup = checkedPath(source.setup);
    const auto before = sourceSnapshot(source, progress);
    std::map<std::string, const Member*> expected;
    std::set<std::string> directories;
    std::uint64_t total = 0;
    std::vector<std::string> args{"--test", "--extract", "--collisions=error", "--silent", "--output-dir", destination.string()};
    for (const auto& member : members) {
        expected.emplace(member.path.generic_string(), &member);
        for (auto dir = member.path.parent_path(); !dir.empty(); dir = dir.parent_path()) directories.insert(dir.generic_string());
        total += member.size;
        args.emplace_back("--include"); args.push_back('/' + member.path.generic_string());
    }
    require(fs::space(destination).available >= total + 64 * 1024 * 1024, "Insufficient space for selected game assets");
    args.push_back(setup.string());
    run(extractor, std::move(args), progress, "Extracting and testing source members", 65536);
    for (const auto& [path, identity] : before) unchanged(path, identity);
    std::set<std::string> found;
    std::uint64_t verified = 0;
    std::array<guchar, 256 * 1024> buffer{};
    for (const auto& entry : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(destination)) {
        report(progress, "Verifying extracted source members", verified, total);
        const auto relative = entry.path().lexically_relative(destination).generic_string();
        memberPath(relative);
        struct stat st{};
        require(::lstat(entry.path().c_str(), &st) == 0 && !S_ISLNK(st.st_mode), "Linked or missing extracted member");
        if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
            require(directories.contains(relative), "Unexpected extracted directory: " + relative); continue;
        }
        const auto match = expected.find(relative);
        require(match != expected.end() && found.insert(relative).second && S_ISREG(st.st_mode) && st.st_nlink == 1 &&
                st.st_size >= 0 && static_cast<std::uint64_t>(st.st_size) == match->second->size,
                "Unexpected, linked, special, or wrong-size extracted file: " + relative);
        Fd file(::open(entry.path().c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
        struct stat opened{};
        require(file.value >= 0 && ::fstat(file.value, &opened) == 0 && opened.st_dev == st.st_dev && opened.st_ino == st.st_ino,
                "Extracted file changed while opening");
        std::unique_ptr<GChecksum, decltype(&g_checksum_free)> checksum(g_checksum_new(G_CHECKSUM_MD5), g_checksum_free);
        require(checksum != nullptr, "Cannot initialize media checksum");
        std::uint64_t count = 0;
        for (;;) {
            report(progress, "Verifying extracted source members", verified, total);
            const auto n = ::read(file.value, buffer.data(), buffer.size());
            if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
            require(n >= 0, "Cannot read extracted game asset");
            if (!n) break;
            require(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n) <= match->second->size - count, "Extracted file grew during verification");
            g_checksum_update(checksum.get(), buffer.data(), n);
            count += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n); verified += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n);
        }
        require(count == match->second->size && match->second->checksum == g_checksum_get_string(checksum.get()),
                "Extracted asset checksum mismatch: " + relative);
        unchanged(entry.path(), st);
        require(::chmod(entry.path().c_str(), 0600) == 0, "Cannot protect extracted asset");
    }
    require(found.size() == expected.size(), "Native media extraction omitted selected members");
    report(progress, "Verifying extracted source members", total, total);
}
} // namespace

void extract(const Prepared& source, const fs::path& extractor,
             const std::vector<Member>& members, const fs::path& output,
             const Progress& progress) {
    for (const auto& member : members)
        require(selected(member), "Refusing non-native asset extraction: " + member.path.string());
    extractChecked(source, extractor, members, output, progress);
}

void extractFontSource(const Prepared& source, const fs::path& extractor,
                       const Member& member, const fs::path& privateOutput,
                       const Progress& progress) {
    require(fontSource(member), "Only the bounded original app/K22.exe may be read for font recovery");
    const auto inventory = list(source, extractor, progress);
    const auto original = std::find_if(inventory.begin(), inventory.end(), [&](const Member& entry) {
        return entry.path == member.path && entry.size == member.size && entry.checksum == member.checksum;
    });
    require(original != inventory.end(), "Font-source member does not match the original media listing");
    extractChecked(source, extractor, {member}, privateOutput, progress);
}

namespace {
std::uint32_t crc32(std::string_view bytes) {
    std::uint32_t crc = 0xffffffffu;
    for (const auto byte : bytes) {
        crc ^= static_cast<unsigned char>(byte);
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 8; ++bit) crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb88320u & (0u - (crc & 1u)));
    }
    return ~crc;
}
std::uint32_t le32(std::string_view bytes, std::size_t at) {
    std::uint32_t value = 0;
    for (int i = 3; i >= 0; --i) value = value << 8 | static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[at + i]);
    return value;
}
// Inno >= 4.1.6 compresses the setup header block as LZMA1 (5 property bytes, end marker).
// libarchive's .lzma reader accepts it once the unknown-size alone header is restored.
std::string inflateHeader(std::string_view raw) {
    constexpr std::size_t limit = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
    require(raw.size() > 5, "Truncated Inno setup header");
    std::string alone(raw.substr(0, 5));
    alone.append(8, '\xff');
    alone.append(raw.substr(5));
    Archive archive(archive_read_new(), archive_read_free);
    struct archive_entry* entry = nullptr;
    require(archive && archive_read_support_filter_lzma(archive.get()) == ARCHIVE_OK &&
            archive_read_support_format_raw(archive.get()) == ARCHIVE_OK &&
            archive_read_open_memory(archive.get(), alone.data(), alone.size()) == ARCHIVE_OK &&
            archive_read_next_header(archive.get(), &entry) == ARCHIVE_OK &&
            archive_filter_code(archive.get(), 0) == ARCHIVE_FILTER_LZMA, "Unsupported Inno setup header compression");
    std::string output;
    std::array<char, 65536> buffer{};
    for (;;) {
        const auto n = archive_read_data(archive.get(), buffer.data(), buffer.size());
        require(n >= 0, "Corrupt Inno setup header");
        if (!n) break;
        require(static_cast<std::size_t>(n) <= limit - output.size(), "Inno setup header exceeds safety limit");
        output.append(buffer.data(), static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
    }
    return output;
}
// The setup-0 block (Inno >= 4.0.9): 64-byte version id, CRC32 over {stored size, compressed flag},
// then 4096-byte chunks each preceded by their CRC32. The loader also names the id, so only a
// CRC-valid occurrence counts. Wizard images follow the entries as length-prefixed BMP strings:
// WizardImageFile immediately followed by WizardSmallImageFile.
WizardImages wizardImagesFrom(std::string_view exe) {
    constexpr std::string_view id = "Inno Setup Setup Data (";
    std::string raw;
    bool compressed = false, found = false;
    for (auto at = exe.find(id); at != std::string_view::npos; at = exe.find(id, at + 1)) {
        const auto block = at + 64;
        if (block + 9 > exe.size() || crc32(exe.substr(block + 4, 5)) != le32(exe, block)) continue;
        const std::size_t stored = le32(exe, block + 4);
        require(!found && stored <= exe.size() - block - 9, "Ambiguous or truncated Inno setup header");
        found = true;
        compressed = exe[block + 8] != 0;
        for (auto chunk = block + 9, end = chunk + stored; chunk < end;) {
            const auto size = std::min<std::size_t>(4100, end - chunk);
            require(size > 4 && crc32(exe.substr(chunk + 4, size - 4)) == le32(exe, chunk), "Inno setup header checksum mismatch");
            raw.append(exe.substr(chunk + 4, size - 4));
            chunk += size;
        }
    }
    require(found, "No Inno setup header in original setup");
    const auto header = compressed ? inflateHeader(raw) : raw;
    const auto bitmap = [&](std::size_t at, std::size_t& length) {
        if (at > header.size() || header.size() - at < 4 + 54) return false;
        length = le32(header, at);
        return length >= 54 && length <= header.size() - at - 4 && header.compare(at + 4, 2, "BM") == 0 &&
               le32(header, at + 6) == length;
    };
    for (auto at = header.find("BM", 4); at != std::string::npos; at = header.find("BM", at + 1)) {
        std::size_t large = 0, small = 0;
        if (bitmap(at - 4, large) && bitmap(at + large, small))
            return {header.substr(at, large), header.substr(at + large + 4, small)};
    }
    throw std::runtime_error("Original setup has no wizard images");
}
} // namespace

WizardImages wizardImages(const fs::path& setupPath) {
    const auto setup = checkedPath(setupPath);
    const auto identity = regular(setup, 64ULL * 1024 * 1024);
    std::string exe(static_cast<std::size_t>(identity.st_size), '\0');
    Fd file(::open(setup.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
    require(file.value >= 0 && ::pread(file.value, exe.data(), exe.size(), 0) == static_cast<ssize_t>(exe.size()),
            "Cannot read original setup");
    unchanged(setup, identity);
    require(exe.starts_with("MZ"), "Source installer is not an original Windows setup file");
    return wizardImagesFrom(exe);
}

void selfCheck() {
    auto rejected = [](auto operation) {
        bool failed = false;
        try { operation(); } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { failed = true; }
        require(failed, "Media security boundary regression");
    };
    const auto u32 = [](std::uint32_t value) { std::string s(4, '\0'); for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) s[i] = static_cast<char>(value >> 8 * i); return s; };
    const auto bmp = [&](char fill, std::uint32_t size) { return u32(size) + "BM" + u32(size) + std::string(size - 6, fill); };
    const auto payload = "entries" + bmp('a', 60) + bmp('b', 70) + "decompressor";
    std::string chunks;
    for (std::size_t at = 0; at < payload.size(); at += 4096) { const auto part = payload.substr(at, 4096); chunks += u32(crc32(part)) + part; }
    const auto head = u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(chunks.size())) + '\0';
    std::string id = "Inno Setup Setup Data (5.2.1)";
    id.resize(64, '\0');
    const auto exe = "MZ loader " + id + "Inno Setup Messages" + std::string(64, '\0') + id + u32(crc32(head)) + head + chunks;
    const auto images = wizardImagesFrom(exe);
    require(crc32("123456789") == 0xcbf43926u && images.large.size() == 60 && images.large[6] == 'a' &&
            images.small.size() == 70 && images.small[6] == 'b', "Inno wizard image parser regression");
    auto corrupt = exe;
    corrupt[corrupt.size() - 20] ^= 1;
    rejected([&] { wizardImagesFrom(corrupt); });
    require(fontSource({"app/K22.exe", 2347008, {}}) && !selected({"app/K22.exe", 2347008, {}}),
            "Temporary font source must remain excluded from native assets");
    require(!fontSource({"app/Kabus22.exe", 1244972, {}}) && !fontSource({"app/k22.exe", 2347008, {}}) &&
            !fontSource({"app/K22.exe", 0, {}}) && !fontSource({"app/K22.exe", 64ULL * 1024 * 1024 + 1, {}}),
            "Temporary font-source allowlist regression");
    for (const auto* path : {"", "/app/file", "../file", "app/../file", "app//file", "app/./file", "app\\file", "C:/file", "app/a\nfile", "app/file.", "app/ file"})
        rejected([&] { memberPath(path); });
    memberPath("app/Help/Help_Files/fon_inzar enerji.jpg");
    rejected([] { Paths paths; paths.add("app/FILE.k22", false); paths.add("app/file.k22", false); });
    rejected([] { Paths paths; paths.add("app/File/a.k22", false); paths.add("app/file/b.k22", false); });
    rejected([] { Paths paths; paths.add("app/a", false); paths.add("app/a/b", false); });
    rejected([] { Paths paths; paths.add("app/a", false); paths.add("app/a", false); });
    Paths paths; paths.add("app/a/b", false); paths.add("app/a", true);
    const auto parsed = parseList("976276272 MD5 653c42ebd759d9908243dbdaea217eed app/Kaynak.k22\n");
    require(parsed.size() == 1 && parsed.front().size == 976276272 && selected(parsed.front()), "Large original member regression");
    rejected([] { parseList("1 MD5 00000000000000000000000000000000 ../bad\n"); });
    rejected([] { parseList("18446744073709551616 MD5 00000000000000000000000000000000 app/a.k22\n"); });
    rejected([] { parseList("1 MD5 00000000000000000000000000000000 app/a.k22\n1 MD5 00000000000000000000000000000000 app/A.k22\n"); });
    rejected([] { parseList("1 MD5 00000000000000000000000000000000 app//bad.k22\n"); });
    validateVerbosePaths("Listing media\n - \"app/Kabus22.exe\" - overwritten\n - \"app/Kabus22.exe\"\n - \"app/yazi_de.k22\"\nDone.\n");
    rejected([] { validateVerbosePaths(" - \"app/data.k22\" - overwritten\n - \"app/data.k22\"\n"); });
    rejected([] { validateVerbosePaths(" - \"app/A.exe\" - overwritten\n - \"app/a.exe\"\n"); });
    for (const auto* path : {"app/K22.exe", "app/a.dll", "app/kayit0.sav", "app/a.url", "Drivers/a.exe", "app/Help/a.exe", "app/Kabus 22 Mode/acknex.wdf"})
        require(!selected({path, 0, {}}), "Unsafe native asset allowlist regression");
    for (const auto* path : {"app/K22.wrs", "app/yoldata.DAT", "app/Help/Help_TR.html", "app/Gallery/a.JPG", "app/Menu_sound/menu_fon.ogg", "app/Kabus 22 Mode/K22_mode.wrs", "app/Kabus 22 Mode/Menu_ses/menu_fon.ogg"})
        require(selected({path, 0, {}}), "Original asset allowlist regression");
    const std::vector<IsoMember> iso{{"JPN-K22.exe", 344953, false}, {"JPN-K22-1.bin", 729654912, false},
                                    {"JPN-K22-2.bin", 730000000, false}, {"JPN-K22-3.bin", 565412946, false},
                                    {"DirectX/DXSETUP.exe", 503144, false}};
    require(sourcePair(iso).size() == 4, "Actual ISO slice layout regression");
    rejected([] { sourcePair({{"setup.exe", 1, false}, {"setup-1.bin", 1, false}, {"setup-3.bin", 1, false}}); });
}

namespace k22::setup {
namespace {
constexpr const char* marker = "Kabus22 native installation 1\n";
constexpr const char* shortcutName = "kabus22-native.desktop";
constexpr std::uint64_t maxPayload = 4ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
void require(bool good, const std::string& message) {
    if (!good) throw std::runtime_error(message);
}
void report(const Progress& callback, const std::string& stage, std::uint64_t done = 0, std::uint64_t total = 0) {
    if (callback && !callback(stage, done, total)) throw Cancelled();
}
void cleanText(const std::string& text) {
    for (unsigned char c : text) require(c >= 32 && c != 127, "Paths cannot contain control characters");
}
fs::path checkedAbsolute(const fs::path& path) {
    require(!path.empty(), "Required path is empty");
    cleanText(path.string());
    auto result = fs::absolute(path).lexically_normal();
    while (result != result.root_path() && result.filename().empty()) result = result.parent_path();
    return result;
}
bool within(const fs::path& parent, const fs::path& child) {
    auto a = parent.begin(), b = child.begin();
    for (; a != parent.end(); ++a, ++b) if (b == child.end() || *a != *b) return false;
    return true;
}
struct Identity {
    fs::path path;
    struct stat info{};
};
bool same(const struct stat& a, const struct stat& b, bool contents = false) {
    return a.st_dev == b.st_dev && a.st_ino == b.st_ino && (a.st_mode & S_IFMT) == (b.st_mode & S_IFMT) &&
        (!contents || (a.st_size == b.st_size && a.st_mtim.tv_sec == b.st_mtim.tv_sec && a.st_mtim.tv_nsec == b.st_mtim.tv_nsec));
}
bool sameSnapshot(const struct stat& expected, const struct stat& current) {
    return same(expected, current, true) && expected.st_nlink == current.st_nlink &&
        expected.st_ctim.tv_sec == current.st_ctim.tv_sec && expected.st_ctim.tv_nsec == current.st_ctim.tv_nsec;
}
struct stat lstatPath(const fs::path& path, bool missing = false) {
    struct stat value{};
    if (::lstat(path.c_str(), &value) != 0) {
        if (missing && errno == ENOENT) return {};
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot inspect " + path.string() + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
    }
    require(!S_ISLNK(value.st_mode), "Refusing symbolic link: " + path.string());
    return value;
}
struct Created {
    std::vector<Identity> directories;
    ~Created() {
        for (auto it = directories.rbegin(); it != directories.rend(); ++it) {
            struct stat now{};
            if (::lstat(it->path.c_str(), &now) == 0 && same(it->info, now)) ::rmdir(it->path.c_str());
        }
    }
};
void chain(const fs::path& path, Created* created = nullptr) {
    fs::path current = path.root_path();
    for (const auto& part : path.relative_path()) {
        current /= part;
        auto value = lstatPath(current, true);
        if (!value.st_mode) {
            if (!created) return;
            require(::mkdir(current.c_str(), 0700) == 0, "Cannot create private directory: " + current.string());
            value = lstatPath(current);
            created->directories.push_back({current, value});
        }
        require(S_ISDIR(value.st_mode), "Directory component is not a directory: " + current.string());
        const bool shared = value.st_mode & (S_IWGRP | S_IWOTH);
        const bool sticky = (value.st_mode & S_ISVTX) && (value.st_uid == 0 || value.st_uid == geteuid());
        require(!shared || sticky, "Unsafe writable ancestor: " + current.string());
    }
}
fs::path writableAncestor(fs::path path) {
    chain(path);
    while (!lstatPath(path, true).st_mode) path = path.parent_path();
    require(::access(path.c_str(), W_OK | X_OK) == 0, "Folder is not writable: " + path.string());
    return path;
}
struct Fd {
    int value = -1;
    explicit Fd(int fd) : value(fd) { require(value >= 0, "Cannot open file: " + std::string(std::strerror(errno))); }
    ~Fd() { if (value >= 0) ::close(value); }
    Fd(const Fd&) = delete;
    Fd& operator=(const Fd&) = delete;
};
struct Temporary {
    fs::path path;
    struct stat identity{};
    bool retain = false;
    explicit Temporary(const fs::path& parent) {
        auto name = (parent/".kabus22-setup-XXXXXX").string();
        require(::mkdtemp(name.data()) != nullptr, "Cannot create private staging directory: " + std::string(std::strerror(errno)));
        path = name; identity = lstatPath(path);
    }
    ~Temporary() {
        struct stat now{};
        if (!retain && ::lstat(path.c_str(), &now) == 0 && same(identity, now)) {
            std::error_code error; fs::remove_all(path, error);
        }
    }
};
void mkdirPrivate(const fs::path& path) {
    require(::mkdir(path.c_str(), 0700) == 0, "Cannot create private staging directory: " + path.string());
}
void writeAll(int fd, const char* data, std::size_t size) {
    while (size) {
        const auto count = ::write(fd, data, size);
        if (count < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        require(count > 0, "Cannot write staged file: " + std::string(std::strerror(errno)));
        data += count; size -= static_cast<std::size_t>(count);
    }
}
void writeFile(const fs::path& path, std::string_view data, mode_t mode = 0600) {
    Fd out(::open(path.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, mode));
    writeAll(out.value, data.data(), data.size());
    require(::fsync(out.value) == 0, "Cannot synchronize file: " + path.string());
}
std::string smallFile(const fs::path& path, std::size_t maximum = 65536) {
    Fd in(::open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
    struct stat value{};
    require(::fstat(in.value, &value) == 0 && S_ISREG(value.st_mode) && value.st_size >= 0 &&
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(value.st_size) <= maximum && value.st_uid == geteuid() && value.st_nlink == 1 &&
        !(value.st_mode & (S_IWGRP | S_IWOTH)), "Invalid private ownership record: " + path.string());
    std::string data(static_cast<std::size_t>(value.st_size), '\0');
    std::size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.size()) {
        const auto count = ::read(in.value, data.data() + offset, data.size() - offset);
        if (count < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        require(count > 0, "Cannot read ownership record"); offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(count);
    }
    return data;
}
void nativeElf(const fs::path& file, bool executable) {
    Fd in(::open(file.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
    struct stat value{}; Elf64_Ehdr header{};
    require(::fstat(in.value, &value) == 0 && S_ISREG(value.st_mode) && value.st_size >= static_cast<off_t>(sizeof(header)) &&
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(value.st_size) <= maxPayload, "Invalid native ELF payload: " + file.string());
    require(::pread(in.value, &header, sizeof(header), 0) == sizeof(header) &&
        std::memcmp(header.e_ident, ELFMAG, SELFMAG) == 0 && header.e_ident[EI_CLASS] == ELFCLASS64 &&
        header.e_ident[EI_DATA] == ELFDATA2LSB && header.e_ident[EI_VERSION] == EV_CURRENT &&
        header.e_machine == EM_X86_64 && header.e_version == EV_CURRENT && header.e_ehsize == sizeof(header) &&
        (header.e_type == ET_EXEC || header.e_type == ET_DYN) && (!executable || (header.e_entry != 0 && ::access(file.c_str(), X_OK) == 0)),
        "Payload must be a real native x86-64 ELF, not Windows, Wine, or a shell script: " + file.string());
}
std::uint64_t copyDescriptor(int in, const struct stat& initial, const fs::path& relative,
                             const fs::path& to, mode_t mode, const Progress& progress) {
    Fd out(::open(to.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, mode));
    std::array<char, 128 * 1024> buffer{};
    std::uint64_t done = 0;
    for (;;) {
        const auto count = ::read(in, buffer.data(), buffer.size());
        if (count < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        require(count >= 0, "Cannot read source file: " + relative.string());
        if (!count) break;
        require(done <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>(initial.st_size) && static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count) <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>(initial.st_size) - done, "Source grew while copying");
        writeAll(out.value, buffer.data(), static_cast<std::size_t>(count));
        done += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count); report(progress, "Copying " + relative.filename().string(), done, initial.st_size);
    }
    struct stat current{};
    require(::fstat(in, &current) == 0 && sameSnapshot(initial, current) && done == static_cast<std::uint64_t>(initial.st_size),
        "Source changed while copying: " + relative.string());
    require(::fsync(out.value) == 0, "Cannot synchronize copied file"); return done;
}
std::uint64_t copyFile(const fs::path& from, const fs::path& to, mode_t mode,
                       const Progress& progress, std::uint64_t maximum = maxPayload) {
    Fd in(::open(from.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
    struct stat initial{};
    require(::fstat(in.value, &initial) == 0 && S_ISREG(initial.st_mode) && initial.st_size >= 0 &&
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(initial.st_size) <= maximum, "Invalid source file: " + from.string());
    return copyDescriptor(in.value, initial, from, to, mode, progress);
}
std::string lower(std::string text) {
    for (char& c : text) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c += 'a' - 'A';
    return text;
}
std::string desktopValue(const std::string& text) {
    std::string output;
    for (char c : text) {
        switch (c) {
        case '\\': output += "\\\\"; break;
        case ' ': output += "\\s"; break;
        case '\t': output += "\\t"; break;
        case '\n': output += "\\n"; break;
        case '\r': output += "\\r"; break;
        default: output += c;
        }
    }
    return output;
}
std::string execArgument(const std::string& text) {
    std::string quoted = "\"";
    for (char c : text) {
        if (c == '%') quoted += "%%";
        else { if (c == '\\' || c == '"' || c == '`' || c == '$') quoted += '\\'; quoted += c; }
    }
    quoted += '"'; return desktopValue(quoted);
}
std::string desktopEntry(const Result& result) {
    // env avoids GIO treating %% in argv[0] as an unexpanded executable path.
    const auto command = "/usr/bin/env -- " + execArgument(result.executable.string()) +
        " --install-dir " + execArgument(result.root.string());
    return "[Desktop Entry]\nType=Application\nVersion=1.0\nName=Kabus22\nComment=Configure and play Kabus22 natively\nExec=" + command +
        "\nIcon=" + desktopValue((result.root/"kabus22.png").string()) + "\nPath=" + desktopValue(result.root.string()) +
        "\nTerminal=false\nCategories=Game;\nActions=OpenGL;VulkanRaster;VulkanRayTracing;\nX-Kabus22-Native=true\nX-Kabus22-InstallRoot=" + desktopValue(result.root.string()) +
        "\n\n[Desktop Action OpenGL]\nName=Settings — OpenGL\nExec=" + command + " --renderer opengl" +
        "\n\n[Desktop Action VulkanRaster]\nName=Settings — Vulkan raster\nExec=" + command + " --renderer vulkan-raster" +
        "\n\n[Desktop Action VulkanRayTracing]\nName=Settings — Vulkan hardware ray tracing\nExec=" + command + " --renderer vulkan-rt\n";
}
std::string json(const std::string& text) {
    std::string out = "\"";
    for (char c : text) { if (c == '\\' || c == '"') out += '\\'; out += c; }
    return out + '"';
}
std::string sha256(const fs::path& path, const Progress& progress) {
    Fd in(::open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
    std::unique_ptr<GChecksum, decltype(&g_checksum_free)> checksum(g_checksum_new(G_CHECKSUM_SHA256), g_checksum_free);
    require(bool(checksum), "Cannot allocate inventory checksum");
    std::array<guchar, 128 * 1024> bytes{};
    std::uint64_t done = 0;
    for (;;) {
        const auto count = ::read(in.value, bytes.data(), bytes.size());
        if (count < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        require(count >= 0, "Cannot read inventory member"); if (!count) break;
        g_checksum_update(checksum.get(), bytes.data(), count); done += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count);
        report(progress, "Recording installed inventory", done, fs::file_size(path));
    }
    return g_checksum_get_string(checksum.get());
}
void renameNew(const fs::path& from, const fs::path& to) {
    require(::syscall(SYS_renameat2, AT_FDCWD, from.c_str(), AT_FDCWD, to.c_str(), 1U) == 0,
        "Cannot publish without replacing existing files: " + to.string() + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
}
void exchange(const fs::path& from, const fs::path& to) {
    require(::syscall(SYS_renameat2, AT_FDCWD, from.c_str(), AT_FDCWD, to.c_str(), 2U) == 0, // RENAME_EXCHANGE
        "Cannot atomically replace " + to.string() + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
}
// Existing desktop entries (file or symlink) are replaced; a directory in their place is not.
bool shortcutPresent(const fs::path& path) {
    struct stat value{};
    if (::lstat(path.c_str(), &value) != 0) {
        require(errno == ENOENT, "Cannot inspect " + path.string() + ": " + std::strerror(errno));
        return false;
    }
    require(!S_ISDIR(value.st_mode), "Refusing to replace a directory with a shortcut: " + path.string());
    return true;
}
// False: root is absent. True: an empty private folder or an earlier Kabus22 installation to replace.
// Anything else (e.g. home or Documents) is refused untouched; foreign data is never deleted.
bool replaceable(const fs::path& root) {
    const auto value = lstatPath(root, true);
    if (!value.st_mode) return false;
    require(S_ISDIR(value.st_mode), "Destination exists and is not a folder: " + root.string());
    require(value.st_uid == geteuid() && !(value.st_mode & (S_IWGRP | S_IWOTH)),
        "Destination folder must be owned by you and not writable by others: " + root.string());
    if (fs::is_empty(root)) return true;
    require(lstatPath(root/".kabus22-owned", true).st_mode && smallFile(root/".kabus22-owned") == marker,
        "Destination folder is not empty and is not a Kabus22 installation; choose a new or empty folder, "
        "or an existing Kabus22 installation to replace: " + root.string());
    require(layout::running_version(root).empty(), "Close the Kabus22 program running from " + root.string() + " before replacing it");
    return true;
}
std::vector<Identity> tree(const fs::path& root) {
    std::vector<Identity> result{{root, lstatPath(root)}};
    for (const auto& entry : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(root)) {
        struct stat value{};
        require(::lstat(entry.path().c_str(), &value) == 0, "Cannot inspect staged entry: " + entry.path().string());
        const auto relative = entry.path().lexically_relative(root);
        // Only the versioned layout's own top-level links (current, bin, lib, share) are owned links.
        const bool layoutLink = S_ISLNK(value.st_mode) && relative.parent_path().empty() &&
            (relative == "current" || relative == "bin" || relative == "lib" || relative == "share");
        require(layoutLink || S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) || (S_ISREG(value.st_mode) && value.st_nlink == 1), "Unexpected link or special file in staging: " + entry.path().string());
        cleanText(entry.path().string()); result.push_back({entry.path(), value});
    }
    return result;
}
Fd directoryFd(const fs::path& path) {
    Fd current(::open("/", O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC));
    for (const auto& part : path.relative_path()) {
        const int next = ::openat(current.value, part.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
        require(next >= 0, "Cannot pin directory without following links: " + path.string());
        ::close(current.value); current.value = next;
    }
    return Fd(std::exchange(current.value, -1));
}
void rollbackOwned(const fs::path& source, const fs::path& destination, const std::vector<Identity>& identities) {
    auto parent = directoryFd(destination.parent_path());
    Fd root(::openat(parent.value, destination.filename().c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
    struct stat now{};
    require(::fstat(root.value, &now) == 0 && same(identities.front().info, now), "Concurrent replacement preserved: " + destination.string());
    std::map<fs::path, struct stat> directories;
    for (const auto& item : identities) if (S_ISDIR(item.info.st_mode))
        directories.emplace(item.path == source ? fs::path{} : item.path.lexically_relative(source), item.info);
    for (auto it = identities.rbegin(); it != identities.rend(); ++it) {
        if (it->path == source) continue;
        const auto relative = it->path.lexically_relative(source);
        Fd cursor(::dup(root.value));
        fs::path prefix;
        bool unchanged = true;
        for (const auto& component : relative.parent_path()) {
            prefix /= component;
            const int next = ::openat(cursor.value, component.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
            if (next < 0) { unchanged = false; break; }
            ::close(cursor.value); cursor.value = next;
            const auto known = directories.find(prefix);
            if (::fstat(cursor.value, &now) != 0 || known == directories.end() || !same(known->second, now)) { unchanged = false; break; }
        }
        if (!unchanged || ::fstatat(cursor.value, relative.filename().c_str(), &now, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) != 0) continue;
        if (!same(it->info, now, !S_ISDIR(now.st_mode))) continue;
        ::unlinkat(cursor.value, relative.filename().c_str(), S_ISDIR(now.st_mode) ? AT_REMOVEDIR : 0);
    }
    const auto name = destination.filename().string();
    if (::fstatat(parent.value, name.c_str(), &now, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) == 0 && same(identities.front().info, now))
        ::unlinkat(parent.value, name.c_str(), AT_REMOVEDIR);
    require(::fstatat(parent.value, name.c_str(), &now, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) != 0 && errno == ENOENT,
        "Rollback preserved changed or unowned files at " + destination.string());
}
std::uint64_t addBytes(std::uint64_t total, std::uint64_t size) {
    require(size <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() - total, "Installation size overflow"); return total + size;
}
void enough(const fs::path& where, std::uint64_t needed) {
    require(fs::space(where).available >= needed, "Insufficient free space at " + where.string() + ": need " + std::to_string(needed) + " bytes");
}
struct Payload { fs::path source, relative; std::uint64_t bytes; };
std::vector<Payload> payload(const fs::path& engine, const fs::path& launcher, const fs::path& updater) {
    nativeElf(engine, true);
    nativeElf(launcher, true);
    nativeElf(updater, true);
    require(fs::canonical(engine) != fs::canonical(launcher) && fs::canonical(engine) != fs::canonical(updater) &&
        fs::canonical(launcher) != fs::canonical(updater), "Engine, settings launcher and updater must be separate executables");
    std::vector<Payload> result;
    std::uint64_t total = 0;
    const auto add = [&](const fs::path& source, const fs::path& relative) {
        const auto bytes = fs::file_size(source);
        const auto found = std::find_if(result.begin(), result.end(),
            [&](const auto& file) { return file.relative == relative; });
        if (found != result.end()) {
            require(found->bytes == bytes && (found->source == source || sha256(found->source, {}) == sha256(source, {})),
                "Conflicting native payload member: " + relative.string());
            return;
        }
        total = addBytes(total, bytes);
        require(total <= maxPayload && result.size() < 10000, "Native payload exceeds bounds");
        result.push_back({source, relative, bytes});
    };
    add(engine, "bin/kabus22");
    add(launcher, "bin/kabus22-launcher");
    add(updater, "bin/kabus22-updater");
    static const std::regex library(R"(lib[A-Za-z0-9_+.-]+\.so(?:\.[0-9]+)*)");
    static const std::regex host(R"((?:ld-linux[^.]*|lib(?:c|m|dl|pthread|rt|resolv|util|anl|nss_[^.]+|GL|GLX|GLdispatch|OpenGL|EGL|GLESv[12]|vulkan|drm(?:_[^.]+)?|gbm|cuda|nvidia[^.]*|vdpau|va(?:-x11|-drm|-wayland)?))\.so(?:\.[0-9]+)*)");
    std::vector<fs::path> roots;
    for (const auto& executable : {engine, launcher, updater}) {
        const auto root = executable.parent_path().parent_path();
        if (std::find(roots.begin(), roots.end(), root) != roots.end()) continue;
        roots.push_back(root);
        const auto libraries = root/"lib";
        if (!fs::exists(libraries)) continue; // Developer executables may use audited host dependencies.
        require(S_ISDIR(lstatPath(libraries).st_mode), "Payload lib path is not a directory");
        bool bundled = false, gtk = false;
        std::size_t count = 0;
        for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(libraries)) {
            const auto name = entry.path().filename().string();
            if (!std::regex_match(name, library)) continue;
            require(!std::regex_match(name, host), "Do not bundle host OS/GPU libraries: " + name);
            const auto resolved = fs::canonical(entry.path());
            require(within(fs::canonical(libraries), resolved), "Library link leaves trusted payload: " + name);
            nativeElf(resolved, false);
            require(++count < 1024, "Native dependency payload exceeds bounds");
            add(resolved, fs::path("lib")/name);
            bundled = true;
            gtk = gtk || name == "libgtk-3.so.0";
        }
        const auto notices = root/"share/licenses/kabus22/dependencies";
        if (bundled) {
            require(fs::exists(notices) && S_ISDIR(lstatPath(notices).st_mode), "Bundled native libraries require their dependency license notices");
            for (const auto& entry : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(notices)) {
                const auto value = lstatPath(entry.path());
                require(S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) || (S_ISREG(value.st_mode) && value.st_nlink == 1), "Invalid dependency notice member");
                if (S_ISDIR(value.st_mode)) continue;
                const auto relative = entry.path().lexically_relative(notices);
                cleanText(relative.string());
                require(value.st_size >= 0 && value.st_size <= 64 * 1024 * 1024, "Oversized dependency notice");
                add(entry.path(), fs::path("share/licenses/kabus22/dependencies")/relative);
            }
        }
        const auto schemas = root/"share/glib-2.0/schemas";
        require(!gtk || fs::exists(schemas), "Bundled GTK requires its settings schemas");
        if (fs::exists(schemas)) {
            require(S_ISDIR(lstatPath(schemas).st_mode), "Payload schema path is not a directory");
            for (const auto* name : {"gschemas.compiled", "org.gtk.Settings.ColorChooser.gschema.xml",
                    "org.gtk.Settings.Debug.gschema.xml", "org.gtk.Settings.EmojiChooser.gschema.xml",
                    "org.gtk.Settings.FileChooser.gschema.xml"}) {
                const auto value = lstatPath(schemas/name);
                require(S_ISREG(value.st_mode) && value.st_nlink == 1 && value.st_size > 0 &&
                    value.st_size <= 4 * 1024 * 1024, "Missing or invalid GTK settings schema");
                add(schemas/name, fs::path("share/glib-2.0/schemas")/name);
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
std::string foldPath(std::string_view value) {
    require(g_utf8_validate(value.data(), static_cast<gssize>(value.size()), nullptr), "Invalid UTF-8 patch path");
    std::unique_ptr<gchar, decltype(&g_free)> folded(g_utf8_casefold(value.data(), static_cast<gssize>(value.size())), g_free);
    std::unique_ptr<gchar, decltype(&g_free)> normalized(g_utf8_normalize(folded.get(), -1, G_NORMALIZE_ALL_COMPOSE), g_free);
    require(normalized != nullptr, "Cannot normalize patch path");
    return normalized.get();
}
bool dataAsset(const std::string& ext) {
    static const std::set<std::string> known{".wdl", ".wrs", ".ini", ".wmb", ".mdl", ".pcx", ".bmp", ".tga", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png",
        ".dds", ".ogg", ".wav", ".mp3", ".avi", ".txt", ".fx", ".dat", ".k22", ".ttf"};
    return known.contains(ext);
}
// Installed Windows folders mix original data with user state and Windows-only components.
// Imports the ISO install's file set (media::selected) plus Kabus22Patch data; skips
// executables/DLLs, saves, uninstaller logs, ReShade/DXVK files and runtime-written state.
bool windowsAsset(const fs::path& relative) {
    const auto name = lower(relative.generic_string());
    if (name.starts_with("_data/")) return dataAsset(lower(relative.extension().string()));
    if (name == "k22.ini") return true;
    if (name == "ftz.k22" || name == "rms.k22" || name == "rmo.k22" || name.starts_with("unins")) return false;
    try { return media::selected({fs::path("app")/relative, 0, {}}); } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { return false; }
}
struct PatchFile {
    fs::path relative;
    struct stat info{};
    bool replace = false;
};
struct PatchSnapshot {
    fs::path path;
    Fd parent, root;
    std::map<fs::path, struct stat> directories;
    std::vector<PatchFile> files;
    std::optional<PatchFile> font;
    std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    bool windows = false;           // installed Windows game folder instead of Kabus22Patch
    std::vector<std::string> skipped; // windows: entries deliberately not imported

    static Fd pinRoot(int parent, const fs::path& name) {
        struct stat named{}, pinned{};
        require(::fstatat(parent, name.c_str(), &named, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) == 0 && S_ISDIR(named.st_mode),
            "Optional patch must be a directory, not a link");
        Fd directory(::openat(parent, name.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
        require(::fstat(directory.value, &pinned) == 0 && sameSnapshot(named, pinned),
            "Optional patch root changed while pinning");
        return Fd(std::exchange(directory.value, -1));
    }

    explicit PatchSnapshot(const fs::path& input, bool windowsFolder = false)
        : path(checkedAbsolute(input)), parent(directoryFd(path.parent_path())),
          root(pinRoot(parent.value, path.filename())), windows(windowsFolder) {
        struct stat pinned{};
        require(::fstat(root.value, &pinned) == 0, "Cannot inspect pinned patch root");
        directories.emplace(fs::path{}, pinned);
        std::set<std::string> names;
        std::uint64_t total = 0;
        std::size_t count = 0;
        enumerate(root.value, {}, 0, names, total, count);
        checkRoot();
    }

    void checkRoot() const {
        struct stat named{}, pinned{};
        const auto& expected = directories.at(fs::path{});
        require(::fstatat(parent.value, path.filename().c_str(), &named, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) == 0 &&
            ::fstat(root.value, &pinned) == 0 && sameSnapshot(expected, named) && sameSnapshot(expected, pinned),
            "Patch root changed after snapshot");
    }

    Fd openDirectory(const fs::path& relative) const {
        checkRoot();
        Fd cursor(::dup(root.value));
        fs::path prefix;
        for (const auto& component : relative) {
            prefix /= component;
            const auto known = directories.find(prefix);
            require(known != directories.end(), "Unknown patch directory: " + prefix.string());
            Fd next(::openat(cursor.value, component.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
            struct stat current{};
            require(::fstat(next.value, &current) == 0 && sameSnapshot(known->second, current),
                "Patch directory changed after snapshot: " + prefix.string());
            ::close(cursor.value); cursor.value = std::exchange(next.value, -1);
        }
        return Fd(std::exchange(cursor.value, -1));
    }

    Fd openSource(const PatchFile& file) const {
        auto directory = openDirectory(file.relative.parent_path());
        Fd in(::openat(directory.value, file.relative.filename().c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC));
        struct stat current{};
        require(::fstat(in.value, &current) == 0 && S_ISREG(current.st_mode) && current.st_nlink == 1 &&
            sameSnapshot(file.info, current), "Patch file changed after snapshot: " + file.relative.string());
        return Fd(std::exchange(in.value, -1));
    }

    void copy(const PatchFile& file, const fs::path& to, const Progress& progress) const {
        auto in = openSource(file);
        copyDescriptor(in.value, file.info, file.relative, to, 0600, progress);
    }

    void verify() const {
        checkRoot();
        for (const auto& [relative, info] : directories) {
            auto directory = openDirectory(relative);
            struct stat current{};
            require(::fstat(directory.value, &current) == 0 && sameSnapshot(info, current),
                "Patch directory changed after snapshot: " + relative.string());
        }
        for (const auto& file : files) { auto in = openSource(file); }
        if (font) { auto in = openSource(*font); }
        checkRoot();
    }

    void matchGame(const fs::path& game) {
        std::map<std::string, fs::path> names;
        for (const auto& entry : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(game)) {
            const auto relative = entry.path().lexically_relative(game);
            require(names.emplace(foldPath(relative.generic_string()), relative).second,
                "Game has case-fold duplicate paths");
        }
        const auto match = [&](const fs::path& relative, bool directory) {
            const auto found = names.find(foldPath(relative.generic_string()));
            if (found == names.end()) return false;
            require(found->second == relative, "Patch changes existing filename case: " + relative.string());
            const auto value = lstatPath(game/relative);
            require(directory ? S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) : S_ISREG(value.st_mode),
                "Patch conflicts with a file or directory: " + relative.string());
            return true;
        };
        for (const auto& [relative, info] : directories)
            if (!relative.empty()) match(relative, true);
        for (auto& file : files) file.replace = match(file.relative, false);
    }

    void enumerate(int directory, const fs::path& prefix, std::size_t depth,
                   std::set<std::string>& names, std::uint64_t& total, std::size_t& count) {
        Fd duplicate(::dup(directory));
        std::unique_ptr<DIR, decltype(&closedir)> entries(::fdopendir(duplicate.value), closedir);
        require(bool(entries), "Cannot enumerate pinned patch directory");
        duplicate.value = -1;
        for (;;) {
            errno = 0;
            const auto* entry = ::readdir(entries.get());
            if (!entry) { require(errno == 0, "Cannot read pinned patch directory"); break; }
            const std::string component = entry->d_name;
            if (component == "." || component == "..") continue;
            const auto relative = prefix/component;
            const auto text = relative.generic_string();
            cleanText(text);
            require(text.size() <= 1024 && component.find('\\') == std::string::npos,
                "Unsafe patch path: " + text);
            const auto folded = foldPath(text);
            for (const gchar* p = text.c_str(); *p; p = g_utf8_next_char(p))
                require(!g_unichar_iscntrl(g_utf8_get_char(p)), "Control character in patch path");
            require(names.insert(folded).second, "Patch has case-fold duplicate names");
            require(++count <= 200000, "Patch exceeds safe entry limit");
            struct stat value{};
            require(::fstatat(directory, component.c_str(), &value, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) == 0, "Cannot inspect source entry: " + text);
            const bool isFont = windows ? lower(text) == "k22.exe" : relative == "K22.exe";
            if (windows && ((!S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) && !isFont && !windowsAsset(relative)) ||
                    (S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) && folded == foldPath("_data/saves")))) {
                skipped.push_back(text); continue;
            }
            require(S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) || (S_ISREG(value.st_mode) && value.st_nlink == 1),
