`native/modern_box.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "assets.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <optional>

namespace k22::modern_box {
// A6 00585f60 / A7 100b2680's USE_BOX mesh primitive is an oriented,
// affine-normalized sphere, not a rectangular SAT box. These are the source
// 0059f9a0 and 100d0890 moving feature rules, not the point query.
inline Vec3 add(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return {a.x+b.x,a.y+b.y,a.z+b.z};}
inline Vec3 sub(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return {a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y,a.z-b.z};}
inline Vec3 mul(Vec3 a,float s){return {a.x*s,a.y*s,a.z*s};}
inline long double dot(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return (static_cast<long double>(a.y)*b.y+static_cast<long double>(a.z)*b.z)+static_cast<long double>(a.x)*b.x;}
inline Vec3 cross(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return {float(static_cast<long double>(a.y)*b.z-static_cast<long double>(a.z)*b.y),float(static_cast<long double>(a.z)*b.x-static_cast<long double>(a.x)*b.z),float(static_cast<long double>(a.x)*b.y-static_cast<long double>(a.y)*b.x)};}
inline Vec3 unit(Vec3 a){const auto squared=dot(a,a);return squared!=0?mul(a,float(1/std::sqrt(squared))):a;}
inline bool inside(Vec3 p,Vec3 a,Vec3 b,Vec3 c){
    // 0059f7b0/100d03e0 tests float sign bits; the opposite edge is strict.
    const auto u=sub(b,a),v=sub(c,a),q=sub(p,a);
    const float uu=float(dot(u,u)),uv=float(dot(u,v)),vv=float(dot(v,v));
    const float qu=float(dot(q,u)),qv=float(dot(q,v));
    const float x=float(static_cast<long double>(qu)*vv-static_cast<long double>(qv)*uv);
    const float y=float(static_cast<long double>(qv)*uu-static_cast<long double>(qu)*uv);
    const float z=float((static_cast<long double>(x)+y)-(static_cast<long double>(vv)*uu-static_cast<long double>(uv)*uv));
    return (~(std::bit_cast<unsigned>(x)|std::bit_cast<unsigned>(y))&std::bit_cast<unsigned>(z)&0x80000000u)!=0;
}
inline bool root(float a,float b,float c,float limit,bool bonus,float& result){
    // 0059f8d0 / 100d0500. Zero A and strict -.01/limit comparisons are
    // intentional; no epsilon, discriminant clamp or initial-overlap shortcut.
    const float discriminant=float(static_cast<long double>(b)*b-static_cast<long double>(a)*c*4);
    if(!(discriminant>=0))return false;
    const auto square=std::sqrt(static_cast<long double>(discriminant));
    float first=float((-static_cast<long double>(b)-square)/(static_cast<long double>(a)+a));
    float second=float((square-b)/(static_cast<long double>(a)+a));
    if(bonus&&!(first>=0||second>=0))return false;
    if(second<first)std::swap(first,second);
    constexpr float lower=std::bit_cast<float>(0xbc23d70au);
    if(first>lower&&first<limit){result=first;return true;}
    if(second>lower&&second<limit){result=second;return true;}
    return false;
}
struct Contact {float fraction{},scalar{};Vec3 position{},normal{};bool initialOverlap{};};
struct Query {
    Vec3 center,half,delta,direction,velocity;
    std::array<Vec3,3> axes,rows;
    Vec3 translation;
    float length,buffer;
    bool bonus;
    // Moving USE_BOX mesh primitive only. The original stationary packet's
    // reference direction is uninitialized in the public query wrappers.
    Query(Vec3 origin,const std::array<Vec3,3>& orientation,Vec3 extents,Vec3 displacement,float margin,bool a7):center(origin),half(extents),delta(displacement),axes(orientation),buffer(margin),bonus(a7){
        // 005a0b00/100d1690: inverse rigid orientation, then reciprocal half
        // extents. Form one affine matrix before transforming mesh vertices.
        const std::array h{half.x,half.y,half.z};
        for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)rows[i]=mul(axes[i],1.f/h[i]);
        translation={float(-dot(rows[0],center)),float(-dot(rows[1],center)),float(-dot(rows[2],center))};
        velocity={float(dot(rows[0],delta)),float(dot(rows[1],delta)),float(dot(rows[2],delta))};
        length=float(std::sqrt(dot(delta,delta)));direction=unit(delta);
    }
    Vec3 local(Vec3 p)const{return {float(dot(rows[0],p)+translation.x),float(dot(rows[1],p)+translation.y),float(dot(rows[2],p)+translation.z)};}
    Vec3 world(Vec3 p)const{
        const auto x=mul(axes[0],p.x*half.x),y=mul(axes[1],p.y*half.y),z=mul(axes[2],p.z*half.z);
        return {float(((static_cast<long double>(x.x)+z.x)+y.x)+center.x),float(((static_cast<long double>(x.y)+z.y)+y.y)+center.y),float(((static_cast<long double>(x.z)+z.z)+y.z)+center.z)};
    }
    Vec3 worldNormal(Vec3 n)const{
        // 0059f5b0/100d01e0 uses the cofactor products, not R*n or SCALE.
        const Vec3 cofactor{float(static_cast<long double>(n.x)*half.y*half.z),float(static_cast<long double>(n.y)*half.x*half.z),float(static_cast<long double>(half.y)*half.x*n.z)};
        const auto x=mul(axes[0],cofactor.x),y=mul(axes[1],cofactor.y),z=mul(axes[2],cofactor.z);
        return unit({float((static_cast<long double>(z.x)+y.x)+x.x),float((static_cast<long double>(z.y)+y.y)+x.y),float((static_cast<long double>(z.z)+y.z)+x.z)});
    }
    Vec3 broadExtent()const{return {std::abs(axes[0].x)*half.x+std::abs(axes[1].x)*half.y+std::abs(axes[2].x)*half.z,std::abs(axes[0].y)*half.x+std::abs(axes[1].y)*half.y+std::abs(axes[2].y)*half.z,std::abs(axes[0].z)*half.x+std::abs(axes[1].z)*half.y+std::abs(axes[2].z)*half.z};}
    std::optional<Contact> triangle(Vec3 worldA,Vec3 worldB,Vec3 worldC,const Vec3& retainedA,const Vec3& retainedB,const Vec3& retainedC)const{
        const Vec3 a=local(worldA),b=local(worldB),c=local(worldC);
        const auto normal=unit(cross(sub(b,a),sub(c,a)));
        const float constant=float(-dot(a,normal));
        if(!(dot(normal,unit(velocity))<0))return {}; // One-sided source face admission.
        const float speed=float(dot(normal,velocity));
        const long double distance=constant;
        if(bonus&&std::abs(distance)>1&&std::abs(distance+speed)>1&&distance*(distance+speed)>0)return {};
        long double incoming=0;bool embedded=speed==0;
        if(embedded){if(!bonus&&std::abs(distance)>=1)return {};}
        else {
            incoming=(-1-distance)/speed;auto outgoing=(1-distance)/speed;
            if(outgoing<incoming)std::swap(incoming,outgoing);
            if(bonus){if(incoming>1)return {};}
            else {if(incoming>1||outgoing<0)return {};incoming=std::clamp(incoming,0.L,1.L);}
        }
        float time=1;Vec3 point{};bool found=false;
        if(bonus&&incoming<0){
            point=mul(normal,-float(distance));
            if(inside(point,a,b,c)){time=float(distance-1);found=true;}
            else for(Vec3 p:{a,b,c})if(dot(sub(p,velocity),sub(p,velocity))<=dot(p,p)&&dot(p,p)<=1){point=p;time=float(std::sqrt(dot(p,p))-1);found=true;break;}
        }else if(!embedded){
            const auto p=add(mul(normal,-1),mul(velocity,float(incoming)));
            if(inside(p,a,b,c)){point=p;time=float(incoming);found=true;}
        }
        if(!found){
            const float velocitySquared=float(dot(velocity,velocity));
            // Source order: A,B,C vertices, then AB,BC,CA edges. Roots use a
            // strict best-time comparison, so equal-time later features lose.
            for(Vec3 p:{a,b,c}){float t;const auto q=mul(p,-1);if(root(velocitySquared,float(dot(q,velocity)*2),float(dot(p,p)-1),time,bonus,t)){time=t;point=p;found=true;}}
            const std::array points{a,b,c};
            for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i){const auto p=points[i],edge=sub(points[(i+1)%3],p),q=mul(p,-1);const float ee=float(dot(edge,edge)),ev=float(dot(edge,velocity)),eq=float(dot(q,edge));float t;
                const float aa=float(static_cast<long double>(ev)*ev-static_cast<long double>(ee)*velocitySquared);
                const auto twice=mul(velocity,2);
                const float bb=float(dot(q,twice)*ee-(static_cast<long double>(eq)*ev+static_cast<long double>(eq)*ev));
                const float cc=float(static_cast<long double>(eq)*eq+(1-dot(q,q))*ee);
                if(!root(aa,bb,cc,time,bonus,t))continue;
                const float s=float((static_cast<long double>(ev)*t-eq)/ee);
                if(s>=0&&s<=1){time=t;point=add(p,mul(edge,s));found=true;}
            }
        }
        if(!found)return {};
        // 100d1160 keeps the pre-transform vertex pointers and at
        // 100d12a1..12c8 publishes their face normal directly for negative
        // overlaps, without candidate pose. Ordinary/A6 normals stay radial.
        const bool planeNormal=bonus&&static_cast<double>(time)<std::bit_cast<double>(0xbf50624dd2f1a9fcull);
        Vec3 resultNormal;
        if(planeNormal){
            // 100e4170 keeps the reciprocal in x87 until the three final
            // float stores; no intermediate float-rounded reciprocal.
            const auto n=cross(sub(retainedB,retainedA),sub(retainedC,retainedA));
            const auto squared=(static_cast<long double>(n.x)*n.x+static_cast<long double>(n.y)*n.y)+static_cast<long double>(n.z)*n.z;
            const auto reciprocal=squared!=0?1/std::sqrt(squared):1;
            resultNormal={float(n.x*reciprocal),float(n.y*reciprocal),float(n.z*reciprocal)};
        }else resultNormal=worldNormal(sub(mul(velocity,time),point));
        const float travel=length*time,backoff=bonus?buffer:std::min(travel,buffer);
        const float scalar=travel-backoff;
        const auto position=sub(world(point),mul(direction,backoff));
        return Contact{length!=0?std::max(0.f,scalar/length):0,scalar,position,resultNormal,time<=0};
    }
};
}
```

`native/pe_font.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace k22::pe_font_detail {
using Bytes = std::span<const std::uint8_t>;
constexpr std::size_t decodedSize = 192 * 72 * 3;
// Observed identically in the user's original ISO app/K22.exe, patched K22.exe,
// and Ghidra's patched 4GB PE, at raw offset 0x22130c:
// length 17063, SHA256 a16eb595d782967bca34d2c8360c147b5ea1c78780d1a0a58e3a9245d3215c41.
// Fingerprint metadata only; no proprietary image bytes are bundled.
constexpr std::size_t fontLength = 17063;
constexpr std::uint32_t fontCrc = 0xf5b48715;
constexpr std::uint32_t decodedFontCrc = 0x339585ef;

[[noreturn]] inline void fail(std::string_view reason) {
    throw std::runtime_error("embedded engine font: " + std::string(reason));
}
inline void bounds(std::uint64_t offset, std::uint64_t length, std::uint64_t size) {
    if (offset > size || length > size - offset) fail("truncated or out-of-bounds PE/PCX data");
}
inline std::uint16_t u16(Bytes b, std::size_t p) {
    bounds(p, 2, b.size());
    return std::uint16_t(b[p]) | (std::uint16_t(b[p + 1]) << 8);
}
inline std::uint32_t u32(Bytes b, std::size_t p) {
    bounds(p, 4, b.size());
    return std::uint32_t(b[p]) | (std::uint32_t(b[p + 1]) << 8)
         | (std::uint32_t(b[p + 2]) << 16) | (std::uint32_t(b[p + 3]) << 24);
}
inline constexpr auto crcTable = [] {
    std::array<std::uint32_t, 256> table{};
    for (std::uint32_t n = 0; n < table.size(); ++n) {
        auto v = n;
        for (unsigned bit = 0; bit < 8; ++bit) v = (v >> 1) ^ ((v & 1) ? 0xedb88320u : 0u);
        table[n] = v;
    }
    return table;
}();
inline std::uint32_t crcByte(std::uint32_t crc, std::uint8_t value) {
    return crcTable[(crc ^ value) & 255] ^ (crc >> 8);
}
inline std::uint32_t crc32(Bytes b) {
    std::uint32_t crc = 0xffffffff;
    for (auto v : b) crc = crcByte(crc, v);
    return ~crc;
}
struct Rle { std::size_t consumed; std::uint32_t crc; };
inline Rle decodeRle(Bytes b, std::size_t outputSize) {
    std::size_t p = 0, decoded = 0;
    std::uint32_t crc = 0xffffffff;
    while (decoded < outputSize) {
        if (p == b.size()) fail("truncated PCX RLE");
        auto value = b[p++];
        std::size_t count = 1;
        if ((value & 0xc0) == 0xc0) {
            count = value & 63;
            if (!count || p == b.size()) fail("invalid or truncated PCX RLE run");
            value = b[p++];
        }
        if (count > outputSize - decoded) fail("PCX RLE run exceeds image size");
        // Real A6 _a4font runs cross both plane and scanline boundaries.
        decoded += count;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) crc = crcByte(crc, value);
    }
    return {p, ~crc};
}
inline bool fontHeader(Bytes b) {
    return b.size() >= 128 && b[0] == 10 && b[1] == 5 && b[2] == 1 && b[3] == 8
        && u16(b, 4) == 0 && u16(b, 6) == 0 && u16(b, 8) == 191 && u16(b, 10) == 71
        && b[64] == 0 && b[65] == 3 && u16(b, 66) == 192 && u16(b, 68) == 1;
}
inline void validateFont(Bytes pcx) {
    if (pcx.size() != fontLength) fail("truncated or wrong-length A6 _a4font PCX");
    if (!fontHeader(pcx)) fail("invalid RGB24 192x72 A6 _a4font PCX header");
    const auto decoded = decodeRle(pcx.subspan(128), decodedSize);
    if (decoded.consumed != pcx.size() - 128) fail("unexpected trailing A6 _a4font PCX data");
    if (crc32(pcx) != fontCrc || decoded.crc != decodedFontCrc)
        fail("PCX does not match the genuine A6 _a4font fingerprint");
}
struct Range { std::size_t offset, size; std::uint32_t virtualOffset, virtualSize; };
struct Sections { std::array<Range, 96> ranges{}; std::size_t count{}; };
inline Sections peSections(Bytes pe) {
    if (pe.size() < 64 || pe.size() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()
        || u16(pe, 0) != 0x5a4d) fail("missing DOS PE header or invalid PE32 file size");
    const std::size_t nt = u32(pe, 60);
    if (nt < 64) fail("invalid NT header offset");
    bounds(nt, 24, pe.size());
    if (u32(pe, nt) != 0x00004550 || u16(pe, nt + 4) != 0x14c
        || !(u16(pe, nt + 22) & 2)) fail("expected executable x86 PE32");
    const auto count = u16(pe, nt + 6), optionalSize = u16(pe, nt + 20);
    if (!count || count > 96 || optionalSize < 96) fail("invalid PE section/optional header size");
    const auto optional = nt + 24;
    const auto tableSize = std::uint64_t(optionalSize) + std::uint64_t(count) * 40;
    bounds(optional, tableSize, pe.size());
    if (u16(pe, optional) != 0x10b) fail("expected PE32 optional header");
    const auto imageSize = u32(pe, optional + 56), headerSize = u32(pe, optional + 60);
    const auto directories = u32(pe, optional + 92);
    if (!imageSize || headerSize > pe.size() || optional > headerSize
        || tableSize > headerSize - optional || directories > 16
        || std::uint64_t(directories) * 8 > optionalSize - 96u)
        fail("invalid PE image/header dimensions");
    Sections result;
    std::array<Range, 96> all{};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        auto h = pe.subspan(optional + optionalSize + i * 40, 40);
        Range r{u32(h, 20), u32(h, 16), u32(h, 12), u32(h, 8)};
        bounds(r.offset, r.size, pe.size());
        if (r.size && r.offset < headerSize) fail("PE section overlaps headers");
        const auto virtualSize = std::max<std::uint64_t>(r.virtualSize, r.size);
        bounds(r.virtualOffset, virtualSize, imageSize);
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            const auto& a = all[j];
            if (r.size && a.size && r.offset < a.offset + a.size && a.offset < r.offset + r.size)
                fail("overlapping PE raw sections");
            const auto av = std::max<std::uint64_t>(a.virtualSize, a.size);
            if (virtualSize && av && r.virtualOffset < std::uint64_t(a.virtualOffset) + av
                && a.virtualOffset < std::uint64_t(r.virtualOffset) + virtualSize)
                fail("overlapping PE virtual sections");
        }
        all[i] = r;
        // Never scan code, BSS, overlay/certificates, or raw section alignment padding.
        if (!(u32(h, 36) & 0x40) || !r.size) continue;
        if (r.virtualSize) r.size = std::min<std::size_t>(r.size, r.virtualSize);
        result.ranges[result.count++] = r;
    }
    return result;
}

// Pure parser checks; no game-font fixtures, filesystem access, or PE execution.
inline void selfCheck() {
    auto require = [](bool value) { if (!value) fail("parser self-check failed"); };
    auto rejects = [&](auto action) {
        bool rejected = false;
        try { action(); } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { rejected = true; }
        require(rejected);
    };
    const std::array<std::uint8_t, 4> rle{0xc2, 7, 8, 99};
    auto decoded = decodeRle(rle, 3);
    const std::array<std::uint8_t, 3> raw{7, 7, 8};
    require(decoded.consumed == 3 && decoded.crc == crc32(raw));
    rejects([&] { decodeRle(Bytes(rle).first(1), 2); });
    rejects([&] { decodeRle(Bytes(rle).first(2), 3); });
    rejects([&] { decodeRle(rle, 1); });
    const std::array<std::uint8_t, 2> zeroRun{0xc0, 0};
    rejects([&] { decodeRle(zeroRun, 1); });
    const std::array<std::uint8_t, 9> check{'1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9'};
    require(crc32(check) == 0xcbf43926);
    rejects([&] { u32(raw, 0); });
    rejects([&] { bounds(std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max(), 1, 16); });
    rejects([&] { bounds(15, std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max(), 16); });
    rejects([&] { peSections(raw); });
    std::array<std::uint8_t, 240> pe{};
    auto put16 = [&](std::size_t p, std::uint16_t v) {
        pe[p] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v); pe[p + 1] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 8);
    };
    auto put32 = [&](std::size_t p, std::uint32_t v) {
        put16(p, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(v)); put16(p + 2, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(v >> 16));
    };
    put16(0, 0x5a4d); put32(60, 64); put32(64, 0x4550);
    put16(68, 0x14c); put16(70, 1); put16(84, 96); put16(86, 2);
    put16(88, 0x10b); put32(144, 4096); put32(148, 224);
    put32(192, 16); put32(196, 512); put32(200, 16); put32(204, 224); put32(220, 0x40);
    auto layout = peSections(pe);
    require(layout.count == 1 && layout.ranges[0].offset == 224 && layout.ranges[0].size == 16);
    rejects([&] { peSections(Bytes(pe).first(223)); });
    put32(200, 17); rejects([&] { peSections(pe); }); put32(200, 16);
    put32(204, 223); rejects([&] { peSections(pe); }); put32(204, 224);
    put16(88, 0x20b); rejects([&] { peSections(pe); });
    require(!fontHeader(Bytes(pe).first(127)));
    rejects([&] { validateFont({}); });
    rejects([&] { validateFont(raw); });
    std::array<std::uint8_t, 128> pcxHeader{};
    pcxHeader[0] = 10; pcxHeader[1] = 5; pcxHeader[2] = 1; pcxHeader[3] = 8;
    pcxHeader[8] = 191; pcxHeader[10] = 71; pcxHeader[65] = 3;
    pcxHeader[66] = 192; pcxHeader[68] = 1;
    require(fontHeader(pcxHeader));
    rejects([&] { validateFont(pcxHeader); });
    pcxHeader[65] = 1;
    require(!fontHeader(pcxHeader));
}
} // namespace k22::pe_font_detail

namespace k22 {
// Validates the exact installed PCX using the same proof as PE extraction.
inline void validate_engine_font(std::span<const std::uint8_t> pcx) {
    pe_font_detail::validateFont(pcx);
}

// The caller owns source safety/lifetime: use a stable read-only regular PE,
// reject symlinks/special files, and verify identity/size/ctime/mtime before and
// after reading or mapping. Never execute PE code. The returned vector contains
// only the exact original encoded PCX bytes, not any trailing section data.
inline std::vector<std::uint8_t> extract_engine_font(std::span<const std::uint8_t> pe) {
    using namespace pe_font_detail;
    const auto sections = peSections(pe);
    Bytes found;
    std::string invalidReason;
    for (std::size_t n = 0; n < sections.count; ++n) {
        const auto& range = sections.ranges[n];
        auto data = pe.subspan(range.offset, range.size);
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p <= data.size() && data.size() - p >= 128; ++p) {
            if (!fontHeader(data.subspan(p, 128))) continue;
            auto bytes = data.subspan(p, std::min(fontLength, data.size() - p));
            try { validate_engine_font(bytes); }
            catch (const std::runtime_error& error) {
                if (invalidReason.empty()) invalidReason = error.what();
                continue;
            }
            if (!found.empty()) fail("ambiguous _a4font: multiple genuine embedded candidates");
            found = bytes;
        }
    }
    if (found.empty()) {
        if (!invalidReason.empty()) throw std::runtime_error(invalidReason);
        fail("genuine embedded A6 _a4font PCX is missing");
    }
    return {found.begin(), found.end()};
}
} // namespace k22
```

```cpp
void Physics::remove_entity(ObjectId id){
 if(!world_)return;
 // A script callback may remove a geometry while its body batch is pending.
 dGeomID removed=nullptr;
 if(auto it=bodies_.find(id);it!=bodies_.end())removed=it->second.geom;
 else if(auto it=statics_.find(id);it!=statics_.end())removed=it->second.geom;
 if(removed)for(auto& [entity,body]:bodies_)for(std::size_t i=0;i<body.contactBatch.usedGroups;++i){
  auto& group=body.contactBatch.groups[i];
  if(group.first==removed||group.second==removed){group.active.clear();group.rejected.clear();group.first=nullptr;group.second=nullptr;}
 }
 if(auto it=bodies_.find(id);it!=bodies_.end()){destroy_shape(it->second);dBodyDestroy(it->second.body);bodies_.erase(it);}
 if(auto it=statics_.find(id);it!=statics_.end()){destroy_shape(it->second);statics_.erase(it);}
}
bool Physics::box(Shape& shape,ObjectId id){
 auto it=engine_.entities.find(id);if(it==engine_.entities.end()||!it->second.physicsGeometry||!it->second.model||it->second.model->vertices.empty())return false;
 const auto& entity=it->second;Vec3 lo=worldModelVertex(engine_,id,entity,0),hi=lo;
 for(std::size_t i=1;i<entity.model->vertices.size();++i){const auto v=worldModelVertex(engine_,id,entity,i);lo={std::min(lo.x,v.x),std::min(lo.y,v.y),std::min(lo.z,v.z)};hi={std::max(hi.x,v.x),std::max(hi.y,v.y),std::max(hi.z,v.z)};}
 const Vec3 scale{float(engine_.field(id,"scale_x")),float(engine_.field(id,"scale_y")),float(engine_.field(id,"scale_z"))};
 lo={lo.x*scale.x,lo.y*scale.y,lo.z*scale.z};hi={hi.x*scale.x,hi.y*scale.y,hi.z*scale.z};
 shape.entity=id;shape.center={(lo.x+hi.x)*.5f,(lo.y+hi.y)*.5f,(lo.z+hi.z)*.5f};
 shape.extent={hi.x-lo.x,hi.y-lo.y,hi.z-lo.z};
 shape.radius=.5f*std::sqrt(shape.extent.x*shape.extent.x+shape.extent.y*shape.extent.y+shape.extent.z*shape.extent.z);
 if(shape.extent.x<=0)shape.extent.x=1;if(shape.extent.y<=0)shape.extent.y=1;if(shape.extent.z<=0)shape.extent.z=1;
 shape.geom=dCreateBox(space_,shape.extent.x,shape.extent.y,shape.extent.z);dGeomSetData(shape.geom,&shape);return true;
}
void Physics::pose(Shape& shape){
 dMatrix3 r;rotation(r,engine_.angles(shape.entity));const auto p=engine_.position(shape.entity),c=transform(r,shape.center);
 dGeomSetRotation(shape.geom,r);dGeomSetPosition(shape.geom,p.x+c.x,p.y+c.y,p.z+c.z);
}
void Physics::copy_pose(Body& body,float fraction){
 // Original 100b0d40 changes the private quaternion, not the geometry's retained matrix.
 // Keep that quaternion for enable's snapshot capture without making modern ODE Q/R inconsistent.
 auto& q=body.selectedQuaternion;float dot=0;for(int i=0;i<4;++i)dot+=body.previousQuaternion[i]*body.currentQuaternion[i];
 const float angle=std::acos(std::clamp(dot,-1.f,1.f)),sine=std::sin(angle);
 if(sine==0)q=body.currentQuaternion;
 else {const float a=std::sin((1-fraction)*angle)/sine,b=std::sin(fraction*angle)/sine;for(int i=0;i<4;++i)q[i]=a*body.previousQuaternion[i]+b*body.currentQuaternion[i];}
 dBodySetPosition(body.body,(1-fraction)*body.previousPosition[0]+fraction*body.currentPosition[0],(1-fraction)*body.previousPosition[1]+fraction*body.currentPosition[1],(1-fraction)*body.previousPosition[2]+fraction*body.currentPosition[2]);
 const auto* r=dBodyGetRotation(body.body);const auto* p=dBodyGetPosition(body.body);const auto c=transform(r,body.center);
 engine_.set_position(body.entity,{p[0]-c.x,p[1]-c.y,p[2]-c.z});
 engine_.set_field(body.entity,"pan",std::atan2(r[4],r[0])*degrees);
 engine_.set_field(body.entity,"tilt",std::atan2(r[8],std::sqrt(r[4]*r[4]+r[0]*r[0]))*degrees);
 engine_.set_field(body.entity,"roll",std::atan2(r[9],r[10])*degrees);
}
std::optional<Value> Physics::builtin(Runtime&,ProcessContext&,std::string_view name,std::span<const Argument> args){
 const bool owned=name=="ph_setgravity"||name=="phent_settype"||name=="phent_setmass"||name=="phent_setfriction"||name=="phent_setelasticity"||name=="phent_enable"||name=="phent_addcentralforce"||name=="phent_addvelglobal"||name=="phent_addvellocal";
 if(!owned)return std::nullopt;
 auto need=[&](std::size_t n){if(args.size()<n)throw std::runtime_error(std::string(name)+": missing arguments");};
 auto value=[&](std::size_t i){return args[i].current();};
 if(name=="ph_setgravity"){
  need(1);if(!vector_argument(args[0]))return Value{};gravity_=engine_.vector(args[0]);requested_=true;
  if(!world_){initialize();load_world();}dWorldSetGravity(world_,gravity_.x,gravity_.y,gravity_.z);
  for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_)wake_query_body(body);return Value::from_int(1);
 }
 need(2);const auto v=value(0);const ObjectId id=v.kind==Value::Kind::Object?v.bits:0;
 const auto* object=engine_.state.get(id);auto entity=engine_.entities.find(id);if(!object||!object->alive||entity==engine_.entities.end()||!entity->second.physicsGeometry||!entity->second.model)return Value{};
 auto it=bodies_.find(id);
 if(name=="phent_settype"){
  need(3);const auto type=value(1).raw()>>10,shape=value(2).raw()>>10;
  if(it!=bodies_.end()){if(type)return Value{};remove_entity(id);return Value::from_int(1);}
  if(type!=1||shape!=0)return Value{};
  requested_=true;if(!world_){initialize();load_world();}
  if(auto existing=statics_.find(id);existing!=statics_.end()){destroy_shape(existing->second);statics_.erase(existing);}
  auto [entry,inserted]=bodies_.try_emplace(id);auto& body=entry->second;
  if(!box(body,id)){bodies_.erase(entry);return Value::from_int(1);}
  body.body=dBodyCreate(world_);dBodySetData(body.body,&body);dGeomSetBody(body.geom,body.body);engine_.refresh_query_pose(id);
  dMass mass;dMassSetBoxTotal(&mass,1,body.extent.x,body.extent.y,body.extent.z);dBodySetMass(body.body,&mass);
  snapshot(body.previousPosition,body.previousQuaternion,body.body);body.currentPosition=body.previousPosition;body.currentQuaternion=body.previousQuaternion;body.selectedQuaternion=body.currentQuaternion;
  return Value::from_int(1);
 }
 if(it==bodies_.end())return Value{};auto& body=it->second;
 if(name=="phent_setmass"){
  need(3);if(value(2).raw()!=0)return Value{};const float total=float(value(1).real());
  // Only positive PH_BOX mass is reachable in the actual Bonus census; mass0 is not a kinematic policy.
  if(total<=0)throw std::runtime_error("Unreachable Bonus zero/negative rigid mass has no proved modern ODE mapping");
  body.mass=total;dMass mass;dMassSetBoxTotal(&mass,total,body.extent.x,body.extent.y,body.extent.z);dBodySetMass(body.body,&mass);
 }else if(name=="phent_setfriction"){
  body.friction=std::max(0.f,float(value(1).real()))/100;if(body.friction>1)body.friction=FLT_MAX;
 }else if(name=="phent_setelasticity"){
  need(3);body.bounce=std::clamp(float(value(1).real()),0.f,100.f)/100;body.threshold=std::max(0.f,float(value(2).real()));
 }else if(name=="phent_enable"){
  if(!value(1)){dBodyDisable(body.body);return Value::from_int(1);}
  wake_query_body(body);std::copy_n(dBodyGetPosition(body.body),4,body.currentPosition.begin());body.currentQuaternion=body.selectedQuaternion;
  body.previousPosition=body.currentPosition;body.previousQuaternion=body.currentQuaternion;return Value::from_int(1);
 }else {
  if(!vector_argument(args[1]))return Value{};const auto force=engine_.vector(args[1]);
  if(name=="phent_addcentralforce"){
   if(std::abs(force.x)>.0001f||std::abs(force.y)>.0001f||std::abs(force.z)>.0001f)dBodyAddForce(body.body,force.x,force.y,force.z);
  }else {
   need(3);if(!vector_argument(args[2]))return Value{};const auto point=engine_.vector(args[2]);const float scale=body.mass/float(engine_.number("time")/16);
   if(name=="phent_addvelglobal")dBodyAddForceAtPos(body.body,force.x*scale,force.y*scale,force.z*scale,point.x,point.y,point.z);
   else dBodyAddRelForceAtRelPos(body.body,force.x*scale,force.y*scale,force.z*scale,point.x,point.y,point.z);
  }
 }
 wake_query_body(body);return Value::from_int(1);
}
void Physics::load_world(){
 if(!requested_)return;initialize();destroy_shape(worldShape_);worldShape_=Shape{};
 if(engine_.world){
  const auto& world=*engine_.world;const auto& mesh=world.collision;
  // 1005c360 populates the world face list from section 11, including repetitions.
  // 10087e70 then selects only 100870d0's bit-0x40-clear partition.
  auto append=[&](std::size_t i){if(i<mesh.flags.size()&&(mesh.flags[i]&0x40))return;for(auto index:mesh.triangles[i])worldShape_.indices.push_back(index);};
  if(world.faces.empty()){
   // Direct collision-only Worlds (the consumer boundary) already supply the face feed.
   worldShape_.indices.reserve(mesh.triangles.size()*3);for(std::size_t i=0;i<mesh.triangles.size();++i)append(i);
  }else{
   std::vector<std::size_t> first(world.faces.size()+1);
   for(std::size_t i=0;i<world.faces.size();++i)first[i+1]=first[i]+world.faces[i].edgeCount-2;
   std::size_t count=0;for(auto face:world.bspBlocks)count+=first[face+1]-first[face];
   worldShape_.indices.reserve(count*3);
   for(auto face:world.bspBlocks)for(std::size_t i=first[face];i<first[face+1];++i)append(i);
  }
  if(worldShape_.indices.size()==3){const std::array<dTriIndex,3> triangle{worldShape_.indices[0],worldShape_.indices[1],worldShape_.indices[2]};worldShape_.indices.insert(worldShape_.indices.end(),triangle.begin(),triangle.end());}
  if(!worldShape_.indices.empty()){
   worldShape_.mesh=dGeomTriMeshDataCreate();dGeomTriMeshDataBuildSingle(worldShape_.mesh,mesh.vertices.data(),sizeof(Vec3),int(mesh.vertices.size()),worldShape_.indices.data(),int(worldShape_.indices.size()),3*sizeof(dTriIndex));
   // Original main-world contacts precede actor pairs, not space iteration order.
   worldShape_.geom=dCreateTriMesh(nullptr,worldShape_.mesh,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);dGeomSetData(worldShape_.geom,&worldShape_);
  }
 }
 refresh_statics();
}
void Physics::refresh_statics(){
 for(auto it=statics_.begin();it!=statics_.end();){const auto* object=engine_.state.get(it->first);if(!object||!object->alive||!engine_.entities.contains(it->first)){destroy_shape(it->second);it=statics_.erase(it);}else ++it;}
 for(const auto& [id,entity]:engine_.entities){
  const auto* object=engine_.state.get(id);if(!object||!object->alive||bodies_.contains(id)||!entity.physicsGeometry||!entity.model||entity.type==0)continue;
  const bool solid=(engine_.flags(id)&engine_.constant("passable"))==0;
  auto it=statics_.find(id);
  if(!solid){if(it!=statics_.end())dGeomDisable(it->second.geom);continue;}
  const bool polygon=(engine_.flags(id)&0x04000000u)!=0||entity.type==5;
  if(it!=statics_.end()&&bool(it->second.mesh)!=polygon){destroy_shape(it->second);statics_.erase(it);it=statics_.end();}
  if(it==statics_.end()){
   auto [entry,inserted]=statics_.try_emplace(id);auto& shape=entry->second;if(!box(shape,id)){statics_.erase(entry);continue;}
   if(polygon){
    dGeomDestroy(shape.geom);shape.geom=nullptr;const auto& model=*entity.model;
    const Vec3 scale{float(engine_.field(id,"scale_x")),float(engine_.field(id,"scale_y")),float(engine_.field(id,"scale_z"))};
    shape.vertices.reserve(model.vertices.size());shape.indices.reserve(model.triangles.size()*3);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<model.vertices.size();++i){const auto v=worldModelVertex(engine_,id,entity,i);shape.vertices.push_back({v.x*scale.x-shape.center.x,v.y*scale.y-shape.center.y,v.z*scale.z-shape.center.z});}
    for(const auto& triangle:model.triangles){const auto& indices=triangle.indices;if(model.clockwise)shape.indices.insert(shape.indices.end(),{indices[2],indices[1],indices[0]});else shape.indices.insert(shape.indices.end(),indices.begin(),indices.end());}
    if(shape.indices.empty()){statics_.erase(entry);continue;}
    shape.mesh=dGeomTriMeshDataCreate();dGeomTriMeshDataBuildSingle(shape.mesh,shape.vertices.data(),sizeof(Vec3),int(shape.vertices.size()),shape.indices.data(),int(shape.indices.size()),3*sizeof(dTriIndex));
    shape.geom=dCreateTriMesh(space_,shape.mesh,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);dGeomSetData(shape.geom,&shape);
   }
   it=entry;
  }
  dGeomEnable(it->second.geom);pose(it->second);
 }
}
void Physics::collect_contact(ContactBatch& batch,const dContact& contact){
 // 1007ab80: ordered depth<=double .0001 rejects; unordered is admitted.
 if(contact.geom.depth<=.0001)return;
 const auto& c=contact.geom;
 const Vec3 n{c.normal[0],c.normal[1],c.normal[2]},p{c.pos[0],c.pos[1],c.pos[2]};
 const float plane=float((static_cast<long double>(p.z)*n.z+static_cast<long double>(p.y)*n.y)+static_cast<long double>(p.x)*n.x);
 std::size_t index=batch.usedGroups;
 for(std::size_t i=batch.usedGroups;i>0;--i){
  const auto& group=batch.groups[i-1];const auto& g=group.normal;
  if(group.first==c.g1&&group.second==c.g2&&
     static_cast<long double>(group.plane)-1.5f<=plane&&plane<=static_cast<long double>(group.plane)+1.5f&&
     (static_cast<long double>(n.z)*g.z+static_cast<long double>(n.y)*g.y)+static_cast<long double>(n.x)*g.x>=.9f){index=i-1;break;}
 }
 if(index==batch.usedGroups){
  if(index==batch.groups.size())batch.groups.emplace_back();
  auto& group=batch.groups[index];group.normal=n;group.plane=plane;group.depth=-1;group.first=c.g1;group.second=c.g2;
  ++batch.usedGroups;
 }
 auto& group=batch.groups[index];group.active.push_back(batch.candidates.size());
 batch.candidates.emplace_back(contact,p);
}
void Physics::reduce_contacts(ContactBatch& batch,ContactGroup& group){
 // Original 1006d2a0/1006c9b0/1006cc80/1006cf60, not a max-four manifold.
 // Explicit float stores retain the recovered spill points; long double keeps
 // unspilled arithmetic extended. Original incoming x87/CRT mode is unknown.
 constexpr float epsilon=.0001f;
 auto& active=group.active;
 if(active.size()<4)return;
 auto nearZero=[&](Vec3 v){return !(float(std::fabs(double(v.x)))>epsilon||float(std::fabs(double(v.y)))>epsilon||float(std::fabs(double(v.z)))>epsilon);};
 if(nearZero(group.normal))return;
 auto difference=[](Vec3 b,Vec3 a){return Vec3{float(static_cast<long double>(b.x)-a.x),float(static_cast<long double>(b.y)-a.y),float(static_cast<long double>(b.z)-a.z)};};
 auto radius=[](Vec3 v){return float((static_cast<long double>(v.x)*v.x+static_cast<long double>(v.y)*v.y)+static_cast<long double>(v.z)*v.z);};
 Vec3 t{};
 for(std::size_t i=1;i<active.size()&&nearZero(t);++i)t=difference(batch.candidates[active[i]].point,batch.candidates[active[0]].point);
 const float length=float(std::sqrt(double(radius(t))));
 if(length<=epsilon)t={};
 else{
  t={float(static_cast<long double>(t.x)/length),float(static_cast<long double>(t.y)/length),float(static_cast<long double>(t.z)/length)};
  if(float(std::fabs(double(t.x)))<epsilon)t.x=0;
  if(float(std::fabs(double(t.y)))<epsilon)t.y=0;
  if(float(std::fabs(double(t.z)))<epsilon)t.z=0;
 }
 const auto n=group.normal;const Vec3 negative{-t.x,-t.y,-t.z};
 const Vec3 b{float(static_cast<long double>(negative.y)*n.z-static_cast<long double>(negative.z)*n.y),
              float(static_cast<long double>(negative.z)*n.x-static_cast<long double>(negative.x)*n.z),
              float(static_cast<long double>(negative.x)*n.y-static_cast<long double>(negative.y)*n.x)};
 auto dot=[](Vec3 p,Vec3 axis){return float((static_cast<long double>(p.y)*axis.y+static_cast<long double>(p.z)*axis.z)+static_cast<long double>(p.x)*axis.x);};
 group.depth=-1;
 for(auto index:active){
  auto& candidate=batch.candidates[index];const auto p=candidate.point;
  if(candidate.payload.geom.depth>group.depth)group.depth=candidate.payload.geom.depth;
  const float z=dot(p,n),y=dot(p,b),x=dot(p,t);candidate.point={x,y,z};
 }
 std::size_t pivot=0;
 for(std::size_t i=1;i<active.size();++i){
  const auto p=batch.candidates[active[i]].point,q=batch.candidates[active[pivot]].point;
  if(p.y<q.y||(!(p.y>q.y)&&!(p.y<q.y)&&p.x<q.x))pivot=i;
 }
 std::swap(active[0],active[pivot]);
 auto discard=[&](std::size_t index){std::swap(active[index],active.back());group.rejected.push_back(active.back());active.pop_back();};
 for(std::size_t i=0;i+1<active.size();++i){
  for(std::size_t j=i+1;j<active.size();){
   const auto delta=difference(batch.candidates[active[j]].point,batch.candidates[active[i]].point);
   if(!(float(std::fabs(double(delta.x)))>1.5f||float(std::fabs(double(delta.y)))>1.5f||float(std::fabs(double(delta.z)))>1.5f))discard(j);
   else ++j;
  }
 }
 auto area=[](Vec3 a,Vec3 b,Vec3 c){return float((static_cast<long double>(c.y)-a.y)*(static_cast<long double>(b.x)-a.x)-(static_cast<long double>(b.y)-a.y)*(static_cast<long double>(c.x)-a.x));};
 for(std::size_t i=1;i+1<active.size();++i){
  for(std::size_t j=i+1;j<active.size();){
   const auto a=batch.candidates[active[0]].point,b=batch.candidates[active[i]].point,c=batch.candidates[active[j]].point;
   const float raw=area(a,b,c),orientation=float(std::fabs(double(raw)))>epsilon?raw:0;
   bool keep=orientation>0,remove=orientation==0;
   if(remove){
    const float rb=radius(difference(b,a)),rc=radius(difference(c,a));
    keep=!(static_cast<long double>(rc)-epsilon>=rb); // Less OR unordered; no premature float spill.
   }
   if(!keep)std::swap(active[i],active[j]);
   if(remove)discard(j);else ++j;
  }
 }
 if(active.size()<4)return;
 contactHull_.clear();contactHull_.reserve(active.size());
 contactHull_.push_back(active[0]);contactHull_.push_back(active[1]);
 for(std::size_t i=2;i<active.size();++i){
  const auto c=batch.candidates[active[i]].point;
  while(contactHull_.size()>=2){
   const auto a=batch.candidates[contactHull_[contactHull_.size()-2]].point,b=batch.candidates[contactHull_.back()].point;
   const float turn=area(a,b,c);
   if(float(std::fabs(double(turn)))>epsilon&&turn>=0)break;
   group.rejected.push_back(contactHull_.back());contactHull_.pop_back();
  }
  contactHull_.push_back(active[i]);
 }
 active.swap(contactHull_);contactHull_.clear();
}
void Physics::flush_contacts(ContactBatch& batch){
 for(std::size_t i=0;i<batch.usedGroups;++i){
  auto& group=batch.groups[i];reduce_contacts(batch,group);
  for(auto index:group.active){
   const auto& contact=batch.candidates[index].payload;
   auto joint=dJointCreateContact(world_,contacts_,&contact);
   dJointAttach(joint,dGeomGetBody(contact.geom.g1),dGeomGetBody(contact.geom.g2));
  }
  group.active.clear();group.rejected.clear();group.normal={};group.plane=0;group.depth=-1;group.first=nullptr;group.second=nullptr;
 }
 batch.usedGroups=0;batch.candidates.clear();
}
void Physics::near_callback(void* physics,dGeomID first,dGeomID second){static_cast<Physics*>(physics)->collide(first,second);}
void Physics::collide(dGeomID first,dGeomID second){
 auto a=dGeomGetBody(first),b=dGeomGetBody(second);if(!a&&!b)return;
 if(!a){std::swap(first,second);std::swap(a,b);}
 const auto idA=static_cast<Body*>(dBodyGetData(a))->entity;
 const bool eligibleA=dBodyIsEnabled(a)&&!(engine_.flags(idA)&512u);
 if(b){
  const auto idB=static_cast<Body*>(dBodyGetData(b))->entity;const bool eligibleB=dBodyIsEnabled(b)&&!(engine_.flags(idB)&512u);
  if(!eligibleA&&!eligibleB)return;
  if(!eligibleA||(eligibleB&&idB<idA)){std::swap(first,second);std::swap(a,b);}
 }else if(!eligibleA)return;
 // All five source-reachable boxes retain constructor group 1, which permits same-group pairs.
 auto& body=*static_cast<Body*>(dBodyGetData(a));auto* other=b?static_cast<Body*>(dBodyGetData(b)):nullptr;
 const auto* staticShape=static_cast<Shape*>(dGeomGetData(second));const ObjectId otherId=other?other->entity:staticShape->entity;
 const bool mainWorld=staticShape==&worldShape_;
 // 1007bcc8/1007bce5 tests geometry flag9 only for the no-body ENTITY partner.
 if(!other&&!mainWorld&&(engine_.flags(otherId)&512u))return;
 // Original reusable 100-entry scratch limits ONE query, not the body batch.
 auto& contact=contactScratch_;const int count=dCollide(first,second,int(contact.size()),&contact[0].geom,sizeof(dContact));if(!count)return;
 const float friction=other?(body.friction==FLT_MAX||other->friction==FLT_MAX?FLT_MAX:std::sqrt(body.friction*other->friction)):body.friction;
 const float bounce=other?body.bounce*other->bounce:body.bounce,threshold=other?std::max(body.threshold,other->threshold):body.threshold;
 auto target=[&](const dContactGeom& c,bool normal){engine_.set_vector(engine_.global_vector("target"),{c.pos[0],c.pos[1],c.pos[2]});if(normal)engine_.set_vector(engine_.global_vector("normal"),{c.normal[0],c.normal[1],c.normal[2]});};
 auto event=[&](ObjectId receiver,ObjectId otherEntity,int type,const dContactGeom& c,bool normal){if(!(std::uint32_t(engine_.field(receiver,"event_flags"))&(1u<<unsigned(type))))return;target(c,normal);engine_.invoke_event(*runtime_,receiver,otherEntity,type);};
 const bool fast=speed_squared(a)+speed_squared(b)>threshold*threshold;
 for(int i=0;i<count;++i){auto& c=contact[std::size_t(i)];c.surface.mode=(dContactApprox1_1|dContactApprox1_2)|(mainWorld||other||i>0?dContactSoftERP|dContactSoftCFM:0)|(other||bounce>0?dContactBounce:0);c.surface.mu=friction;c.surface.bounce=bounce;c.surface.bounce_vel=threshold;c.surface.soft_erp=.2f;c.surface.soft_cfm=1.e-6f;
  if(fast){event(body.entity,otherId,6,c.geom,true);if(other)event(otherId,body.entity,6,c.geom,true);}
  collect_contact(body.contactBatch,c);
 }
 if(mainWorld){
  const auto mask=std::uint32_t(engine_.field(body.entity,"event_flags"));
  if((mask&2u)&&!(mask&0x40000000u)){
   const auto& c=contact[0].geom;const auto* velocity=dBodyGetLinearVel(a);
   const Vec3 v{bounce*velocity[0],bounce*velocity[1],bounce*velocity[2]};
   const float dot=c.normal[0]*v.x+c.normal[1]*v.y+c.normal[2]*v.z;
   engine_.set_vector(engine_.global_vector("bounce"),{v.x-2*dot*c.normal[0],v.y-2*dot*c.normal[1],v.z-2*dot*c.normal[2]});
   event(body.entity,0,1,c,true);
  }
  engine_.set_field(body.entity,"event_flags",std::uint32_t(engine_.field(body.entity,"event_flags"))|0x40000000u);
 }else{
  event(body.entity,otherId,2,contact[0].geom,false);
  if(otherId)event(otherId,body.entity,5,contact[0].geom,false);
 }
}
void Physics::step(Runtime& runtime){
 if(!world_||engine_.global("freeze_mode").raw()>=1)return;
 // Engine/Runtime publish TIME; genuine Bonus defines TIME as TIME_STEP.
 const float rate=float(engine_.number("ph_fps_max_lock"));if(rate<=0)return;const float delta=float(engine_.number("time")/16),interval=1/rate;
 accumulator_=std::min(.25f,accumulator_+delta);
 if(bodies_.empty()){while(accumulator_>=interval)accumulator_-=interval;return;}
 runtime_=&runtime;bool completed=false;
 // Source leaves both damping coefficients at .001; no damping work when no substep is due.
 const float dampingRate=accumulator_>=interval?(float(std::pow(double(float(1/(1-.001f))),-double(interval)))-1)/interval:0;
 if(accumulator_>=interval)refresh_statics();
 while(accumulator_>=interval){
  for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_){dBodySetPosition(body.body,body.currentPosition[0],body.currentPosition[1],body.currentPosition[2]);dBodySetQuaternion(body.body,body.currentQuaternion.data());body.selectedQuaternion=body.currentQuaternion;body.previousPosition=body.currentPosition;body.previousQuaternion=body.currentQuaternion;std::copy_n(dBodyGetForce(body.body),3,body.force.begin());std::copy_n(dBodyGetTorque(body.body),3,body.torque.begin());}
  for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_)if(dBodyIsEnabled(body.body)&&!(engine_.flags(id)&512u)){
   // 10087e70 resets the contact mark before even testing for a world mesh.
   engine_.set_field(id,"event_flags",std::uint32_t(engine_.field(id,"event_flags"))&~0x40000000u);
   if(worldShape_.geom)collide(body.geom,worldShape_.geom);
  }
  dSpaceCollide(space_,this,&Physics::near_callback);
  // Isolate each initiating body's world + eligible partner query subsequence.
  // Keep modern dSpaceCollide's pair admission and encounter order: original
  // kernel geometry/multiplicity/order and per-body event timing are not parity
  // claims. No solver step occurs between these equivalent body-batch flushes.
  for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_)flush_contacts(body.contactBatch);
  for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_){if(!dBodyIsEnabled(body.body))continue;
   const auto* v=dBodyGetLinearVel(body.body);
   const float linear=dampingRate*body.mass;
   if(std::abs(v[0]*linear)>.0001f||std::abs(v[1]*linear)>.0001f||std::abs(v[2]*linear)>.0001f)dBodyAddForce(body.body,v[0]*linear,v[1]*linear,v[2]*linear);
   const auto* w=dBodyGetAngularVel(body.body);dVector3 local,torque;dBodyVectorFromWorld(body.body,w[0],w[1],w[2],local);dMass mass;dBodyGetMass(body.body,&mass);
   const float angular=dampingRate;
   dBodyVectorToWorld(body.body,(mass.I[0]*local[0]+mass.I[1]*local[1]+mass.I[2]*local[2])*angular,(mass.I[4]*local[0]+mass.I[5]*local[1]+mass.I[6]*local[2])*angular,(mass.I[8]*local[0]+mass.I[9]*local[1]+mass.I[10]*local[2])*angular,torque);
   // 100665c0 divides by 1000 before 10067000's near-zero test, then multiplies back.
   if(std::abs(torque[0]/1000)>.0001f||std::abs(torque[1]/1000)>.0001f||std::abs(torque[2]/1000)>.0001f)dBodyAddTorque(body.body,torque[0],torque[1],torque[2]);
  }
  const int iterations=int(engine_.number("ph_iterations"));int stepped;
  if(iterations>0){dWorldSetQuickStepNumIterations(world_,iterations);stepped=dWorldQuickStep(world_,interval);}else stepped=dWorldStep(world_,interval);
  dJointGroupEmpty(contacts_);
  if(!stepped){
   // ODE guarantees unchanged objects on allocation failure; discard only our damping corrections.
   for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_){dBodySetForce(body.body,body.force[0],body.force[1],body.force[2]);dBodySetTorque(body.body,body.torque[0],body.torque[1],body.torque[2]);}
   runtime_=nullptr;throw std::runtime_error("ODE world step could not allocate working memory");
  }
  Vec3 lo{-100000,-100000,-100000},hi{100000,100000,100000};
  if(engine_.world){const auto& mesh=engine_.world->mesh;if(mesh.max.x>mesh.min.x||mesh.max.y>mesh.min.y||mesh.max.z>mesh.min.z){lo=mesh.min;hi=mesh.max;}}
  for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_){
   const auto* p=dBodyGetPosition(body.body);const float radius=body.radius;
   // 1007a6a0 restores only position and zeros velocities; it does not reset orientation or forces.
   if(!std::isfinite(p[0])||!std::isfinite(p[1])||!std::isfinite(p[2])||p[0]<lo.x-radius||p[0]>hi.x+radius||p[1]<lo.y-radius||p[1]>hi.y+radius||p[2]<lo.z-radius||p[2]>hi.z+radius){
    dBodySetLinearVel(body.body,0,0,0);dBodySetAngularVel(body.body,0,0,0);dBodySetPosition(body.body,body.previousPosition[0],body.previousPosition[1],body.previousPosition[2]);
   }
   engine_.synchronize_query_body(id,body.geom);
   snapshot(body.currentPosition,body.currentQuaternion,body.body);body.selectedQuaternion=body.currentQuaternion;dBodySetForce(body.body,body.force[0],body.force[1],body.force[2]);dBodySetTorque(body.body,body.torque[0],body.torque[1],body.torque[2]);
  }
  accumulator_-=interval;completed=true;
 }
 for(auto& [id,body]:bodies_){copy_pose(body,accumulator_/interval);if(completed){dBodySetForce(body.body,0,0,0);dBodySetTorque(body.body,0,0,0);}}
 runtime_=nullptr;
}
}
```

```cpp
Vec3 Renderer::project(Vec3 position,const Camera&camera,WindowMetrics metrics){
    Rect viewport=camera.viewport;if(viewport.width<=0||viewport.height<=0)viewport={0,0,float(metrics.width),float(metrics.height)};
    if(viewport.width<=0||viewport.height<=0)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot project onto zero-sized game view");
    Matrix matrix=camera_matrix(camera,viewport.width/viewport.height);
    float x=matrix[0]*position.x+matrix[4]*position.y+matrix[8]*position.z+matrix[12];
    float y=matrix[1]*position.x+matrix[5]*position.y+matrix[9]*position.z+matrix[13];
    float w=matrix[3]*position.x+matrix[7]*position.y+matrix[11]*position.z+matrix[15];
    if(w==0)return {std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity(),std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity(),0};
    return {viewport.x+(x/w+1)*viewport.width*.5f,viewport.y+(1-y/w)*viewport.height*.5f,w};
}
std::optional<PortalSurface>Renderer::portal_surface(const RenderFrame&frame,const Camera&camera,WindowMetrics metrics){
    Rect viewport=camera.viewport;if(viewport.width<=0||viewport.height<=0)viewport={0,0,float(metrics.width),float(metrics.height)};
    if(viewport.width<=0||viewport.height<=0)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot select portal for zero-sized game view");
    Matrix projection=camera_matrix(camera,viewport.width/viewport.height);
    auto select=[&](const Model&model,const Matrix&matrix)->std::optional<PortalSurface>{
        if(model.formatVersion!=6)return {};
        bool hasMirror=false;for(const auto&material:model.materials)hasMirror|=(material.flags&0x2000)!=0;
        if(!hasMirror)return {};
        auto point=[&](Vec3 p){return transformed_point(matrix,p);};
        for(const auto&triangle:model.triangles){
            if(triangle.materialIndex>=model.materials.size()||!(model.materials[triangle.materialIndex].flags&0x2000))continue;
            std::array<Vec3,3>positions;for(int index=0;index<3;++index){if(triangle.indices[index]>=model.vertices.size())throw std::runtime_error("Portal triangle references invalid game vertex");positions[index]=point(model.vertices[triangle.indices[index]].position);}
            Vec3 local=model.vertices[triangle.indices[0]].normal,normal{};
            for(int col=0;col<3;++col){float squared=matrix[col*4]*matrix[col*4]+matrix[col*4+1]*matrix[col*4+1]+matrix[col*4+2]*matrix[col*4+2];float component=col==0?local.x:col==1?local.y:local.z;if(squared>0){normal.x+=matrix[col*4]*component/squared;normal.y+=matrix[col*4+1]*component/squared;normal.z+=matrix[col*4+2]*component/squared;}}
            normal=unit(normal);if(!camera.noCull&&dot(normal,add(camera.position,mul(positions[0],-1)))<=0)continue;
            bool outside=false;
            std::array<std::array<float,4>,3>clip{};
            for(int vertex=0;vertex<3;++vertex)for(int row=0;row<4;++row)clip[vertex][row]=projection[row]*positions[vertex].x+projection[4+row]*positions[vertex].y+projection[8+row]*positions[vertex].z+projection[12+row];
            for(int plane=0;plane<6;++plane){int axis=plane/2;bool all=true;for(const auto&p:clip)all&=(plane%2?p[axis]>p[3]:p[axis]<-p[3]);outside|=all;}
            if(!outside)return PortalSurface{positions[0],normal};
        }
        return {};
    };
    if(frame.world&&camera.drawWorld&&(camera.layers&1))if(auto surface=select(frame.world->mesh,transform({}, {}, {1,1,1})))return surface;
    for(const auto&instance:frame.instances){
        if(!instance.model||!instance.visible||instance.viewSpace||instance.alpha<=0||!(instance.layers&camera.layers)||(camera.excludeEntityId&&instance.objectId==camera.excludeEntityId))continue;
        if(auto surface=select(*instance.model,transform(instance.position,instance.angles,instance.scale)))return surface;
    }
    return {};
}
void Renderer::poll(Input&in){
    auto&i=*impl_;
    in.pressed.reset();in.released.reset();in.mousePressed.reset();in.mouseReleased.reset();
    in.controllerPressed.reset();in.controllerReleased.reset();
    for(auto&buttons:in.joystickPressed)buttons.reset();
    for(auto&buttons:in.joystickReleased)buttons.reset();
    in.mouseDX=in.mouseDY=in.wheelX=in.wheelY=0;in.text.clear();
    std::uint64_t now=SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();in.dt=double(now-i.counter)/SDL_GetPerformanceFrequency();i.counter=now;
    auto joystick_slot=[&](SDL_JoystickID id)->int{
        // Legacy joystick slots use SDL instance IDs, never transient device indices.
        for(int index=0;index<2;++index)if(i.joysticks[index]&&SDL_JoystickInstanceID(i.joysticks[index])==id)return index;
        return -1;
    };
    SDL_Event event;
    bool devicesChanged=false;
    auto controller_event=[&](SDL_JoystickID id){return i.controller&&SDL_JoystickInstanceID(SDL_GameControllerGetJoystick(i.controller))==id;};
    while(SDL_PollEvent(&event)){
        switch(event.type){
        case SDL_QUIT:i.quit=true;break;
        case SDL_WINDOWEVENT:
            if(event.window.event==SDL_WINDOWEVENT_CLOSE)i.quit=true;
            if(event.window.event==SDL_WINDOWEVENT_FOCUS_LOST){in.released|=in.keys;in.keys.reset();in.mouseReleased|=in.mouseButtons;in.mouseButtons.reset();}
            break;
        case SDL_KEYDOWN:case SDL_KEYUP:{
            int key=event.key.keysym.scancode;
            if(key>=0&&key<SDL_NUM_SCANCODES){bool down=event.type==SDL_KEYDOWN;in.keys.set(key,down);if(!event.key.repeat)(down?in.pressed:in.released).set(key);}
            break;
        }
        case SDL_MOUSEMOTION:
            in.mouseX=event.motion.x;in.mouseY=event.motion.y;in.mouseDX+=event.motion.xrel;in.mouseDY+=event.motion.yrel;break;
        case SDL_MOUSEBUTTONDOWN:case SDL_MOUSEBUTTONUP:
            if(event.button.button<8){bool down=event.type==SDL_MOUSEBUTTONDOWN;in.mouseButtons.set(event.button.button,down);(down?in.mousePressed:in.mouseReleased).set(event.button.button);in.mouseX=event.button.x;in.mouseY=event.button.y;}
            break;
        case SDL_MOUSEWHEEL:{
            float direction=event.wheel.direction==SDL_MOUSEWHEEL_FLIPPED?-1:1;
            in.wheelX+=event.wheel.preciseX*direction;in.wheelY+=event.wheel.preciseY*direction;break;
        }
        case SDL_TEXTINPUT:in.text+=event.text.text;break;
        case SDL_JOYDEVICEADDED:i.open_joystick(event.jdevice.which);devicesChanged=true;break;
        case SDL_JOYDEVICEREMOVED:{
            int index=joystick_slot(event.jdevice.which);
            if(index>=0){SDL_JoystickClose(i.joysticks[index]);i.joysticks[index]=nullptr;in.joystickReleased[index]|=in.joystickButtons[index];in.joystickButtons[index].reset();in.joystickAxes[index].fill(0);}
            devicesChanged=true;
            break;
        }
        case SDL_JOYBUTTONDOWN:case SDL_JOYBUTTONUP:{
            int index=joystick_slot(event.jbutton.which);
            if(index>=0&&event.jbutton.button<32){bool down=event.type==SDL_JOYBUTTONDOWN;in.joystickButtons[index].set(event.jbutton.button,down);(down?in.joystickPressed[index]:in.joystickReleased[index]).set(event.jbutton.button);}
            break;
        }
        case SDL_CONTROLLERDEVICEADDED:
            i.open_controller(event.cdevice.which);break;
        case SDL_CONTROLLERDEVICEREMOVED:
            if(i.controller&&SDL_JoystickInstanceID(SDL_GameControllerGetJoystick(i.controller))==event.cdevice.which){std::cerr<<"kabus22: game controller removed\n";SDL_GameControllerClose(i.controller);i.controller=nullptr;in.controllerReleased|=in.controllerButtons;in.controllerButtons.reset();in.controllerAxes.fill(0);}
            break;
        case SDL_CONTROLLERBUTTONDOWN:case SDL_CONTROLLERBUTTONUP:
            if(controller_event(event.cbutton.which)&&event.cbutton.button<SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_MAX){bool down=event.type==SDL_CONTROLLERBUTTONDOWN;in.controllerButtons.set(event.cbutton.button,down);(down?in.controllerPressed:in.controllerReleased).set(event.cbutton.button);}break;
        case SDL_CONTROLLERAXISMOTION:
            if(controller_event(event.caxis.which)&&event.caxis.axis<SDL_CONTROLLER_AXIS_MAX)in.controllerAxes[event.caxis.axis]=event.caxis.value/(event.caxis.value<0?32768.0f:32767.0f);break;
        default:break;
        }
    }
    if(devicesChanged)for(int device=0;device<SDL_NumJoysticks();++device){i.open_joystick(device);i.open_controller(device);}
    if(i.controller){
        for(int axis=0;axis<SDL_CONTROLLER_AXIS_MAX;++axis){int value=SDL_GameControllerGetAxis(i.controller,static_cast<SDL_GameControllerAxis>(axis));in.controllerAxes[axis]=value/(value<0?32768.0f:32767.0f);}
        for(int button=0;button<SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_MAX;++button){bool down=SDL_GameControllerGetButton(i.controller,static_cast<SDL_GameControllerButton>(button));if(down!=in.controllerButtons[button]){(down?in.controllerPressed:in.controllerReleased).set(button);in.controllerButtons.set(button,down);}}
    }
    for(int index=0;index<2;++index){
        auto*joy=i.joysticks[index];in.joystickConnected[index]=joy!=nullptr;
        if(!joy)continue;
        for(int axis=0;axis<6;++axis){int value=axis<SDL_JoystickNumAxes(joy)?SDL_JoystickGetAxis(joy,axis):0;in.joystickAxes[index][axis]=value/(value<0?32768.0f:32767.0f);}
        for(int button=0;button<32;++button){bool down=button<SDL_JoystickNumButtons(joy)&&SDL_JoystickGetButton(joy,button);if(down!=in.joystickButtons[index][button]){(down?in.joystickPressed[index]:in.joystickReleased[index]).set(button);in.joystickButtons[index].set(button,down);}}
    }
    int x{},y{};SDL_GetMouseState(&x,&y);if(!SDL_GetRelativeMouseMode()){in.mouseX=x;in.mouseY=y;}in.quit=i.quit;
}
Vec2 Renderer::text_extent(const FontAtlas&font,std::string_view text){float x=0,width=0;int lines=1;for(unsigned char ch:text){if(ch=='\n'){width=std::max(width,x);x=0;++lines;}else x+=font.glyphs[ch].advance;}return {std::max(width,x),lines*font.lineHeight};}
const FontAtlas&Renderer::font_atlas(std::string_view family,int pixels,bool bold,bool italic){
    if(pixels<1||pixels>512)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid native font pixel size");
    std::string key=std::string(family)+"|"+std::to_string(pixels)+"|"+std::to_string(bold)+std::to_string(italic);
    auto&i=*impl_;auto found=i.fonts.find(key);if(found!=i.fonts.end())return *found->second;
    std::string path(family);
    if(path.find('/')==std::string::npos){
        FcPattern*pattern=FcPatternCreate();if(!pattern)throw std::bad_alloc();
        FcPatternAddString(pattern,FC_FAMILY,reinterpret_cast<const FcChar8*>(path.c_str()));FcPatternAddInteger(pattern,FC_WEIGHT,bold?FC_WEIGHT_BOLD:FC_WEIGHT_REGULAR);FcPatternAddInteger(pattern,FC_SLANT,italic?FC_SLANT_ITALIC:FC_SLANT_ROMAN);
        FcConfigSubstitute(nullptr,pattern,FcMatchPattern);FcDefaultSubstitute(pattern);
        FcResult result;FcPattern*match=FcFontMatch(nullptr,pattern,&result);FcPatternDestroy(pattern);
        if(!match)throw std::runtime_error("No native font matching "+path);
        FcChar8*file{};
        if(FcPatternGetString(match,FC_FILE,0,&file)!=FcResultMatch){FcPatternDestroy(match);throw std::runtime_error("Native font has no file");}
        path=reinterpret_cast<const char*>(file);FcPatternDestroy(match);
    }
    FT_Face face{};if(FT_New_Face(i.freetype,path.c_str(),0,&face))throw std::runtime_error("Cannot load native font "+path);
    struct FaceGuard{FT_Face face;~FaceGuard(){FT_Done_Face(face);}}guard{face};
    FT_Size_RequestRec size{FT_SIZE_REQUEST_TYPE_REAL_DIM,0,pixels*64,0,0};
    if(FT_Request_Size(face,&size))throw std::runtime_error("Cannot size native font");
    auto font=std::make_unique<FontAtlas>();font->lineHeight=pixels;font->ascent=face->size->metrics.ascender/64.0f;
    std::array<std::vector<std::uint8_t>,256>bitmaps;int rowX=1,rowY=1,rowHeight=0;const int atlasWidth=1024;
    iconv_t converter=iconv_open("UTF-32LE","WINDOWS-1254");if(converter==(iconv_t)-1)throw std::runtime_error("Native Turkish code page conversion unavailable");
    for(int ch=0;ch<256;++ch){std::uint32_t cp=ch;char byte=char(ch),output[4]{};char*input=&byte,*out=output;size_t inputLength=1,outputLength=4;if(iconv(converter,&input,&inputLength,&out,&outputLength)!=size_t(-1)&&outputLength==0)std::memcpy(&cp,output,4);if(FT_Load_Char(face,cp,FT_LOAD_RENDER)){iconv_close(converter);throw std::runtime_error("Native font glyph rasterization failed");}auto&slot=*face->glyph;auto&g=font->glyphs[ch];int w=slot.bitmap.width,h=slot.bitmap.rows;if(rowX+w+1>atlasWidth){rowX=1;rowY+=rowHeight+1;rowHeight=0;}g.pixels={float(rowX),float(rowY),float(w),float(h)};g.bearing={float(slot.bitmap_left),float(slot.bitmap_top)};g.advance=slot.advance.x/64.0f;auto&bitmap=bitmaps[ch];bitmap.resize(w*h);for(int y=0;y<h;++y){const auto*src=slot.bitmap.buffer+(slot.bitmap.pitch>=0?y:h-1-y)*std::abs(slot.bitmap.pitch);if(slot.bitmap.pixel_mode==FT_PIXEL_MODE_GRAY)std::memcpy(bitmap.data()+y*w,src,w);else if(slot.bitmap.pixel_mode==FT_PIXEL_MODE_MONO)for(int x=0;x<w;++x)bitmap[y*w+x]=(src[x/8]&(0x80>>(x%8)))?255:0;else{iconv_close(converter);throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported native font bitmap format");}}rowX+=w+1;rowHeight=std::max(rowHeight,h);}
    iconv_close(converter);font->image.width=atlasWidth;font->image.height=rowY+rowHeight+1;font->image.rgba.resize(std::size_t(font->image.width)*font->image.height*4,0);for(int ch=0;ch<256;++ch){const auto&g=font->glyphs[ch];int w=g.pixels.width,h=g.pixels.height;for(int y=0;y<h;++y)for(int x=0;x<w;++x){size_t p=((size_t(g.pixels.y)+y)*atlasWidth+size_t(g.pixels.x)+x)*4;font->image.rgba[p]=font->image.rgba[p+1]=font->image.rgba[p+2]=255;font->image.rgba[p+3]=bitmaps[ch][y*w+x];}}return *i.fonts.emplace(std::move(key),std::move(font)).first->second;
}

extern "C" {
#include <libavutil/sha.h>
#include <libavutil/mem.h>

namespace k22 {
EffectKind Renderer::identify_effect(std::string_view name,std::span<const std::byte>source){
    auto matches=[&](std::string_view expected){
        if(name.size()!=expected.size())return false;
        for(std::size_t index=0;index<name.size();++index){
            unsigned char character=name[index];
            if(character>='A'&&character<='Z')character+='a'-'A';
            if(character!=expected[index])return false;
        }
        return true;
    };
    constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t,32>mixHash{
        0xd3,0xfc,0xbb,0x34,0x9f,0x1e,0x65,0x25,0xb8,0x0b,0x9c,0x60,0x4c,0x06,0x51,0xd2,
        0xea,0x47,0xb6,0xb6,0xac,0xd4,0x8a,0x17,0x38,0x31,0xab,0x62,0x0e,0x0f,0xb4,0x99};
    constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t,32>sunMixHash{
        0xcd,0xff,0xda,0x3a,0x5c,0x12,0xa4,0x82,0x14,0x26,0x0b,0xd4,0xbc,0xf9,0xe8,0x56,
        0xad,0x01,0xc5,0xe6,0xa2,0xae,0x3c,0x23,0x1d,0x04,0x00,0xa3,0x2c,0x18,0x81,0xb8};
    EffectKind kind;
    if(matches("normal_mix.fx"))kind=EffectKind::NormalMix;
    else if(matches("normal_sunmix.fx"))kind=EffectKind::NormalSunMix;
    else throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported native material effect resource: "+std::string(name));
    // AVSHA is opaque; retain one library-allocated context per calling thread.
    thread_local std::unique_ptr<AVSHA,decltype(&av_free)>context(av_sha_alloc(),av_free);
    if(!context)throw std::bad_alloc();
    if(av_sha_init(context.get(),256)!=0)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot initialize material effect SHA256");
    if(!source.empty())av_sha_update(context.get(),reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(source.data()),source.size());
    std::array<std::uint8_t,32>digest{};
    av_sha_final(context.get(),digest.data());
    if(digest!=(kind==EffectKind::NormalMix?mixHash:sunMixHash))
        throw std::runtime_error("Native material effect source does not match recovered SHA256: "+std::string(name));
    return kind;
}

}
```

```cpp
// Prefixed with "#version 330 core\n" (plus "#define K22_SHADOW_MAPS 1\n" when shadow maps are on).
const char* sceneVS=R"(
layout(location=0) in vec3 position;layout(location=1) in vec3 normal;layout(location=2) in vec2 texcoord;layout(location=3) in vec2 lightcoord;
layout(location=4) in vec3 nextPosition;layout(location=5) in vec3 nextNormal;

#endif
vec3 nativeDynamic(vec3 p,vec3 n){
    vec3 result=vec3(0);
    for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){
        vec4 a=texelFetch(lights,i*5),b=texelFetch(lights,i*5+1),d=texelFetch(lights,i*5+2),e=texelFetch(lights,i*5+3),c=texelFetch(lights,i*5+4);
        if(b.a<0)continue;
        if(c.z>0.5)continue; // Source sun is consumed separately; serialized baked lights are an enhanced fragment path.
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);
        vec3 direction=d.w==3?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,.0001);
        float attenuation=d.w==3?1:(distance<=a.w?1/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,.0001):0);
        if(d.w==2){float rho=dot(-direction,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1:rho<=c.y?0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,.0001),e.w);}
        result+=b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation*max(dot(n,direction),0);
#ifdef K22_SHADOW_MAPS
        if(i==shadowLight)vertexShadowLight=b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation*max(dot(n,direction),0);
#endif
    }
#ifdef K22_SHADOW_MAPS
    vertexDynamicRaw=result;
#endif
    return clamp(result,0,1);
}
void ordinaryMaterial(vec3 p,vec3 n,out vec3 diffuse,out vec3 specular){
    diffuse=preparedEmissive+preparedAmbient.rgb*ambientLight;specular=vec3(0);
    for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){
        vec4 a=texelFetch(lights,i*5),b=texelFetch(lights,i*5+1),d=texelFetch(lights,i*5+2),e=texelFetch(lights,i*5+3),c=texelFetch(lights,i*5+4);
        if(b.a<0)continue;
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);
        vec3 direction=d.w==3?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,.0001);
        float attenuation=d.w==3?1:(distance<=a.w?1/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,.0001):0);
        if(d.w==2){float rho=dot(-direction,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1:rho<=c.y?0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,.0001),e.w);}
        vec3 light=b.rgb*b.a*attenuation*(i==selectedLight?materialSunStrength:1);
        diffuse+=preparedDiffuse*light*max(dot(n,direction),0);
        vec3 halfVector=direction+infiniteViewer;float magnitude=length(halfVector);
        if(any(notEqual(preparedSpecular,vec3(0)))){
            float power=magnitude>0?(materialPower==0?1:pow(max(dot(n,halfVector/magnitude),0),materialPower)):0;
            specular+=preparedSpecular*light*power;
        }
    }
    diffuse=clamp(diffuse,0,1);specular=clamp(specular,0,1);
}
out vec4 instanceColor;flat out vec3 instanceFlags;
void main(){
    instanceColor=vec4(1);instanceFlags=vec3(0);
    vertexDynamicLight=vec3(0);vertexMaterialDiffuse=vec3(0);vertexMaterialSpecular=vec3(0);
    worldTangent=vec3(0);
#ifdef K22_SHADOW_MAPS
    vertexDynamicRaw=vertexShadowLight=vec3(0);
#endif
    if(particleInstanced){vec4 w=particleModel*vec4(position,1);worldPosition=w.xyz;worldNormal=vec3(1,0,0);uv=texcoord;lmuv=lightcoord;instanceColor=particleColor;instanceFlags=particleFlags;gl_Position=viewProjection*w;gl_ClipDistance[0]=dot(clipPlane,w);return;}
    vec3 p0=position,n0=normal,p1=position,n1=normal,t0=tangent,t1=tangent;
    if(vertexCount>0){int a=frame0*vertexCount*3+gl_VertexID,b=frame1*vertexCount*3+gl_VertexID;p0=texelFetch(poses,a).xyz;p1=texelFetch(poses,b).xyz;n0=texelFetch(poses,a+vertexCount).xyz;n1=texelFetch(poses,b+vertexCount).xyz;t0=texelFetch(poses,a+vertexCount*2).xyz;t1=texelFetch(poses,b+vertexCount*2).xyz;}
    if(firstOverride)p0=position;if(firstNormalOverride)n0=normal;if(firstOverride||firstNormalOverride)t0=tangent;
    if(nextOverride)p1=nextPosition;if(nextNormalOverride)n1=nextNormal;if(nextOverride||nextNormalOverride)t1=nextTangent;
    vec4 w=model*vec4(mix(p0,p1,interpolation),1);worldPosition=w.xyz;worldNormal=normalize(normalMatrix*mix(n0,n1,interpolation))*normalOrientation;worldTangent=mat3(model)*mix(t0,t1,interpolation);
    if(worldVertexLighting)vertexDynamicLight=nativeDynamic(worldPosition,worldNormal);
    if(explicitMaterial&&effectKind==0)ordinaryMaterial(worldPosition,worldNormal,vertexMaterialDiffuse,vertexMaterialSpecular);
    if(effectKind!=0){vec3 localN=mix(n0,n1,interpolation),localT=mix(t0,t1,interpolation);mat3 basis=transpose(mat3(mat3(model)*localT,mat3(model)*cross(localT,localN),mat3(model)*localN));effectLight=normalize(basis*-(sunDirection+(effectKind==1?skillExtra.xyz:vec3(0))));effectView=normalize(basis*(cameraPosition-w.xyz));}
    uv=texcoord;lmuv=lightcoord;gl_Position=viewProjection*w;gl_ClipDistance[0]=dot(clipPlane,w);
})";
const char* sceneFS=R"(
in vec3 worldPosition,worldNormal,worldTangent;in vec2 uv,lmuv;out vec4 color;
uniform bool pbr,toneInShader,roughnessMap;uniform float legacyRoughness,normalOrientation;uniform sampler2D pbrNormal,pbrOrm;
in vec3 vertexDynamicLight;uniform bool worldVertexLighting;
in vec3 vertexMaterialDiffuse,vertexMaterialSpecular;
in vec4 instanceColor;flat in vec3 instanceFlags;uniform bool particleInstanced;
uniform sampler2D skin,lightmap;uniform int spriteFrames,frame0,frame1;uniform float interpolation;uniform bool hasLightmap,unlit,flare,overlay,invertFlare,textureAlpha,noFog;
uniform vec4 tint;uniform vec3 sunDirection,cameraPosition,fogColor;uniform vec2 uvScale,uvOffset,fogRange;uniform float alpha,materialAmbient,surfaceAmbient;uniform bool skyMask;
uniform sampler2D portalImage;uniform mat4 portalProjection;uniform vec4 portalViewport,portalPlane;uniform bool portalEnabled;uniform float reflectionWeight;

// Sun depth map plus one point/spot depth cube (shadowLight, -1 none); casterPass renders depth only.

// Vertex nativeDynamic with the shadow light's interpolated term occluded per fragment; scales the Gouraud result per
// channel (as the ray-traced visibleNativeDynamic does).
vec3 shadowedDynamic(vec3 p,vec3 n){
    if(!shadowMaps||shadowLight<0||all(lessThanEqual(vertexShadowLight,vec3(0))))return vertexDynamicLight;
    vec3 unshadowed=clamp(vertexDynamicRaw,0,1),result=clamp(vertexDynamicRaw-vertexShadowLight*(1-lightShadow(shadowLight,p,n)),0,1);
    return vertexDynamicLight*vec3(unshadowed.x>0?result.x/unshadowed.x:1,unshadowed.y>0?result.y/unshadowed.y:1,unshadowed.z>0?result.z/unshadowed.z:1);
}
#define K22_SUN_SHADOW(p,n) (shadowMaps&&!hasLightmap?k22SunShadow(sunShadowMap,sunShadowMatrix,p,n,sunShadowTexel):1.0)
#define K22_LIGHT_SHADOW(i,p,n) lightShadow(i,p,n)
#define K22_DYNAMIC(p,n) shadowedDynamic(p,n)
#else
#define K22_SUN_SHADOW(p,n) 1.0
#define K22_LIGHT_SHADOW(i,p,n) 1.0
#define K22_DYNAMIC(p,n) vertexDynamicLight
#endif
vec3 enhancedBaked(vec3 p,vec3 n){
    if(hasLightmap)return vec3(0);
    vec3 result=vec3(0);
    for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){
        vec4 a=texelFetch(lights,i*5),b=texelFetch(lights,i*5+1);
        if(b.a>=0)continue; // Only serialized baked records, independent of native slot order.
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta),attenuation=max(1-distance/max(a.w,.0001),0);
        result+=b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation*attenuation*max(dot(n,delta/max(distance,.0001)),0);
    }
    return result;
}
void main(){
    if(skyMask){color=vec4(1);return;}
    vec2 coord=uv*uvScale+uvOffset;vec4 texel;
    if(spriteFrames>1){float cols=floor(1.0/uvScale.x+0.5),f0=float(frame0),f1=float(frame1);texel=mix(texture(skin,coord+vec2(mod(f0,cols)/cols,floor(f0/cols)*uvScale.y)),texture(skin,coord+vec2(mod(f1,cols)/cols,floor(f1/cols)*uvScale.y)),interpolation);}else texel=texture(skin,coord); // sprite grid cells (engine.cpp load_entity_asset)
    if(effectKind!=0){
        vec3 bump=2*texture(normalSkin,uv*normalUvScale+uvOffset).rgb-1;
        vec3 reflection=normalize(2*dot(bump,effectLight)*bump-effectLight);
        float specular=skillMain.z*pow(clamp(dot(reflection,normalize(effectView)),0,1),skillMain.w);
        vec4 sunlight=effectKind==1?vec4(.9,.9,1,.9):skillExtra;
        color=(skillMain.x*preparedAmbient+skillMain.y*clamp(dot(effectLight,bump),0,1)*sunlight+vec4(specular))*texel;
        return;
    }
    bool useOverlay=particleInstanced?instanceFlags.y>0.5:overlay,useFlare=particleInstanced?instanceFlags.x>0.5:flare,useInversion=particleInstanced?instanceFlags.z>0.5:invertFlare;
    if(useOverlay&&(max(max(texel.r,texel.g),texel.b)<0.001||texel.a<0.5))discard;
    if(useFlare&&!textureAlpha){float brightness=max(max(texel.r,texel.g),texel.b);texel.a*=useInversion?1-brightness:brightness;}
    vec4 t=texel*tint*instanceColor;t.a*=alpha;if(t.a<0.01)discard;
#ifdef K22_SHADOW_MAPS
    if(casterPass){color=vec4(0);return;}
#endif
    vec3 illumination=vec3(1);float sunVisibility=1.0;
    if(!unlit&&!explicitMaterial){
        illumination=hasLightmap?2*clamp(texture(lightmap,lmuv).rgb+vec3(surfaceAmbient),0,1):vec3(materialAmbient);
        vec3 n=normalize(worldNormal);sunVisibility=K22_SUN_SHADOW(worldPosition,n);if(!hasLightmap)illumination+=vec3(max(dot(n,sunDirection),0))*sunVisibility;
        if(worldVertexLighting)illumination+=K22_DYNAMIC(worldPosition,n)+enhancedBaked(worldPosition,n);
        else for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){vec4 a=texelFetch(lights,i*5),b=texelFetch(lights,i*5+1);if((texelFetch(lights,i*5+4).z>0.5&&b.a>=0&&texelFetch(lights,i*5+2).w==3)||(hasLightmap&&b.a<0))continue;vec3 d=a.xyz-worldPosition;float distance=length(d);float attenuation=max(1-distance/max(a.w,0.0001),0);illumination+=b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation*attenuation*max(dot(n,d/max(distance,0.0001)),0)*K22_LIGHT_SHADOW(i,worldPosition,n);}
    }
    vec3 rgb=explicitMaterial?clamp(clamp(t.rgb*vertexMaterialDiffuse*2,0,1)+vertexMaterialSpecular,0,1):t.rgb*illumination;
    if(pbr&&!unlit&&!explicitMaterial&&!particleInstanced)rgb=k22Pbr(t.rgb,illumination,worldPosition,normalize(worldNormal),worldTangent,normalOrientation,texture(pbrNormal,coord).rgb,texture(pbrOrm,coord),roughnessMap,legacyRoughness,cameraPosition,sunDirection,sunVisibility,!hasLightmap);
    if(!noFog&&fogRange.y>fogRange.x){float f=clamp((length(worldPosition-cameraPosition)-fogRange.x)/(fogRange.y-fogRange.x),0,1);rgb=mix(rgb,fogColor,f);}
    if(portalEnabled&&reflectionWeight>0&&abs(dot(portalPlane,vec4(worldPosition,1)))<0.1){
        vec4 reflected=portalProjection*vec4(worldPosition,1);
        if(reflected.w>0){vec2 coord=(reflected.xy/reflected.w*.5+.5)*portalViewport.zw+portalViewport.xy;rgb=mix(rgb,texture(portalImage,coord).rgb,reflectionWeight);}
    }
    if(pbr&&toneInShader)rgb=k22ToneMap(rgb);
    color=vec4(rgb,t.a);
})";

layout(location=0) in vec3 position;layout(location=4) in vec3 nextPosition;

const char* shadowGS=R"(#version 330 core
layout(triangles) in;layout(triangle_strip,max_vertices=42) out;
in float planeDistance[];in vec3 projectedPosition[];flat out float opacity;out vec3 shadowPosition;
uniform vec2 viewport;uniform float areaThreshold,alpha;uniform bool reversed;
float distanceToPlane(vec4 p,int plane){
    if(plane==0)return p.z+p.w;
    if(plane==1)return p.x+p.w;if(plane==2)return p.w-p.x;
    if(plane==3)return p.y+p.w;return p.w-p.y;
}
void main(){
    vec4 polygon[10],scratch[10];float pd[10],sd[10];vec3 positions[10],sp[10];int count=3;
    for(int i=0;i<3;++i){polygon[i]=gl_in[i].gl_Position;pd[i]=planeDistance[i];positions[i]=projectedPosition[i];}
    for(int plane=0;plane<6&&count>0;++plane){
        int outputCount=0;
        for(int i=0;i<count;++i){
            int j=(i+count-1)%count;float a=plane==5?pd[j]:distanceToPlane(polygon[j],plane),b=plane==5?pd[i]:distanceToPlane(polygon[i],plane);
            if((a>=0)!=(b>=0)){float t=a/(a-b);scratch[outputCount]=mix(polygon[j],polygon[i],t);sd[outputCount]=mix(pd[j],pd[i],t);sp[outputCount++]=mix(positions[j],positions[i],t);}
            if(b>=0){scratch[outputCount]=polygon[i];sd[outputCount]=pd[i];sp[outputCount++]=positions[i];}
        }
        count=outputCount;for(int i=0;i<count;++i){polygon[i]=scratch[i];pd[i]=sd[i];positions[i]=sp[i];}
    }
    for(int i=1;i+1<count;++i){
        vec4 triangle[3];triangle[0]=polygon[0];triangle[1]=polygon[i];triangle[2]=polygon[i+1];
        vec2 p[3];for(int j=0;j<3;++j)p[j]=triangle[j].xy/triangle[j].w*viewport*.5;
        // Source screen Y runs down, unlike OpenGL NDC.
        float area=-((p[0].y-p[1].y)*(p[0].x-p[2].x)-(p[0].x-p[1].x)*(p[0].y-p[2].y));
        if(reversed?area>areaThreshold:area<areaThreshold)continue;
        for(int duplicate=0;duplicate<2;++duplicate){
            opacity=duplicate==0?alpha:0;
            for(int j=0;j<3;++j){gl_Position=triangle[j];shadowPosition=positions[j==0?0:j==1?i:i+1];if(duplicate!=0)gl_Position.z-=0.0009765625*gl_Position.w;EmitVertex();}
            EndPrimitive();
        }
    }
})";

struct UIVertex { float x,y,u,v,r,g,b,a; };
struct Batch { GLuint first{},count{};std::uint32_t material{};GLuint centroidFirst{},centroidCount{}; };
struct MeshGPU { GLuint vao{},vertices{},indices{},tangents{},poseBuffer{},poses{};std::vector<Batch> batches;int frameCount{},primaryMax{},skinLayers{};Bounds bounds;std::vector<Bounds> frameBounds; };
// width/height stay the original image's; pack replacements change only GPU storage, never UV policy.
struct TextureGPU {GLuint id{};std::uint32_t width{},height{};std::uint64_t serial{};bool dynamic{},alpha{},mipsValid{};GLuint normal{},orm{};bool roughness{};};
struct MeshOverride {
    GLuint positions{},normals{},tangents{};
    std::uint64_t revision{~0ull},tangentRevision{~0ull},boundsRevision{~0ull};
    std::size_t count{},normalCount{},boundsCount{};
    std::uint32_t frame{~0u};
    const Model*model{},*boundsModel{};
    std::vector<Vec3>tangentData;
    Bounds bounds;
    bool tangentReady{};
};
Bounds mesh_override_bounds(MeshOverride&data,const Model&model,std::uint64_t revision,std::span<const Vec3>positions){
    if(data.boundsModel!=&model||data.boundsRevision!=revision||data.boundsCount!=positions.size()){
        data.bounds=position_bounds(positions);data.boundsModel=&model;data.boundsRevision=revision;data.boundsCount=positions.size();
    }
    return data.bounds;
}
bool override_tangents_needed(const MeshOverride&data,EffectKind effect,std::uint64_t revision){
    return effect!=EffectKind::None&&(!data.tangentReady||data.tangentRevision!=revision);
}
void set_override_pose(MeshOverride&data,const Model&model,std::uint64_t revision,std::size_t count,std::size_t normalCount,std::uint32_t frame){
    data.tangentReady=false;data.revision=revision;data.count=count;data.normalCount=normalCount;data.frame=frame;data.model=&model;
}
void release_override(MeshOverride&data){
    if(data.positions)glDeleteBuffers(1,&data.positions);
    if(data.normals)glDeleteBuffers(1,&data.normals);
    if(data.tangents)glDeleteBuffers(1,&data.tangents);
}
void purge_model_overrides(std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t,MeshOverride>&overrides,const Model*model){
    for(auto it=overrides.begin();it!=overrides.end();){
        if(it->second.model==model||it->second.boundsModel==model){release_override(it->second);it=overrides.erase(it);}
        else ++it;
    }
}
struct EffectBank { GLuint texture{};std::uint32_t width{},height{};bool dynamic{},alpha{}; };
struct EffectBindings { std::uint64_t generation{~0ull};EffectKind kind{EffectKind::None};std::array<EffectBank,2> banks{}; };
struct ParticleGPU { Matrix model; Color color; std::array<float,3> flags; };
struct WarpGPU {GLuint texture{},offsetBuffer{},offsetTexture{};std::uint32_t width{},height{};std::uint64_t serial{~0ull};int phase{-1};float range{};bool mipsValid{};};
struct SkyGPU {GLuint texture{};std::uint32_t frames{};};
GLint effective_mip_filter(double mode){return mode<1?GL_LINEAR:mode<=2?GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_NEAREST:GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR;}
// Single-level clamped 2D render target with its own framebuffer (depth attachments draw no color).
void render_target(GLuint&fbo,GLuint&texture,GLint format,GLenum pixels,GLenum type,int w,int h,GLenum attachment=GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0){
    glGenTextures(1,&texture);glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D,texture);glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D,0,format,w,h,0,pixels,type,nullptr);
    for(auto [name,value]:{std::pair{GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,GL_NEAREST},{GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,GL_NEAREST},{GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S,GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE},{GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T,GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE}})glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,name,value);
    glGenFramebuffers(1,&fbo);glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER,fbo);glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_FRAMEBUFFER,attachment,GL_TEXTURE_2D,texture,0);
    if(attachment!=GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0){glDrawBuffer(GL_NONE);glReadBuffer(GL_NONE);}
    if(glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER)!=GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE)throw std::runtime_error("Incomplete OpenGL effect framebuffer");
}
bool blended(const DrawInstance&d){bool transparent=d.alpha<1||d.additive||d.translucent||d.flare;if(d.model)for(const auto&material:d.model->materials)transparent|=material.alpha<1;return transparent;}
GLint uniform(GLuint program,const char*name){return glGetUniformLocation(program,name);}
} // namespace

            uiVertices.reserve(4096);lightData.reserve(128);transparent.reserve(256);

    }
    bool retire_completion(){
        if(!completionCount)return true;
        auto&fence=completion[completionFront];GLenum status;
        do {status=glClientWaitSync(fence,GL_SYNC_FLUSH_COMMANDS_BIT,1000000000ull);}while(status==GL_TIMEOUT_EXPIRED);
```
