```cpp
            VkAccelerationStructureBuildGeometryInfoKHR info{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_GEOMETRY_INFO_KHR};info.type=VK_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BOTTOM_LEVEL_KHR;info.flags=VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREFER_FAST_TRACE_BIT_KHR|VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_UPDATE_BIT_KHR;info.geometryCount=geometries.size();info.pGeometries=geometries.data();
            VkAccelerationStructureBuildSizesInfoKHR sizes{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_SIZES_INFO_KHR};rt.buildSizes(s.device,VK_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_TYPE_DEVICE_KHR,&info,counts.data(),&sizes);

            barrier(s.command,VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT|VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT|VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR|VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT,VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR,VK_ACCESS_HOST_WRITE_BIT|VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT|VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_READ_BIT_KHR|VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_WRITE_BIT_KHR,VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_READ_BIT_KHR|VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_WRITE_BIT_KHR);

        }
        if(instances.size()>=0xffffffu)throw std::runtime_error("Ray TLAS instance index exceeds Vulkan 24-bit custom index");VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR instance{};for(unsigned row=0;row<3;++row)for(unsigned column=0;column<4;++column)instance.transform.matrix[row][column]=geometry.transform[column*4+row];instance.instanceCustomIndex=instances.size();instance.mask=d.model&&d.model->formatVersion==6?1:d.shadowRequested?6:2; // 1 level/map geometry, 2 models and sprites (contact shadows), 4 SHADOW-flag casters (actor shadows).

        for(const auto& m:geometry.materials)if(m.count){GpuMaterial packed{};packed.uv=m.uvTransform;packed.tint=color(m.tint);packed.factors={m.alpha,std::clamp(m.interpolation,0.f,1.f),0,0};packed.metadata={m.flags,texture(m.texture,m.sampler),texture(m.normalTexture,m.normalSampler),std::max(m.spriteFrames,1u)};packed.frames={m.frame0,m.frame1,m.first,m.count};packed.normalUv=m.normalUvTransform;packed.ambient=color(m.effectAmbient);packed.skillMain=m.skillMain;packed.skillExtra=m.skillExtra;packed.sun={m.effectSunDirection.x,m.effectSunDirection.y,m.effectSunDirection.z,0};packed.camera={m.effectCameraPosition.x,m.effectCameraPosition.y,m.effectCameraPosition.z,0};packed.preparedAmbient=m.preparedAmbient;packed.preparedDiffuse=m.preparedDiffuse;packed.preparedSpecular=m.preparedSpecular;packed.preparedEmissive=m.preparedEmissive;packed.ambientLight=m.ambientLight;packed.viewer={m.infiniteViewer.x,m.infiniteViewer.y,m.infiniteViewer.z,0};packed.lightState={static_cast<std::int32_t>(m.lightCount),m.selectedLight,static_cast<std::int32_t>(texture(m.lightmap,m.lightmapSampler)),0};if(m.lightmap)packed.metadata[0]|=8192u;packed.factors[2]=m.surfaceAmbient;packed.factors[3]=m.materialAmbient;materials.push_back(packed);}
    }
    // The existing GPU padding word carries the finite, scene-topology reflection layer bound.
    if(!records.empty())records.front().padding=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(triangleCount);
    if(slot.sceneUsed==slot.scenes.size())slot.scenes.emplace_back();auto& packet=slot.scenes[slot.sceneUsed++];
    auto& input=rt.upload(packet.instances,std::max<std::size_t>(instances.size()*sizeof(VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR),sizeof(VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR)),VK_BUFFER_USAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_KHR|VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT,instances.empty()?nullptr:instances.data());
    VkAccelerationStructureGeometryKHR geometry{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_KHR};geometry.geometryType=VK_GEOMETRY_TYPE_INSTANCES_KHR;geometry.geometry.instances={VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_INSTANCES_DATA_KHR};geometry.geometry.instances.data.deviceAddress=input.address;
    VkAccelerationStructureBuildGeometryInfoKHR info{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_GEOMETRY_INFO_KHR};info.type=VK_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_TYPE_TOP_LEVEL_KHR;info.flags=VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREFER_FAST_TRACE_BIT_KHR|VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_UPDATE_BIT_KHR;info.geometryCount=1;info.pGeometries=&geometry;
    std::uint32_t count=instances.size();VkAccelerationStructureBuildSizesInfoKHR sizes{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_SIZES_INFO_KHR};rt.buildSizes(s.device,VK_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_TYPE_DEVICE_KHR,&info,&count,&sizes);

    auto scratch=rt.scratch(update?sizes.updateScratchSize:sizes.buildScratchSize);info.scratchData.deviceAddress=(scratch.address+rt.scratchAlignment-1)/rt.scratchAlignment*rt.scratchAlignment;

    rt.upload(packet.records,std::max<std::size_t>(records.size()*sizeof(GpuInstance),sizeof(GpuInstance)),VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT,records.empty()?nullptr:records.data());rt.upload(packet.materials,std::max<std::size_t>(materials.size()*sizeof(GpuMaterial),sizeof(GpuMaterial)),VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT,materials.empty()?nullptr:materials.data());
    textures.resize(textureLimit,textures.front());packet.textures.swap(textures);rt.scene_descriptors(packet);
    barrier(s.command,VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR|VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT,VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT,VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_WRITE_BIT_KHR|VK_ACCESS_HOST_WRITE_BIT,VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_READ_BIT_KHR|VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT);
}
void rt_replace_texture(RayTracing& rt,VkImageView oldView,VkImageView newView){
    if(!rt.s.rayEnabled||oldView==newView)return;
    auto& slot=rt.slot();if(!slot.set||!slot.sceneUsed)return;
    auto& scene=slot.scenes[slot.sceneUsed-1];bool changed=false;
    for(auto& texture:scene.textures)if(texture.imageView==oldView){texture.imageView=newView;changed=true;}
    // Descriptor writes are copied by Vulkan: prior draw sets retain the old, fence-retired views.
    if(changed)rt.scene_descriptors(scene);
}
VkDescriptorSetLayout rt_layout(const RayTracing& rt){return rt.layout;}
VkDescriptorSet rt_set(const RayTracing& rt){return rt.slots[rt.s.slotIndex].set;}
void rt_release(RayTracing& rt){
    for(auto& slot:rt.slots){for(auto& b:slot.blas)rt.destroy(b.acceleration);slot.blas.clear();slot.blasLookup.clear();for(auto& scene:slot.scenes){rt.destroy(scene.tlas);rt.s.destroy(scene.instances);rt.s.destroy(scene.records);rt.s.destroy(scene.materials);}slot.scenes.clear();slot.sceneUsed=0;for(auto& a:slot.garbage)rt.destroy(a);slot.garbage.clear();for(auto& p:slot.poses)rt.s.destroy(p->pose.vertices);slot.poses.clear();slot.poseGroups.clear();slot.poseLookup.clear();slot.set={};}
    for(auto* map:{&rt.models,&rt.expandedModels}){for(auto& [key,m]:*map){rt.s.destroy(m.base);rt.s.destroy(m.endpoints);}map->clear();}for(auto& [key,o]:rt.overrides)rt.s.destroy(o.endpoint);rt.overrides.clear();
}
void rt_purge_model(RayTracing& rt,const Model* model){
    for(auto& slot:rt.slots){
        for(auto& scene:slot.scenes){rt.destroy(scene.tlas);scene.count=0;}slot.set={};
        for(auto it=slot.blas.begin();it!=slot.blas.end();)if(it->pose->model==model){rt.destroy(it->acceleration);it=slot.blas.erase(it);}else ++it;
        slot.blasLookup.clear();for(std::size_t i=0;i<slot.blas.size();++i)slot.blasLookup[slot.blas[i].pose].push_back(i);
        for(auto it=slot.poses.begin();it!=slot.poses.end();)if((*it)->model==model){slot.poseLookup.erase(&(*it)->pose);rt.s.destroy((*it)->pose.vertices);it=slot.poses.erase(it);}else ++it;
        for(auto it=slot.poseGroups.begin();it!=slot.poseGroups.end();)if(it->first.model==model)it=slot.poseGroups.erase(it);else ++it;
    }
    for(auto* map:{&rt.models,&rt.expandedModels})if(auto it=map->find(model);it!=map->end()){rt.s.destroy(it->second.base);rt.s.destroy(it->second.endpoints);map->erase(it);}for(auto it=rt.overrides.begin();it!=rt.overrides.end();)if(it->second.model==model){rt.s.destroy(it->second.endpoint);it=rt.overrides.erase(it);}else ++it;
}
void rt_purge_image(RayTracing& rt,const k22::Image*){
    // Material records and sampled-image sets are frame-slot-owned, never retained by image identity.
    // The public purge wrapper drains before raster destroys image views; invalidate those dead sets.
    for(auto& slot:rt.slots)slot.set={};
}
```

```cpp
ImportResult import_windows(const fs::path& game,const fs::path& root,const fs::path& slotDirectory,const Meta& meta){

  for(int slot=0;slot<count;++slot)if(!payload.contains("kayit"+std::to_string(slot)+".sav"))throw std::runtime_error("refusing import: kysd.sav lists slot "+std::to_string(slot+1)+" but kayit"+std::to_string(slot)+".sav is missing");}

 auto order=[](const std::string& n){return n=="kysd.sav"?1:n=="ftz.k22"?2:0;};std::vector<std::string> names;for(const auto& [n,_]:payload)names.push_back(n);

  if(fs::exists(fs::symlink_status(target))){if(!fs::is_regular_file(fs::symlink_status(target)))throw std::runtime_error("refusing to replace non-regular "+target.string());backup(root,relative);result.backedUp.push_back(relative.generic_string());}
  write_atomic(target,payload.at(name));if(slot_number(name)>=0)write_meta(target,slotMeta);result.imported.push_back(relative.generic_string());
 }
 return result;
}
```

```cpp
   fail("unknown $"+name);}

  if(take("[")){space();auto b=p;while(p<s.size()&&std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[p])))++p;auto index=std::stoul(std::string(s.substr(b,p-b)));if(!take("]"))fail("expected ]");auto* o=v.kind==Value::Kind::Object?object(v.bits):nullptr;if(!o||index>=o->array.size())fail(name+"["+std::to_string(index)+"] is not an array element");v=o->array[index].value;}

 bool compare(){auto a=sum();for(auto op:{"==","!=","<=",">=","<",">"}){if(!take(op))continue;auto b=sum();std::string_view o=op;if(a.text!=b.text)fail("comparing text with number");
   if(a.text){bool eq=lower(a.string)==lower(b.string);if(o=="==")return eq;if(o=="!=")return !eq;fail("text supports only == and !=");}
   bool eq=std::fabs(a.number-b.number)<0.0005;if(o=="==")return eq;if(o=="!=")return !eq;if(o=="<=")return a.number<=b.number||eq;if(o==">=")return a.number>=b.number||eq;if(o=="<")return a.number<b.number&&!eq;return a.number>b.number&&!eq;}

std::string show(const Val& v){if(v.text)return '"'+v.string+'"';std::ostringstream o;o<<v.number;return o.str();}
// walk-to ... path: grid A* (24-unit cells) over the A6 query the player's own ent_move uses (Engine::collide with USE_BOX, i.e. the
// player's NARROW/FAT hull, plus IGNORE_PASSABLE). Cell height = floor under the cell (point trace down) + the player's height above
// its own floor; an edge is a hull sweep between cell centres, raised 16 units for the scripted step-up (dmr_yercekimi lifts the
// player onto stairs; a sweep at floor level stops at every riser), and may climb or drop at most 32. Cells are keyed by XY and a 48-unit
// height band, so stacked floors (stairwells, galleries) are separate nodes. An entity goal (level=true) must also be reached within
// 96 units of height. Read-only queries, no gameplay effect.
// ponytail: 8-neighbour grid, 60000-cell cap, entities as they stand at planning time; a stuck walk re-plans (moving blockers).
std::vector<float> plan(Engine& e,ObjectId player,Vec3 from,Vec3 goal,float radius,bool level,std::string& why){
 constexpr float cell=24;const ProcessContext ctx{0,player,0};
 auto floorAt=[&](float x,float y,float z)->std::optional<float>{auto h=e.collide({x,y,z+48},{x,y,z-400},{},4,player,&ctx);if(!h.hit||h.fraction<=0)return std::nullopt;return h.position.z;};
 auto clear=[&](Vec3 a,Vec3 b){a.z+=16;b.z+=16;return !e.collide(a,b,{},4|8192,player,&ctx).hit;};
 auto flat=[](Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return std::hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);};
 const auto under=floorAt(from.x,from.y,from.z);if(!under){why="no floor under the player";return {};}
 const float lift=from.z-*under;
 struct Node{Vec3 p;float g;std::int64_t parent;int ix,iy;bool closed=false;};
 // 21 bits per axis, non-negative, so -1 stays the "no parent/not found" sentinel
 auto key=[&](std::int64_t x,std::int64_t y,float z){const auto b=std::int64_t(std::floor((z-from.z)/48));return ((x+(1<<20))<<42)|((y+(1<<20))<<21)|(b+(1<<20));};
 auto togo=[&](Vec3 p){return level?std::hypot(flat(p,goal),p.z-goal.z):flat(p,goal);};
 std::unordered_map<std::int64_t,Node> nodes;using Open=std::pair<float,std::int64_t>;std::priority_queue<Open,std::vector<Open>,std::greater<>> open;
 nodes[key(0,0,from.z)]={from,0,-1,0,0};open.push({togo(from),key(0,0,from.z)});std::int64_t found=-1;float nearestD=togo(from);Vec3 nearestP=from;
 for(int expanded=0;!open.empty()&&expanded<60000;){
  const auto k=open.top().second;open.pop();auto& n=nodes[k];if(n.closed)continue;n.closed=true;++expanded;const Node cur=n;
  if(const float d=flat(cur.p,goal);d<radius&&(!level||std::fabs(cur.p.z-goal.z)<96)){found=k;break;}else if(const float t=togo(cur.p);t<nearestD){nearestD=t;nearestP=cur.p;}
  const std::int64_t ix=cur.ix,iy=cur.iy;
  for(int dx=-1;dx<=1;++dx)for(int dy=-1;dy<=1;++dy){if(!dx&&!dy)continue;
   const float x=from.x+float(ix+dx)*cell,y=from.y+float(iy+dy)*cell;const auto fz=floorAt(x,y,cur.p.z-lift);
   if(!fz||std::fabs(*fz+lift-cur.p.z)>32)continue;
   const Vec3 p{x,y,*fz+lift};const auto nk=key(ix+dx,iy+dy,p.z);auto it=nodes.find(nk);if(it!=nodes.end()&&it->second.closed)continue;
   const float g=cur.g+std::hypot(flat(cur.p,p),p.z-cur.p.z);if(it!=nodes.end()&&it->second.g<=g)continue;if(!clear(cur.p,p))continue;
   nodes[nk]={p,g,k,int(ix+dx),int(iy+dy)};open.push({g+togo(p),nk});}
 }
 if(found<0){why="no hull path; nearest reachable cell ("+std::to_string(int(nearestP.x))+","+std::to_string(int(nearestP.y))+","+std::to_string(int(nearestP.z))+") is "+std::to_string(int(nearestD))+" from the goal ("+std::to_string(nodes.size())+" cells)";return {};}
 std::vector<Vec3> cells;for(auto k=found;k>=0;k=nodes[k].parent)cells.push_back(nodes[k].p);std::reverse(cells.begin(),cells.end());
 std::vector<float> out;for(std::size_t i=0;i+1<cells.size();){auto j=cells.size()-1;while(j>i+1&&!clear(cells[i],cells[j]))--j;out.push_back(cells[j].x);out.push_back(cells[j].y);i=j;}
 out.push_back(goal.x);out.push_back(goal.y); // final leg: the goal itself (the last cell is already within RADIUS of it)
 return out;
}
}
struct Scenario::Impl {
 std::filesystem::path file,output;std::vector<Step> steps;std::size_t pc=0;long progress=0;bool aborted=false,realtime=true,livePad=false;std::uint32_t seed=0;
 std::string text; // "type": SDL text input delivered with the next applied frame
 double best=0;long lastImprove=0;int escape=0,escapes=0,replans=0;std::size_t leg=0; // walk-to/route progress
 int passed=0,failed=0,skipped=0;std::ostringstream log;std::map<std::string,Val> stored;
 std::bitset<SDL_NUM_SCANCODES> keys,priorKeys;std::bitset<8> mouse,priorMouse;float mouseX=0,mouseY=0,priorX=0,priorY=0;
 std::array<std::bitset<32>,2> joy,priorJoy;std::array<std::array<float,6>,2> axes{};std::array<bool,2> joyUsed{};
 // Trailing "timeout N" (frames) applies to wait/press-until.
 static long timeout(std::vector<std::string>& w,int line,long fallback){if(w.size()>=2&&w[w.size()-2]=="timeout"){auto n=number(w.back(),line);w.resize(w.size()-2);return n;}return fallback;}
 void add(Step s){steps.push_back(std::move(s));}
 void press(int key,int line,const std::string& source,long hold){add({Op::Key,line,source,{},{},key,0,0,0,0,true});add({Op::Frames,line,source,{},{},0,0,hold});add({Op::Key,line,source,{},{},key,0,0,0,0,false});add({Op::Frames,line,source,{},{},0,0,3});}
 void parse(const std::string& raw,int line){
  auto text=raw.substr(0,raw.find('#'));auto w=words(text);if(w.empty())return;auto& c=w[0];auto need=[&](std::size_t n){if(w.size()<n)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": too few arguments for "+c);};
  Step s{Op::Frames,line,join(w,0,w.size())};
  if(c=="frames"){need(2);s.count=number(w[1],line);}
  else if(c=="down"||c=="up"){need(2);s.op=Op::Key;s.key=scancode(w[1],line);s.down=c=="down";}
  else if(c=="press"){need(2);press(scancode(w[1],line),line,s.source,w.size()>2?number(w[2],line):3);return;}
  else if(c=="mouse"){need(3);s.op=Op::Mouse;s.x=float(number(w[1],line));s.y=float(number(w[2],line));}
  else if(c=="mouse-down"||c=="mouse-up"){need(2);s.op=Op::MouseButton;s.key=int(number(w[1],line));s.down=c=="mouse-down";if(s.key<1||s.key>7)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": mouse button 1..7");}
  else if(c=="joy"){need(5);s.index=int(number(w[1],line));if(s.index<0||s.index>1)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": joystick 0 or 1");s.key=int(number(w[3],line));
   if(w[2]=="button"){s.op=Op::JoyButton;s.down=w[4]=="down";if(s.key<0||s.key>31||(w[4]!="down"&&w[4]!="up"))throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": joy N button 0..31 down|up");}
   else if(w[2]=="axis"){s.op=Op::JoyAxis;s.x=std::stof(w[4]);if(s.key<0||s.key>5||std::fabs(s.x)>1)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": joy N axis 0..5 -1..1");}
   else throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": joy N button|axis");}
  else if(c=="press-until"){s.count=timeout(w,line,600);need(3);s.op=Op::PressUntil;s.key=scancode(w[1],line);s.condition=join(w,2,w.size());}
  else if(c=="wait"){s.count=timeout(w,line,600);need(3);if(w[1]!="until")throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": wait until CONDITION [timeout N]");s.op=Op::Wait;s.condition=join(w,2,w.size());}
  else if(c=="assert"){need(2);s.op=Op::Assert;s.condition=join(w,1,w.size());}
  // expect-exit [timeout N]: the original scripts end the process (CikisMenu.wdl Exit); must be the last step.
  else if(c=="expect-exit"){s.count=timeout(w,line,600);s.op=Op::ExpectExit;}
  else if(c=="store"){need(3);s.op=Op::Store;s.name=w[1];s.condition=join(w,2,w.size());}
  // set GLOBAL|GLOBAL[i] EXPR: writes a WDL VAR (or VAR array element) as a number, like a script assignment.
  else if(c=="set"){need(3);s.op=Op::Set;s.name=w[1];s.condition=join(w,2,w.size());}
  else if(c=="find"){need(3);s.op=Op::Find;s.name=w[1];s.condition=w[2];}
  // list ACTION: log every live entity running ACTION (id, position, skill1-3, distance) for route discovery.
  // list near R: every live entity within R of the player, with its file and PASSABLE flag (finds action-less blockers).
  else if(c=="list"){need(2);s.op=Op::List;s.condition=w[1];if(w[1]=="near"){need(3);s.radius=std::stof(w[2]);}}
  // walk-to @entity|X Y RADIUS [path] [run] [timeout N]: greedy steering with the default arrow bindings (GenelAyarlar.wdl GA_Tuslar), A held when "run".
  // "path" plans a hull route first (plan() above) and walks it as waypoints, re-planning when stuck.
  // turn-to @entity|X Y [DEGREES=8] [timeout N]: Left/Right only, until the player faces the target.
  else if(c=="walk-to"||c=="turn-to"){const bool turn=c=="turn-to";s.count=timeout(w,line,turn?300:1200);
   while(!turn&&w.size()>3&&(w.back()=="run"||w.back()=="path")){if(w.back()=="run")s.down=true;else s.index=1;w.pop_back();}
   if(turn&&w.size()>=2&&(w.size()==2||(w.size()==3&&w[1].front()!='@')))w.push_back("8");need(3);s.op=turn?Op::TurnTo:Op::WalkTo;
   if(w[1].front()=='@'){if(w.size()!=3)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": "+c+" @name RADIUS");s.name=w[1].substr(1);}
   else{if(w.size()!=4)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": "+c+" X Y RADIUS");s.x=std::stof(w[1]);s.y=std::stof(w[2]);}
   s.radius=std::stof(w.back());}
  // route RADIUS X1 Y1 X2 Y2 ... [run] [timeout N]: walk-to through waypoints; when stuck it re-anchors on the nearest
  // waypoint (behind or ahead), so a random knock-back or a sidestep past an obstacle resumes the route from where the player is.
  else if(c=="route"){s.count=timeout(w,line,3600);if(w.back()=="run"){s.down=true;w.pop_back();}if(w.size()<4||w.size()%2)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": route RADIUS X1 Y1 [X2 Y2 ...] [run] [timeout N]");
   s.op=Op::WalkTo;s.radius=std::stof(w[1]);for(std::size_t i=2;i<w.size();++i)s.path.push_back(std::stof(w[i]));}
  else if(c=="capture"){need(2);s.op=Op::Capture;s.name=w[1];if(s.name.find_first_not_of("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-.")!=std::string::npos||s.name.front()=='.')throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": capture name must be a plain file stem");}
  else if(c=="print"){need(2);s.op=Op::Print;s.condition=join(w,1,w.size());}
  // type TEXT: SDL text input (Input::text) for the next frame, e.g. a native console command line before "press Return".
  else if(c=="type"){need(2);s.op=Op::Type;s.name=join(w,1,w.size());}
  // A leading realtime (before any step) also covers script bootstrap (main.cpp media clock).
  else if(c=="realtime"){need(2);s.op=Op::Realtime;s.down=w[1]=="on";if(w[1]!="on"&&w[1]!="off")throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": realtime on|off");if(steps.empty()){realtime=s.down;return;}}
  // seed N: applies before the scripts start, wherever it appears (main.cpp).
  else if(c=="seed"){need(2);auto n=number(w[1],line);if(n<0||n>0xffffffffL)throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": seed 0..4294967295");seed=std::uint32_t(n);return;}
  // pad live: the renderer's real game controller/joystick input passes through (live pad tests, tools/virtual-gamepad); whole file.
  else if(c=="pad"){need(2);if(w[1]!="live")throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": pad live");livePad=true;return;}
  // Drives the original YukleMenu (YukleMenu.wdl:169-343) from the main menu with ordinary keys; slot N reads kayitN.sav.
  else if(c=="load-save"){need(2);auto n=std::to_string(number(w[1],line));
   for(auto expanded:{"wait until ParlaklikMenuAcik == 1 || AMP_OyunYukle.visible == 1 timeout 7200","press-until Return ParlaklikMenuAcik == 0 timeout 600","wait until AMP_OyunYukle.visible == 1 timeout 1200","press-until Down AM_Cursor == 1 timeout 600","press-until Return YUMP_Cursor.visible == 1 timeout 600"})parse(expanded,line);
   parse("press-until Down YUM_Cursor+YUM_Kafa >= "+n+" timeout 3600",line);parse("press-until Up YUM_Cursor+YUM_Kafa <= "+n+" timeout 3600",line);parse("assert YUM_Cursor+YUM_Kafa == "+n,line);parse("press-until Return YUMP_Cursor.visible == 0 timeout 600",line);return;}
  else throw std::runtime_error("scenario line "+std::to_string(line)+": unknown command '"+c+"'");
  add(std::move(s));
 }
 void report(const Step& s,const char* result,std::uint64_t frame,const std::string& detail={}){log.str("");log<<"scenario: line "<<s.line<<' '<<result<<" frame="<<frame<<' '<<s.source;if(!detail.empty())log<<" -- "<<detail;std::fprintf(stdout,"%s\n",log.str().c_str());std::fflush(stdout);}
 void next(){++pc;progress=0;escape=0;leg=0;replans=0;}
 void apply(Input& in){
  in.keys=keys;in.pressed=keys&~priorKeys;in.released=priorKeys&~keys;priorKeys=keys;
  in.mouseButtons=mouse;in.mousePressed=mouse&~priorMouse;in.mouseReleased=priorMouse&~mouse;priorMouse=mouse;
  in.mouseX=mouseX;in.mouseY=mouseY;in.mouseDX=mouseX-priorX;in.mouseDY=mouseY-priorY;priorX=mouseX;priorY=mouseY;in.wheelX=in.wheelY=0;in.text=std::move(text);text.clear();
  if(livePad)return;
  in.controllerButtons.reset();in.controllerPressed.reset();in.controllerReleased.reset();in.controllerAxes.fill(0);
  for(int j=0;j<2;++j){in.joystickConnected[j]=joyUsed[j];in.joystickButtons[j]=joy[j];in.joystickPressed[j]=joy[j]&~priorJoy[j];in.joystickReleased[j]=priorJoy[j]&~joy[j];priorJoy[j]=joy[j];in.joystickAxes[j]=axes[j];}
 }
};
Scenario::Scenario(const std::filesystem::path& file,std::filesystem::path output):impl_(std::make_unique<Impl>()){
 impl_->file=file;impl_->output=std::move(output);std::ifstream in(file);if(!in)throw std::runtime_error("cannot read scenario "+file.string());
 int line=0;for(std::string text;std::getline(in,text);){++line;if(!text.empty()&&text.back()=='\r')text.pop_back();impl_->parse(text,line);}
 if(impl_->steps.empty())throw std::runtime_error("scenario has no steps: "+file.string());
 std::filesystem::create_directories(impl_->output);
}
Scenario::~Scenario()=default;
bool Scenario::realtime()const{return impl_->realtime;}
std::uint32_t Scenario::seed()const{return impl_->seed;}
bool Scenario::step(Engine& engine,Runtime& runtime,Renderer* renderer,Input& in,std::uint64_t frame){
 auto& s=*impl_;
 auto eval=[&](const std::string& text){return Eval{engine,runtime,s.stored,frame,text};};
 // Condition errors (unknown global, bad syntax) fail the step; waits abort because later steps depend on them.
 auto check=[&](const Step& step,bool& result)->bool{try{result=eval(step.condition).condition();return true;}catch(const std::exception& e){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,e.what());return false;}};
 while(!s.aborted&&s.pc<s.steps.size()){
  auto& step=s.steps[s.pc];
  switch(step.op){
   case Op::Frames:if(s.progress++<step.count){s.apply(in);return true;}s.next();break;
   case Op::Key:s.keys.set(std::size_t(step.key),step.down);s.next();break;
   case Op::Mouse:s.mouseX=step.x;s.mouseY=step.y;s.next();break;
   case Op::MouseButton:s.mouse.set(std::size_t(step.key),step.down);s.next();break;
   case Op::Type:s.text+=step.name;s.next();break;
   case Op::JoyButton:s.joyUsed[step.index]=true;s.joy[step.index].set(std::size_t(step.key),step.down);s.next();break;
   case Op::JoyAxis:s.joyUsed[step.index]=true;s.axes[step.index][step.key]=step.x;s.next();break;
   case Op::Realtime:s.realtime=step.down;s.next();break;
   case Op::Wait:case Op::PressUntil:{
    // press-until: check, hold 3 frames, release 3 frames, repeat.
    const bool press=step.op==Op::PressUntil;const long phase=press?s.progress%6:0;
    if(phase==0){bool ok=false;if(!check(step,ok)){s.aborted=true;break;}
     if(ok){++s.passed;s.report(step,"PASS",frame,"after "+std::to_string(s.progress)+" frames");s.next();break;}
     if(s.progress>=step.count){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,"timeout after "+std::to_string(s.progress)+" frames");s.aborted=true;break;}
     if(press)s.keys.set(std::size_t(step.key));}
    if(press&&phase==3)s.keys.reset(std::size_t(step.key));
    ++s.progress;s.apply(in);return true;}
   case Op::Assert:{bool ok=false;if(check(step,ok)){if(ok)++s.passed;else ++s.failed;s.report(step,ok?"PASS":"FAIL",frame);}s.next();break;}
   case Op::Store:case Op::Print:try{auto v=eval(step.condition).value();if(step.op==Op::Store)s.stored[step.name]=v;s.report(step,"INFO",frame,show(v));}catch(const std::exception& e){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,e.what());}s.next();break;
   case Op::Set:try{
    auto v=eval(step.condition).value();if(v.text)throw std::runtime_error("set takes a number");
    auto name=step.name;std::optional<std::size_t> index;if(auto b=name.find('[');b!=std::string::npos){if(name.back()!=']')throw std::runtime_error("expected NAME[i]");index=number(name.substr(b+1,name.size()-b-2),step.line);name.resize(b);}
    auto it=engine.state.globals.find(name);if(it==engine.state.globals.end())throw std::runtime_error("unknown WDL global "+name);
    if(!index){if(it->second.value.kind!=Value::Kind::Number)throw std::runtime_error(name+" is not a number");it->second.value=Value::from_double(v.number);}
    else{auto* o=it->second.value.kind==Value::Kind::Object?engine.state.get(it->second.value.bits):nullptr;if(!o||*index>=o->array.size())throw std::runtime_error(step.name+" is not an array element");o->array[*index].value=Value::from_double(v.number);}
    ++s.passed;s.report(step,"PASS",frame,show(v));}catch(const std::exception& e){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,e.what());}s.next();break;
   case Op::WalkTo:case Op::TurnTo:{
    Eval at{engine,runtime,s.stored,frame,{}};const auto up=SDL_SCANCODE_UP,left=SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT,right=SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT,run=SDL_SCANCODE_A;
    auto release=[&]{for(auto k:{up,left,right,run})s.keys.reset(k);};
    Vec3 goal{step.x,step.y,0};
    if(!step.name.empty()){auto it=s.stored.find(step.name);if(it==s.stored.end()||it->second.text){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,"unknown stored entity @"+step.name);s.aborted=true;break;}goal=engine.position(ObjectId(it->second.number));}
    if(!at.player()){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,"no player");s.aborted=true;break;}
    const auto pos=engine.position(at.player());
    const auto where=" at ("+std::to_string(int(pos.x))+","+std::to_string(int(pos.y))+","+std::to_string(int(pos.z))+")";
    const bool planned=step.index==1,turn=step.op==Op::TurnTo;
    auto replan=[&]{std::string why;step.path=plan(engine,at.player(),pos,goal,step.radius,!step.name.empty(),why);s.leg=0;s.best=INFINITY;s.lastImprove=s.progress;
     if(step.path.empty()){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,why+where);s.aborted=true;return false;}
     std::string via;for(std::size_t i=0;i+1<step.path.size();i+=2)via+=" ("+std::to_string(int(step.path[i]))+","+std::to_string(int(step.path[i+1]))+")";
     s.report(step,"INFO",frame,"planned "+std::to_string(step.path.size()/2)+" waypoints"+where+" via"+via);return true;};
    if(planned&&s.progress==0&&!replan())break;
    const bool last=step.path.empty()||2*(s.leg+1)>=step.path.size();
    Vec3 target=goal;if(!step.path.empty()&&!(last&&!step.name.empty()))target={step.path[2*s.leg],step.path[2*s.leg+1],0};
    target.z=pos.z;const double d=at.dist(target),f=at.facing(target);
    const bool done=turn?std::fabs(f)<step.radius:d<(planned&&!last?16:step.radius);const double band=turn?step.radius:10;
    if(done&&!last){++s.leg;s.best=INFINITY;s.lastImprove=s.progress;s.report(step,"INFO",frame,"leg "+std::to_string(s.leg)+where);++s.progress;s.apply(in);return true;}
    if(done){release();++s.passed;s.report(step,"PASS",frame,"after "+std::to_string(s.progress)+" frames"+where);s.next();break;}
    if(s.progress>=step.count){release();++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,"timeout, distance "+std::to_string(int(d))+" facing "+std::to_string(int(f))+where);s.aborted=true;break;}
    // ponytail: greedy steering plus a blind sidestep (alternating sides) after 40 frames without 2 units of progress; "path" re-plans (5x max), routes re-anchor.
    // Frame counts are 1/60 s frames, scaled to the step (fps_limit), so a turn in place is not taken for "stuck" at high rates.
    const auto frames60=[&](double n){return long(std::lround(n/(60*in.dt)));};
    if(!turn){if(s.progress==0||d<s.best-2){s.best=d;s.lastImprove=s.progress;}if(!s.escape&&s.progress-s.lastImprove>frames60(40)){s.escape=int(frames60(45));++s.escapes;s.lastImprove=s.progress;
     if(planned){if(s.replans++<5&&!replan())break;}
     else if(!step.path.empty()){auto nearest=s.leg;for(std::size_t i=0;2*i<step.path.size();++i)if(at.dist(Vec3{step.path[2*i],step.path[2*i+1],pos.z})<at.dist(Vec3{step.path[2*nearest],step.path[2*nearest+1],pos.z}))nearest=i;if(nearest!=s.leg){s.leg=nearest;s.best=INFINITY;s.report(step,"INFO",frame,"stuck, re-anchored on leg "+std::to_string(s.leg)+where);}}}}
    if(s.escape){--s.escape;const bool steer=s.escape>=frames60(30),side=s.escapes%2;s.keys.set(left,steer&&side);s.keys.set(right,steer&&!side);s.keys.set(up,true);s.keys.set(run,step.down);}
    else{s.keys.set(left,f>band);s.keys.set(right,f< -band);s.keys.set(up,!turn&&std::fabs(f)<60);s.keys.set(run,!turn&&step.down);}
    ++s.progress;s.apply(in);return true;}
   case Op::Find:{
    auto action=runtime.function(step.condition);ObjectId best=0;double bestDistance=0;Eval near{engine,runtime,s.stored,frame,{}};
    for(const auto& [id,data]:engine.entities)if(runs(engine,id,action)){auto d=near.player()?near.dist(id):0;if(!best||d<bestDistance){best=id;bestDistance=d;}}
    if(!best){++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,action?"no live entity runs this action":"unknown action");s.aborted=true;break;}
    s.stored[step.name]={false,double(best),{}};++s.passed;s.report(step,"PASS",frame,"entity "+std::to_string(best)+" at distance "+std::to_string(int(bestDistance)));s.next();break;}
   case Op::List:{
    const bool nearby=step.condition=="near";auto action=nearby?FunctionId{}:runtime.function(step.condition);Eval near{engine,runtime,s.stored,frame,{}};std::ostringstream o;int n=0;
    for(const auto& [id,data]:engine.entities){const auto* obj=engine.state.get(id);const double d=near.player()?near.dist(id):0;if(nearby?!(obj&&obj->alive&&id!=near.player()&&d<step.radius):!runs(engine,id,action))continue;auto p=engine.position(id);o<<" ["<<id<<" ("<<int(p.x)<<','<<int(p.y)<<','<<int(p.z)<<")";if(nearby){o<<' '<<data.file;for(auto f:{"passable","polygon","narrow","fat","min_x","max_x","min_y","max_y","min_z","max_z","pan","tilt","roll","invisible","transparent","overlay","bright","flare","unlit","oriented","alpha","ambient","floor_dist"})o<<' '<<f<<'='<<engine.field(id,f);}else o<<" s1="<<engine.field(id,"skill1")<<" s2="<<engine.field(id,"skill2")<<" s3="<<engine.field(id,"skill3");o<<" d="<<int(d)<<']';++n;}
    s.report(step,"INFO",frame,std::to_string(n)+o.str());s.next();break;}
   case Op::ExpectExit:if(s.progress++<step.count){s.apply(in);return true;}++s.failed;s.report(step,"FAIL",frame,"engine still running");s.aborted=true;break;
   case Op::Capture:
    if(!renderer||frame==0){++s.skipped;s.report(step,"SKIP",frame,renderer?"no completed frame":"headless");}
    else{auto path=(s.output/(step.name+".ppm")).string();renderer->capture(path);++s.passed;s.report(step,"PASS",frame,path);}
    s.next();break;
  }
 }
 s.apply(in);return false;
}
int Scenario::finish(std::ostream& out,std::uint64_t frames,bool quit){
 auto& s=*impl_;
 // The exit may land inside the key/frame steps of the press that triggered it.
 if(quit&&!s.aborted&&!s.steps.empty()&&s.steps.back().op==Op::ExpectExit&&std::all_of(s.steps.begin()+std::ptrdiff_t(std::min(s.pc,s.steps.size())),s.steps.end()-1,[](const Step& x){return x.op==Op::Frames||x.op==Op::Key;})){++s.passed;s.report(s.steps.back(),"PASS",frames,"engine exited");s.pc=s.steps.size();}
 const auto notRun=s.aborted?s.steps.size()-s.pc:s.pc<s.steps.size()?s.steps.size()-s.pc:0;const bool ok=!s.failed&&!notRun;
 out<<"scenario: "<<s.file.filename().string()<<' '<<(ok?"PASS":"FAIL")<<" passed="<<s.passed<<" failed="<<s.failed<<" skipped="<<s.skipped<<" not_run="<<notRun<<" frames="<<frames<<'\n';
 return ok?0:1;
}
}
```

`native/scenario.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <iosfwd>
#include <memory>
namespace k22 {
class Engine;class Runtime;class Renderer;struct Input;
// Scripted gameplay run (docs/GAMEPLAY_TESTING.md): timed input, waits and assertions on the live WDL state.
class Scenario {
public:
 Scenario(const std::filesystem::path& file,std::filesystem::path output);
 ~Scenario();
 // Before each tick: runs instantaneous steps, then owns the frame's keyboard/mouse/joystick input. False once finished.
 bool step(Engine&,Runtime&,Renderer*,Input&,std::uint64_t frame);
 bool realtime()const;
 // "seed N" (default 0): the WDL random() stream; scenario mode never reseeds it from the OS (randomize).
 std::uint32_t seed()const;
 // Prints the summary; returns the process exit code. quit: the engine ended the run itself (expect-exit).
 int finish(std::ostream&,std::uint64_t frames,bool quit=false);
private:
 struct Impl;std::unique_ptr<Impl> impl_;
};
}
```

```comp
#version 450
layout(local_size_x=64) in;
layout(set=0,binding=0,std430) readonly buffer Base { float base[]; };
layout(set=0,binding=1,std430) readonly buffer First { float first[]; };
layout(set=0,binding=2,std430) readonly buffer Next { float next[]; };
layout(set=0,binding=3,std430) writeonly buffer Output { float outputPose[]; };
layout(push_constant) uniform PoseParameters { uint count; uint firstOffset; uint nextOffset; float blend; uint nextFallback; } pose;
void main(){
    uint i=gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;if(i>=pose.count)return;
    uint dst=i*13u,a=pose.firstOffset+i*9u,b=pose.nextOffset+i*9u;
    for(uint j=0u;j<6u;++j){bool fallback=(pose.nextFallback&(j<3u?1u:2u))!=0u;outputPose[dst+j]=mix(first[a+j],fallback?first[a+j]:next[b+j],pose.blend);}
    for(uint j=6u;j<10u;++j)outputPose[dst+j]=base[dst+j];
    for(uint j=0u;j<3u;++j)outputPose[dst+10u+j]=mix(first[a+6u+j],next[b+6u+j],pose.blend);
}
```

`native/shaders/effects.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "raster_uniform.glsl"
// Vulkan fullscreen effect passes (mode = u.dataPass.x); OpenGL runs the same effects.glsl functions.
layout(set=0,binding=5,std430) readonly buffer Lights { vec4 lightData[]; };
layout(set=0,binding=1) uniform sampler2D inputA;
layout(set=0,binding=2) uniform sampler2D inputB;
layout(set=0,binding=3) uniform sampler2D inputC;
layout(set=0,binding=4) uniform sampler2D inputD;
layout(set=0,binding=10) uniform samplerCubeShadow cubeShadowMap;
layout(location=0) in vec2 uv;
layout(location=0) out vec4 color;
#define K22_FLIP_Y 1
#define K22_LIGHT(i) lightData[i]
#define K22_FOG_VISIBILITY(i,x) (k22ShadowMaps&&u.dataShadowLight.w>0.0&&(i)==int(u.dataEffects.w)?k22CubeShadow(cubeShadowMap,u.dataShadowLight.xyz,x,vec3(0),k22CubeShadowNear,u.dataShadowLight.w):1.0)
#include "pbr.glsl"
#include "effects.glsl"
vec3 forwardAxis(){return u.dataCamera.xyz;}
void main(){
    int mode=k22Pass;vec2 texel=u.dataPass.zw;
    if(mode==1){float d=texture(inputA,uv).r;color=vec4(d>=1.0?u.dataRange.x:k22LinearDepth(d,u.dataCamera.w,u.dataRange.x));return;}
    if(mode==2){color=vec4(k22Ssao(inputA,uv,texel,u.dataInverseViewProjection,u.dataViewProjection,cameraPosition,forwardAxis(),k22Noise(gl_FragCoord.xy+u.dataPass.y)));return;}
    if(mode==3){
        // 4x4 depth-aware blur of the AO term, applied with multiplicative blending.
        float center=texture(inputB,uv).r,sum=0.0,weight=0.0;
        for(int y=-2;y<2;++y)for(int x=-2;x<2;++x){vec2 o=(vec2(x,y)+0.5)*texel;float w=1.0/(1.0+abs(texture(inputB,uv+o).r-center)*0.25);sum+=texture(inputA,uv+o).r*w;weight+=w;}
        color=vec4(vec3(sum/weight),1);return;
    }
    if(mode==4){float d=texture(inputA,uv).r;vec3 eye=cameraPosition;vec3 p=eye+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv),u.dataInverseViewProjection,eye,forwardAxis())*d;color=vec4(k22FogInscatter(eye,p,u.dataRange.yz,k22Noise(gl_FragCoord.xy+u.dataPass.y)),d);return;}
    if(mode==14){
        // Half-resolution fog (mode 4, alpha = its sample's linear depth): bilinear weights damped by relative depth
        // difference so fog does not bleed across silhouettes; the closest-depth texel when every neighbour differs.
        vec2 size=vec2(textureSize(inputA,0)),p=uv*size-0.5,f=fract(p);ivec2 b=ivec2(floor(p)),last=ivec2(size)-1;float d=texture(inputB,uv).r;
        vec3 sum=vec3(0),best=vec3(0);float weight=0.0,closest=1e30;
        for(int i=0;i<4;++i){ivec2 o=ivec2(i&1,i>>1);vec4 s=texelFetch(inputA,clamp(b+o,ivec2(0),last),0);float dz=abs(s.a-d);
            float w=(o.x==1?f.x:1.0-f.x)*(o.y==1?f.y:1.0-f.y)*exp(-dz/(0.05*max(d,1e-3)));sum+=w*s.rgb;weight+=w;if(dz<closest){closest=dz;best=s.rgb;}}
        color=vec4(weight>1e-4?sum/weight:best,0);return;
    }
    if(mode==5){color=vec4(k22BloomPrefilter(k22BloomDown(inputA,uv,texel)),1);return;}
    if(mode==6){color=vec4(k22BloomDown(inputA,uv,texel),1);return;}
    if(mode==7){color=vec4(k22BloomUp(inputA,uv,texel),1);return;}
    if(mode==8){vec4 c=texture(inputA,uv);if(u.dataRange.w>0.0)c.rgb+=u.dataRange.w*texture(inputB,uv).rgb;color=vec4(k22PbrOn?k22ToneMap(c.rgb):c.rgb,c.a);return;}
    if(mode==9){
        // TAA (render_policy::motion_visible/variance_clip): moving entities reproject with their motion vectors (nearest
        // motion sample of the 3x3 neighborhood unless the scene depth hides it), the rest through the depth captured
        // before view-space entities; the history is clipped to the neighborhood's YCoCg mean +- 1.25 sigma.
        const mat3 toYCoCg=mat3(0.25,0.5,-0.25,0.5,0.0,0.5,0.25,-0.5,-0.25),fromYCoCg=mat3(1,1,1,1,0,-1,-1,1,-1);
        vec3 current=toYCoCg*texture(inputA,uv).rgb,m1=vec3(0),m2=vec3(0);vec4 motion=vec4(0);
        for(int y=-1;y<=1;++y)for(int x=-1;x<=1;++x){vec2 o=uv+vec2(x,y)*texel;vec3 s=toYCoCg*texture(inputA,o).rgb;m1+=s;m2+=s*s;vec4 v=texture(inputD,o);if(v.z>0.0&&(motion.z==0.0||v.z<motion.z))motion=v;}
        float d=texture(inputC,uv).r;vec2 puv=vec2(-1);
        if(motion.z>0.0&&motion.z<=d*1.03){if(motion.w>0.0)puv=uv+motion.xy;}
        else{vec3 p=cameraPosition+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv),u.dataInverseViewProjection,cameraPosition,forwardAxis())*d;vec4 previous=u.dataPreviousViewProjection*vec4(p,1);if(previous.w>0.0)puv=k22UvFromNdc(previous.xy/previous.w);}
        if(u.dataRange.w==0.0||any(lessThan(puv,vec2(0)))||any(greaterThan(puv,vec2(1)))){color=vec4(fromYCoCg*current,1);return;}
        vec3 mean=m1/9.0,sigma=sqrt(max(m2/9.0-mean*mean,0.0)),history=toYCoCg*texture(inputB,puv).rgb-mean;
        vec3 e=abs(history)/(sigma*1.25+1e-4);float m=max(e.x,max(e.y,e.z));if(m>1.0)history/=m;
        color=vec4(fromYCoCg*mix(mean+history,current,0.1),1);return;
    }
    if(mode==10){color=vec4(k22Fxaa(inputA,uv,texel),1);return;}
    if(mode==13){
        // FSR motion: unjittered previous-minus-current UV. Entity vectors (scene pass 3, previous unjittered minus this
        // jittered pixel) where the scene depth agrees, as in TAA; the camera reprojection of the depth elsewhere.
        float d=texture(inputA,uv).r;vec3 p=cameraPosition+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv),u.dataInverseViewProjection,cameraPosition,forwardAxis())*d;
        vec4 c=u.dataViewProjection*vec4(p,1),q=u.dataPreviousViewProjection*vec4(p,1),m=texture(inputB,uv);vec2 current=k22UvFromNdc(c.xy/c.w);
        color=vec4(m.z>0.0&&m.z<=d*1.03?m.xy+uv-current:q.w>0.0?k22UvFromNdc(q.xy/q.w)-current:vec2(0),0,1);return;
    }
    if(mode==12){
        // sharpen: AMD FidelityFX CAS (contrast-adaptive sharpening) on the final LDR image; sharpness 0.4 (0..1).
        // Per-channel amount shrinks where the 3x3 cross is already contrasty or near clipping, so no halos.
        vec4 e=texture(inputA,uv);
        vec3 b=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(0,-1)*texel).rgb,d=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(-1,0)*texel).rgb,f=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(1,0)*texel).rgb,h=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(0,1)*texel).rgb;
        vec3 a=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(-1,-1)*texel).rgb,c=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(1,-1)*texel).rgb,g=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(-1,1)*texel).rgb,i=texture(inputA,uv+vec2(1,1)*texel).rgb;
        a=clamp(a,0.0,1.0);b=clamp(b,0.0,1.0);c=clamp(c,0.0,1.0);d=clamp(d,0.0,1.0);f=clamp(f,0.0,1.0);g=clamp(g,0.0,1.0);h=clamp(h,0.0,1.0);i=clamp(i,0.0,1.0);vec3 m=clamp(e.rgb,0.0,1.0);
        vec3 lo=min(min(min(d,m),min(f,b)),h),hi=max(max(max(d,m),max(f,b)),h);
        lo+=min(lo,min(min(a,c),min(g,i)));hi+=max(hi,max(max(a,c),max(g,i)));
        vec3 amp=sqrt(clamp(min(lo,2.0-hi)/max(hi,vec3(1e-5)),0.0,1.0));
        vec3 w=amp*(-1.0/mix(8.0,5.0,0.4));
        color=vec4(clamp((b*w+d*w+f*w+h*w+m)/(1.0+4.0*w),0.0,1.0),e.a);return;
    }
    color=texture(inputA,uv);
}

```

`native/shaders/effects.glsl`:

```glsl
// Wave-2 effect math shared by the OpenGL 3.3 shaders (embedded at configure time) and the Vulkan shaders.
// Conventions: matrices are GL clip space (z in [-1,1]); depth samples are window depth in [0,1];
// "linear depth" is the positive view distance along the camera forward axis. Colors are the game's
// gamma-space values (HDR when PBR is on). K22_FLIP_Y=1 (Vulkan) means texture row 0 is NDC +Y.
#ifndef K22_EFFECTS_GLSL
#define K22_EFFECTS_GLSL
#ifndef K22_FLIP_Y
#define K22_FLIP_Y 0
#endif
float k22Luma(vec3 c){return dot(c,vec3(0.299,0.587,0.114));}
vec2 k22NdcFromUv(vec2 uv){vec2 n=uv*2.0-1.0;
#if K22_FLIP_Y
    n.y=-n.y;
#endif
    return n;}
vec2 k22UvFromNdc(vec2 n){
#if K22_FLIP_Y
    n.y=-n.y;
#endif
    return n*0.5+0.5;}
float k22LinearDepth(float depth,float n,float f){float z=depth*2.0-1.0;return 2.0*n*f/(f+n-z*(f-n));}
// World-space ray through a pixel, scaled so its component along the camera forward axis is 1.
vec3 k22ViewRay(vec2 ndc,mat4 inverseViewProjection,vec3 eye,vec3 forward){vec4 p=inverseViewProjection*vec4(ndc,1.0,1.0);vec3 r=p.xyz/p.w-eye;return r/dot(r,forward);}
// Jimenez interleaved gradient noise in [0,1).
float k22Noise(vec2 pixel){return fract(52.9829189*fract(dot(pixel,vec2(0.06711056,0.00583715))));}
// ---- SSAO: hemisphere samples around the depth-reconstructed normal; returns ambient visibility in [0,1]. ----
const int k22AoSamples=12;const float k22AoRadius=20.0,k22AoStrength=0.65;
float k22Ssao(sampler2D linearDepth,vec2 uv,vec2 texel,mat4 inverseViewProjection,mat4 vp,vec3 eye,vec3 forward,float noise){
    float d=texture(linearDepth,uv).r;if(d<=0.0)return 1.0;
    vec3 p=eye+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv),inverseViewProjection,eye,forward)*d;
    vec3 px=eye+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv+vec2(texel.x,0)),inverseViewProjection,eye,forward)*texture(linearDepth,uv+vec2(texel.x,0)).r;
    vec3 nx=eye+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv-vec2(texel.x,0)),inverseViewProjection,eye,forward)*texture(linearDepth,uv-vec2(texel.x,0)).r;
    vec3 py=eye+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv+vec2(0,texel.y)),inverseViewProjection,eye,forward)*texture(linearDepth,uv+vec2(0,texel.y)).r;
    vec3 ny=eye+k22ViewRay(k22NdcFromUv(uv-vec2(0,texel.y)),inverseViewProjection,eye,forward)*texture(linearDepth,uv-vec2(0,texel.y)).r;
    vec3 dx=abs(px.x+px.y+px.z-p.x-p.y-p.z)<abs(nx.x+nx.y+nx.z-p.x-p.y-p.z)?px-p:p-nx,dy=abs(py.x+py.y+py.z-p.x-p.y-p.z)<abs(ny.x+ny.y+ny.z-p.x-p.y-p.z)?py-p:p-ny;
    vec3 n=cross(dx,dy);if(dot(n,n)<1e-12)return 1.0;n=normalize(n);if(dot(n,eye-p)<0.0)n=-n;
    vec3 t=normalize(abs(n.z)<0.9?cross(n,vec3(0,0,1)):cross(n,vec3(1,0,0))),b=cross(n,t);
    float occlusion=0.0,angle=noise*6.2831853;
    for(int i=0;i<k22AoSamples;++i){
        float s=(float(i)+0.5)/float(k22AoSamples),r=k22AoRadius*mix(0.1,1.0,s*s),a=angle+float(i)*2.3999632;
        float z=sqrt(1.0-s),xy=sqrt(s);vec3 q=p+(t*cos(a)*xy+b*sin(a)*xy+n*z)*r+n*0.5;
        vec4 c=vp*vec4(q,1.0);if(c.w<=0.0)continue;vec2 sampleUv=k22UvFromNdc(c.xy/c.w);
        if(any(lessThan(sampleUv,vec2(0)))||any(greaterThan(sampleUv,vec2(1))))continue;
        float sceneDepth=texture(linearDepth,sampleUv).r,sampleDepth=dot(q-eye,forward);
        if(sceneDepth>0.0&&sceneDepth<sampleDepth-0.5)occlusion+=clamp(k22AoRadius/abs(d-sceneDepth),0.0,1.0);
    }
    return 1.0-k22AoStrength*occlusion/float(k22AoSamples);
}
// ---- Bloom: soft-knee threshold in display (gamma) space, conservative additive strength. ----
const float k22BloomThreshold=0.7,k22BloomKnee=0.2,k22BloomStrength=0.15;
vec3 k22BloomPrefilter(vec3 c){float b=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),s=clamp(b-k22BloomThreshold+k22BloomKnee,0.0,2.0*k22BloomKnee);s=s*s/(4.0*k22BloomKnee);return c*max(s,b-k22BloomThreshold)/max(b,1e-4);}
vec3 k22BloomDown(sampler2D image,vec2 uv,vec2 texel){return 0.25*(texture(image,uv+texel*vec2(-1,-1)).rgb+texture(image,uv+texel*vec2(1,-1)).rgb+texture(image,uv+texel*vec2(-1,1)).rgb+texture(image,uv+texel*vec2(1,1)).rgb);}
vec3 k22BloomUp(sampler2D image,vec2 uv,vec2 texel){
    vec3 s=4.0*texture(image,uv).rgb;
    s+=2.0*(texture(image,uv+vec2(texel.x,0)).rgb+texture(image,uv-vec2(texel.x,0)).rgb+texture(image,uv+vec2(0,texel.y)).rgb+texture(image,uv-vec2(0,texel.y)).rgb);
    s+=texture(image,uv+texel).rgb+texture(image,uv-texel).rgb+texture(image,uv+vec2(texel.x,-texel.y)).rgb+texture(image,uv+vec2(-texel.x,texel.y)).rgb;
    return s/16.0;
}
// ---- FXAA (Lottes 3.11 quality-style edge search, 12 steps) on display-space LDR color. ----
vec3 k22Fxaa(sampler2D image,vec2 uv,vec2 texel){
    vec3 rgbM=texture(image,uv).rgb;float lM=k22Luma(rgbM);
    float lN=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+vec2(0,-texel.y)).rgb),lS=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+vec2(0,texel.y)).rgb),lE=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+vec2(texel.x,0)).rgb),lW=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+vec2(-texel.x,0)).rgb);
    float lMax=max(lM,max(max(lN,lS),max(lE,lW))),lMin=min(lM,min(min(lN,lS),min(lE,lW))),range=lMax-lMin;
    if(range<max(0.0312,lMax*0.125))return rgbM;
    float lNW=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+vec2(-texel.x,-texel.y)).rgb),lNE=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+vec2(texel.x,-texel.y)).rgb),lSW=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+vec2(-texel.x,texel.y)).rgb),lSE=k22Luma(texture(image,uv+texel).rgb);
    float horizontal=abs(lNW+lNE-2.0*lN)+2.0*abs(lW+lE-2.0*lM)+abs(lSW+lSE-2.0*lS),vertical=abs(lNW+lSW-2.0*lW)+2.0*abs(lN+lS-2.0*lM)+abs(lNE+lSE-2.0*lE);
    bool isHorizontal=horizontal>=vertical;float l1=isHorizontal?lN:lW,l2=isHorizontal?lS:lE,g1=abs(l1-lM),g2=abs(l2-lM);
    float stepLen=isHorizontal?texel.y:texel.x;float lLocal;float gScaled;
    if(g1>=g2){stepLen=-stepLen;lLocal=0.5*(l1+lM);gScaled=0.25*g1;}else{lLocal=0.5*(l2+lM);gScaled=0.25*g2;}
    vec2 edge=uv;if(isHorizontal)edge.y+=0.5*stepLen;else edge.x+=0.5*stepLen;
    vec2 dir=isHorizontal?vec2(texel.x,0):vec2(0,texel.y);
    vec2 p1=edge-dir,p2=edge+dir;float e1=k22Luma(texture(image,p1).rgb)-lLocal,e2=k22Luma(texture(image,p2).rgb)-lLocal;bool r1=abs(e1)>=gScaled,r2=abs(e2)>=gScaled;
    for(int i=0;i<12&&!(r1&&r2);++i){float q=i<4?1.0:i<8?1.5:2.0;if(!r1){p1-=dir*q;e1=k22Luma(texture(image,p1).rgb)-lLocal;r1=abs(e1)>=gScaled;}if(!r2){p2+=dir*q;e2=k22Luma(texture(image,p2).rgb)-lLocal;r2=abs(e2)>=gScaled;}}
    float d1=isHorizontal?uv.x-p1.x:uv.y-p1.y,d2=isHorizontal?p2.x-uv.x:p2.y-uv.y;bool nearer1=d1<d2;float dMin=min(d1,d2),span=d1+d2;
    bool correct=((nearer1?e1:e2)<0.0)!=(lM-lLocal<0.0);float offset=correct?0.5-dMin/span:0.0;
    float average=(2.0*(lN+lS+lE+lW)+lNW+lNE+lSW+lSE)/12.0,sub=clamp(abs(average-lM)/range,0.0,1.0);sub=(-2.0*sub+3.0)*sub*sub;offset=max(offset,sub*sub*0.75);
    vec2 target=uv;if(isHorizontal)target.y+=offset*stepLen;else target.x+=offset*stepLen;return texture(image,target).rgb;
}
// ---- Shadow maps (raster fallback). Sun: orthographic depth map, 3x3 PCF. Point/spot: GL-convention depth cube
// whose 90-degree faces share one perspective, so the reference depth follows from the major-axis distance.
float k22SunShadow(sampler2DShadow map,mat4 matrix,vec3 p,vec3 n,float texelWorld){
    vec4 c=matrix*vec4(p+n*(1.5*texelWorld),1.0);vec3 q=c.xyz/c.w;vec2 uv=k22UvFromNdc(q.xy);
    if(any(lessThan(uv,vec2(0)))||any(greaterThan(uv,vec2(1)))||q.z>1.0)return 1.0;
    vec2 texel=1.0/vec2(textureSize(map,0));float ref=q.z*0.5+0.5-0.0005,sum=0.0;
    for(int y=-1;y<=1;++y)for(int x=-1;x<=1;++x)sum+=texture(map,vec3(uv+vec2(x,y)*texel,ref));
    return sum/9.0;
}
// Cube shadow near plane (render_policy::cubeShadowNear): fixtures around a light do not occlude it.
const float k22CubeShadowNear=16.0;
float k22CubeShadow(samplerCubeShadow map,vec3 light,vec3 p,vec3 n,float nearPlane,float farPlane){
    vec3 d=p-light;float distance=length(d);if(distance<=nearPlane||distance>=farPlane)return 1.0;
    float texelWorld=2.0*distance/float(textureSize(map,0).x);d=p+n*(2.0*texelWorld)-light;
    vec3 t=normalize(abs(d.z)<0.9*length(d)?cross(d,vec3(0,0,1)):cross(d,vec3(1,0,0))),b=normalize(cross(d,t));
    float sum=0.0;
    for(int i=0;i<4;++i){vec3 s=d+(t*(i==0?1.0:i==1?-1.0:0.0)+b*(i==2?1.0:i==3?-1.0:0.0))*texelWorld;vec3 a=abs(s);float z=max(a.x,max(a.y,a.z));
        float ref=((farPlane+nearPlane)/(farPlane-nearPlane)-2.0*farPlane*nearPlane/((farPlane-nearPlane)*z))*0.5+0.5;sum+=texture(map,vec4(s,ref-0.0002));}
    return sum*0.25;
}
// ---- Volumetric fog: single-scattering of the scene lights along the view ray (Henyey-Greenstein g=0.25).
// The medium follows the level fog (extinction 3/(end-start) beyond fog start) or, when the level has no fog,
// a faint haze. Only in-scattered light is added: the original linear fog blend stays untouched.
const int k22FogSteps=24;const float k22FogHaze=0.00015,k22FogMaxDistance=3000.0,k22FogG=0.25,k22FogHalo=0.1;
float k22FogDensity(float distance,vec2 fogSpan){return fogSpan.y>fogSpan.x?(distance>fogSpan.x?3.0/(fogSpan.y-fogSpan.x):0.0):k22FogHaze;}
// Normalized so an isotropic medium scatters with weight 1.
float k22Phase(float cosine){float g2=k22FogG*k22FogG;return (1.0-g2)/pow(1.0+g2-2.0*k22FogG*cosine,1.5);}
// Includer defines K22_LIGHT(i), int lightCount and K22_FOG_VISIBILITY(i,x) (1.0 when unshadowed), as for pbr.glsl.
// Scattered radiance uses the light's own falloff times a halo term 1/(1+(d/(0.15 range))^2) and a (1-d/range)^2 window:
// native lights are constant inside their range, which alone would turn the haze into a uniform veil.
#ifdef K22_FOG_VISIBILITY
vec3 k22FogInscatter(vec3 eye,vec3 surface,vec2 fogSpan,float noise){
    vec3 ray=surface-eye;float total=min(length(ray),k22FogMaxDistance);if(total<=0.0)return vec3(0);vec3 dir=normalize(ray);
    float ds=total/float(k22FogSteps),transmittance=1.0;vec3 result=vec3(0);
    for(int s=0;s<k22FogSteps;++s){
        float t=(float(s)+noise)*ds,sigma=k22FogDensity(t,fogSpan);if(sigma<=0.0)continue;vec3 x=eye+dir*t;vec3 radiance=vec3(0);
        for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){
            vec4 a=K22_LIGHT(i*5),b=K22_LIGHT(i*5+1),d=K22_LIGHT(i*5+2),e=K22_LIGHT(i*5+3),c=K22_LIGHT(i*5+4);
            if(c.z>0.5||d.w==3.0)continue;
            vec3 delta=a.xyz-x;float distance=length(delta);if(distance>a.w)continue;vec3 L=delta/max(distance,0.0001);
            float window=max(1.0-distance/max(a.w,0.0001),0.0),halo=distance/max(k22FogHalo*a.w,0.0001),attenuation=window*window/(1.0+halo*halo)*(b.a<0.0?1.0:1.0/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,0.0001));
            if(d.w==2.0){float rho=dot(-L,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1.0:rho<=c.y?0.0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,0.0001),e.w);}
            if(attenuation>0.0)radiance+=clamp(b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation,0.0,1.0)*k22Phase(dot(dir,-L))*K22_FOG_VISIBILITY(i,x);
        }
        result+=transmittance*sigma*ds*radiance;transmittance*=exp(-sigma*ds);
    }
    return result;
}
#endif
#endif

```

`native/shaders/pbr.glsl`:

```glsl
// Shared by the OpenGL 3.3 scene shader (embedded at configure time) and the Vulkan scene shaders.
// Includer defines K22_LIGHT(i) (vec4 light record word) and int lightCount before including; optionally
// K22_PBR_LIGHT_VISIBILITY(i), the shadow visibility of dynamic light i applied to its specular term.
// Scene colors stay in the game's gamma-2.2 space; lighting math runs on linearized values.
#ifndef K22_PBR_GLSL
#define K22_PBR_GLSL
const float k22Knee=0.6;
vec3 k22Linear(vec3 c){return pow(max(c,vec3(0)),vec3(2.2));}
vec3 k22Gamma(vec3 c){return pow(max(c,vec3(0)),vec3(1.0/2.2));}
// Identity below the linear knee, Reinhard shoulder above (render_policy::tone_map).
vec3 k22ToneMap(vec3 g){vec3 x=k22Linear(g),t=max(x-k22Knee,vec3(0))/(1.0-k22Knee);return k22Gamma(min(x,vec3(k22Knee))+(1.0-k22Knee)*t/(1.0+t));}
vec3 k22InverseToneMap(vec3 g){vec3 y=k22Linear(clamp(g,vec3(0),vec3(1.0-0.25/255.0))),s=max(y-k22Knee,vec3(0))/(1.0-k22Knee);return k22Gamma(min(y,vec3(k22Knee))+(1.0-k22Knee)*s/(1.0-s));}
float k22Ggx(float NdotH,float a){float a2=a*a,d=NdotH*NdotH*(a2-1.0)+1.0;return a2/(3.14159265*d*d);}
float k22Smith(float NdotV,float NdotL,float r){float k=(r+1.0)*(r+1.0)/8.0;return NdotV/(NdotV*(1.0-k)+k)*NdotL/(NdotL*(1.0-k)+k);}
// Karis' analytic split-sum environment BRDF.
vec2 k22EnvBrdf(float r,float NdotV){vec4 q=r*vec4(-1,-0.0275,-0.572,0.022)+vec4(1,0.0425,1.04,-0.04);float a=min(q.x*q.x,exp2(-9.28*NdotV))*q.x+q.y;return vec2(-1.04,1.04)*a+q.zw;}
vec3 k22Direct(vec3 N,vec3 V,vec3 L,vec3 radiance,vec3 F0,float r){
    float NdotL=dot(N,L);if(NdotL<=0.0)return vec3(0);
    vec3 H=normalize(L+V);float NdotV=max(dot(N,V),1e-4),NdotH=max(dot(N,H),0.0);
    vec3 F=F0+(1.0-F0)*pow(1.0-max(dot(H,V),0.0),5.0);
    return k22Ggx(NdotH,r*r)*k22Smith(NdotV,NdotL,r)*F/(4.0*NdotV)*radiance;
}
// Legacy dynamic light terms saturate at 1; cap specular radiance the same way so highlights never exceed the light.
vec3 k22DirectCapped(vec3 N,vec3 V,vec3 L,vec3 radiance,vec3 F0,float r){return min(k22Direct(N,V,L,radiance,F0,r),radiance);}
// base/illumination: legacy gamma-space texel and lighting multiplier. Diffuse keeps the legacy product exactly
// for flat normals, metallic 0 and AO 1 apart from the (1-F) energy split. IBL is ambient-only: the environment
// radiance seen in reflections is approximated by the local diffuse exitance albedo*irradiance (no sky cubemap),
// so black surfaces stay black and dielectrics conserve the legacy brightness.
vec3 k22Pbr(vec3 base,vec3 illumination,vec3 p,vec3 Ng,vec3 T,float orientation,vec3 normalSample,vec4 orm,bool roughnessMap,float legacyRoughness,vec3 eye,vec3 sunDir,float sunVisibility,bool useSun){
    vec3 N=Ng;
    if(dot(T,T)>1e-8){vec3 t=T-Ng*dot(Ng,T);if(dot(t,t)>1e-8){t=normalize(t);vec3 m=normalSample*2.0-1.0;N=normalize(t*m.x+cross(Ng,t)*orientation*m.y+Ng*m.z);}}
    float ao=orm.r,roughness=clamp(roughnessMap?orm.g:legacyRoughness,0.05,1.0),metallic=orm.b;
    vec3 albedo=k22Linear(base),irradiance=k22Linear(illumination),V=normalize(eye-p);
    float NdotV=max(dot(N,V),1e-4),bump=0.5+0.5*dot(N,Ng);bump*=bump;
    vec3 F0=mix(vec3(0.04),albedo,metallic),Fr=F0+(max(vec3(1.0-roughness),F0)-F0)*pow(1.0-NdotV,5.0);
    vec2 env=k22EnvBrdf(roughness,NdotV);
    vec3 color=albedo*irradiance*ao*((1.0-Fr)*(1.0-metallic)*bump+(F0*env.x+env.y));
    if(useSun)color+=k22DirectCapped(N,V,normalize(sunDir),vec3(sunVisibility),F0,roughness);
    for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){
        vec4 a=K22_LIGHT(i*5),b=K22_LIGHT(i*5+1),d=K22_LIGHT(i*5+2),e=K22_LIGHT(i*5+3),c=K22_LIGHT(i*5+4);
        if(b.a<0.0||c.z>0.5)continue;
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);
        vec3 L=d.w==3.0?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,0.0001);
        float attenuation=d.w==3.0?1.0:(distance<=a.w?1.0/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,0.0001):0.0);
        if(d.w==2.0){float rho=dot(-L,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1.0:rho<=c.y?0.0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,0.0001),e.w);}
        if(attenuation>0.0){vec3 radiance=k22Linear(clamp(b.rgb*b.a*attenuation,0.0,1.0));
#ifdef K22_PBR_LIGHT_VISIBILITY
            radiance*=K22_PBR_LIGHT_VISIBILITY(i);
#endif
            color+=k22DirectCapped(N,V,L,radiance,F0,roughness);}
    }
    return k22Gamma(color);
}
#endif
```

`native/shaders/ray_query.glsl`:

```glsl
layout(set=1,binding=0) uniform accelerationStructureEXT rtAcceleration;
struct RtInstance { uint64_t vertices; uint64_t indices; uint materialBase; uint padding; vec4 clipPlane; };
struct RtMaterial {
    vec4 uvTransform; vec4 tint; vec4 factors;
    uvec4 metadata; uvec4 frames;
    vec4 normalUvTransform; vec4 ambient; vec4 skillMain; vec4 skillExtra;
    vec4 sunDirection; vec4 cameraPosition;
    vec4 preparedAmbient; vec4 preparedDiffuse; vec4 preparedSpecular; vec4 preparedEmissive;
    vec4 ambientLight; vec4 viewer; ivec4 lightState;
};
layout(set=1,binding=1,std430) readonly buffer RtInstances { RtInstance rtInstances[]; };
layout(set=1,binding=2,std430) readonly buffer RtMaterials { RtMaterial rtMaterials[]; };
layout(set=1,binding=3) uniform sampler2D rtTextures[1024];
layout(buffer_reference,std430,buffer_reference_align=4) readonly buffer RtVertices { float words[]; };
layout(buffer_reference,std430,buffer_reference_align=4) readonly buffer RtIndices { uint words[]; };
vec3 rtPosition(RtVertices v,uint i){uint a=i*13u;return vec3(v.words[a],v.words[a+1u],v.words[a+2u]);}
vec3 rtNormal(RtVertices v,uint i){uint a=i*13u+3u;return vec3(v.words[a],v.words[a+1u],v.words[a+2u]);}
vec3 rtTangent(RtVertices v,uint i){uint a=i*13u+10u;return vec3(v.words[a],v.words[a+1u],v.words[a+2u]);}
vec2 rtUv(RtVertices v,uint i){uint a=i*13u+6u;return vec2(v.words[a],v.words[a+1u]);}
vec3 rtSafeNormal(vec3 v){float s=dot(v,v);return s>0.0?v*inversesqrt(s):vec3(0);}
void rtOrdinaryVertex(RtMaterial m,vec3 p,vec3 n,out vec3 diffuse,out vec3 specular){
    diffuse=m.preparedEmissive.rgb+m.preparedAmbient.rgb*m.ambientLight.rgb;
    specular=vec3(0);
    for(int i=0;i<m.lightState.x;++i){
        vec4 a=lightData[i*5],b=lightData[i*5+1],d=lightData[i*5+2],e=lightData[i*5+3],c=lightData[i*5+4];
        if(b.a<0)continue;
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);
        vec3 direction=d.w==3?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,.0001);
        float attenuation=d.w==3?1:(distance<=a.w?1/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,.0001):0);
        if(d.w==2){float rho=dot(-direction,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1:rho<=c.y?0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,.0001),e.w);}
        float strength=i==m.lightState.y?m.ambientLight.w:1;
        vec3 light=b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation*strength;
        float incidence=max(dot(n,direction),0);
        diffuse+=m.preparedDiffuse.rgb*light*incidence;
        if(any(notEqual(m.preparedSpecular.rgb,vec3(0)))){
            vec3 halfway=rtSafeNormal(direction+m.viewer.xyz);
            float shine=dot(halfway,halfway)>0?(m.preparedSpecular.w==0?1:pow(max(dot(n,halfway),0),m.preparedSpecular.w)):0;
            specular+=m.preparedSpecular.rgb*light*shine;
        }
    }
    diffuse=clamp(diffuse,0,1);specular=clamp(specular,0,1);
}
vec4 rtMaterialHit(uint instanceIndex,uint geometryIndex,uint triangle,bool front,vec2 bary,mat4x3 transform){
    RtInstance instance=rtInstances[instanceIndex];
    RtMaterial m=rtMaterials[instance.materialBase+geometryIndex];
    if((m.metadata.x&16u)==0u && front==((m.metadata.x&32u)!=0u))return vec4(0);
    RtIndices indices=RtIndices(instance.indices);RtVertices vertices=RtVertices(instance.vertices);
    uint a=indices.words[m.frames.z+triangle*3u],b=indices.words[m.frames.z+triangle*3u+1u],c=indices.words[m.frames.z+triangle*3u+2u];
    vec3 w=vec3(1.0-bary.x-bary.y,bary);
    vec3 worldHit=transform*vec4(rtPosition(vertices,a)*w.x+rtPosition(vertices,b)*w.y+rtPosition(vertices,c)*w.z,1);
    if(dot(instance.clipPlane,vec4(worldHit,1))<0.0)return vec4(0);
    vec2 uv=rtUv(vertices,a)*w.x+rtUv(vertices,b)*w.y+rtUv(vertices,c)*w.z;
    vec2 coord=uv*m.uvTransform.xy+m.uvTransform.zw;
    vec4 texel;
    if(m.metadata.w>1u){float cols=floor(1.0/m.uvTransform.x+0.5),f0=float(m.frames.x),f1=float(m.frames.y);texel=mix(textureLod(rtTextures[nonuniformEXT(m.metadata.y)],coord+vec2(mod(f0,cols)/cols,floor(f0/cols)*m.uvTransform.y),0),textureLod(rtTextures[nonuniformEXT(m.metadata.y)],coord+vec2(mod(f1,cols)/cols,floor(f1/cols)*m.uvTransform.y),0),m.factors.y);} // sprite grid cells, see scene.frag
    else texel=textureLod(rtTextures[nonuniformEXT(m.metadata.y)],coord,0);
    if((m.metadata.x&64u)!=0u){
        vec3 light=vec3(0),view=vec3(0);uint ids[3]=uint[3](a,b,c);
        for(uint j=0u;j<3u;++j){uint id=ids[j];vec3 n=rtNormal(vertices,id),t=rtTangent(vertices,id);mat3 basis=transpose(mat3(mat3(transform)*t,mat3(transform)*cross(t,n),mat3(transform)*n));vec3 p=transform*vec4(rtPosition(vertices,id),1);light+=rtSafeNormal(basis*-(m.sunDirection.xyz+((m.metadata.x&128u)==0u?m.skillExtra.xyz:vec3(0))))*w[j];view+=rtSafeNormal(basis*(m.cameraPosition.xyz-p))*w[j];}
        vec3 bump=2.0*textureLod(rtTextures[nonuniformEXT(m.metadata.z)],uv*m.normalUvTransform.xy+m.normalUvTransform.zw,0).rgb-1.0;
        vec3 reflected=rtSafeNormal(2.0*dot(bump,light)*bump-light);
        float specular=m.skillMain.z*pow(clamp(dot(reflected,rtSafeNormal(view)),0.0,1.0),m.skillMain.w);
        vec4 sunlight=(m.metadata.x&128u)==0u?vec4(.9,.9,1,.9):m.skillExtra;
        vec4 result=(m.skillMain.x*m.ambient+m.skillMain.y*clamp(dot(light,bump),0.0,1.0)*sunlight+vec4(specular))*texel;
        // FX has no fragment discard; opaque native passes ignore its output alpha.
        if((m.metadata.x&1024u)==0u)result.a=1.0;
        return result;
    }
    if((m.metadata.x&1u)!=0u&&(max(max(texel.r,texel.g),texel.b)<.001||texel.a<.5))return vec4(0);
    if((m.metadata.x&2u)!=0u&&(m.metadata.x&8u)==0u){float brightness=max(max(texel.r,texel.g),texel.b);texel.a*=((m.metadata.x&4u)!=0u)?1.0-brightness:brightness;}
    vec4 result=texel*m.tint;result.a*=m.factors.x;
    if((m.metadata.x&2048u)!=0u){
        vec3 diffuse=vec3(0),specular=vec3(0);uint ids[3]=uint[3](a,b,c);
        mat3 normalTransform=mat3(transform);
        for(int j=0;j<3;++j){float squared=dot(normalTransform[j],normalTransform[j]);normalTransform[j]=squared>0?normalTransform[j]/squared:vec3(0);}
        float orientation=(m.metadata.x&32u)!=0u?-1:1;
        for(uint j=0u;j<3u;++j){
            vec3 vertexDiffuse,vertexSpecular;
            rtOrdinaryVertex(m,transform*vec4(rtPosition(vertices,ids[j]),1),rtSafeNormal(normalTransform*rtNormal(vertices,ids[j]))*orientation,vertexDiffuse,vertexSpecular);
            diffuse+=vertexDiffuse*w[j];specular+=vertexSpecular*w[j];
        }
        // D3D9 MODULATE2X applies only to textured diffuse; vertex specular is added afterward.
        result.rgb=clamp(clamp(result.rgb*diffuse*2,0,1)+specular,0,1);
    }
    if(result.a<.01)return vec4(0);
    if((m.metadata.x&1024u)==0u)result.a=1.0;
    return result;
}
bool rtAdditive(uint instanceIndex,uint geometryIndex){return (rtMaterials[rtInstances[instanceIndex].materialBase+geometryIndex].metadata.x&(512u|1024u))==(512u|1024u);}
// The committed operand of SPIR-V query getters must remain a compile-time constant.
#define rtHitColor(q,c) rtMaterialHit(rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,c),rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,c),rayQueryGetIntersectionPrimitiveIndexEXT(q,c),rayQueryGetIntersectionFrontFaceEXT(q,c),rayQueryGetIntersectionBarycentricsEXT(q,c),rayQueryGetIntersectionObjectToWorldEXT(q,c))
// Occluders are judged as seen from the light, like the back-face-culled shadow-map caster pass: the ray runs from the
// receiver toward the light, so a one-sided face blocks only when its front faces the light (the ray meets its back).
// One-sided BSP faces that are invisible from the light side therefore pass light, and a light inside its own closed
// emitter model is not self-occluded. Native additive (glow) surfaces add light and never block it.
// Lights often sit inside lamp/pole/emitter fixtures: as with the shadow cube near plane (render_policy::cubeShadowNear),
// geometry closer than this to a point or spot light does not occlude it.
const float rtLightClearance=16.0;
// TLAS instance masks: 1 level/map geometry, 2 models and sprites, 4 models with the original SHADOW flag (actor shadows).
float rtVisibility(vec3 origin,vec3 direction,float maxDistance,uint mask){
    if(maxDistance<=.001||dot(direction,direction)==0.0)return 1.0;
    rayQueryEXT q;rayQueryInitializeEXT(q,rtAcceleration,gl_RayFlagsNoneEXT,mask,origin,.001,normalize(direction),maxDistance);
    float visibility=1.0;
    while(rayQueryProceedEXT(q))if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,false)==gl_RayQueryCandidateIntersectionTriangleEXT&&!rtAdditive(rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,false),rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,false))){vec4 color=rtMaterialHit(rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,false),rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,false),rayQueryGetIntersectionPrimitiveIndexEXT(q,false),!rayQueryGetIntersectionFrontFaceEXT(q,false),rayQueryGetIntersectionBarycentricsEXT(q,false),rayQueryGetIntersectionObjectToWorldEXT(q,false));if(color.a>0.0){visibility*=1.0-clamp(color.a,0.0,1.0);if(visibility<.01){rayQueryTerminateEXT(q);return 0.0;}}}
    return visibility;
}
float rtVisibility(vec3 origin,vec3 direction,float maxDistance){return rtVisibility(origin,direction,maxDistance,255u);}
vec3 rtReflection(vec3 origin,vec3 direction,float maxDistance,vec3 fallback){
    if(maxDistance<=.001||dot(direction,direction)==0.0)return fallback;
    vec3 radiance=vec3(0);float visibility=1.0,minDistance=.001;
    direction=normalize(direction);
    // A straight ray intersects each display triangle at most once: no arbitrary layer cap.
    for(uint layer=0u;layer<rtInstances[0].padding&&minDistance<=maxDistance;++layer){
        rayQueryEXT q;rayQueryInitializeEXT(q,rtAcceleration,gl_RayFlagsNoneEXT,255,origin,minDistance,direction,maxDistance);
        while(rayQueryProceedEXT(q))if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,false)==gl_RayQueryCandidateIntersectionTriangleEXT){vec4 color=rtHitColor(q,false);if(color.a>0.0)rayQueryConfirmIntersectionEXT(q);}
        if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,true)==gl_RayQueryCommittedIntersectionNoneEXT)break;
        vec4 color=rtHitColor(q,true);float alpha=clamp(color.a,0.0,1.0);
        uint flags=rtMaterials[rtInstances[rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,true)].materialBase+rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,true)].metadata.x;
        radiance+=visibility*alpha*color.rgb;
        // Native additive blending adds radiance without obscuring the geometry behind it.
        if((flags&(512u|1024u))!=(512u|1024u))visibility*=1.0-alpha;
        if(visibility<=0.0)return radiance;
        // Advance one representable distance, not a scene-unit epsilon that can skip thin layers.
        minDistance=uintBitsToFloat(floatBitsToUint(rayQueryGetIntersectionTEXT(q,true))+1u);
    }
    return radiance+visibility*fallback;
}
```
