`native/shaders/rt_filter.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Ray-traced signal denoiser. Mode 0: temporal accumulation with reprojection (motion vectors of moving entities, the
// previous view-projection elsewhere), disocclusion rejection (render_policy::history_valid) and a variance clip of the
// history. Mode 1: one edge-aware a-trous iteration (B3 kernel, depth/normal stopping; mirror-smooth reflections and the
// lightmapped actor-shadow mask alpha are not blurred).
layout(local_size_x=8,local_size_y=8) in;
layout(set=0,binding=0,std140) uniform Signals { mat4 inverseViewProjection,previousViewProjection; vec4 eye,sun,params,camera; ivec4 config; vec4 actor; } g;
layout(push_constant) uniform Push { int mode,stride; } pc;
layout(set=0,binding=2) uniform sampler2D gDepth;
layout(set=0,binding=3) uniform sampler2D gData;
layout(set=0,binding=4) uniform sampler2D previousDepth;
layout(set=0,binding=5) uniform sampler2D previousData;
layout(set=0,binding=6) uniform sampler2D motionData;
layout(set=0,binding=10,rgba16f) uniform readonly image2D inMask;
layout(set=0,binding=11,rgba16f) uniform readonly image2D inGi;
layout(set=0,binding=12,rgba16f) uniform readonly image2D inReflect;
layout(set=0,binding=13,rgba16f) uniform readonly image2D historyMask;
layout(set=0,binding=14,rgba16f) uniform readonly image2D historyGi;
layout(set=0,binding=15,rgba16f) uniform readonly image2D historyReflect;
layout(set=0,binding=16,r32f) uniform readonly image2D historyLength;
layout(set=0,binding=17,rgba16f) uniform writeonly image2D outMask;
layout(set=0,binding=18,rgba16f) uniform writeonly image2D outGi;
layout(set=0,binding=19,rgba16f) uniform writeonly image2D outReflect;
layout(set=0,binding=20,r32f) uniform writeonly image2D outLength;
vec3 decodeNormal(vec2 o){vec3 n=vec3(o,1.0-abs(o.x)-abs(o.y));if(n.z<0.0)n.xy=(1.0-abs(n.yx))*vec2(n.x>=0.0?1.0:-1.0,n.y>=0.0?1.0:-1.0);return normalize(n);}
float linearDepth(float d){float n=g.params.w,f=g.eye.w,z=d*2.0-1.0;return 2.0*n*f/(f+n-z*(f-n));}
bool use(int bit){return (g.config.x&bit)!=0;}
// render_policy::variance_clip (gamma 2): history outside the current 3x3 signal mean +- 2 sigma is pulled onto that box,
// so a shadow or bounce that moved with its caster does not linger on the receiver.
vec4 clipHistory(vec4 history,vec4 m1,vec4 m2){vec4 mean=m1/9.0,d=history-mean,e=abs(d)/(sqrt(max(m2/9.0-mean*mean,0.0))*2.0+1e-4);float m=max(max(e.x,e.y),max(e.z,e.w));return m>1.0?mean+d/m:history;}
void main(){
    ivec2 pixel=ivec2(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy),size=g.config.yz;if(pixel.x>=size.x||pixel.y>=size.y)return;
    float depth=texelFetch(gDepth,pixel,0).r;vec4 data=texelFetch(gData,pixel,0);
    if(pc.mode==0){
        vec4 mask=use(1)?imageLoad(inMask,pixel):vec4(1),gi=use(2)?imageLoad(inGi,pixel):vec4(0),reflection=use(4)?imageLoad(inReflect,pixel):vec4(0);float count=0.0;
        if(depth<1.0&&g.config.w!=0){
            // Moving entities follow their motion vector (rasterized like this G-buffer, so the view depths agree).
            vec2 uv=(vec2(pixel)+0.5)/vec2(size),puv;float expected;vec4 motion=texelFetch(motionData,pixel,0);
            if(motion.z>0.0&&abs(motion.z-linearDepth(depth))<=0.01*motion.z){puv=uv+motion.xy;expected=motion.w;}
            else{vec4 world=g.inverseViewProjection*vec4(uv.x*2.0-1.0,1.0-uv.y*2.0,depth*2.0-1.0,1.0);vec4 previous=g.previousViewProjection*vec4(world.xyz/world.w,1.0);puv=vec2(previous.x/previous.w*0.5+0.5,0.5-previous.y/previous.w*0.5);expected=previous.w;}
            if(expected>0.0){ivec2 q=ivec2(floor(puv*vec2(size)));
                if(all(greaterThanEqual(q,ivec2(0)))&&all(lessThan(q,size))){
                    float before=linearDepth(texelFetch(previousDepth,q,0).r);float normalDot=dot(decodeNormal(data.xy),decodeNormal(texelFetch(previousData,q,0).xy));
                    // render_policy::history_valid: 5% relative view-depth change, normal cosine 0.9.
                    if(abs(expected-before)<=0.05*max(expected,before)&&normalDot>=0.9){
                        vec4 m1[3]=vec4[3](vec4(0),vec4(0),vec4(0)),m2[3]=m1;
                        for(int y=-1;y<=1;++y)for(int x=-1;x<=1;++x){ivec2 o=clamp(pixel+ivec2(x,y),ivec2(0),size-1);vec4 s=use(1)?imageLoad(inMask,o):vec4(0);m1[0]+=s;m2[0]+=s*s;s=use(2)?imageLoad(inGi,o):vec4(0);m1[1]+=s;m2[1]+=s*s;s=use(4)?imageLoad(inReflect,o):vec4(0);m1[2]+=s;m2[2]+=s*s;}
                        count=min(imageLoad(historyLength,q).r+1.0,64.0);
                        if(use(1))mask=mix(clipHistory(imageLoad(historyMask,q),m1[0],m2[0]),mask,max(1.0/(count+1.0),0.15));
                        if(use(2))gi=mix(clipHistory(imageLoad(historyGi,q),m1[1],m2[1]),gi,max(1.0/(count+1.0),0.06));
                        if(use(4))reflection=mix(clipHistory(imageLoad(historyReflect,q),m1[2],m2[2]),reflection,max(1.0/(count+1.0),0.15));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if(use(1))imageStore(outMask,pixel,mask);if(use(2))imageStore(outGi,pixel,gi);if(use(4))imageStore(outReflect,pixel,reflection);imageStore(outLength,pixel,vec4(count));
        return;
    }
    vec4 mask=use(1)?imageLoad(inMask,pixel):vec4(1),gi=use(2)?imageLoad(inGi,pixel):vec4(0),reflection=use(4)?imageLoad(inReflect,pixel):vec4(0);
    if(depth<1.0){
        const float taps[3]=float[3](0.375,0.25,0.0625);
        float center=linearDepth(depth);vec3 n=decodeNormal(data.xy);bool blurReflection=data.b>0.05,mapped=(int(data.a+0.5)&1)!=0;
        vec4 sm=vec4(0),sg=vec4(0),sr=vec4(0);float wm=0.0,wr=0.0,sa=0.0,wa=0.0;
        for(int y=-2;y<=2;++y)for(int x=-2;x<=2;++x){
            ivec2 q=pixel+ivec2(x,y)*pc.stride;if(any(lessThan(q,ivec2(0)))||any(greaterThanEqual(q,size)))continue;
            float d=texelFetch(gDepth,q,0).r;if(d>=1.0)continue;vec4 other=texelFetch(gData,q,0);
            float w=taps[abs(x)]*taps[abs(y)]*exp(-abs(linearDepth(d)-center)/(0.02*center*float(pc.stride)))*pow(max(dot(n,decodeNormal(other.xy)),0.0),32.0);
            if(use(1)){vec4 s=imageLoad(inMask,q);sm+=w*s;if(!mapped&&(int(other.a+0.5)&1)==0){sa+=w*s.a;wa+=w;}}if(use(2))sg+=w*imageLoad(inGi,q);wm+=w;
            if(use(4)&&blurReflection){float wq=w*(other.b>0.05?1.0:0.0);sr+=wq*imageLoad(inReflect,q);wr+=wq;}
        }
        // Lightmapped pixels' actor-shadow alpha is only accumulated: its rays aim at small lamps, and the spatial blur thinned
        // a body's shadow strip to half its darkness. On model pixels alpha is the baked-light visibility, blurred among
        // model pixels only (the two encodings never mix).
        if(wm>0.0){if(use(1))mask=vec4((sm/wm).rgb,wa>0.0?sa/wa:mask.a);if(use(2))gi=sg/wm;}
        if(wr>0.0)reflection=sr/wr;
    }
    if(use(1))imageStore(outMask,pixel,mask);if(use(2))imageStore(outGi,pixel,gi);if(use(4))imageStore(outReflect,pixel,reflection);
}

```

`native/shaders/rt_signals.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#extension GL_EXT_ray_query : require
#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference2 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require
#extension GL_EXT_nonuniform_qualifier : require
// Screen-space ray-traced signals of the primary view, one stochastic sample per pixel and frame:
// soft shadows (area sun/point/spot lights, actor shadows, baked-light shadows on models), ambient occlusion, one-bounce
// diffuse GI and roughness-aware reflections. rt_filter.comp accumulates and denoises them; scene.frag consumes them.
layout(local_size_x=8,local_size_y=8) in;
layout(set=0,binding=0,std140) uniform Signals { mat4 inverseViewProjection,previousViewProjection; vec4 eye,sun,params,camera; ivec4 config; vec4 actor,planar; } g;
// eye: xyz position, w far; sun: xyz direction, w angular radius (rad); params: x frame, y GI distance, z occlusion distance, w near;
// camera: xyz forward, w light count; config: x signal bits (1 shadows, 2 GI, 4 reflections), yz size, w history valid;
// actor: x first, y count of the actor-shadow light records appended after the shading lights (render_policy::actor_shadow_lights),
// z SHADOW_ALPHA / 100; planar: xyz direction toward the planar shadow's light (render_policy::planar_light_direction),
// w 1 when the frame has SHADOW casters.
layout(set=0,binding=1,std430) readonly buffer Lights { vec4 lightData[]; };
#include "ray_query.glsl"
layout(set=0,binding=2) uniform sampler2D gDepth;
layout(set=0,binding=3) uniform sampler2D gData;
layout(set=0,binding=10,rgba16f) uniform writeonly image2D outMask;
layout(set=0,binding=11,rgba16f) uniform writeonly image2D outGi;
layout(set=0,binding=12,rgba16f) uniform writeonly image2D outReflect;
uint seed;
uint pcg(uint v){uint s=v*747796405u+2891336453u;uint w=((s>>((s>>28u)+4u))^s)*277803737u;return (w>>22u)^w;}
float rnd(){seed=pcg(seed);return float(seed)*(1.0/4294967296.0);}
vec3 linear(vec3 c){return pow(max(c,vec3(0)),vec3(2.2));}
float luma(vec3 c){return dot(c,vec3(0.299,0.587,0.114));}
vec3 decodeNormal(vec2 o){vec3 n=vec3(o,1.0-abs(o.x)-abs(o.y));if(n.z<0.0)n.xy=(1.0-abs(n.yx))*vec2(n.x>=0.0?1.0:-1.0,n.y>=0.0?1.0:-1.0);return normalize(n);}
mat3 basis(vec3 n){vec3 t=normalize(abs(n.z)<0.999?cross(n,vec3(0,0,1)):cross(n,vec3(1,0,0)));return mat3(t,cross(n,t),n);}
vec3 cosineDirection(vec3 n){float u=rnd(),phi=6.2831853*rnd(),r=sqrt(u);return basis(n)*vec3(r*cos(phi),r*sin(phi),sqrt(1.0-u));}
vec3 sphereOffset(){float z=2.0*rnd()-1.0,phi=6.2831853*rnd(),r=sqrt(max(1.0-z*z,0.0));return vec3(r*cos(phi),r*sin(phi),z);}
// Native light falloffs, as scene.frag: per-vertex world lighting (native) or the per-fragment model loop.
float lightContribution(int i,vec3 p,vec3 n,bool native,out vec3 target,out float range){
    vec4 a=lightData[i*5],b=lightData[i*5+1],d=lightData[i*5+2],e=lightData[i*5+3],c=lightData[i*5+4];
    target=a.xyz;range=0.0;if(b.a<0.0)return 0.0;
    vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);vec3 L;float attenuation;
    if(native){if(c.z>0.5)return 0.0;L=d.w==3.0?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,0.0001);attenuation=d.w==3.0?1.0:(distance<=a.w?1.0/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,0.0001):0.0);
        if(d.w==2.0){float rho=dot(-L,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1.0:rho<=c.y?0.0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,0.0001),e.w);}
        if(d.w==3.0){target=p+L*g.eye.w;range=-1.0;}}
    else{if(c.z>0.5&&d.w==3.0)return 0.0;L=delta/max(distance,0.0001);attenuation=max(1.0-distance/max(a.w,0.0001),0.0);attenuation*=attenuation;}
    if(range==0.0)range=a.w;
    return luma(b.rgb*abs(b.a))*attenuation*max(dot(n,L),0.0);
}
vec3 hitRadiance(uint instanceIndex,uint geometryIndex,uint triangle,bool front,vec2 bary,mat4x3 transform){
    vec4 albedo=rtMaterialHit(instanceIndex,geometryIndex,triangle,front,bary,transform);if(albedo.a<=0.0)return vec3(0);
    RtInstance instance=rtInstances[instanceIndex];RtMaterial m=rtMaterials[instance.materialBase+geometryIndex];uint flags=m.metadata.x;
    if((flags&(64u|2048u|4096u))!=0u)return linear(albedo.rgb)*albedo.a; // Effect, explicit-material and unlit hits are already final.
    RtIndices indices=RtIndices(instance.indices);RtVertices vertices=RtVertices(instance.vertices);
    uint ia=indices.words[m.frames.z+triangle*3u],ib=indices.words[m.frames.z+triangle*3u+1u],ic=indices.words[m.frames.z+triangle*3u+2u];vec3 w=vec3(1.0-bary.x-bary.y,bary);
    vec3 p=transform*vec4(rtPosition(vertices,ia)*w.x+rtPosition(vertices,ib)*w.y+rtPosition(vertices,ic)*w.z,1);
    mat3 normalTransform=mat3(transform);for(int j=0;j<3;++j){float s=dot(normalTransform[j],normalTransform[j]);normalTransform[j]=s>0.0?normalTransform[j]/s:vec3(0);}
    vec3 n=rtSafeNormal(normalTransform*(rtNormal(vertices,ia)*w.x+rtNormal(vertices,ib)*w.y+rtNormal(vertices,ic)*w.z));if(!front)n=-n;
    vec3 illumination;
    if((flags&8192u)!=0u){uint a=ia*13u+8u,b=ib*13u+8u,c=ic*13u+8u;vec2 lm=vec2(vertices.words[a],vertices.words[a+1u])*w.x+vec2(vertices.words[b],vertices.words[b+1u])*w.y+vec2(vertices.words[c],vertices.words[c+1u])*w.z;
        illumination=2.0*clamp(textureLod(rtTextures[nonuniformEXT(uint(m.lightState.z))],lm,0).rgb+vec3(m.factors.z),0.0,1.0);}
    else illumination=vec3(m.factors.w);
    for(int i=0;i<int(g.camera.w);++i){vec4 a=lightData[i*5],b=lightData[i*5+1],d=lightData[i*5+2],e=lightData[i*5+3],c=lightData[i*5+4];if(b.a<0.0||c.z>0.5)continue;
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);vec3 L=d.w==3.0?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,0.0001);float attenuation=d.w==3.0?1.0:(distance<=a.w?1.0/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,0.0001):0.0);
        if(d.w==2.0){float rho=dot(-L,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1.0:rho<=c.y?0.0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,0.0001),e.w);}
        illumination+=clamp(b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation,0.0,1.0)*max(dot(n,L),0.0);}
    return linear(albedo.rgb*illumination)*albedo.a;
}
// Actor shadows on lightmapped surfaces (the A6 planar shadow's replacement; under shadows=rt the planar pass is never
// drawn). The lightmaps already hold the static light and its world shadows, so only models with the original SHADOW
// flag (TLAS mask 4) are traced, toward the lights of render_policy::actor_shadow_lights (baked WMB and native point/spot
// lights whose range holds a caster, and the sun), toward a point jittered within clamp(0.005 range, 0.5, 2) units (lamp
// bulbs are small: the 2-12 unit soft-shadow sphere blurred a body's shadow away a few metres from it). Weight: luma x N.L
// x falloff (baked: linear 1 - d/range; native: its D3D attenuation and cone; sun: 1), at most 1. A blocked baked light
// counts only where the level geometry lets it reach the receiver (else the lightmap holds none of it); the sun counts only
// there at all, so indoor levels get no sun shadow.
// Darkness = SHADOW_ALPHA x min(occluded weight / strongest weight, 1): blocking the receiver's dominant light darkens it
// like the original planar shadow, a weaker light gives a proportionally lighter shadow. Where even the strongest light
// is faint (weight below 0.02) or no light reaches at all, the shadow blends into one cast toward the planar shadow's own
// light direction (g.planar, at SHADOW_ALPHA, regardless of the level geometry like the planar shadow), so every caster
// keeps a shadow close to the original's. Per pixel and frame: the dominant light, one other light picked in proportion
// to its weight (it stands for all the others), and the sun.
float actorWeight(int i,vec3 p,vec3 n,out vec3 L){
    vec4 a=lightData[i*5],b=lightData[i*5+1],d=lightData[i*5+2],e=lightData[i*5+3],c=lightData[i*5+4];
    vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta),attenuation=1.0;L=d.w==3.0?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,0.0001);
    if(d.w!=3.0&&b.a<0.0)attenuation=max(1.0-distance/max(a.w,0.0001),0.0);
    else if(d.w!=3.0){attenuation=distance<=a.w?1.0/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,0.0001):0.0;
        if(d.w==2.0){float rho=dot(-L,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1.0:rho<=c.y?0.0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,0.0001),e.w);}}
    return min(luma(b.rgb*abs(b.a))*attenuation,1.0)*max(dot(n,L),0.0);
}
// Any alpha-tested (as the contact rays) SHADOW caster up to reach: its TLAS instance index, else -1.
int casterHit(vec3 origin,vec3 direction,float reach){
    if(reach<=0.001)return -1;
    rayQueryEXT q;rayQueryInitializeEXT(q,rtAcceleration,gl_RayFlagsTerminateOnFirstHitEXT,4,origin,0.001,direction,reach);
    while(rayQueryProceedEXT(q))if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,false)==gl_RayQueryCandidateIntersectionTriangleEXT&&!rtAdditive(rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,false),rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,false))&&rtHitColor(q,false).a>=0.5)rayQueryConfirmIntersectionEXT(q);
    return rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,true)!=gl_RayQueryCommittedIntersectionNoneEXT?int(rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,true)):-1;
}
// A point/spot light blocked by a caster: the caster instance, else -1. A baked light must also pass the level geometry;
// native lights are D3D hardware lights that shine through walls (and often sit in wall fixtures, as in ev), so they need not.
int lightCaster(int i,vec3 origin){
    vec4 a=lightData[i*5];vec3 toward=a.xyz+sphereOffset()*clamp(a.w*0.005,0.5,2.0)-origin;float reach=length(toward);vec3 direction=toward/max(reach,0.0001);reach=max(reach-rtLightClearance,0.0);
    int hit=casterHit(origin,direction,reach);return hit>=0&&(lightData[i*5+1].a>=0.0||rtVisibility(origin,direction,reach,1u)>=0.5)?hit:-1;
}
float actorShadow(vec3 origin,vec3 n){
    float total=0.0,strongest=0.0,sunLight=0.0;int dominant=-1,sun=-1;vec3 L,sunL=vec3(0);
    for(int j=0;j<int(g.actor.y);++j){int i=int(g.actor.x)+j;float c=actorWeight(i,origin,n,L);if(c<=0.001)continue;
        if(lightData[i*5+2].w==3.0){sun=i;sunLight=c;sunL=L;continue;}
        total+=c;if(c>strongest){strongest=c;dominant=i;}}
    float rest=total-strongest,seen=0.0;int other=-1;
    if(rest>0.001)for(int j=0;j<int(g.actor.y);++j){int i=int(g.actor.x)+j;if(i==dominant||i==sun)continue;float c=actorWeight(i,origin,n,L);if(c<=0.001)continue;seen+=c;if(rnd()*seen<c)other=i;}
    float occluded=(dominant>=0&&lightCaster(dominant,origin)>=0?strongest:0.0)+(other>=0&&lightCaster(other,origin)>=0?rest:0.0);
    int sunHit=-1;vec3 sunDirection=vec3(0);
    if(sun>=0){mat3 frame=basis(sunL);float r=g.sun.w*sqrt(rnd()),phi=6.2831853*rnd();sunDirection=normalize(frame*vec3(r*cos(phi),r*sin(phi),1.0));sunHit=casterHit(origin,sunDirection,g.eye.w);}
    float planar=strongest<0.02&&g.planar.w>0.0&&dot(n,g.planar.xyz)>0.0&&casterHit(origin,g.planar.xyz,g.eye.w)>=0?1.0:0.0;
    if(occluded<=0.0&&sunHit<0&&planar==0.0)return 1.0;
    if(sun>=0){sunLight*=rtVisibility(origin,sunDirection,g.eye.w,1u);if(sunLight>0.001){strongest=max(strongest,sunLight);if(sunHit>=0)occluded+=sunLight;}}
    float lit=min(strongest/0.02,1.0);
    return 1.0-g.actor.z*(lit*min(occluded/max(strongest,0.0001),1.0)+(1.0-lit)*planar);
}
// Model and vertex-lit receivers: visibility of the baked WMB lights that scene.frag adds per pixel (the model light loop,
// enhancedBaked) with the same falloff, against all geometry (the level, every model, the receiver itself), so a character
// is shadowed by its own limbs, by other actors and by the walls. The dominant light is traced every frame and one other in
// proportion to its contribution (it stands for all the others); the ratio scales the baked term.
float bakedWeight(int i,vec3 p,vec3 n){
    vec4 a=lightData[i*5],b=lightData[i*5+1];if(b.a>=0.0)return 0.0;
    vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta),attenuation=max(1.0-distance/max(a.w,0.0001),0.0);
    return luma(b.rgb*abs(b.a))*attenuation*attenuation*max(dot(n,delta/max(distance,0.0001)),0.0);
}
float bakedRay(int i,vec3 origin){
    vec4 a=lightData[i*5];vec3 toward=a.xyz+sphereOffset()*clamp(a.w*0.005,0.5,2.0)-origin;float reach=length(toward);
    return rtVisibility(origin,toward/max(reach,0.0001),max(reach-rtLightClearance,0.0));
}
float bakedVisibility(vec3 p,vec3 origin,vec3 n){
    float total=0.0,strongest=0.0,seen=0.0;int dominant=-1,other=-1;
    for(int i=0;i<int(g.camera.w);++i){float c=bakedWeight(i,p,n);total+=c;if(c>strongest){strongest=c;dominant=i;}}
    if(dominant<0)return 1.0;
    float rest=total-strongest;
    if(rest>0.001*total)for(int i=0;i<int(g.camera.w);++i){if(i==dominant)continue;float c=bakedWeight(i,p,n);if(c<=0.0)continue;seen+=c;if(rnd()*seen<c)other=i;}
    return (strongest*bakedRay(dominant,origin)+(other>=0?rest*bakedRay(other,origin):0.0))/(strongest+(other>=0?rest:0.0));
}
// rtReflection with the transmitted fraction returned separately (the receiving color is not known here).
vec4 reflectionLayers(vec3 origin,vec3 direction,float maxDistance){
    vec3 radiance=vec3(0);float visibility=1.0,minDistance=.001;
    for(uint layer=0u;layer<rtInstances[0].padding&&minDistance<=maxDistance;++layer){
        rayQueryEXT q;rayQueryInitializeEXT(q,rtAcceleration,gl_RayFlagsNoneEXT,255,origin,minDistance,direction,maxDistance);
        while(rayQueryProceedEXT(q))if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,false)==gl_RayQueryCandidateIntersectionTriangleEXT){vec4 color=rtHitColor(q,false);if(color.a>0.0)rayQueryConfirmIntersectionEXT(q);}
        if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,true)==gl_RayQueryCommittedIntersectionNoneEXT)break;
        vec4 color=rtHitColor(q,true);float alpha=clamp(color.a,0.0,1.0);
        uint flags=rtMaterials[rtInstances[rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,true)].materialBase+rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,true)].metadata.x;
        radiance+=visibility*alpha*color.rgb;if((flags&(512u|1024u))!=(512u|1024u))visibility*=1.0-alpha;if(visibility<=0.0)break;
        minDistance=uintBitsToFloat(floatBitsToUint(rayQueryGetIntersectionTEXT(q,true))+1u);
    }
    return vec4(radiance,visibility);
}
// Shadow-terminator origin (Hanika 2021) of model pixels. Low-poly models are shaded with vertex normals but traced
// against flat triangles, so rays leaving a facet near the terminator re-enter neighbouring facets: blocky, acne-like
// self-shadow. The camera ray re-finds the base-mesh triangle under the pixel (tessellated pixels within the PN bulge
// `slack`); the origin is lifted onto the surface its vertex normals describe (outward projection onto each vertex
// tangent plane, weighted by the barycentrics), then offset along the camera-facing geometric normal against acne.
vec3 terminatorOrigin(vec3 p,float bias,vec3 fallback){
    vec3 toward=p-g.eye.xyz;float len=length(toward),slack=max(bias*4.0,len*0.004);if(len<=slack)return fallback;
    rayQueryEXT q;rayQueryInitializeEXT(q,rtAcceleration,gl_RayFlagsNoneEXT,255,g.eye.xyz,len-slack,toward/len,len+slack);
    while(rayQueryProceedEXT(q))if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,false)==gl_RayQueryCandidateIntersectionTriangleEXT&&rtHitColor(q,false).a>=0.5)rayQueryConfirmIntersectionEXT(q);
    if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,true)==gl_RayQueryCommittedIntersectionNoneEXT)return fallback;
    RtInstance instance=rtInstances[rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,true)];RtMaterial m=rtMaterials[instance.materialBase+rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,true)];
    RtIndices indices=RtIndices(instance.indices);RtVertices vertices=RtVertices(instance.vertices);uint first=m.frames.z+rayQueryGetIntersectionPrimitiveIndexEXT(q,true)*3u;
    mat4x3 transform=rayQueryGetIntersectionObjectToWorldEXT(q,true);
    mat3 normalTransform=mat3(transform);for(int j=0;j<3;++j){float s=dot(normalTransform[j],normalTransform[j]);normalTransform[j]=s>0.0?normalTransform[j]/s:vec3(0);}
    vec2 bary=rayQueryGetIntersectionBarycentricsEXT(q,true);vec3 w=vec3(1.0-bary.x-bary.y,bary),v[3],vn[3];
    for(uint j=0u;j<3u;++j){uint id=indices.words[first+j];v[j]=transform*vec4(rtPosition(vertices,id),1);vn[j]=rtSafeNormal(normalTransform*rtNormal(vertices,id));}
    vec3 hit=v[0]*w.x+v[1]*w.y+v[2]*w.z,facet=rtSafeNormal(cross(v[1]-v[0],v[2]-v[0]));if(dot(facet,g.eye.xyz-hit)<0.0)facet=-facet;
    vec3 lifted=hit;for(int j=0;j<3;++j){vec3 nj=dot(vn[j],facet)<0.0?-vn[j]:vn[j];lifted-=w[j]*min(dot(hit-v[j],nj),0.0)*nj;}
    return lifted+facet*bias;
}
void main(){
    ivec2 pixel=ivec2(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy);if(pixel.x>=g.config.y||pixel.y>=g.config.z)return;
    seed=pcg(uint(pixel.x)+uint(pixel.y)*uint(g.config.y))^pcg(uint(g.params.x)*9781u+1u);
    float depth=texelFetch(gDepth,pixel,0).r;vec4 data=texelFetch(gData,pixel,0);int flags=int(data.a+0.5);
    vec4 mask=vec4(1),gi=vec4(0,0,0,1),reflection=vec4(0,0,0,1);
    if(depth<1.0){
        vec2 uv=(vec2(pixel)+0.5)/vec2(g.config.yz);vec4 world=g.inverseViewProjection*vec4(uv.x*2.0-1.0,1.0-uv.y*2.0,depth*2.0-1.0,1.0);vec3 p=world.xyz/world.w,n=decodeNormal(data.xy);
        float viewDistance=length(p-g.eye.xyz);vec3 origin=p+n*max(0.02,viewDistance*0.0005);
        if((flags&5)==0&&(g.config.x&3)!=0)origin=terminatorOrigin(p,max(0.02,viewDistance*0.0005),origin); // Lit, non-lightmapped (model) pixels.
        // Unlit/effect surfaces (flag 4) take no lighting signals but still reflect (original unlit mirrors). Ordinary D3D-lit
        // materials (flag 16: the A6 default mat_model of every campaign model) are lit like native world vertices (D3D
        // attenuation, sun apart). Their lights are D3D hardware lights that shone through the level and every prop, and the
        // level's static shadow reaches them through the floor light they sample, so only the models that cast shadows in
        // the original (SHADOW flag, TLAS mask 4: actors, the receiver itself when it is one) occlude them.
        if((g.config.x&1)!=0&&(flags&4)==0){
            bool ordinary=(flags&16)!=0,native=(flags&2)!=0||ordinary;uint occluders=ordinary?4u:255u;float shadowed=0.0,unshadowed=0.0;
            for(int i=0;i<int(g.camera.w);++i){vec3 target;float range;float c=lightContribution(i,p,n,native,target,range);if(c<=0.0)continue;unshadowed+=c;
                // Area light: a random point on a sphere scaled with the light range (directional: cone around it).
                vec3 jittered=target+sphereOffset()*(range<0.0?g.eye.w*0.01:clamp(range*0.03,2.0,12.0));vec3 delta=jittered-origin;float distance=length(delta);
                shadowed+=c*rtVisibility(origin,delta/max(distance,0.0001),max(distance-(range<0.0?0.01:rtLightClearance),0.0),occluders);}
            mask.r=unshadowed>0.0?shadowed/unshadowed:1.0;
            if((flags&1)==0&&dot(n,g.sun.xyz)>0.0){mat3 b=basis(normalize(g.sun.xyz));float r=g.sun.w*sqrt(rnd()),phi=6.2831853*rnd();mask.g=rtVisibility(origin,normalize(b*vec3(r*cos(phi),r*sin(phi),1.0)),g.eye.w,occluders);}
            // Ambient occlusion: one cosine ray, alpha-tested like the raster pass; additive glow models (lamp cones, flares)
            // are light, not occluders. Lightmapped receivers already hold the level's baked occlusion, so they see only
            // models (instance mask 2: contact shadows of actors, floor at 0.3 as it scales the whole lightmap); model and
            // vertex-lit receivers see everything within reach, themselves included, with a quadratic falloff that keeps
            // the darkening to creases and contacts (scene.frag scales their ambient term).
            bool mapped=(flags&1)!=0;
            rayQueryEXT q;rayQueryInitializeEXT(q,rtAcceleration,gl_RayFlagsNoneEXT,mapped?2:255,origin,0.01,cosineDirection(n),g.params.z);
            while(rayQueryProceedEXT(q))if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,false)==gl_RayQueryCandidateIntersectionTriangleEXT&&!rtAdditive(rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,false),rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,false))&&rtHitColor(q,false).a>=0.5)rayQueryConfirmIntersectionEXT(q);
            if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,true)!=gl_RayQueryCommittedIntersectionNoneEXT){float t=rayQueryGetIntersectionTEXT(q,true)/g.params.z;mask.b=mapped?mix(0.3,1.0,t):1.0-(1.0-t)*(1.0-t);}
            mask.a=mapped?actorShadow(origin,n):ordinary?1.0:bakedVisibility(p,origin,n); // Baked lights do not light ordinary materials.
        }
        if((g.config.x&2)!=0&&(flags&(4|16))==0){ // scene.frag adds GI to its own lighting model only.
            rayQueryEXT q;rayQueryInitializeEXT(q,rtAcceleration,gl_RayFlagsNoneEXT,255,origin,0.01,cosineDirection(n),g.params.y);
            while(rayQueryProceedEXT(q))if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,false)==gl_RayQueryCandidateIntersectionTriangleEXT){vec4 color=rtHitColor(q,false);if(color.a>=0.5)rayQueryConfirmIntersectionEXT(q);}
            if(rayQueryGetIntersectionTypeEXT(q,true)!=gl_RayQueryCommittedIntersectionNoneEXT)
                gi.rgb=hitRadiance(rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT(q,true),rayQueryGetIntersectionGeometryIndexEXT(q,true),rayQueryGetIntersectionPrimitiveIndexEXT(q,true),rayQueryGetIntersectionFrontFaceEXT(q,true),rayQueryGetIntersectionBarycentricsEXT(q,true),rayQueryGetIntersectionObjectToWorldEXT(q,true));
        }
        if((g.config.x&4)!=0&&(flags&8)!=0){
            vec3 V=normalize(g.eye.xyz-p),R=reflect(-V,n);float roughness=data.b;
            if(roughness>0.02){float a=roughness*roughness,u=rnd(),phi=6.2831853*rnd(),cosTheta=sqrt((1.0-u)/(1.0+(a*a-1.0)*u)),sinTheta=sqrt(1.0-cosTheta*cosTheta);vec3 h=basis(n)*vec3(sinTheta*cos(phi),sinTheta*sin(phi),cosTheta);R=reflect(-V,h);if(dot(R,n)<=0.0)R=reflect(-V,n);}
            reflection=reflectionLayers(p,normalize(R),g.eye.w);
        }
    }
    if((g.config.x&1)!=0)imageStore(outMask,pixel,mask);
    if((g.config.x&2)!=0)imageStore(outGi,pixel,gi);
    if((g.config.x&4)!=0)imageStore(outReflect,pixel,reflection);
}
```

```frag
            else if(signalShadows)contribution*=mask.a; // Baked lights on models: rt_signals.comp bakedVisibility.
#else
            if(k22ShadowMaps&&b.a>=0&&attenuation>0)contribution*=cubeMapVisibility(i,n);
#endif
            illumination+=contribution;
        }
#if K22_RAY_QUERY
        if(signals&&(k22RtSignals&2)!=0)illumination=k22Gamma(k22Linear(illumination)+texelFetch(rtGi,ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy),0).rgb);
#endif
    }
    vec3 materialDiffuse=vertexMaterialDiffuse;
#if K22_RAY_QUERY
    if(signalShadows&&explicitMaterial&&!unlit)materialDiffuse=max(materialDiffuse-ordinaryOcclusion(worldPosition,normalize(worldNormal)),0);
#endif
    vec3 rgb=explicitMaterial?clamp(clamp(t.rgb*materialDiffuse*2,0,1)+vertexMaterialSpecular,0,1):t.rgb*illumination;
    if(k22PbrOn&&!unlit&&!explicitMaterial){
#if K22_RAY_QUERY
        float sunVisibility=hasLightmap?1.0:signalShadows?mask.g:k22ShadowMaps?sunMapVisibility(normalize(worldNormal)):directVisibility(sunDirection,rayMaxDistance());
#else
        float sunVisibility=k22ShadowMaps&&!hasLightmap?sunMapVisibility(normalize(worldNormal)):1.0;
#endif
        rgb=k22Pbr(t.rgb,illumination,worldPosition,normalize(worldNormal),worldTangent,normalOrientation,texture(pbrNormal,coord).rgb,texture(pbrOrm,coord),k22RoughnessMap,k22LegacyRoughness,cameraPosition,sunDirection,sunVisibility,!hasLightmap);
    }
#if K22_RAY_QUERY
    // Actor shadows (rt_signals.comp actorShadow) darken the lit surface like the planar shadow they replace (alpha over it).
    if(signalShadows&&hasLightmap)rgb*=mask.a;
#endif
    if(!noFog&&fogRange.y>fogRange.x){float f=clamp((length(worldPosition-cameraPosition)-fogRange.x)/(fogRange.y-fogRange.x),0,1);rgb=mix(rgb,fogColor,f);}
    if(portalEnabled&&reflectionWeight>0&&abs(dot(portalPlane,vec4(worldPosition,1)))<0.1){
        vec4 reflected=portalProjection*vec4(worldPosition,1);
        if(reflected.w>0){vec2 coord=vec2(reflected.x/reflected.w*.5+.5,.5-reflected.y/reflected.w*.5)*portalViewport.zw+portalViewport.xy;rgb=mix(rgb,texture(portalImage,coord).rgb,reflectionWeight);}
    }
#if K22_RAY_QUERY
    if(signals&&(k22RtSignals&4)!=0){if(!portalEnabled&&reflectionWeight>0){vec4 r=texelFetch(rtReflect,ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy),0);rgb=mix(rgb,r.rgb+r.a*rgb,reflectionWeight);}}
    else rgb=reflectedRadiance(rgb);
#endif
    if(k22PbrOn&&k22ToneInShader)rgb=k22ToneMap(rgb);
    color=vec4(rgb,t.a);
}
```

```tesc
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "raster_uniform.glsl"
// tessellation=1: MDL model triangles become PN patches (scene.tese). Every scene.vert varying passes through unchanged.
layout(vertices=3) out;

layout(location=5) out vec3 outEffectLight[];
layout(location=6) out vec3 outEffectView[];

layout(location=8) out vec3 outMaterialSpecular[];
layout(location=9) out vec3 outTangent[];
layout(location=10) out vec4 outPreviousClip[];
// Distance-adaptive level from the edge alone (shared edges get equal levels: no cracks): about one segment per two
// world units of edge at 256 units from the camera, clamped to 1..8, and flat beyond 2000 units.
float edgeLevel(vec3 a,vec3 b){float d=distance((a+b)*0.5,cameraPosition);return d>2000.0?1.0:clamp(distance(a,b)*128.0/max(d,1.0),1.0,8.0);}
void main(){
    #define I gl_InvocationID
    outPosition[I]=inPosition[I];outNormal[I]=inNormal[I];outUv[I]=inUv[I];outLightUv[I]=inLightUv[I];outDynamicLight[I]=inDynamicLight[I];
    outEffectLight[I]=inEffectLight[I];outEffectView[I]=inEffectView[I];outMaterialDiffuse[I]=inMaterialDiffuse[I];outMaterialSpecular[I]=inMaterialSpecular[I];outTangent[I]=inTangent[I];outPreviousClip[I]=inPreviousClip[I];
    if(I==0){
        // Outer level k is the edge opposite corner k.
        gl_TessLevelOuter[0]=edgeLevel(inPosition[1],inPosition[2]);gl_TessLevelOuter[1]=edgeLevel(inPosition[2],inPosition[0]);gl_TessLevelOuter[2]=edgeLevel(inPosition[0],inPosition[1]);
        gl_TessLevelInner[0]=max(gl_TessLevelOuter[0],max(gl_TessLevelOuter[1],gl_TessLevelOuter[2]));
    }
}
```

`native/shaders/scene.tese`:

```tese
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "raster_uniform.glsl"
// Curved PN triangles (Vlachos et al. 2001) over world-space vertices and smoothed normals; everything else is linear.
// Vulkan's upper-left tessellation domain origin: `cw` keeps the input triangle's winding (culling unchanged).
layout(triangles,fractional_odd_spacing,cw) in;
layout(location=0) in vec3 P[];
layout(location=1) in vec3 N[];
layout(location=2) in vec2 inUv[];
layout(location=3) in vec2 inLightUv[];
layout(location=4) in vec3 inDynamicLight[];
layout(location=5) in vec3 inEffectLight[];
layout(location=6) in vec3 inEffectView[];
layout(location=7) in vec3 inMaterialDiffuse[];
layout(location=8) in vec3 inMaterialSpecular[];
layout(location=9) in vec3 inTangent[];
layout(location=10) in vec4 inPreviousClip[];
layout(location=0) out vec3 worldPosition;
layout(location=1) out vec3 worldNormal;
layout(location=2) out vec2 uv;
layout(location=3) out vec2 lmuv;
layout(location=4) out vec3 vertexDynamicLight;
layout(location=5) out vec3 effectLight;
layout(location=6) out vec3 effectView;
layout(location=7) out vec3 vertexMaterialDiffuse;
layout(location=8) out vec3 vertexMaterialSpecular;
layout(location=11) flat out vec4 instanceTint;  // scene.frag interface; only particleInstanced draws (never tessellated) read it.
layout(location=12) flat out vec4 instanceFlags;
layout(location=9) out vec3 worldTangent;
layout(location=10) out vec4 previousClip;
layout(push_constant) uniform CasterPush { mat4 casterViewProjection; } casterPush;
// Edge control point next to corner a toward corner b: a third of the way, projected onto a's tangent plane. The
// projection is invariant to the normal's sign, so mirrored (normalOrientation -1) models bulge the same way.
// k fades the projection out where a corner's shared normal misrepresents an adjacent face (welded box/plate corners
// would inflate into pillows): MDL models carry that PN weight in lightmap_uv.x (render_policy smooth_normals). An
// edge uses the smaller weight of its two corners, so both triangles sharing it agree (no cracks).
vec3 edgePoint(vec3 a,vec3 b,vec3 n,float k){return (2.0*a+b-k*dot(b-a,n)*n)/3.0;}
vec3 edgeNormal(vec3 a,vec3 b,vec3 na,vec3 nb){vec3 e=b-a;float l=dot(e,e);vec3 h=na+nb-(l>0.0?2.0*dot(e,na+nb)/l:0.0)*e;return dot(h,h)>0.0?normalize(h):na;}
void main(){
    instanceTint=tint;instanceFlags=vec4(0);
    vec3 w=gl_TessCoord;
    #define LINEAR(V) (V[0]*w.x+V[1]*w.y+V[2]*w.z)
    uv=LINEAR(inUv);lmuv=LINEAR(inLightUv);vertexDynamicLight=LINEAR(inDynamicLight);effectLight=LINEAR(inEffectLight);effectView=LINEAR(inEffectView);
    vertexMaterialDiffuse=LINEAR(inMaterialDiffuse);vertexMaterialSpecular=LINEAR(inMaterialSpecular);worldTangent=LINEAR(inTangent);
    vec3 n0=normalize(N[0]),n1=normalize(N[1]),n2=normalize(N[2]);
    float k01=min(inLightUv[0].x,inLightUv[1].x),k12=min(inLightUv[1].x,inLightUv[2].x),k20=min(inLightUv[2].x,inLightUv[0].x);
    vec3 b210=edgePoint(P[0],P[1],n0,k01),b120=edgePoint(P[1],P[0],n1,k01),b021=edgePoint(P[1],P[2],n1,k12),b012=edgePoint(P[2],P[1],n2,k12),b102=edgePoint(P[2],P[0],n2,k20),b201=edgePoint(P[0],P[2],n0,k20);
    vec3 e=(b210+b120+b021+b012+b102+b201)/6.0,b111=e+(e-(P[0]+P[1]+P[2])/3.0)*0.5;
    float wa=w.x,wb=w.y,wc=w.z; // `u` is the uniform block (raster_uniform.glsl).
    precise vec3 p=P[0]*wa*wa*wa+P[1]*wb*wb*wb+P[2]*wc*wc*wc+3.0*(b210*wa*wa*wb+b120*wa*wb*wb+b021*wb*wb*wc+b012*wb*wc*wc+b102*wc*wc*wa+b201*wc*wa*wa)+6.0*b111*wa*wb*wc;
    worldPosition=p;
    // Motion pass: clip space is linear in position, so carry the PN bulge into the previous frame unchanged.
    previousClip=k22Pass==3?LINEAR(inPreviousClip)+u.dataPreviousViewProjection*vec4(p-LINEAR(P),0):vec4(0);
    worldNormal=normalize(n0*wa*wa+n1*wb*wb+n2*wc*wc+edgeNormal(P[0],P[1],n0,n1)*wa*wb+edgeNormal(P[1],P[2],n1,n2)*wb*wc+edgeNormal(P[2],P[0],n2,n0)*wc*wa);
    gl_Position=(k22Pass==1?casterPush.casterViewProjection:viewProjection)*vec4(p,1);
    gl_Position.y=-gl_Position.y;
    gl_Position.z=(gl_Position.z+gl_Position.w)*.5;
    gl_ClipDistance[0]=dot(clipPlane,vec4(p,1));
}
```

`native/shaders/scene.vert`:

```vert
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "raster_uniform.glsl"
layout(location=0) in vec3 position;
layout(location=1) in vec3 normal;
layout(location=2) in vec2 texcoord;
layout(location=3) in vec2 lightcoord;
layout(location=4) in vec3 tangent;
layout(location=0) out vec3 worldPosition;
layout(location=1) out vec3 worldNormal;
layout(location=2) out vec2 uv;
layout(location=3) out vec2 lmuv;
layout(location=4) out vec3 vertexDynamicLight;
layout(location=5) out vec3 effectLight;
layout(location=6) out vec3 effectView;
layout(location=7) out vec3 vertexMaterialDiffuse;
layout(location=8) out vec3 vertexMaterialSpecular;
layout(location=9) out vec3 worldTangent;
layout(location=10) out vec4 previousClip; // Motion-vector pass (3): previous-frame clip position.
layout(location=11) flat out vec4 instanceTint;  // particleInstanced: per-particle tint, else the uniform tint.
layout(location=12) flat out vec4 instanceFlags; // particleInstanced: flare, overlay, invertFlare.
layout(set=0,binding=5,std430) readonly buffer Lights { vec4 lightData[]; };
// Pass 3 with dataPass.y set: the previous frame's GPU-deformed pose (PackedVertex, 13 floats per vertex).
layout(set=0,binding=6,std430) readonly buffer PreviousPose { float previousPose[]; };
// Shadow-caster pass (pass 1): the face view-projection is pushed per face; caster descriptor sets are shared by all faces.
layout(push_constant) uniform CasterPush { mat4 casterViewProjection; } casterPush;
vec3 nativeDynamic(vec3 p,vec3 n){
    vec3 result=vec3(0);
    for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){
        vec4 a=lightData[i*5],b=lightData[i*5+1],d=lightData[i*5+2],e=lightData[i*5+3],c=lightData[i*5+4];
        if(b.a<0)continue;
        if(c.z>0.5)continue;
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);
        vec3 direction=d.w==3?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,.0001);
        float attenuation=d.w==3?1:(distance<=a.w?1/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,.0001):0);
        if(d.w==2){float rho=dot(-direction,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1:rho<=c.y?0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,.0001),e.w);}
        result+=b.rgb*abs(b.a)*attenuation*max(dot(n,direction),0);
    }
    return clamp(result,0,1);
}
void ordinaryMaterial(vec3 p,vec3 n,out vec3 diffuse,out vec3 specular){
    diffuse=preparedEmissive+preparedAmbient.rgb*ambientLight;specular=vec3(0);
    for(int i=0;i<lightCount;++i){
        vec4 a=lightData[i*5],b=lightData[i*5+1],d=lightData[i*5+2],e=lightData[i*5+3],c=lightData[i*5+4];
        if(b.a<0)continue;
        vec3 delta=a.xyz-p;float distance=length(delta);
        vec3 direction=d.w==3?-d.xyz:delta/max(distance,.0001);
        float attenuation=d.w==3?1:(distance<=a.w?1/max(e.x+e.y*distance+e.z*distance*distance,.0001):0);
        if(d.w==2){float rho=dot(-direction,d.xyz);attenuation*=rho>=c.x?1:rho<=c.y?0:pow((rho-c.y)/max(c.x-c.y,.0001),e.w);}
        vec3 light=b.rgb*b.a*attenuation*(i==selectedLight?materialSunStrength:1);
        diffuse+=preparedDiffuse*light*max(dot(n,direction),0);
        vec3 halfVector=direction+infiniteViewer;float magnitude=length(halfVector);
        if(any(notEqual(preparedSpecular,vec3(0)))){
            float power=magnitude>0?(materialPower==0?1:pow(max(dot(n,halfVector/magnitude),0),materialPower)):0;
            specular+=preparedSpecular*light*power;
        }
    }
    diffuse=clamp(diffuse,0,1);specular=clamp(specular,0,1);
}
void main(){
    vertexDynamicLight=vec3(0);vertexMaterialDiffuse=vec3(0);vertexMaterialSpecular=vec3(0);effectLight=vec3(0);effectView=vec3(0);
    mat4 drawModel=model;instanceTint=tint;instanceFlags=vec4(0);
    if(particleInstanced){int b=gl_InstanceIndex*24;drawModel=mat4(previousPose[b],previousPose[b+1],previousPose[b+2],previousPose[b+3],previousPose[b+4],previousPose[b+5],previousPose[b+6],previousPose[b+7],previousPose[b+8],previousPose[b+9],previousPose[b+10],previousPose[b+11],previousPose[b+12],previousPose[b+13],previousPose[b+14],previousPose[b+15]);
        instanceTint=vec4(previousPose[b+16],previousPose[b+17],previousPose[b+18],previousPose[b+19]);instanceFlags=vec4(previousPose[b+20],previousPose[b+21],previousPose[b+22],0);}
    vec4 w=drawModel*vec4(position,1);worldPosition=w.xyz;worldNormal=normalize(normalMatrix*normal)*normalOrientation;worldTangent=mat3(drawModel)*tangent;
    if(worldVertexLighting)vertexDynamicLight=nativeDynamic(worldPosition,worldNormal);
    if(explicitMaterial&&effectKind==0)ordinaryMaterial(worldPosition,worldNormal,vertexMaterialDiffuse,vertexMaterialSpecular);
    if(effectKind!=0){mat3 basis=transpose(mat3(mat3(model)*tangent,mat3(model)*cross(tangent,normal),mat3(model)*normal));effectLight=normalize(basis*-(sunDirection+(effectKind==1?skillExtra.xyz:vec3(0))));effectView=normalize(basis*(cameraPosition-w.xyz));}
    uv=texcoord;lmuv=lightcoord;
    int base=gl_VertexIndex*13;previousClip=k22Pass==3?u.dataPreviousViewProjection*(u.dataPreviousModel*vec4(u.dataPass.y!=0?vec3(previousPose[base],previousPose[base+1],previousPose[base+2]):position,1)):vec4(0);
    gl_Position=(k22Pass==1?casterPush.casterViewProjection:viewProjection)*w;
    gl_Position.y=-gl_Position.y;
    gl_Position.z=(gl_Position.z+gl_Position.w)*.5;
    gl_ClipDistance[0]=dot(clipPlane,w);
}
```

`native/shaders/shadow.geom`:

```geom
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "raster_uniform.glsl"
layout(triangles) in;
layout(triangle_strip,max_vertices=42) out;
layout(location=0) in float planeDistance[];
layout(location=1) in vec3 projectedPosition[];
layout(location=0) flat out float opacity;
layout(location=1) out vec3 shadowPosition;
float distanceToPlane(vec4 p,int plane){
    if(plane==0)return p.z+p.w;
    if(plane==1)return p.x+p.w;if(plane==2)return p.w-p.x;
    if(plane==3)return p.y+p.w;return p.w-p.y;
}
void main(){
    vec4 polygon[10],scratch[10];float pd[10],sd[10];vec3 positions[10],sp[10];int count=3;
    for(int i=0;i<3;++i){polygon[i]=gl_in[i].gl_Position;pd[i]=planeDistance[i];positions[i]=projectedPosition[i];}
    for(int plane=0;plane<6&&count>0;++plane){
        int outputCount=0;
        for(int i=0;i<count;++i){
            int j=(i+count-1)%count;float a=plane==5?pd[j]:distanceToPlane(polygon[j],plane),b=plane==5?pd[i]:distanceToPlane(polygon[i],plane);
            if((a>=0)!=(b>=0)){float t=a/(a-b);scratch[outputCount]=mix(polygon[j],polygon[i],t);sd[outputCount]=mix(pd[j],pd[i],t);sp[outputCount++]=mix(positions[j],positions[i],t);}
            if(b>=0){scratch[outputCount]=polygon[i];sd[outputCount]=pd[i];sp[outputCount++]=positions[i];}
        }
        count=outputCount;for(int i=0;i<count;++i){polygon[i]=scratch[i];pd[i]=sd[i];positions[i]=sp[i];}
    }
    for(int i=1;i+1<count;++i){
        vec4 triangle[3];triangle[0]=polygon[0];triangle[1]=polygon[i];triangle[2]=polygon[i+1];
        vec2 p[3];for(int j=0;j<3;++j)p[j]=triangle[j].xy/triangle[j].w*viewport*.5;
        // Original source screen Y runs down; area is evaluated before Vulkan conversion.
        float area=-((p[0].y-p[1].y)*(p[0].x-p[2].x)-(p[0].x-p[1].x)*(p[0].y-p[2].y));
        if(reversed?area>areaThreshold:area<areaThreshold)continue;
        for(int duplicate=0;duplicate<2;++duplicate){
            opacity=duplicate==0?alpha:0;
            for(int j=0;j<3;++j){
                gl_Position=triangle[j];shadowPosition=positions[j==0?0:j==1?i:i+1];
                gl_Position.y=-gl_Position.y;
                gl_Position.z=(gl_Position.z+gl_Position.w)*.5;
                if(duplicate!=0)gl_Position.z-=0.00048828125*gl_Position.w;
                EmitVertex();
            }
            EndPrimitive();
        }
    }
}
```

```vert
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
```

```frag
layout(location=0) in vec2 uv;

layout(location=0) out vec4 color;
void main(){
    vec2 screen=vec2(uv.x-.5,uv.y-.5);vec3 ray=normalMatrix*vec3(1,-screen.x*cone.x,-screen.y*cone.y);vec2 coord;int face=layer;float fade=1;
    if(cube){
        vec3 a=abs(ray);float m=max(max(a.x,a.y),a.z);
        if(a.x>=a.y&&a.x>=a.z){face=ray.x<0?0:2;coord=vec2(ray.x<0?ray.y:-ray.y,-ray.z)/m;}
        else if(a.y>=a.z){face=ray.y>0?1:3;coord=vec2(ray.y>0?ray.x:-ray.x,-ray.z)/m;}
        else{face=ray.z<0?4:5;coord=vec2(ray.x,ray.z<0?-ray.y:ray.y)/m;}

    }else{

        coord=(curve*.5)*n.xy+scroll;if(blend)fade=clamp(n.z-clip,0,1);
    }
    color=texture(image,vec3(coord,face));color.a*=floor(fade*255)/255;
}
```

`native/texture_pack.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "texture_pack.hpp"

extern "C" {
#include <libavcodec/avcodec.h>
#include <libavutil/error.h>
#include <libavutil/frame.h>

namespace k22 {
namespace {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
constexpr std::uint32_t maxSide = 8192;
constexpr std::uintmax_t maxPng = 64ULL * 1024 * 1024, maxManifest = 1024 * 1024;
constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t, 8> pngSignature{137, 'P', 'N', 'G', 13, 10, 26, 10};
constexpr std::array<const char*, 5> kindNames{"albedo", "normal", "roughness", "metallic", "ao"};
struct CodecFree { void operator()(AVCodecContext* p) const { avcodec_free_context(&p); } };
struct FrameFree { void operator()(AVFrame* p) const { av_frame_free(&p); } };
struct PacketFree { void operator()(AVPacket* p) const { av_packet_free(&p); } };
struct SwsFree { void operator()(SwsContext* p) const { sws_freeContext(p); } };
// Original resource/material names are Windows-1254 bytes; index.tsv is UTF-8 with TSV control bytes replaced.
std::string tsv_utf8(std::string_view name) {
    std::string out;iconv_t converter = iconv_open("UTF-8", "WINDOWS-1254");
    if (converter == (iconv_t)-1) throw std::runtime_error("Windows-1254 conversion unavailable");
    for (unsigned char byte : name) {
        if (byte < 0x20) { out += '_'; continue; }
        char in = char(byte), buffer[4]{}; char* input = &in; char* output = buffer; std::size_t inLeft = 1, outLeft = sizeof(buffer);
        if (iconv(converter, &input, &inLeft, &output, &outLeft) == std::size_t(-1)) out += '?'; else out.append(buffer, sizeof(buffer) - outLeft);
    }
    iconv_close(converter);return out;
}
using Codec = std::unique_ptr<AVCodecContext, CodecFree>;
using Frame = std::unique_ptr<AVFrame, FrameFree>;
using Packet = std::unique_ptr<AVPacket, PacketFree>;
void check(int result, const char* operation) {
    if (result >= 0) return;
    std::array<char, AV_ERROR_MAX_STRING_SIZE> error{};
    av_strerror(result, error.data(), error.size());
    throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + error.data());
}
std::string lower(std::string_view text) {
    std::string out(text);
    for (auto& c : out) c = c == '\\' ? '/' : c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' ? char(c + 32) : c;
    return out;
}
bool inside(const fs::path& child, const fs::path& parent) {
    auto relative = child.lexically_relative(parent);
    return !relative.empty() && *relative.begin() != "..";
}
std::vector<std::uint8_t> read_file(const fs::path& path, std::uintmax_t limit) {
    auto size = fs::file_size(path);
    if (size > limit) throw std::runtime_error("file exceeds size limit");
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes(size);
    if (!in || (size && !in.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()), std::streamsize(size))))
        throw std::runtime_error("cannot read " + path.string());
    return bytes;
}
void write_file(const fs::path& path, std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes) {
    std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    if (!out || !out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), std::streamsize(bytes.size())) || !out.flush())
        throw std::runtime_error("cannot write " + path.string());
}
bool valid_image(const Image& image) {
    return image.width && image.height && image.rgba.size() == std::size_t(image.width) * image.height * 4;
}
// PNG width/height from the 33-byte signature+IHDR prefix, without decoding.
std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t> png_header(const fs::path& path) {
    std::array<std::uint8_t, 33> header{};
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!in.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(header.data()), header.size())) throw std::runtime_error("truncated PNG header");
    auto big = [&](std::size_t o) { return std::uint32_t(header[o]) << 24 | std::uint32_t(header[o + 1]) << 16 | std::uint32_t(header[o + 2]) << 8 | header[o + 3]; };
    if (!std::equal(pngSignature.begin(), pngSignature.end(), header.begin())) throw std::runtime_error("not a PNG file");
    if (big(8) != 13 || std::memcmp(header.data() + 12, "IHDR", 4) != 0) throw std::runtime_error("missing PNG IHDR");
    return {big(16), big(20)};
}
}

std::uint64_t texture_key(const Image& image) {
    if (!valid_image(image)) throw std::runtime_error("texture key requires a valid RGBA8 image");
    std::uint64_t hash = 0xcbf29ce484222325ULL;
    auto mix = [&](std::uint8_t byte) { hash = (hash ^ byte) * 0x100000001b3ULL; };
    for (std::uint32_t value : {image.width, image.height})
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) mix(std::uint8_t(value >> (8 * i)));
    for (auto byte : image.rgba) mix(byte);
    return hash;
}
std::string texture_key_hex(std::uint64_t key) {
    std::string text(16, '0');
    for (int i = 15; i >= 0; --i, key >>= 4) text[i] = "0123456789abcdef"[key & 15];
    return text;
}

Image decode_png(std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes) {
    if (bytes.size() < pngSignature.size() || !std::equal(pngSignature.begin(), pngSignature.end(), bytes.begin()))
        throw std::runtime_error("not a PNG file");
    if (bytes.size() > maxPng) throw std::runtime_error("PNG exceeds 64 MiB");
    const AVCodec* decoder = avcodec_find_decoder(AV_CODEC_ID_PNG);
    if (!decoder) throw std::runtime_error("PNG decoder unavailable");
    Codec codec(avcodec_alloc_context3(decoder));
    Frame frame(av_frame_alloc());
    Packet packet(av_packet_alloc());
    if (!codec || !frame || !packet) throw std::bad_alloc();
    codec->err_recognition = AV_EF_CRCCHECK | AV_EF_CAREFUL | AV_EF_EXPLODE;
    check(avcodec_open2(codec.get(), decoder, nullptr), "Opening PNG decoder");
    check(av_new_packet(packet.get(), int(bytes.size())), "PNG packet allocation");
    std::memcpy(packet->data, bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    check(avcodec_send_packet(codec.get(), packet.get()), "Submitting PNG");
    check(avcodec_receive_frame(codec.get(), frame.get()), "Decoding PNG");
    if (frame->width <= 0 || frame->height <= 0 || frame->width > int(maxSide) || frame->height > int(maxSide))
        throw std::runtime_error("PNG dimensions outside 1..8192");
    Image image{std::uint32_t(frame->width), std::uint32_t(frame->height), std::vector<std::uint8_t>(std::size_t(frame->width) * frame->height * 4)};
    const auto format = AVPixelFormat(frame->format);
    if (format == AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA) {
        for (int y = 0; y < frame->height; ++y)
            std::memcpy(image.rgba.data() + std::size_t(y) * frame->width * 4, frame->data[0] + std::ptrdiff_t(y) * frame->linesize[0], std::size_t(frame->width) * 4);
        return image;
    }
    std::unique_ptr<SwsContext, SwsFree> scale(sws_getContext(frame->width, frame->height, format, frame->width, frame->height,
        AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA, SWS_POINT | SWS_ACCURATE_RND | SWS_BITEXACT, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr));
    if (!scale) throw std::runtime_error("Unable to convert PNG pixels");
    // Gray PNG samples are full-range luma; keep 8-bit values exact as R=G=B.
    const int* table = sws_getCoefficients(SWS_CS_DEFAULT);
    sws_setColorspaceDetails(scale.get(), table, 1, table, 1, 0, 1 << 16, 1 << 16);
    std::uint8_t* destinations[4] = {image.rgba.data(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
    int strides[4] = {frame->width * 4, 0, 0, 0};
    check(sws_scale(scale.get(), frame->data, frame->linesize, 0, frame->height, destinations, strides), "Converting PNG pixels");
    return image;
}
std::vector<std::uint8_t> encode_png(const Image& image) {
    if (!valid_image(image) || image.width > maxSide || image.height > maxSide) throw std::runtime_error("PNG encode requires a valid RGBA8 image up to 8192 px");
    const AVCodec* encoder = avcodec_find_encoder(AV_CODEC_ID_PNG);
    if (!encoder) throw std::runtime_error("PNG encoder unavailable");
    Codec codec(avcodec_alloc_context3(encoder));
    Frame frame(av_frame_alloc());
    Packet packet(av_packet_alloc());
    if (!codec || !frame || !packet) throw std::bad_alloc();
    codec->width = int(image.width); codec->height = int(image.height);
    codec->pix_fmt = AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA; codec->time_base = {1, 1};
    check(avcodec_open2(codec.get(), encoder, nullptr), "Opening PNG encoder");
    frame->width = codec->width; frame->height = codec->height; frame->format = AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA;
    check(av_frame_get_buffer(frame.get(), 0), "PNG frame allocation");
    for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < image.height; ++y)
        std::memcpy(frame->data[0] + std::ptrdiff_t(y) * frame->linesize[0], image.rgba.data() + std::size_t(y) * image.width * 4, std::size_t(image.width) * 4);
    check(avcodec_send_frame(codec.get(), frame.get()), "Submitting PNG frame");
    check(avcodec_send_frame(codec.get(), nullptr), "Flushing PNG encoder");
    check(avcodec_receive_packet(codec.get(), packet.get()), "Encoding PNG");
    return {packet->data, packet->data + packet->size};
}

Image upscale_texture_2x(const Image& in, bool wrap) {
    if (!valid_image(in)) throw std::runtime_error("Texture upscale requires a valid RGBA8 image");
    const int w = int(in.width), h = int(in.height), W = w * 2, H = h * 2;
    auto at = [wrap](int i, int n) { return wrap ? (i % n + n) % n : std::clamp(i, 0, n - 1); };
    // upscale.py bleed(): visible colour grows 4 texels into alpha-0 texels, so colour-key RGB never reaches visible edges.
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> src = in.rgba, seen(std::size_t(w) * h);
    bool any = false, all = true;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < seen.size(); ++i) { seen[i] = src[i * 4 + 3] > 0; any |= bool(seen[i]); all &= bool(seen[i]); }
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 4 && any && !all; ++pass) {
        auto next = seen; all = true;
        for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
            const std::size_t i = std::size_t(y) * w + x; if (seen[i]) continue;
            int sum[3]{}, n = 0;
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) { const std::size_t j = std::size_t(at(y + dy, h)) * w + at(x + dx, w); if (seen[j]) { for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) sum[c] += src[j * 4 + c]; ++n; } }
            if (n) { for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) src[i * 4 + c] = std::uint8_t((sum[c] + n / 2) / n); next[i] = 1; } else all = false;
        }
        seen.swap(next);
    }
    std::array<std::uint32_t, 17> colours{}; std::size_t distinct = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < in.rgba.size() && distinct <= 16; i += 4) { std::uint32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, &in.rgba[i], 4); if (std::find(colours.begin(), colours.begin() + distinct, v) == colours.begin() + distinct) colours[distinct++] = v; }
    Image out{in.width * 2, in.height * 2, std::vector<std::uint8_t>(std::size_t(W) * H * 4), in.sourceDepth, in.nativeStorageBytes, in.nativeTextureAlpha, in.a6AlphaFormat};
    auto texel = [&](int x, int y) { return src.data() + (std::size_t(at(y, h)) * w + at(x, w)) * 4; };
    auto put = [&](int X, int Y, const std::uint8_t* rgb) { std::memcpy(&out.rgba[(std::size_t(Y) * W + X) * 4], rgb, 3); };
    if (distinct <= 16) {
        // Flat/low-colour art (signage, text): Scale2x/EPX, upscale.py scale2x(); only existing colours are emitted.
        auto same = [](const std::uint8_t* a, const std::uint8_t* b) { return std::memcmp(a, b, 4) == 0; };
        for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
            const auto *P = texel(x, y), *A = texel(x, y - 1), *B = texel(x + 1, y), *C = texel(x - 1, y), *D = texel(x, y + 1);
            put(2 * x, 2 * y, same(C, A) && !same(C, D) && !same(A, B) ? A : P);
            put(2 * x + 1, 2 * y, same(A, B) && !same(A, C) && !same(B, D) ? B : P);
            put(2 * x, 2 * y + 1, same(D, C) && !same(D, B) && !same(C, A) ? C : P);
            put(2 * x + 1, 2 * y + 1, same(B, D) && !same(B, A) && !same(D, C) ? D : P);
        }
    } else {
        // Photographic surfaces: separable Lanczos-3 (2x phases at -/+0.25 texel), then upscale.py's mild unsharp mask
        // (35 %, threshold 2). Deterministic and never invents structure.
        float weights[2][6];
        for (int ph = 0; ph < 2; ++ph) {
            float total = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) { const double p = std::numbers::pi * ((j - 3 + ph) - (ph ? 0.25 : -0.25)); total += weights[ph][j] = float(3 * std::sin(p) * std::sin(p / 3) / (p * p)); }
            for (auto& v : weights[ph]) v /= total;
        }
        // Row bands on every core: this runs once per texture during level load.
        auto bands = [](int count, const auto& fn) {
            const int n = std::clamp(int(std::thread::hardware_concurrency()), 1, 16), step = (count + n - 1) / n;
            if (count < 64 || n == 1) { fn(0, count); return; }
            std::vector<std::jthread> pool;
            for (int b = step; b < count; b += step) pool.emplace_back([&fn, b, step, count] { fn(b, std::min(count, b + step)); });
            fn(0, step);
        };
        const std::size_t stride = std::size_t(W) * 3;
        std::vector<int> taps(std::size_t(W) * 6), left(W), right(W);
        for (int X = 0; X < W; ++X) { for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) taps[X * 6 + j] = at((X >> 1) + j - 3 + (X & 1), w) * 4; left[X] = at(X - 1, W) * 3; right[X] = at(X + 1, W) * 3; }
        std::vector<float> row(stride * h), col(stride * H), tmp(stride * H);
        bands(h, [&](int y0, int y1) {
            for (int y = y0; y < y1; ++y) {
                const auto* s = &src[std::size_t(y) * w * 4]; float* o = &row[y * stride];
                for (int X = 0; X < W; ++X, o += 3) { const float* k = weights[X & 1]; const int* t = &taps[X * 6]; for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) o[c] += k[j] * s[t[j] + c]; }
            }
        });
        bands(H, [&](int y0, int y1) {
            for (int Y = y0; Y < y1; ++Y) {
                float* o = &col[Y * stride];
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) { const float* r = &row[at((Y >> 1) + j - 3 + (Y & 1), h) * stride]; const float k = weights[Y & 1][j]; for (std::size_t i = 0; i < stride; ++i) o[i] += k * r[i]; }
                float* b = &tmp[Y * stride];
                for (int X = 0; X < W; ++X) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) b[X * 3 + c] = (o[left[X] + c] + 2 * o[X * 3 + c] + o[right[X] + c]) * 0.25f;
            }
        });
        bands(H, [&](int y0, int y1) {
            for (int Y = y0; Y < y1; ++Y) {
                const float *v = &col[Y * stride], *up = &tmp[at(Y - 1, H) * stride], *mid = &tmp[Y * stride], *down = &tmp[at(Y + 1, H) * stride];
                auto* o = &out.rgba[std::size_t(Y) * W * 4];
                for (int X = 0; X < W; ++X) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
                    const std::size_t i = std::size_t(X) * 3 + c; float x = v[i];
                    const float d = x - (up[i] + 2 * mid[i] + down[i]) * 0.25f;
                    if (std::abs(d) > 2) x += 0.35f * d;
                    o[X * 4 + c] = std::uint8_t(std::clamp(x + 0.5f, 0.f, 255.f));
                }
            }
        });
    }
    // Alpha is nearest-scaled: alpha-test coverage is identical at every threshold, including the game's references.
    for (int Y = 0; Y < H; ++Y) for (int X = 0; X < W; ++X) out.rgba[(std::size_t(Y) * W + X) * 4 + 3] = in.rgba[(std::size_t(Y >> 1) * w + (X >> 1)) * 4 + 3];
    return out;
}

fs::path texture_pack_root() {
    const char* xdg = std::getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME");
    if (xdg && *xdg && fs::path(xdg).is_absolute()) return fs::path(xdg) / "kabus22/packs";
    const char* home = std::getenv("HOME");
    if (!home || !*home) throw std::runtime_error("HOME or XDG_DATA_HOME required for texture packs");
    return fs::path(home) / ".local/share/kabus22/packs";
}

TexturePack load_texture_pack(const fs::path& directory) {
    TexturePack pack;
    pack.name = directory.filename().string();
    pack.path = directory;
    try {
        std::error_code ec;
        if (!fs::is_directory(directory, ec)) { pack.detail = "missing directory"; return pack; }
        const auto manifest = directory / "pack.txt";
        if (!fs::is_regular_file(fs::symlink_status(manifest, ec))) { pack.detail = "missing pack.txt (regular file, not symlink)"; return pack; }
        auto bytes = read_file(manifest, maxManifest);
        std::string_view text(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size());
        struct Raw { std::uint64_t key; std::size_t kind; std::string path; };
        std::vector<Raw> raw;
        std::unordered_set<std::string> seen;
        bool hasName = false, hasLicense = false;
        std::size_t number = 0;
        auto malformed = [&](std::string reason) { pack.detail = "pack.txt line " + std::to_string(number) + ": " + reason; return pack; };
        for (std::size_t start = 0; start <= text.size();) {
            auto end = std::min(text.find('\n', start), text.size());
            auto line = text.substr(start, end - start);
            start = end + 1; ++number;
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.remove_suffix(1);
            if (number == 1) { if (line != "kabus22-texture-pack 1") return malformed("expected header 'kabus22-texture-pack 1'"); continue; }
            if (line.empty()) continue;
            std::vector<std::string_view> fields;
            for (std::size_t p = 0;;) { auto tab = line.find('\t', p); fields.push_back(line.substr(p, tab - p)); if (tab == line.npos) break; p = tab + 1; }
            if (fields.size() == 2 && (fields[0] == "name" || fields[0] == "license")) {
                bool& flag = fields[0] == "name" ? hasName : hasLicense;
                if (flag) return malformed("duplicate " + std::string(fields[0]));
                if (!raw.empty()) return malformed(std::string(fields[0]) + " after entries");
                if (fields[1].empty()) return malformed("empty " + std::string(fields[0]));
                flag = true;
                (fields[0] == "name" ? pack.displayName : pack.license) = fields[1];
                continue;
            }
            if (fields.size() != 3) return malformed("expected key<TAB>kind<TAB>path");
            if (!hasName || !hasLicense) return malformed("name and license must precede entries");
            if (fields[0].size() != 16 || fields[0].find_first_not_of("0123456789abcdef") != fields[0].npos) return malformed("key must be 16 lowercase hex digits");
            auto kind = std::size_t(std::find(kindNames.begin(), kindNames.end(), fields[1]) - kindNames.begin());
            if (kind == kindNames.size()) return malformed("unknown kind '" + std::string(fields[1]) + "'");
            if (!seen.insert(std::string(fields[0]) + '\t' + std::string(fields[1])).second) return malformed("duplicate key/kind");
            raw.push_back({std::stoull(std::string(fields[0]), nullptr, 16), kind, std::string(fields[2])});
        }
        if (!hasName || !hasLicense) { pack.detail = "pack.txt: missing name or license"; return pack; }
        const auto root = fs::canonical(directory);
        for (const auto& entry : raw) {
            auto reject = [&](const std::string& reason) {
                std::cerr << "kabus22: texture pack " << pack.name << ": " << texture_key_hex(entry.key) << ' ' << kindNames[entry.kind] << ": " << reason << '\n';
            };
            fs::path relative(entry.path);
            if (relative.empty() || relative.is_absolute() || relative.has_root_path()) { reject("path must be relative"); continue; }
            if (std::any_of(relative.begin(), relative.end(), [](const fs::path& part) { return part == ".."; })) { reject("path must not contain '..'"); continue; }
            if (lower(relative.extension().string()) != ".png") { reject("only .png files are accepted"); continue; }
            auto file = fs::canonical(root / relative, ec);
            if (ec) { reject("missing file"); continue; }
            if (!inside(file, root) || file == root) { reject("path escapes pack directory"); continue; }
            if (!fs::is_regular_file(file, ec)) { reject("not a regular file"); continue; }
            if (fs::file_size(file, ec) > maxPng || ec) { reject("file exceeds 64 MiB"); continue; }
            std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t> size;
            try { size = png_header(file); } catch (const std::exception& error) { reject(error.what()); continue; }
            if (!size.first || !size.second || size.first > maxSide || size.second > maxSide) { reject("dimensions outside 1..8192"); continue; }
            pack.entries[entry.key][entry.kind] = PackFile{file, size.first, size.second};
        }
        for (auto it = pack.entries.begin(); it != pack.entries.end();) {
            const PackFile* first = nullptr; bool mismatch = false;
            for (const auto& file : it->second) if (file) { if (!first) first = &*file; else mismatch |= file->width != first->width || file->height != first->height; }
            if (!first || mismatch) {
                if (mismatch) std::cerr << "kabus22: texture pack " << pack.name << ": " << texture_key_hex(it->first) << ": kinds have different dimensions\n";
                it = pack.entries.erase(it);
            } else ++it;
        }
        pack.valid = !pack.entries.empty();
        pack.detail = pack.valid ? std::to_string(pack.entries.size()) + " textures" : "no usable entries";
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        pack.valid = false; pack.entries.clear();
        pack.detail = error.what();
    }
    return pack;
}

std::vector<TexturePack> discover_texture_packs() {
    std::vector<TexturePack> packs;
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto root = texture_pack_root();
    if (!fs::is_directory(root, ec)) return packs;
    std::vector<fs::path> directories;
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(root, ec))
        if (!entry.is_symlink(ec) && entry.is_directory(ec)) directories.push_back(entry.path());
    std::sort(directories.begin(), directories.end(), [](const fs::path& a, const fs::path& b) { return a.filename() < b.filename(); });
    for (const auto& directory : directories) packs.push_back(load_texture_pack(directory));
    return packs;
}

TexturePackSet::TexturePackSet(std::vector<TexturePack> packs) : packs_(std::move(packs)) {}

std::optional<PackTexture> TexturePackSet::find(const Image& original) const {
    if (!valid_image(original)) return std::nullopt;
    const auto key = texture_key(original);
    if (rejected_.contains(key)) return std::nullopt;
    for (const auto& pack : packs_) {
        auto found = pack.entries.find(key);
        if (found == pack.entries.end()) continue;
        auto reject = [&](const std::string& reason) {
            std::cerr << "kabus22: texture pack " << pack.name << ": " << texture_key_hex(key) << ": " << reason << '\n';
            rejected_[key] = true;
            return std::nullopt;
        };
        const auto& files = found->second;
        const auto& first = *std::find_if(files.begin(), files.end(), [](const auto& file) { return file.has_value(); });
        const std::uint32_t scale = first->width / original.width;
        if (first->width % original.width || (scale != 1 && scale != 2 && scale != 4 && scale != 8) || first->height != std::uint64_t(original.height) * scale)
            return reject(std::to_string(first->width) + "x" + std::to_string(first->height) + " is not 1/2/4/8 x " +
                          std::to_string(original.width) + "x" + std::to_string(original.height));
        std::array<std::optional<Image>, 5> images;
        for (std::size_t kind = 0; kind < files.size(); ++kind) {
            if (!files[kind]) continue;
            try {
                images[kind] = decode_png(read_file(files[kind]->path, maxPng));
                if (images[kind]->width != files[kind]->width || images[kind]->height != files[kind]->height) throw std::runtime_error("decoded size differs from PNG header");
            } catch (const std::exception& error) { return reject(std::string(kindNames[kind]) + ": " + error.what()); }
        }
        PackTexture result;
        result.scale = scale;
        if (auto& albedo = images[std::size_t(PackKind::Albedo)]) {
            albedo->sourceDepth = original.sourceDepth; albedo->nativeStorageBytes = original.nativeStorageBytes; albedo->nativeTextureAlpha = original.nativeTextureAlpha;
            result.albedo = std::make_shared<const Image>(std::move(*albedo));
        }
        if (auto& normal = images[std::size_t(PackKind::Normal)]) {
            for (std::size_t i = 3; i < normal->rgba.size(); i += 4) normal->rgba[i] = 255;
            result.normal = std::make_shared<const Image>(std::move(*normal));
        }
        const auto& ao = images[std::size_t(PackKind::AO)], &roughness = images[std::size_t(PackKind::Roughness)], &metallic = images[std::size_t(PackKind::Metallic)];
        result.ao = ao.has_value(); result.roughness = roughness.has_value(); result.metallic = metallic.has_value();
        if (result.ao || result.roughness || result.metallic) {
            Image orm{first->width, first->height, std::vector<std::uint8_t>(std::size_t(first->width) * first->height * 4)};
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < orm.rgba.size(); i += 4) {
                orm.rgba[i] = ao ? ao->rgba[i] : 255;
                orm.rgba[i + 1] = roughness ? roughness->rgba[i] : 255;
                orm.rgba[i + 2] = metallic ? metallic->rgba[i] : 0;
                orm.rgba[i + 3] = 255;
            }
            result.orm = std::make_shared<const Image>(std::move(orm));
        }
        return result;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::size_t dump_textures(const fs::path& data, bool bonus, const fs::path& output) {
    const auto dataRoot = fs::canonical(data);
    if (inside(fs::weakly_canonical(fs::absolute(output)), dataRoot)) throw std::runtime_error("dump output must not be inside the game data directory");
    fs::create_directories(output);
    const auto outputRoot = fs::canonical(output);
    if (inside(outputRoot, dataRoot)) throw std::runtime_error("dump output must not be inside the game data directory");
    Assets assets(data, bonus);
    if (bonus) assets.mount("K22_mode.wrs");
    else for (auto name : {"K22Widescreen.wrs", "K22.wrs", "Kaynak.k22"}) if (assets.contains(name)) assets.mount(name); // Same first-mounted-wins order as native/main.cpp.
    assets.initialize_native_lightmap_tables(102400, false, true);
    assets.set_native_alpha_depth(32);
    struct Row { std::uint32_t width, height; std::string category, source; };
    std::map<std::uint64_t, Row> rows;
    auto add = [&](const Image* image, std::string_view category, const std::string& source) {
        if (!image) return;
        try {
            auto key = texture_key(*image);
            if (rows.contains(key)) return;
            write_file(outputRoot / (texture_key_hex(key) + ".png"), encode_png(*image));
            rows.emplace(key, Row{image->width, image->height, std::string(category), source});
        } catch (const std::exception& error) { std::cerr << "kabus22: dump: skipping " << source << ": " << error.what() << '\n'; }
    };
    auto extension = [](const std::string& name) { auto dot = name.rfind('.'); return dot == name.npos ? std::string{} : name.substr(dot); };
    const auto names = assets.names();
    std::unordered_set<std::string> spriteFiles;
    for (const auto& name : names) {
        const auto ext = extension(name);
        if (ext != ".wmb" && ext != ".mdl" && ext != ".hmp") continue;
        try {
            if (ext == ".wmb") {
                const auto& world = assets.world(name);
                for (const auto& entity : world.entities) if (!entity.file.empty()) spriteFiles.insert(lower(entity.file));
                for (const auto& material : world.mesh.materials)
                    add(material.texture.get(), (material.flags & 15) == 5 ? "sky" : "world", name + ":" + (material.textureName.empty() ? material.name : material.textureName));
            } else {
                const auto& model = assets.model(name);
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < model.materials.size(); ++i) add(model.materials[i].texture.get(), "model", name + ":skin" + std::to_string(i));
            }
        } catch (const std::exception& error) { std::cerr << "kabus22: dump: skipping " << name << ": " << error.what() << '\n'; }
        assets.release_level();
    }
    for (const auto& name : names) {
        const auto ext = extension(name);
        if (ext != ".pcx" && ext != ".tga" && ext != ".bmp" && ext != ".dds") continue;
        try {
            auto image = assets.image_ptr(name);
            add(image.get(), name.find("font") != name.npos ? "font" : spriteFiles.contains(name) ? "sprite" : "ui", name);
            assets.purge_image(name);
        } catch (const std::exception& error) { std::cerr << "kabus22: dump: skipping " << name << ": " << error.what() << '\n'; }
    }
    std::string index;
    for (const auto& [key, row] : rows)
        index += texture_key_hex(key) + '\t' + std::to_string(row.width) + '\t' + std::to_string(row.height) + '\t' + row.category + '\t' + tsv_utf8(row.source) + '\n';
    write_file(outputRoot / "index.tsv", std::span(reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(index.data()), index.size()));
    return rows.size();
}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace k22 {
// Contract E key: FNV-1a-64 over LE width, LE height, then engine-decoded RGBA8 rows.
std::uint64_t texture_key(const Image&);
std::string texture_key_hex(std::uint64_t);
// Lossless PNG through the existing FFmpeg dependency; any PNG pixel format decodes to RGBA8 top row first.
Image decode_png(std::span<const std::uint8_t>);
std::vector<std::uint8_t> encode_png(const Image&);
// texture_upscale (Vulkan): 2x one original texture, docs/TEXTURE_RESTORATION.md --method auto without AI. <=16 colours:
// Scale2x; else Lanczos-3 + mild unsharp. RGB is resampled after bleeding visible colour into alpha-0 texels; alpha is
// nearest-scaled, so alpha-test coverage is identical at every threshold. wrap: tiling (world) vs edge (model atlas).
Image upscale_texture_2x(const Image&, bool wrap);
enum class PackKind { Albedo, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO };
struct PackFile { std::filesystem::path path; std::uint32_t width{}, height{}; };
struct TexturePack {
    std::string name, displayName, license, detail;
    std::filesystem::path path;
    bool valid{};
    std::unordered_map<std::uint64_t, std::array<std::optional<PackFile>,5>> entries;
};
// Replacement set for one original image. Missing kinds keep originals/defaults:
// albedo original, flat normal, legacy roughness, metallic 0, AO 1.
struct PackTexture {
    std::shared_ptr<const Image> albedo, normal, orm; // orm RGBA: R=AO, G=roughness, B=metallic, A=255.
    bool roughness{}, metallic{}, ao{};
    std::uint32_t scale{1};
};
std::filesystem::path texture_pack_root(); // ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/kabus22/packs
TexturePack load_texture_pack(const std::filesystem::path& directory); // Never throws for pack content; valid=false with detail.
std::vector<TexturePack> discover_texture_packs(); // Every child directory of the root, sorted by directory name.
class TexturePackSet {
public:
    explicit TexturePackSet(std::vector<TexturePack> packs); // Priority order; invalid packs rejected by caller.
    // First pack containing the key provides every kind; decoded lazily, invalid entries logged once and ignored.
    std::optional<PackTexture> find(const Image& original) const;
    const std::vector<TexturePack>& packs() const { return packs_; }
private:
    std::vector<TexturePack> packs_;
    mutable std::unordered_map<std::uint64_t,bool> rejected_;
};
// Contract D --dump-textures: never writes inside data. Returns written texture count.
std::size_t dump_textures(const std::filesystem::path& data, bool bonus, const std::filesystem::path& output);
}
```

`native/vulkan_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vulkan_loader.hpp"
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
namespace k22::vk22 {
namespace api {
#define K22_DEFINE_VULKAN(name) PFN_##name name{};
K22_VULKAN_FUNCTIONS(K22_DEFINE_VULKAN)
#undef K22_DEFINE_VULKAN
}
void load_vulkan(){
    // The loader remains resident while SDL and any Vulkan device can use it.
    static void* library=[] {
        void* handle=dlopen("libvulkan.so.1",RTLD_NOW|RTLD_LOCAL);
        if(!handle)throw std::runtime_error(std::string("Explicit Vulkan renderer requires host libvulkan.so.1: ")+dlerror());
        struct Dispatch {
#define K22_LOCAL_VULKAN(name) PFN_##name name{};
            K22_VULKAN_FUNCTIONS(K22_LOCAL_VULKAN)
#undef K22_LOCAL_VULKAN
        } loaded;
        try {
#define K22_LOAD_VULKAN(name) loaded.name=reinterpret_cast<PFN_##name>(dlsym(handle,#name)); if(!loaded.name)throw std::runtime_error("Host Vulkan loader lacks required entrypoint " #name);
            K22_VULKAN_FUNCTIONS(K22_LOAD_VULKAN)
#undef K22_LOAD_VULKAN
        }catch(...){dlclose(handle);throw;}
        // Publish only a complete immutable dispatch; failed loads leave no dangling pointers.
#define K22_PUBLISH_VULKAN(name) api::name=loaded.name;
        K22_VULKAN_FUNCTIONS(K22_PUBLISH_VULKAN)
#undef K22_PUBLISH_VULKAN
        return handle;
    }();
    (void)library;
}
}
```
