```h
#pragma once
#include <FidelityFX/gpu/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler_resources.h>

/// An enumeration of all the permutations that can be passed to the FSR3 Upscaler algorithm.
///
/// FSR3 Upscaler features are organized through a set of pre-defined compile
/// permutation options that need to be specified. Which shader blob
/// is returned for pipeline creation will be determined by what combination
/// of shader permutations are enabled.
///
/// @ingroup FSR3Upscaler
typedef enum Fs3UpscalerShaderPermutationOptions
{
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_USE_LANCZOS_TYPE       = (1 << 0),  ///< Off means reference, On means LUT
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_HDR_COLOR_INPUT        = (1 << 1),  ///< Enables the HDR code path
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_LOW_RES_MOTION_VECTORS = (1 << 2),  ///< Indicates low resolution motion vectors provided
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_JITTER_MOTION_VECTORS  = (1 << 3),  ///< Indicates motion vectors were generated with jitter
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_DEPTH_INVERTED         = (1 << 4),  ///< Indicates input resources were generated with inverted depth
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_ENABLE_SHARPENING      = (1 << 5),  ///< Enables a supplementary sharpening pass
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_FORCE_WAVE64           = (1 << 6),  ///< doesn't map to a define, selects different table
    FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_ALLOW_FP16             = (1 << 7),  ///< Enables fast math computations where possible
} Fs3UpscalerShaderPermutationOptions;

// Constants for FSR3 Upscaler dispatches. Must be kept in sync with cbFSR3Upscaler in ffx_fsr2_callbacks_hlsl.h
typedef struct Fsr3UpscalerConstants {

    int32_t                     renderSize[2];
    int32_t                     previousFrameRenderSize[2];
    
    int32_t                     upscaleSize[2];
    int32_t                     previousFrameUpscaleSize[2];
    
    int32_t                     maxRenderSize[2];
    int32_t                     maxUpscaleSize[2];

    float                       deviceToViewDepth[4];

    float                       jitterOffset[2];
    float                       previousFrameJitterOffset[2];

    float                       motionVectorScale[2];
    float                       downscaleFactor[2];

    float                       motionVectorJitterCancellation[2];
    float                       tanHalfFOV;
    float                       jitterPhaseCount;

    float                       deltaTime;
    float                       deltaPreExposure;
    float                       viewSpaceToMetersFactor;    
    float                       frameIndex;

    float                       velocityFactor;
    float                       reactivenessScale;
    float                       shadingChangeScale;
    float                       accumulationAddedPerFrame;
    float                       minDisocclusionAccumulation;
} Fsr3UpscalerConstants;

struct FfxFsr3UpscalerContextDescription;
struct FfxDeviceCapabilities;
struct FfxPipelineState;

// FfxFsr3UpscalerContext_Private
// The private implementation of the FSR3 Upscaler context.
typedef struct FfxFsr3UpscalerContext_Private {

    FfxFsr3UpscalerContextDescription   contextDescription;
    FfxUInt32                           effectContextId;
    Fsr3UpscalerConstants               constants;
    FfxDevice                           device;
    FfxDeviceCapabilities               deviceCapabilities;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelinePrepareInputs;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelinePrepareReactivity;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineShadingChange;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineAccumulate;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineAccumulateSharpen;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineRCAS;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineLumaPyramid;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineGenerateReactive;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineTcrAutogenerate;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineShadingChangePyramid;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineLumaInstability;
    FfxPipelineState                    pipelineDebugView;
    FfxConstantBuffer                   constantBuffers[FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_CONSTANTBUFFER_COUNT];

    // 2 arrays of resources, as e.g. FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_RESOURCE_IDENTIFIER_LOCK_STATUS will use different resources when bound as SRV vs when bound as UAV
    FfxResourceInternal                 srvResources[FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_RESOURCE_IDENTIFIER_COUNT];
    FfxResourceInternal                 uavResources[FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_RESOURCE_IDENTIFIER_COUNT];

    bool                                firstExecution;
    uint32_t                            resourceFrameIndex;
    float                               previousJitterOffset[2];
    float                               preExposure;
    float                               previousFramePreExposure;

} FfxFsr3UpscalerContext_Private;

// declare fsr3UpscalerCreate so it can be used from fsr3
FFX_API FfxErrorCode fsr3UpscalerCreate(FfxFsr3UpscalerContext_Private* context, const FfxFsr3UpscalerContextDescription* contextDescription);
```

```cpp
// This file is part of the FidelityFX SDK.

// Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
// of this software and associated documentation files(the "Software"), to deal
// in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
// to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and /or sell
// copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
// furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions :
//

// all copies or substantial portions of the Software.
//
// THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
// IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
// FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE

// THE SOFTWARE.

#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_assert.h>
#include <stdlib.h>  // for malloc()

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#include <windows.h>  // required for OutputDebugString()
#include <stdio.h>    // required for sprintf_s
#endif                // #ifndef _WIN32

static FfxAssertCallback s_assertCallback;

// set the printing callback function
void ffxAssertSetPrintingCallback(FfxAssertCallback callback)
{
    s_assertCallback = callback;
    return;
}

// implementation of assert reporting
bool ffxAssertReport(const char* file, int32_t line, const char* condition, const char* message)
{
    if (!file) {

        return true;
    }

#ifdef _WIN32
    // form the final assertion string and output to the TTY.
    const size_t bufferSize = snprintf(NULL, 0, "%s(%d): ASSERTION FAILED. %s\n", file, line, message ? message : condition) + 1;
    char*        tempBuf    = (char*)malloc(bufferSize);
    if (!tempBuf) {

        return true;
    }

    if (!message) {
        sprintf_s(tempBuf, bufferSize, "%s(%d): ASSERTION FAILED. %s\n", file, line, condition);
    } else {
        sprintf_s(tempBuf, bufferSize, "%s(%d): ASSERTION FAILED. %s\n", file, line, message);
    }

    if (!s_assertCallback) {
        OutputDebugStringA(tempBuf);
    } else {
        s_assertCallback(tempBuf);
    }

    // free the buffer.
    free(tempBuf);

#else
    FFX_UNUSED(line);
    FFX_UNUSED(condition);
    FFX_UNUSED(message);
#endif

    return true;
}
```

```cpp
#include "ffx_breadcrumbs_list.h"

void* ffxBreadcrumbsAppendList(void* src, size_t currentCount, size_t elementSize, size_t appendCount, FfxAllocationCallbacks* callbacks)
{
    FFX_ASSERT(src ? currentCount > 0 : currentCount == 0);

    void* dst = callbacks->fpRealloc(src, elementSize * (currentCount + appendCount));
    FFX_ASSERT(dst);

    return dst;
}

void* ffxBreadcrumbsPopList(void* src, size_t newCount, size_t elementSize, FfxAllocationCallbacks* callbacks)
{
    FFX_ASSERT(src);

    void* dst = nullptr;
    if (newCount > 0)
    {
        dst = callbacks->fpRealloc(src, elementSize * newCount);
        FFX_ASSERT(dst);
    }
    else
        callbacks->fpFree(src);

    return dst;
}
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>      // sprintf_s
#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_assert.h>

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, str)                                  \
    do                                                                                   \
    {                                                                                    \
        buff = (char*)ffxBreadcrumbsAppendList(buff, count, 1, sizeof(str) - 1, allocs); \
        memcpy(buff + count, str, sizeof(str) - 1);                                      \
        count += sizeof(str) - 1;                                                        \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING_DYNAMIC(buff, count, src)                  \
    do                                                                           \
    {                                                                            \
        const char* _str = src;                                                  \
        const size_t _length = strlen(_str);                                     \
        buff = (char*)ffxBreadcrumbsAppendList(buff, count, 1, _length, allocs); \
        memcpy(buff + count, _str, _length);                                     \
        count += _length;                                                        \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_NUMBER(buff, count, number, maxLength, format)    \
    do                                                                           \
    {                                                                            \
        char _numberStr[maxLength];                                              \
        const size_t _length = sprintf_s(_numberStr, maxLength, format, number); \
        buff = (char*)ffxBreadcrumbsAppendList(buff, count, 1, _length, allocs); \
        memcpy(buff + count, _numberStr, _length);                               \
        count += _length;                                                        \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_UINT(buff, count, number) \
    FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_NUMBER(buff, count, number, 11, "%u")

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_UINT64(buff, count, number) \
    FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_NUMBER(buff, count, number, 21, "%zu")

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_FLOAT(buff, count, number) \
    FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_NUMBER(buff, count, number, 18, "%.3f")

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINTING_INDENT "    "

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_STRING(buff, count, baseStruct, member)                             \
    do                                                                                            \
    {                                                                                             \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINTING_INDENT #member ": "); \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING_DYNAMIC(buff, count, baseStruct.member);                    \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, "\n");                                         \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_UINT(buff, count, baseStruct, member)                               \
    do                                                                                            \
    {                                                                                             \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINTING_INDENT #member ": "); \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_UINT(buff, count, baseStruct.member);                              \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, "\n");                                         \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_UINT64(buff, count, baseStruct, member)                             \
    do                                                                                            \
    {                                                                                             \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINTING_INDENT #member ": "); \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_UINT64(buff, count, baseStruct.member);                            \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, "\n");                                         \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_FLOAT(buff, count, baseStruct, member)                              \
    do                                                                                            \
    {                                                                                             \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINTING_INDENT #member ": "); \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_FLOAT(buff, count, baseStruct.member);                             \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, "\n");                                         \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_BOOL(buff, count, baseStruct, member)                               \
    do                                                                                            \
    {                                                                                             \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINTING_INDENT #member ": "); \
        if (baseStruct.member)                                                                    \
        {                                                                                         \
            FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, "True\n");                                 \
        }                                                                                         \
        else                                                                                      \
        {                                                                                         \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, "False\n");                                    \
        }                                                                                         \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_HEX_NUMBER(buff, count, baseStruct, member, maxLength, format)        \
    do                                                                                              \
    {                                                                                               \
        FFX_BREADCRUMBS_APPEND_STRING(buff, count, FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINTING_INDENT #member ": 0x"); \
        char _hexStr[maxLength];                                                                    \
        const size_t _length = sprintf_s(_hexStr, maxLength, format, baseStruct.member);            \
        buff = (char*)ffxBreadcrumbsAppendList(buff, count, 1, _length + 1, allocs);                \
        memcpy(buff + count, _hexStr, _length);                                                     \
        count += _length;                                                                           \
        buff[count++] = '\n';                                                                       \
    } while (false)

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_HEX32(buff, count, baseStruct, member) \
    FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_HEX_NUMBER(buff, count, baseStruct, member, 9, "%X")

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_HEX64(buff, count, baseStruct, member) \
    FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_HEX_NUMBER(buff, count, baseStruct, member, 17, "%zX")

#define FFX_BREADCRUMBS_PRINT_HEX_BYTE(buff, count, val)                         \
    do                                                                           \
    {                                                                            \
        buff = (char*)ffxBreadcrumbsAppendList(buff, count, 1, 2, allocs);       \
        buff[count++] = (char)((val >> 4) + ((val >> 4) >= 10 ? '7' : '0'));     \
        buff[count++] = (char)((val & 0x0F) + ((val & 0x0F) >= 10 ? '7' : '0')); \
    } while (false)

#if defined(__cplusplus)
```

```cpp
#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_message.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#include <windows.h>  // required for OutputDebugString()
#endif                // #ifdef _WIN32

static ffxMessageCallback s_messageCallback;
static uint32_t s_debugLevel;

// set the printing callback function
void ffxSetPrintMessageCallback(ffxMessageCallback callback, uint32_t debugLevel)
{
    s_messageCallback = callback;
    s_debugLevel = debugLevel;
    return;
}

void ffxPrintMessage(uint32_t type, const wchar_t* message)
{
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!s_messageCallback) {
        // Format the message string
        wchar_t buffer[512];
        if (type == FFX_MESSAGE_TYPE_ERROR) {
            swprintf_s(buffer, 512, L"FSR_API_DEBUG_ERROR: %ls\n", message);
        }
        else if (type == FFX_MESSAGE_TYPE_WARNING) {
            swprintf_s(buffer, 512, L"FSR_API_DEBUG_WARNING: %ls\n", message);
        }
        OutputDebugStringW(buffer);
    } else {
        s_messageCallback(type, message);
    }
#else
    FFX_UNUSED(type);
    FFX_UNUSED(message);
#endif
    return;
}
```

```cpp
    FFX_ASSERT(backendInterface->fpDestroyPipeline);

    backendInterface->fpDestroyPipeline(backendInterface, pipeline, effectContextId);

{
    FFX_ASSERT(backendInterface->fpDestroyResource);

    FfxResourceInternal copyResource;
    copyResource.internalIndex = resource.internalIndex + 1;
    backendInterface->fpDestroyResource(backendInterface, copyResource, effectContextId);
}

void ffxSafeReleaseResource(FfxInterface* backendInterface, FfxResourceInternal resource, FfxUInt32 effectContextId)
{
    FFX_ASSERT(backendInterface->fpDestroyResource);

    backendInterface->fpDestroyResource(backendInterface, resource, effectContextId);
```

`third_party/k22-ffx-posix/k22_ffx_posix.h`:

```h
// Kabus22 (ported from IKV third_party/ikv-ffx-posix): POSIX stand-ins for the MSVC CRT names used by the vendored
// FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 sources, so the upstream files need no portability edits (their bug-fix patches are listed in
// third_party/FidelityFX-SDK/KABUS-PROVENANCE.txt). Force-included (-include) into every FSR translation unit.
// The engine keeps libvulkan optional (dlopen, VK_NO_PROTOTYPES): the SDK's direct vk* calls bind to its dispatch.
#pragma once
#include "vulkan_loader.hpp"
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cwchar>
#include <codecvt>
#include <locale>
#include <string>
#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_util.h>
// wchar_t is 4 bytes here (2 on Windows): FfxFsr3UpscalerContext_Private's resource/pipeline names take 818 KiB, more
// than the upstream 512 KiB opaque FfxFsr3UpscalerContext (ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp static_asserts the fit).
#undef FFX_SDK_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_SIZE
#define FFX_SDK_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_SIZE (1024 * 256)
template<class T,std::size_t N> constexpr std::size_t _countof(T (&)[N]) noexcept {return N;}
inline int wcscpy_s(wchar_t* destination,std::size_t capacity,const wchar_t* source) {
    if(!destination||!capacity)return 22;
    if(!source||std::wcslen(source)>=capacity){destination[0]=L'\0';return 22;}
    std::wcscpy(destination,source);return 0;
}
template<std::size_t N> int wcscpy_s(wchar_t (&destination)[N],const wchar_t* source) {return wcscpy_s(destination,N,source);}
inline int strcpy_s(char* destination,std::size_t capacity,const char* source) {
    if(!destination||!capacity)return 22;
    if(!source||std::strlen(source)>=capacity){destination[0]='\0';return 22;}
    std::strcpy(destination,source);return 0;
}
#define sprintf_s std::snprintf
```

`tools/build_kabus_baseline.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Build, provision exact distro sources, then publish offline using an existing
# tools/Dockerfile.ubuntu24 toolchain image (built with Dockerfile stdin only).
# Only the enumerated source slices enter containers; never mount the repo root.
set -eu

usage() {
    printf '%s\n' 'Usage: build_kabus_baseline.sh WORK_DIRECTORY [TOOLCHAIN_IMAGE]' \
        'Default image: kabus22-ubuntu24-toolchain' \
        'Publishes WORK_DIRECTORY/Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage and its report/source bundle.' \
        'Requires the pinned runtime in build-appimage/cache; existing outputs are never overwritten.'
}
case ${1-} in -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;; esac
if [ "$#" -lt 1 ] || [ "$#" -gt 2 ]; then usage >&2; exit 2; fi
root=$(CDPATH= cd -P -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
mkdir -p -- "$1"
work=$(CDPATH= cd -P -- "$1" && pwd)
case "$root/" in
    "$work/"*) printf '%s\n' 'Work directory must not expose the repository root or its ancestors.' >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
image=${2-kabus22-ubuntu24-toolchain}
# Resolve the tag once: building, source acquisition and publication use one image.
image=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' "$image")
owner=$(id -u):$(id -g)
runtime=$root/build-appimage/cache/uruntime-appimage-squashfs-lite-x86_64
output=$work/Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage
for path in "$root" "$work" "$runtime"; do
    case $path in *,*) printf 'Docker bind paths cannot contain commas: %s\n' "$path" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
done
if [ ! -f "$runtime" ] || [ ! -r "$runtime" ]; then
    printf 'Missing readable pinned AppImage runtime: %s\n' "$runtime" >&2; exit 1
fi
for suffix in '' .json .sources.tar.gz; do
    if [ -e "$output$suffix" ] || [ -L "$output$suffix" ]; then
        printf 'Refusing to overwrite: %s\n' "$output$suffix" >&2; exit 1
    fi
done
mkdir -p -- "$work/cache" "$work/sources"

container() {
    network=$1
    shift
    # POSIX positional parameters preserve paths and command arguments without eval.
    docker run --rm --pull=never --platform=linux/amd64 \
        --read-only --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges \
        --user "$owner" --network "$network" \
        --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,mode=1777 --env HOME=/tmp \
        --env CC=/usr/bin/gcc-13 --env CXX=/usr/bin/g++-13 \
        --env 'CFLAGS=-march=x86-64 -mtune=generic' \
        --env 'CXXFLAGS=-march=x86-64 -mtune=generic' \
        --workdir /work \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$work,dst=/work" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$root/CMakeLists.txt,dst=/src/CMakeLists.txt,readonly" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$root/native,dst=/src/native,readonly" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$root/installer,dst=/src/installer,readonly" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$root/cmake,dst=/src/cmake,readonly" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$root/third_party,dst=/src/third_party,readonly" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$root/tools,dst=/src/tools,readonly" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$root/packaging,dst=/src/packaging,readonly" \
        --mount "type=bind,src=$runtime,dst=/runtime,readonly" \
        "$image" "$@"
}

container none /bin/sh -eu -c '
    for target in engine installer; do
        source=/src
        [ "$target" != installer ] || source=/src/installer
        cmake -S "$source" -B "/work/$target" -G Ninja \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-13 \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-13 \
            "-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-march=x86-64 -mtune=generic" \
            "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-march=x86-64 -mtune=generic" \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH=ON
        cmake --build "/work/$target" --parallel 2
    done'

package() {
    network=$1
    shift
    container "$network" python3 /src/tools/package_kabus_appimage.py \
        --engine /work/engine/kabus22 --installer /work/installer/kabus22-setup \
        --launcher /work/installer/kabus22-launcher \
        --updater /work/installer/kabus22-updater \
        --runtime /runtime --cache /work/cache --source-cache /work/sources \
        --output /work/Kabus22-Linux-Installer-x86_64.AppImage "$@"
}

# SourceAcquisition alone has network access; Publish is always offline.
package bridge --acquire-sources
package none
```

`tools/check_frame_pacing.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check live native CLI frame pacing; requires an existing SDL/OpenGL display.

Usage: python3 tools/check_frame_pacing.py --engine /absolute/path/to/kabus22
Only a generated, asset-free WDL program runs. All files/user directories are
private and temporary. The child must finish exactly 11 frames within 20 seconds.
"""
import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time


# MAIN begins on frame 1. Each wait(1) resumes on the following frame:
# baseline 2,3; cap20 4,5; cap40 6,7; cap0 8,9; cap-10 10,11.
FRAMES = 11
FIXTURE = """var caps[4] = (20,40,0,-10);
function sample(phase, handle) {
    file_var_write(handle, phase);
    file_var_write(handle, FPS_MAX);
    file_var_write(handle, TOTAL_FRAMES);
    file_var_write(handle, TIME_FRAME * 1024);
}
function main() {
    var handle = file_open_write("pacing.txt");
    var phase = 0;
    var i = 0;
    wait(1); sample(-1, handle);
    wait(1); sample(-1, handle);
    while (phase < 4) {
        FPS_MAX = caps[phase];
        i = 0;
        while (i < 2) {
            wait(1);
            sample(phase, handle);
            i += 1;
        }
        phase += 1;
    }
    file_close(handle);
}
"""


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--engine", required=True, type=Path,
                        help="Real graphical native kabus22 executable (not a headless check)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    engine = args.engine.resolve(strict=True)
    require(engine.is_file() and os.access(engine, os.X_OK),
            f"not an executable file: {engine}")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="kabus22-pacing-") as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        for variable in ("HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME",
                         "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"):
            directory = root / variable.lower()
            directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            env[variable] = str(directory)
        data = root / "empty-data"
        data.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        script = root / "pacing.wdl"
        script.write_text(FIXTURE, encoding="ascii")
        argv = [str(engine), "--data", str(data), "--script", str(script),
                "--frames", str(FRAMES)]
        print("argv:", shlex.join(argv), flush=True)
        log = root / "engine.log"
        try:
            started = time.monotonic()
            with log.open("wb") as output:
                child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=output,
                                         stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
                try:
                    child.wait(timeout=20)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
                    raise RuntimeError("graphical child exceeded its hard 20-second deadline") from error
                finally:
                    if child.poll() is None:
                        try:
                            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                        except ProcessLookupError:
                            pass
                        child.wait()
            elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
            require(child.returncode == 0, f"graphical child exited {child.returncode}")
            text = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            require(re.search(r"\bNative frames=11 live_processes=0\b", text),
                    "child did not normally complete exactly 11 frames and its WDL process")
            saves = Path(env["XDG_DATA_HOME"]) / "kabus22"
            words = [int(token) for token in (saves / "pacing.txt").read_text().split()]
            require(len(words) == 40, "expected exactly 40 live pacing sample words")
            records = [words[offset:offset + 4] for offset in range(0, 40, 4)]
            intervals = {}
            for index, (phase, cap, frame, raw_time) in enumerate(records):
                expected_phase = -1 if index < 2 else (index - 2) // 2
                expected_cap = (20, 40, 0, -10)[expected_phase] if index >= 2 else cap
                require(phase == expected_phase and cap == expected_cap and frame == index + 2,
                        f"unexpected live phase/cap/frame record: {records[index]}")
                require(1 <= raw_time <= 16384, f"invalid TIME_FRAME raw word: {raw_time}")
                # TIME_FRAME = 16 * seconds in signed 22.10. WDL multiplication
                # by 1024 writes its raw word exactly, avoiding %.3f rounding.
                intervals.setdefault(phase, []).append(raw_time / 16384)
            for phase, label in ((-1, "baseline"), (0, "FPS_MAX=20"), (1, "FPS_MAX=40"),
                                 (2, "FPS_MAX=0"), (3, "FPS_MAX=-10")):
                print(f"{label}: " + ", ".join(f"{dt * 1000:.3f}ms" for dt in intervals[phase]))
            print(f"normal exit: {FRAMES} frames, wall={elapsed:.3f}s; TIME_FRAME saturates at 1000ms")
            # Allow 2ms for quantization/poll-boundary jitter; oversleep is valid.
            # No narrow upper bound: display refresh and scheduler load vary.
            for phase, floor in ((0, 0.050), (1, 0.025), (2, 1.000), (3, 1.000)):
                require(min(intervals[phase]) >= floor - 0.002,
                        f"phase {phase} ran below its {floor * 1000:g}ms pacing floor")
            if max(intervals[-1]) < 0.024:
                require(min(intervals[1]) < min(intervals[0]) * 0.90,
                        "baseline permits 40fps, but changing FPS_MAX 20→40 did not speed up frames")
                print("dynamic 20→40 speedup checked (baseline permits >40fps)")
            else:
                print("dynamic speedup unexercised: baseline display/load does not prove >40fps; "
                      "both pacing floors and zero/negative clamps checked")
            print("Native graphical frame-pacing checks passed")
        except BaseException:
            if log.exists():
                print("--- graphical child failure log ---", file=sys.stderr)
                print(log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"), file=sys.stderr, end="")
            raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(f"Frame-pacing check failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
```

`tools/check_wrs2.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic WRS2 format, corruption, and extraction-safety checks."""
import io
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tempfile

import wrs2


def rejects(call, errors=(ValueError,)):
    try:
        call()
    except errors:
        return
    raise AssertionError("corrupt or unsafe input was accepted")


def record(name, payload=b"\x07ABC\xee\xf3", size=9):
    raw = bytes(value ^ 0xA5 for value in name.encode("ascii"))
    assert len(raw) < 32
    return raw.ljust(32, b"\0") + struct.pack(">II", len(payload), size) + payload


def main():
    for encoded, expected in ((b"\x07ABC\xee\xf3", b"ABCABCABC"),
                              (b"\x00\x00\x00", b"   ")):
        destination = io.BytesIO()
        assert wrs2.decode_lzss(io.BytesIO(encoded), len(encoded), len(expected), destination) is None
        assert destination.getvalue() == expected
    for encoded, size in ((b"\x01", 1), (b"\x00\xee", 3),
                          (b"\x01A", 2), (b"\x00\x00\x00", 2),
                          (b"\x01A\x00", 1)):
        rejects(lambda: wrs2.decode_lzss(io.BytesIO(encoded), len(encoded), size, io.BytesIO()))
    rejects(lambda: wrs2.decode_lzss(io.BytesIO(b"\x01A"), 3, 1, io.BytesIO()))

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        archive = root / "sample.wrs"
        valid = b"WRS2" + record("folder/a.txt") + record("spaces.txt", b"\0\0\0", 3)
        archive.write_bytes(valid)
        entries = wrs2.index_archive(archive)
        assert [(e.name, e.offset, e.compressed_size, e.output_size) for e in entries] == [
            ("folder/a.txt", 44, 6, 9), ("spaces.txt", 90, 3, 3)]
        output = root / "output"
        assert wrs2.extract_archive(archive, output) == ["folder/a.txt", "spaces.txt"]
        assert (output / "folder/a.txt").read_bytes() == b"ABCABCABC"
        assert (output / "spaces.txt").read_bytes() == b"   "
        selected = root / "selected"
        assert wrs2.extract_archive(archive, selected, ["spaces.txt"]) == ["spaces.txt"]
        assert (selected / "spaces.txt").read_bytes() == b"   "
        assert not (selected / "folder").exists()
        rejects(lambda: wrs2.index_archive(archive, max_output=8))
        rejects(lambda: wrs2.extract_archive(archive, root / "limited", max_output=8))
        rejects(lambda: wrs2.extract_archive(archive, output), (ValueError, OSError))
        assert (output / "folder/a.txt").read_bytes() == b"ABCABCABC"

        outside = root / "outside"
        outside.mkdir()
        linked = root / "linked"
        linked.symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)
        rejects(lambda: wrs2.extract_archive(archive, linked), (ValueError, OSError))
        member_link = root / "member-link"
        member_link.mkdir()
        (member_link / "folder").symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)
        rejects(lambda: wrs2.extract_archive(archive, member_link), (ValueError, OSError))
        assert not list(outside.iterdir())
        file_link = root / "file-link"
        (file_link / "folder").mkdir(parents=True)
        sentinel = root / "sentinel"
        sentinel.write_bytes(b"preserve")
        (file_link / "folder/a.txt").symlink_to(sentinel)
        rejects(lambda: wrs2.extract_archive(archive, file_link), (ValueError, OSError))
        assert sentinel.read_bytes() == b"preserve"

        bad_padding = bytearray(record("a.txt"))
        bad_padding[6] = 1
        malformed = [b"", b"WRS", b"WRS2" + b"\0" * 39,
                     b"WRS2" + record("a.txt")[:-1], b"WRS2" + bad_padding,
                     b"WRS2" + record("A.txt") + record("a.TXT")]
        malformed += [b"WRS2" + record(name) for name in
                      ("/a.txt", "../a.txt", "folder/../a.txt", "C:/a.txt", "C:a.txt", "\\\\host\\a.txt")]
        for data in malformed:
            archive.write_bytes(data)
            rejects(lambda: wrs2.index_archive(archive))
    print("WRS2 checks passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/k22_fsr3_blobs.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the vendored FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 FSR 3.1.4 upscaler GLSL passes with glslangValidator and emit a C++ header
holding the SPIR-V and the descriptor reflection the SDK Vulkan backend expects (replaces the Windows-only FidelityFX_SC).

Only the permutations native/fsr_vk.cpp requests are built: LDR (tone-mapped) colour input x sharpening on/off;
reference Lanczos, low-resolution unjittered motion vectors, non-inverted depth, wave32-or-native, no FP16 (fsr_vk.cpp
clamps the reported device capabilities to match). Compile flags mirror the SDK's CMakeCompileFSR3UpscalerShaders.txt.
Ported from IKV tools/ffx_fsr3_blobs.py (upscaler subset, glslangValidator instead of glslc).
"""
import argparse, hashlib, os, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

# Index = order of FfxFsr3UpscalerPass up to DEBUG_VIEW (ACCUMULATE_SHARPEN shares accumulate), then GENERATE_REACTIVE.
PASSES = ["prepare_inputs", "luma_pyramid", "shading_change_pyramid", "shading_change", "prepare_reactivity",
          "luma_instability", "accumulate", "rcas", "debug_view", "autogen_reactive"]
BASE = ["-DFFX_GPU=1", "-DFFX_GLSL=1",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_UPSAMPLE_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=0",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_ACCUMULATE_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=0",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_REPROJECT_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=1",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_POSTPROCESSLOCKSTATUS_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=0",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_UPSAMPLE_USE_LANCZOS_TYPE=2",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_REPROJECT_USE_LANCZOS_TYPE=0",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_LOW_RESOLUTION_MOTION_VECTORS=1",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_JITTERED_MOTION_VECTORS=0",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_INVERTED_DEPTH=0",
        "-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_HDR_COLOR_INPUT=0"]
KINDS = ["cbv", "srv_texture", "uav_texture", "srv_buffer", "uav_buffer", "sampler"]


def reflect(words):
    """Descriptor bindings as {kind: [(set, binding, count, name)]}, classified like the SDK's SPIRV-Reflect use."""
    if words[0] != 0x07230203:
        raise ValueError("not SPIR-V")
    names, deco, member_nonwritable, types, consts, variables, used = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, [], set()
    i = 5
    while i < len(words):
        count, op = words[i] >> 16, words[i] & 0xffff
        a = words[i + 1:i + count]
        if count == 0:
            raise ValueError("bad SPIR-V instruction")
        if op == 5:  # OpName
            names[a[0]] = struct.pack(f"<{len(a) - 1}I", *a[1:]).split(b"\0")[0].decode()
        elif op == 71:  # OpDecorate
            deco.setdefault(a[0], {})[a[1]] = a[2] if len(a) > 2 else True
        elif op == 72 and a[2] == 24:  # OpMemberDecorate NonWritable
            member_nonwritable.setdefault(a[0], set()).add(a[1])
        elif op in (25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 32, 5341):
            types[a[0]] = (op, a[1:])
        elif op == 43:  # OpConstant
            consts[a[1]] = a[2]
        elif op == 59:  # OpVariable
            variables.append((a[1], a[0], a[2]))
        elif op not in (5, 6, 15, 71, 72):  # any other operand use counts as static use (names/decorations/entry point do not)
            used.update(a)
        i += count
    out = {k: [] for k in KINDS}
    for var, ptr, storage in variables:
        d = deco.get(var, {})
        if 33 not in d or var not in used:  # unused declarations (e.g. rw_output_autocomposition) are not bound
            continue
        pointee = types[ptr][1][1]
        n = 1
        while types[pointee][0] in (28, 29):
            if types[pointee][0] == 29:
                raise ValueError("runtime descriptor arrays are unsupported")
            n *= consts[types[pointee][1][1]]
            pointee = types[pointee][1][0]
        op, operands = types[pointee]
        name = names.get(var) or names.get(pointee, "")
        if storage == 0:  # UniformConstant
            if op == 25 and operands[1] != 5:
                kind = "srv_texture" if operands[5] == 1 else "uav_texture"
            elif op == 26:
                kind = "sampler"
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"unsupported resource type for {name}")
        elif storage in (2, 12) and op == 30:
            sdeco = deco.get(pointee, {})
            if storage == 2 and 2 in sdeco:
                kind = "cbv"
            else:
                readonly = 24 in d or len(member_nonwritable.get(pointee, ())) == len(operands)
                kind = "srv_buffer" if readonly else "uav_buffer"
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"unsupported storage class for {name}")
        out[kind].append((d.get(34, 0), d[33], n, name))
    for k in out:
        out[k].sort()
    return out


def compile_pass(validator, sdk, name, defines, out):
    gpu = os.path.join(sdk, "sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu")
    src = os.path.join(sdk, f"sdk/src/backends/vk/shaders/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler_{name}.glsl")
    result = subprocess.run([validator, "-V", "--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-S", "comp", *defines,
                             f"-I{gpu}", f"-I{os.path.join(gpu, 'fsr3upscaler')}", src, "-o", out],
                            capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"glslangValidator failed for {src}:\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}")
    with open(out, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    return list(struct.unpack(f"<{len(data) // 4}I", data))


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--glslang", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--sdk", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = p.parse_args()
    jobs = [(f"{PASSES[i]}_pass", BASE + [f"-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_APPLY_SHARPENING={s}"])
            for i in range(len(PASSES)) for s in (0, 1)]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp, ThreadPoolExecutor(min(os.cpu_count() or 4, 4)) as pool:
        spirv = list(pool.map(lambda n: compile_pass(args.glslang, args.sdk, *jobs[n], os.path.join(tmp, f"{n}.spv")),
                              range(len(jobs))))
    unique, blob_of = {}, []
    lines = ["// Generated by tools/k22_fsr3_blobs.py from third_party/FidelityFX-SDK (v1.1.4, FSR 3.1.4). Do not edit.",
             "#pragma once", "#include <cstdint>", "namespace k22::ffx_blobs {",
             "struct Reflected {std::uint32_t count;const char** names;const std::uint32_t* bindings;"
             "const std::uint32_t* counts;const std::uint32_t* sets;};",
             "struct Blob {const std::uint32_t* words;std::uint32_t bytes;Reflected " + ",".join(KINDS) + ";};"]
    for words in spirv:
        key = hashlib.sha256(struct.pack(f"<{len(words)}I", *words)).hexdigest()[:16]
        if key not in unique:
            r = reflect(words)
            unique[key] = r
            lines.append(f"inline const std::uint32_t spirv_{key}[]={{" + ",".join(map(str, words)) + "};")
            for kind, entries in r.items():
                if not entries:
                    continue
                lines.append(f"inline const char* names_{key}_{kind}[]={{" + ",".join(f'"{e[3]}"' for e in entries) + "};")
                for field, idx in (("bindings", 1), ("counts", 2), ("sets", 0)):
                    lines.append(f"inline const std::uint32_t {field}_{key}_{kind}[]={{" +
                                 ",".join(str(e[idx]) for e in entries) + "};")
        r = unique[key]
        refl = ",".join(f"{{{len(r[k])},names_{key}_{k},bindings_{key}_{k},counts_{key}_{k},sets_{key}_{k}}}"
                        if r[k] else "{0,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr}" for k in KINDS)
        blob_of.append(f"{{spirv_{key},{len(words) * 4},{refl}}}")
    lines.append("// [pass][sharpen]")
    lines.append(f"inline const Blob blobs[{len(PASSES)}][2]={{")
    for i in range(len(PASSES)):
        lines.append("{" + ",".join(blob_of[i * 2:i * 2 + 2]) + "},")
    lines += ["};", "}"]
    tmp_out = args.output + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp_out, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    os.replace(tmp_out, args.output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

```py
                   "swscale": "7.5.100", "swresample": "4.12.100"}
FFMPEG_LIBRARIES = {"lib" + name + ".so." + version.split(".")[0]: "lib" + name + ".so." + version
                    for name, version in FFMPEG_VERSIONS.items()}
# GPU loaders/drivers and their Wayland protocol ABI are host-owned; glibc is never copied.
# Bundling older Wayland libraries can prevent a newer host ICD from loading.
HOST = re.compile(
    r"(?:ld-linux[^/]*|linux-vdso[^/]*|"
    r"lib(?:c|m|dl|pthread|rt|resolv|util|anl|nss_[^.]+)\.so(?:\.[0-9]+)*|"
    r"lib(?:GL|GLX(?:_[^.]+)?|GLdispatch|OpenGL|EGL(?:_[^.]+)?|GLESv[12]|vulkan(?:_[^.]+)?|drm(?:_[^.]+)?|gbm|"
    r"wayland-(?:client|egl|cursor|server)|"
    r"cuda|nvidia[^.]*|nvoptix|vdpau(?:_[^.]+)?|va(?:-x11|-drm|-wayland)?)\.so(?:\.[0-9]+)*)\Z"
)
```
